rows.output: Ní ṣíṣàkóso Ìgbìmọ̀ Gíga Jù Lọ ti UN, Minisita fún Ìṣòwò Walid al-Moualem tún pè fún àwọn olùwàláàjì Síríà láti padà sílé, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ogun orílẹ̀-èdè náà ti wà fún ọdún mẹ́jọ báyìí.
rows.reference: Ni ibanisọrọ pẹlu Ajọ Apapọ UN, Minisita Ilẹ Okeere Walid al-Moualem tun pe awọn oluwabo ni Syria lati pada wale, bi o tilẹ jẹpe ogun ilu naa wa ni ọdun kẹjọ rẹ.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, ẹni tí ó tún jẹ́ igbakeji aláṣẹ, sọ pé àwọn agbára ilẹ̀ òkeèrè náà wà ní ilẹ̀ Síríà ní àìtọ́, ní orúkọ ìjàkálà fún ìpànìyàn, wọ́n á sì “dá a lọ́wọ́.”
rows.reference: Moualem, ti o tun duro bii igbakeji minisita alakoso pata, sọpe awọn ologun ajeji naa wa ni ori ilẹ Siria ni ọna aitọ, labẹ idinbọn pe wọn n ja lodi si awọn ẹṣin-o-ku, ati “ni a o baja bi o ti tọ.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Wọn gbọ́dọ̀ yọ kúrò lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ àti láìsí àwọn ipò kankan," ó sọ fún àwọn olùkópa náà.
rows.reference: "Wọn gbọdọ kuro lẹsẹkẹsẹ ati laisi idinwọn," o sọ fun ajọ naa.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem sọ pé “ògun lórí ìbàjẹ́ ti fẹ́rẹpẹ́rẹpẹ́” ní Síríà, níbi tí ó lé ní mílíọ̀nù 360 ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti kú láti ọdún 2011, pẹ̀lú mílíọ̀nù mìíràn tí wọ́n ti lé kúrò ní ilé wọn.
rows.reference: Moualem tẹnumọ pe "ogun ilodisi idunkoko mọni ti fẹ pari" ni Siria, nibiti awọn eniyan ti o ju 360,000 ti o ti kú niwon 2011, pẹlu awọn milionu ti o ti ṣi kuro ni ibugbe wọn.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: Ó sọ pé Dàmásíkù yóò tẹ̀síwájú “níjà fún ogun yìí tí ó jẹ́ mímọ́ títí tí a ó fi lépa gbogbo ilẹ̀ Síríà” ti àwọn ẹgbẹ́ méjì náà àti “ẹnikẹ́ni tí kò bá ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti wà ní ilẹ̀ Síríà.”
rows.reference: O sọ pe Damasku yoo tẹsiwaju "ja ogun mimọ yii titi a o fi mu gbogbo agbegbe Siria" kuro ninu awọn ẹgbẹ idunkoko mọni ati "eyikeyi awọn ajoji."

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà ní àwọn ọmọ ogun tó tó 2,000 ní Síríà, ní pàtàkì fún ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti ìtọ́nisọ́nà fún àwọn ọmọ ogun Kúrdì àti àwọn ará Síríà Arabíìkì tí wọ́n tako Ààrẹ Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: Orilẹ ede Amẹrika ni o ni awọn ẹgbẹ ogun 2,000 ni Siria, ti o wa fun didanilẹkọ ati imọran fun awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ ogun Kurdish ati Siria ti o jẹ Arabu lati lodi si Aare Bashar al-Assad.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Faransi ni o ni ju 1,000 ọmọ ogun lọ lórí ilẹ̀ ní orílẹ̀-èdè tí ogun ti bàjẹ́.
rows.reference: Faranse ni o ni ẹgbẹrun ọmọ ogun ni ilẹ ni orilẹ-ede ti ogun ti bajẹ.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: Nípa àwọn olùwà-ibi, Moualem sọ pé àwọn ipò náà dára fún wọn láti padà, ó sì fi ẹ̀sùn kan “àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ìwọ̀ oòrùn kan” fún “títan àwọn ẹ̀rù àìrònú” tí ó mú kí àwọn olùwà-ibi máa dúró síta.
rows.reference: Lori ọrọ awọn oluwa abo nilu miiran, Moualem sọ pe awọn ipo ti o dara wa fun wọn lati pada, o si da "awọn orilẹ-ede iwọ oorun" lẹbi fun "itankale ibẹru aitọ" ti o fa awọn awọn oluwa abo nilu miiran lati ma wale.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "A ti pe agbegbe agbaye ati awọn ajo alaanu lati ṣe iranlọwọ fun awọn ipadabọ wọnyi," o sọ.
rows.reference: "A ti pe awọn orilẹ-ede agbaye ati awọn ajọ iranlọwọ eniyan lati ṣe iranlọwọ fun awọn atunṣe ipada yii,"bi o ti wi.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: Wọ́n ń fi ìṣọ̀kan hàn nípa ohun tí ó yẹ kí ó jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ kan.
rows.reference: Wọn n ti ọrọ oṣelu bọ ohun ti o yẹ ki o jẹ ohun iranlọwọ eniyan.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà àti Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù ti kìlọ̀ pé kò sí ìrànwọ́ ìṣọ̀kan fún Síríà títí tí a kò fi ní ìpinnu òṣèlú láàárín Assad àti àwọn alátakò láti parí ogun náà.
rows.reference: Ilu Amẹrika ati Apapọ Uropu ti kilo wi pe koni si iranwọ atunṣe fun Siria titi di igba ti ifohunṣọkan waye laarin Assad ati alatako lati pari ogun naa.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣojú UN sọ pé àdéhùn tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ wáyé láàárín Rọ́ṣíà àti Tọ́kì láti dá àgbègbè ìdènà sílẹ̀ ní agbègbè tó ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ fún àwọn ọmọ ogun tí wọ́n ń tako, Idlib, ti dá ànfàní sílẹ̀ láti tẹ̀síwájú nínú àwọn ìjíròrò òṣèlú.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju UN sọ pe adehun kan laipe laarin Ruṣia ati Tọki lati ṣeto agbegbe kan ti o ni idaniloju ni igbẹkẹle imuduro ibi gbigba awọn aṣodisi ijọba ti Idlib ti ṣe ìdásílẹ̀ anfani lati tẹsiwaju pẹlu awọn ibara-ẹni-sọrọ awọn oloṣelu.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ Rọ́ṣíà-Tọ́kì náà dá ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ọmọ ogun Rọ́ṣíà tí wọ́n ń ṣètìlẹ́yìn fún ní Síríà sí ìpínlẹ̀ náà, níbi tí àwọn ènìyàn mílíọ̀nù mẹ́ta ń gbé.
rows.reference: Ajọsọ Ruṣia-Tọki ti ṣamukuro ipani nla lọwọ awọn ọmọ ogun Siria ti Ruṣia kin lẹhin ni ipinlẹ naa, nibiti milionu meta eniyan n gbe.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem sì tọ́ka sí pé àdéhùn náà ní “àkókò tí ó mọ́” ó sì sọ ìrètí rẹ̀ pé ìgbèjà náà yóò fojúsùn sí àwọn jihadists, títí kan àwọn ọmọ ogun láti ọ̀dọ̀ ẹgbẹ́ Nusra Front tí ó ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Al-Qaeda, tí “a ó pa run.”
rows.reference: Moualem sọ pe adehun naa ni "awọn akoko ipari" ati pe o ni ireti pe awọn jagunjagun yoo dojuko awọn ajija ẹsin jihadi pẹlu awọn onija lati ẹgbẹ Nusra ti Al-Qaeda, ti wọn yoo "pa kuro."

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Àṣojú UN Staffan de Mistura ń retí láti ṣe ìpàdé àkọ́kọ́ ti ẹgbẹ́ tuntun tí ó ní àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìjọba àti ti ìdàrúdàpọ̀ láti kọ ìwé ìpèníjà fún orílẹ̀-èdè Síríà lẹ́yìn ogun àti láti mú ọ̀nà sílẹ̀ fún ìdìbò.
rows.reference: Aṣoju UN Staffan de Mistura ni ireti lati pe awọn ipade akọkọ ti igbimọ tuntun kan ti o ni ijọba ati awọn ẹgbẹ alatako lati ṣe ipinlẹ ofin fun Siria ati ki o gbe ọna si awọn idibo kalẹ.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem ti ṣe alaye awọn ipilẹṣẹ fun ikopa ijọba Siria ninu igbimọ naa, ti o sọ pe iṣẹ igbimọ naa yoo ni opin si “ati ṣe atunyẹwo awọn nkan ti ofin lọwọlọwọ,” o si kilọ lodi si idiwọ.
rows.reference: Moualem gbekalẹ awọn ipo fun ilọwọsi ti ijọba Siria ninu igbimọ naa, o sọ pe iṣẹ igbimọ naa yẹ ki o wa ni idiwọn "lati ṣe atunyẹwo awọn iwe ti ofin ti o wa lọwọlọwọ," o si kilo lodi si idasi.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Kí ó ṣeé ṣe kí Trump gba ipò kejì ní àkókò yìí
rows.reference: Idi ti Trump yoo fi wọle ẹlẹkeji

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: Nípa ìmúlò ìmúlò yẹn, Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump yóò ṣẹ́gun ìdìbò ìpadàbọ̀ ní 2020, àyàfi bí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn olùwòran ìlàlàá ṣe lè fẹ́, ìfipápadà àti ìṣòro náà bá parí ìṣípò rẹ̀ ní kùtùkùtù.
rows.reference: Nipa iṣaro naa, Ọgbẹni Trump yoo tun wọle ni 2020 ayafi, bi awọn ọpọlọpọ oluwo ti ni ireti, ile kuro lori alefa ati ẹgan ba parinijẹ arẹ rẹ laipe.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: Ní ohun tí ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó jẹ́ “Ìparapọ̀ tó ṣeé ṣe jùlọ nínú ìjọ̀ba lailai!”
rows.reference: Ninu ohun ti ko ni iyemeji "Ipari julọ ti o jẹ ti arẹ kan laelae!"

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: Ni akoko yii, ko si ami ti rirẹ ti oluwo.
rows.reference: Ni bayii, kosi aami isuni oluworan.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: Lati ọdun 2014, awọn owo-ori akoko akoko ti pọ si diẹ sii ju miliọnu 1.05 lọ ni CNN ati nipa igba mẹta si miliọnu 1.6 ni MSNBC.
rows.reference: Lati ọdun 2014, awọn oṣuwọn akoko ni diẹ ju ilọpo meji si 1.05 milionu ni CNN ati pe o fẹrẹ di mẹta si 1.6 milionu ni MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: Ìròyìn Fox ní àwọn olùwòran 2.4 mílíọ̀nù ní àkókò ìrọ̀lè, tó pọ̀ sí i ju 1.7 mílíọ̀nù lọ ní ọdún mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn, gẹ́gẹ́ bí Nẹ́lísọ̀n ṣe sọ, àti pé MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" ti ṣe àtọkànwá àwọn ìwọ̀n kábìlì pẹ̀lú bíi 3.5 mílíọ̀nù àwọn olùwòran ní àwọn alẹ́ pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Iroyin Fox ni o ni awọn oluwo ti awọn akoko bi 2.4 milionu, lati ori 1.7 milionu ni ọdun mẹrin sẹyin, ni ibamu si Nielsen, ati MSNBC "Iṣafihan Rakeli Maddow" ti wa loke aworan kebu pẹlu ọpọlọpọ awọn oluwo 3.5 million lori awọn iroyin pataki.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Èyí jẹ́ iná tí àwọn ènìyàn ń fà sí i nítorí pé kìí ṣe nǹkan tí a lè lóye," ni Neal Baer sọ, olùdarí eré tẹlifíṣọ̀n ABC "Designated Survivor," nípa akọ̀wé ilé-iṣẹ́ kan tí ó di ààrẹ lẹ́yìn ìkọlù kan tí ó pa ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin run.
rows.reference: "Eyi ni ina ti a ti fa awọn eniyan si nitoripe kiiṣe ohun ti a loye rẹ," ni Neal Baer sọ, olufihan ti ere ABC "Aṣoju Onwalaye," nipa akọwe ile-igbimọ kan ti o di arẹ lẹhin ti ikolu kan pa Olu-ilu run.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, onimọran apanilẹrin ati onkọwe ti "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," ni imọran miiran.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, gbajugbaja onkọwe apanilẹrin ati onkọwe "Ẹya ti o Pani Lẹrin: Ati Awọn Otitọ Diẹ Nipa Yiyọ wọ Ẹgbẹ Ọmọkùnrin Hollywood "," ni tiọri miiran.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ó rántí ìrìnkiri ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ kan ní Boston ṣáájú ìdìbò 2016.
rows.reference: O ranti ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ kan ti o nlo ni Boston ṣaaju idibo ọdun 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Ọkùnrín náà sọ fún un pé òun yóò dibo fún Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump.
rows.reference: Awakọ naa sọ fun un pe oun yoo dibo fun Ọgbẹni Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Kínni? ó béèrè.
rows.reference: Kí nìdí? o beere.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé, “Nítorí pé ó máa ń jẹ́ kí n rẹ́rìn-ín,” ni Ms. Scovell sọ fún mi.
rows.reference: “O sọ pe, “Nitori pe o n mu mi rẹrin,”” Ms. Scovell sọ fun mi.

rows.source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
rows.output: Ìdánilójú wà nínú ìdàrúdàpọ̀.
rows.reference: Ohun idanilaraya wa ninu Idarudapọ naa.

rows.source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
rows.output: Dájúdájú, kò dọ́gba pẹ̀lú ohunkóhun mìíràn lórí tẹlifíṣọ̀n, àwọn ìtàn tó ń bọ̀ láti Washington lè pinnu ọjọ́ iwájú Roe v. Wade, bóyá àwọn ìdílé aṣikiri lè tún pọ̀ jọ, àti ìlera ètò ọrọ̀ ajé àgbáyé.
rows.reference: Dajudaju, yatọsi ohun miiran lori TV, awọn itan ti o n jade lati Washington le pinnu ọjọ iwaju ti Roe v. Wade, boya awọn idile aṣikiri le tun darapọ ati ilera ọrọ aje agbaye.

rows.source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
rows.output: Ìdàrúdàpọ̀ jẹ́ ohun kan tí àwọn olùwòran tó ní ànfàní nìkan lè lè ṣe.
rows.reference: Iyijade jẹ ohun iyebiye ti awọn oluworan alanfaani kan leni.

rows.source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.output: Àti pé, ó kọjá ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ aráàlú nígbà tí o bá rí ara rẹ̀ ní wákàtí mẹ́fà tí o ń wo ìpàdé àwọn amoyé tí ń jíròrò nípa lílo “ìpìlẹ̀ jinlẹ̀” Bob Woodward fún ìwé rẹ̀ “Ìbínú,” jakẹ́ẹ̀tì ostrich $15,000 Paul Manafort (“aṣọ́ kan tí ó kún fún ìbínú,” Washington Post sọ) àti àwọn ìtànkálẹ̀ tí Stormy Daniels ṣe nípa, um, anatomy Mr. Trump.
rows.reference: Sibẹ, o kọja nini oye gẹgẹbi ọmọ onilu nigba ti o ba ba ara rẹ ni ipo wiwo igbimọ ariyanjiyan awọn oloye nipa Bob Woodward ti o lo “ẹkunrẹrẹ ipinlẹ” fun iwe rẹ "Iberu," Paul Manafort $ 15.000 ostrich-leather bomber jaketi ("Aṣọ ti o nipọn pẹlu hubris," Ti Ifiweranṣẹ Washington sọ) ati awọn iṣokunfa ti Stormy Daniels ti ṣe alaye ti Ọgbẹni Trump, um, ẹkọ ẹya ara.

rows.source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
rows.output: Mo, fún ọ̀kan, kò ní wo Super Mario ní ọ̀nà kan náà mọ́.
rows.reference: Emi, gẹgẹbi ẹnikan, kii yoo wo Super Mario ni ọna kanna mọ.

rows.source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.output: "Apá kan ohun tí ó ń ṣe tí ó sì ń jẹ́ kí ó dàbí eré ìdárayá ni pé ó ń fún ọ ní nǹkan ní gbogbo alẹ́," ni Brent Montgomery, alága ilé-iṣẹ́ Wheelhouse Entertainment àti ẹni tí ó dá "Pawn Stars" sílẹ̀, nípa eré Trump tí ń yí padà àti àwọn ìyípadà ìtàn (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.reference: ”Lara ohun ti o n ṣe ti o fi dabi ẹni pe otitọ ni pe o n fun ọ ni nnkankan ni gbogbo aṣalẹ,” Brent Montgomery ni o sọ bẹẹ, alakoso agba ti Ere Idaraya Wheelhouse ati oluṣẹdati “Pawn Stars,”nipa olukopa iyikiri afihan Trump ati ipinnu yiyi ojoojumọ (nini ija pẹlu N.F.L.,yinyin Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
rows.output: O ko le padanu iṣẹlẹ kan tabi o wa ni ẹhin.
rows.reference: O le fẹ lati padanu ẹpisodu kan aijẹbẹ, wa wa lehin ni.

rows.source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
rows.output: Nígbà tí mo dé Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Fleiss ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí, ó jẹ́ ìwọ̀n 80 ìwọ̀n níta ilé rẹ̀ ní apá ìwọ̀ oòrùn Kauai, ṣùgbọ́n ó wà nínú ilé tí ń wo MSNBC nígbà tí ó ń kọ́ CNN.
rows.reference: Nigba ti mo de ọdọ Arakunrin Fleiss ni ọsẹ yii, o jẹ akoko oorun oni 80 digiri nita ile rẹ ni eti odo ariwa ti Kauai, ṣugbọn n ṣe lo ranju mọ wiwo MSNBC nigba ti o n rẹkọdu CNN.

rows.source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
rows.output: Ó kò lè yọ ara rẹ̀ kúrò, kò sì sí pẹ̀lú Brett Kavanaugh tí ó ń dojú kọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin àti ọjọ́ iwájú Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ tí ó wà nínú ewu.
rows.reference: Kole ya ara rẹ kuro, kiiṣe pẹlu Brett Kavanaugh ti o fẹ kọju ẹgbẹ igbimọ aṣofin ati ọjọ iwaju Ile ẹjọ ti o ṣi wa nibẹ.

rows.source: "I remember when we were doing all those crazy shows back in the day and people said, "This is the beginning of the end of Western civilization,"" Mr. Fleiss told me.
rows.output: "Mo rántí nígbà tí a ń ṣe gbogbo àwọn eré ìdárayá wọ̀nyí tí ó ń fa ìdààmú ní ọjọ́ orí, àwọn ènìyàn sì sọ pé, “Èyí ni ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìparun ti ìwọ̀ oòrùn.”" Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Fleiss sọ fún mi.
rows.reference: "Mo ranti nigba ti a ṣe gbogbo awọn afihan aṣiwere wọnyi latijọ ti awọn eniyan sọ pe,"Eyi ni ibẹrẹ ti opin ọlaju ila oorun, "" Arakunrin Fleiss sọ fun mi.

rows.source: "I thought it was sort of a joke, but it turns out they were right."
rows.output: "Mo rò pé ó jẹ́ irúfẹ́ ẹ̀rín, ṣùgbọ́n ó jẹ́ pé wọ́n tọ́."
rows.reference: "Mo ro pe o jẹ irufẹ yẹyẹ, ṣugbọn o wa jasi otitọ."

rows.source: Amy Chozick, a writer at large for The Times covering business, politics and media, is the author of the memoir "Chasing Hillary."
rows.output: Amy Chozick, onkọwe nla fun The Times ti o n bo iṣowo, iṣelu ati media, ni onkọwe ti iwe-akọọlẹ "Chasing Hillary."
rows.reference: Amy Chozick, onkọwe kan ti o salọ ti nkọ nipa òwò, oṣelu ati awọn midia ni Times, ni onkọwe ti akọsilẹ "Lílé Hillary."

rows.source: Outside money floods into tightest midterm election House races
rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ owó àjèjì ń bọ̀ sí àwọn ìdìbò midterm tó le jù lọ ní ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin
rows.reference: Lati ita ni owo ti maa n ṣan wa fun ere ije ibo Ile ti o le

rows.source: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.
rows.output: Kò ṣeé ṣe kí Pennsylvania 17th rí ìdààmú owó, nítorí ìyípadà àwọn agbègbè ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tí ó fi àwọn méjì tí wọ́n ti wà nípò fún àgọ́ kan náà.
rows.reference: Kiiṣe iyanilẹnu pe Pennsylvania ipo 17th n ri iṣan omi owo, ọpẹ lọwọ apapọ ile igbimọ ẹkun ti o ni awọn oloṣelu ti o tun pada wa lẹẹkeji fun ere ije ijoko kan naa.

rows.source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
rows.output: Ìpínlẹ̀ àdáni yìí tí wọ́n tún ṣe ní àgbègbè ìlú Pittsburg yìí ń fi ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin Rep. Conor Lamb tí ó ṣẹ́gun àtòkọ rẹ̀ nínú ìdìbò àtọkànwá kan ní ìgbà ẹ̀rù.
rows.reference: Eyi laipe ni igberiko ilu ẹkun Pittsburg pits Democrat Aṣoju Conor Lamb - eni ti o gba ijoko rẹ ni agbegbe miiran ni idibo pataki ni igba ojo ti o kọja.

rows.source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
rows.output: Ẹlàǹkà jẹ́ olùdíje lòdì sí alága mìíràn, Olùgbọ́wọ́ Keith Rothfus, tó ń ṣojú agbègbè Pennsylvania 12th àtijọ́, tó ń ṣàkópọ̀ pẹ̀lú agbègbè 17 tuntun.
rows.reference: Lamb n dije pẹlu ẹlomiran, Republikani Keith Rothfus, ti o ṣe aṣoju agbegbe ẹkun Pennsylvania 12th, eyi ti o sunle pupọ pẹlu titun 17th.

rows.source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
rows.output: Àwọn maapu náà tún ṣe lẹ́yìn tí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ Pennsylvania ṣe ìpinnu ní January pé àwọn àgbègbè atijọ́ náà jẹ́ aláìlàáfíà ní ìbamu pẹ̀lú òfin ní ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ àwọn olùfẹ́ranti.
rows.reference: Awọn maapu naa ni atunya lẹhin igbimọ ile-ẹjọ Pennsylvania ti o dajọ ni oṣu kini pe awọn agbegbe atijọ ni ko tọna labẹ ofin ti o si jẹ ojurere fun awọn Republikani.

rows.source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ nínú ọ̀nà tuntun 17th ti fa ìjà owó ìdìbò láàrin àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ìṣọ̀kan pàtàkì, Ẹgbẹ́ Ìṣọ̀kan Ìdìbò Democratic Campaign Congressional (DCCC) àti Ẹgbẹ́ Ìṣọ̀kan Ìdìbò National Republican Campaign (NRCC).
rows.reference: Ere ije ti o wa ni 17th titun ni o ti fi ọwọ kan owo ipolongo ibo laarin awọn ẹgbẹ iṣowo pataki, Igbimọ ti Ipolongo Idibo Ile Aṣofin Democrati (DCCC) ati Igbimọ Ile-iṣẹ ti Ipolongo Idibo National Republikani (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
rows.output: Lamb di orúkọ tí a mọ̀ ní Pennsylvania lẹ́yìn ìborí tó kéré jù lọ nínú ìdìbò pàtàkì kan ní March fún Agbègbè Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin Pennsylvania 18.
rows.reference: Lamb di orukọ olokiki ni Pennsylvania lẹhin ijawebori lọna kiun ni eyi ti ọpọ wo ni ibo oṣu kẹta ninu idibo akanṣe fun Pennsylvania ni 18th Ẹkun Idibo Ile Igbimọ

rows.source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
rows.output: Ìjókòó yẹn ti jẹ́ ti Olùgbọ́wọ́ fún ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún, àti Ààrẹ Donald Trump gba àgbègbè náà ní àwọn àmì 20.
rows.reference: Ijoko yii ni Republikani wa tẹlẹ fun bi ọdun mẹwa, ti Aarẹ Donald Trump jawe bori ni ẹkun rẹ pẹlu ogun koko.

rows.source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
rows.output: Àwọn olùṣàwárí òṣèlú ti fún àwọn Démókràsíìsì ní ẹ̀dá díẹ̀ sílè.
rows.reference: Awọn olumọran nipa oṣelu ti fun Democrati ni ilọwaju diẹ.

rows.source: U.S. Weighed Penalizing El Salvador Over Support for China, Then Backed Off
rows.output: U.S. Ṣe Àwòkọ́ṣe Ìyàwó Lórí El Salvador Nítorínáà Nítorínáà Dàpọ̀
rows.reference: Amẹrika Idiwọn ifiyajẹni El Salvador Nipa Ikilẹhin fun China, Wọn Wa Pehinda

rows.source: Diplomats noted that the Dominican Republic and Panama had already recognized Beijing, with little pushback from Washington.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣojú ìjọba ilẹ̀ Dominican Republic àti Panama ti jẹ́ kí Beijing mọ̀ pé wọ́n jẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè tó ń ṣe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú China, tí Washington kò sì fi ìdààmú kankan hàn.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju ilu ti woye pe Ilẹ Olominira ti Dominican ati Panama ti fontẹlu Beijing, pẹlu ipadasẹhin diẹ lọdọ Washington.

rows.source: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump ní ìpàdé tó gbádùn pẹ̀lú Ààrẹ Juan Carlos Varela ti Panama ní Okudu 2017, ó sì ní ilé ìtàgé kan ní Panama títí tí àwọn alábàáṣiṣẹ́ fi lé àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Trump Organization kúrò.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Trump ni ipade ti o dara pẹlu Aare Juan Carlos Varela ti Panama ni oṣu kẹfa 2017 ati pe o ni otẹẹli ni Panama titi awọn alabaṣiṣẹpọ le ẹgbẹ isakoso Igbimọ Trump jade.

rows.source: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà pinnu láti pe àwọn olórí ìjọba àjèjì padà láti El Salvador, Jamáíkà, àti Panama nípa “àwọn ìpinnu tó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ṣe láti má ṣe mọ̀ Táíwà,” Heather Nauert, agbẹnusọ ilé-iṣẹ́ náà sọ ní ìpàdé kan ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù yìí.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju Ile-iṣẹ Ipinle pinnu lati pe awọn olori Amẹrika ti awọn aṣoju ilu lokeere lati El Salvador, Ilẹ Olominira Dominika ati Panama lori awọn "ipinnu lati ma ṣadamọ Taiwan," Heather Nauert, agbọrọsọ ile-iṣẹ naa, sọ ninu ọrọ kan ni ibẹrẹ osù yii.

rows.source: But penalties were only considered against El Salvador, which received an estimated $140 million in American aid in 2017, including for narcotics controls, development and economic support.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìjìyà ni a kà sí ìdánilójú sí El Salvador, tí ó gba ìdá 140 mílíọ̀nù dọ́là ní ìrànwọ́ ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà ní ọdún 2017, títí kan ìṣòwò òògùn, ìdàgbàsókè, àti àtìlẹyìn ètò ọrọ̀ ajé.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn awọn ijiya ni a kà fun El Salivador nikan, ti o gba iranwọ owo $140milionu Amẹrika ni ọdun 2017, pẹlu fun iṣakoso awọn egbogi oloro, idagbasoke ati atilẹyin aje.

rows.source: The proposed penalties, which included cuts to financial aid and targeted visa restrictions, would have been painful for the Central American country and its high unemployment and murder rates.
rows.output: Àwọn ìjiyà tí a dabaa, tí ó ní àwọn ìdínkù owó ìrànwọ́ àti àwọn ìdènà fisa tí a fojúsùn, yóò ti jẹ́ ìrora fún orílẹ̀-èdè àárín Amẹ́ríkà náà àti àwọn ìṣòro iṣẹ́ tí ó ga àti àwọn ìpànìyàn tí ó ga.
rows.reference: Awọn ijiya ti a pinnu naa, eyi ti o wa pe kosi iranwo owo ati awọn idiwọn ifọwọsi iwe irin-ajo, ibatijẹ irora fun orilẹ-ede Amẹrika Aarin naa ati awọn ainiṣẹ ti o pọ ati awọn ipaniyan ti o ga.

rows.source: As internal meetings progressed, North American and Central American officials postponed a high-level conference focused on security and economic prosperity to follow up a similar gathering last year that was seen as a step forward in efforts to prevent migrants from heading to the United States.
rows.output: Bí àwọn ìpàdé inú ilé ṣe ń lọ, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ilẹ̀ Aṣíá Àríwá àti Àríwá Amẹ́ríkà sun ìpàdé gíga kan tí ó dojú kọ́ ààbò àti ìṣọ̀kan ètò ọrọ̀ ajé láti tẹ̀lé ìpàdé kan náà ní ọdún tó kọjá tí wọ́n rí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìgbésẹ̀ kan tí ó lọ síwájú láti dènà àwọn arìnrìn-àjò láti lọ sí Orílẹ̀-Èdè Amẹ́ríkà.
rows.reference: Bi awọn ipade ti ilọsiwaju ikọkọ ti n lọ lọwọ, Awọn oṣiṣẹ Ariwa Amẹrika ati Amẹrika Aarin ti fi isunsiwaju si apejọ ti o gaju lori aabo ati ọrọ aje lati tẹle iru apejọ kanna ni ọdun to koja ti a ti ri bi igbesẹ siwaju ni awọn igbiyanju lati dena wiwọle awọn arinrin-ajo si Amẹrika.

rows.source: But by mid-September, top administration officials made clear that they wanted the conference to go forward, effectively ending any consideration of penalties for El Salvador.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ní àárín-ọ̀sẹ̀ September, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba tó ga jù lọ fi hàn pé wọ́n fẹ́ kí ìpàdé náà tẹ̀síwájú, ní mímọ̀ pé wọ́n ti parí èyíkéyìí ìmúlò ìjìyà fún El Salvador.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn ni aarin oṣu Kẹsan, awọn olori ile iṣakoso sọ kedere pe wọn fẹ apero naa lati tẹsiwaju, ni fifi opin si ijiya fun El Salivador.

rows.source: Vice President Mike Pence is now slated to address the conference, now scheduled for mid-October, in a signal of the import the administration places on the gathering, the diplomats said.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Mike Pence ni yóò sọ̀rọ̀ sí ìpàdé náà, tí a ti ṣètò fún àárín October, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àmì ìjìnlẹ̀ tí ìjọba fi sí ìpàdé náà, àwọn aṣojú náà sọ.
rows.reference: Igbakeji Aarẹ, Mike Pence ti wa bayi lati ba apejọ sọrọ, eyi ti a ṣeto fun aarin-oṣu kẹwa, ni ifihan pataki ti iṣakoso gbele apejọ naa, awọn aṣoju ni o sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: And the three American envoys quietly returned to El Salvador, Panama and the Dominican Republic with no new tough messages or punishments from Washington.
rows.output: Àti àwọn aṣojú Amẹ́ríkà mẹ́ta náà padà sí El Salvador, Panama àti Dominican Republic ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́, láìsí àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ tuntun tàbí ìjiyà kankan láti Washington.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju Amẹrika mẹta tun pada si El Salvador, Panama ati Ilẹ Olominira Dominican kẹlẹkẹlẹ laisi awọn ifiranṣẹ tabi awọn ijiya titun lati Washington.

rows.source: A White House spokesman for Mr. Bolton declined to comment on the details of the debate that were described by the three American officials, including two diplomats, who agreed to discuss the internal deliberations on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Agbẹnusọ fun Ọfiisi White House ti Ọgbẹni Bolton kọ lati sọ asọye lori awọn alaye ti a ṣe apejuwe ti awọn aṣofin Amẹrika mẹta, pẹlu awọn aṣojú meji, ti wọn gba lati jiroro lori awọn ero inu ile-iṣẹ naa lori ipilẹlẹ ti a ko mọ.
rows.reference: Agbẹnusọ White House kan fun Ọgbẹni Boltonkọ lati ṣe alaye lori awọn ariyanjiyan ti awọn alakoso Amẹrika mẹta ṣe alaye, pẹlu awọn aṣoju meji, ti wọn gba lati jiroro lori awọn igbimọ ti inu ni ibamu si àìdánimọ.

rows.source: Their accounts were corroborated by an outside analyst who is close to the administration and also spoke on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Àwọn ìwífún wọn ni a fọwọ́ sí i nípa olùṣàwárí kan tí ó wà nítòsí ìjọba náà, tí ó sì sọ̀rọ̀ ní ipò àìdánilójú.
rows.reference: Awọn akọọlẹ wọn ni alatupalẹ lati ita kinlẹhin, ẹni ti o sunmọ iṣakoso naa ti o tun sọ ni ipo àìdánimọ.

rows.source: Study History
rows.output: Kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Ìtàn
rows.reference: Ka Itan

rows.source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
rows.output: Ẹ̀yà bàtà tó tẹ̀ lé e lè jẹ́ ìròyìn pàtàkì Robert Mueller lórí bí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump ṣe lè dí ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìd
rows.reference: Bata ti o kan lati mulẹ ni ijabọ lori ida-ofin duro Arakunrin Trump ti agbaninimọran akanṣe Robert Mueller ṣe, eyi ti o ni awọn ẹri ti o rinlẹ ni awujọ.

rows.source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Mueller ni wọ́n sọ pé ó tún ń ṣe ìwádìí bóyá ìpolongo Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump ṣe àjọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Rọ́ṣíà nínú ìkọlù rẹ̀ sí ìdìbò wa.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Mueller tun n ṣewadi boya ipolongo ibo Arakunrin Trump kọlu Rọṣia ni ti ikọlu rẹ si idibo wa.

rows.source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
rows.output: Tí ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin bá yí padà, Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump yóò rí ara rẹ̀ ní ìdájọ́ nínú ara rẹ̀, nígbà tó bá ń gbaradé láti lọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i níwájú àwọn olùdìbò, ó sì lè jẹ́ kí àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ mọ̀ nípa rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bi ayipada ba wa ni ile igbimọ, Arakunrin Trump yoo ri pe oun ni idojukọ nipa ijabọ owo nibẹ, bi o ti tun fẹ ṣe lati dojukọ awọn oludibo, paapaa awọn adajọ ẹgbẹ rẹ.

rows.source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
rows.output: Èyí jẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn àbùkù, tí mo sì kò fẹ́ sọ pé ìṣubú Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump jẹ́ àbùkù - tàbí ti àwọn tó jẹ́ bíi rẹ̀ ní Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Iyẹn jẹ ọpọ boya, emi o wa fẹ sọ pe iṣubu Arakunrin Trump daju – tabi ti ojugba rẹ ni Uropu.

rows.source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
rows.output: Àwọn yíyàn láti ṣe fún gbogbo wa ní ọ̀nà méjèèjì, ní ìlà oòrùn àti ìwọ̀ oòrùn Òkun, yóò ní ipa lórí bí ìpèníjà náà ṣe pọ̀ tó.
rows.reference: Yiyan wa fun gbogbo wa ni oju mejeji ti Okun eyi ti o le sọ bi akitiyan naa ṣe le pẹ to.

rows.source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 1938, awọn ọ̀gágun ará Jámánì ti ṣetán láti ṣe ìdàrúdàpọ̀ lòdì sí Hitler, bí ó bá tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìwọ̀ oòrùn ti kọ̀ láti dúró de wọn, tí wọ́n sì ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún àwọn ará Czechoslovak ní Munich.
rows.reference: Ni 1938, awọn oṣiṣẹ Jamani ṣetan lati gba ijọba lọwọ Hitler, iyẹn bi o jẹpe awọn ila oorun ba ṣodi si ti wọn si kin Czechoslovaks ni Munich lẹhin.

rows.source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
rows.output: A kò ṣàṣeyọrí, a sì pàdánù àǹfààní láti yẹra fún àwọn ọdún tí ó tẹ̀ lé e ti ìwà ipá.
rows.reference: A kuna, a si padanu anfaani lati dẹkun ado olori ọdun naa ti o tẹle.

rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ ìtàn yí padà ní àwọn ibi ìyípadà bẹ́ẹ̀, àti pé ìjìnlẹ̀ ìjọbá ti ń lọ lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ ni a ń yára tàbí a ń dínkù.
rows.reference: Itan wa yika iṣẹlẹ yii, iṣejọba ara ẹni ni o lọsiwaju tabi fa sẹhin.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà ń dojú kọ àwọn ibi ìyípadà wọ̀nyí báyìí.
rows.reference: Awọn Amẹrika wa ni idojukọ asawọ koko yii bayii.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Kí ni a ó ṣe bí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump bá lé Ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n Rod Rosenstein, ẹni tó ń ṣàkóso ìdádúró ìwádìí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Mueller?
rows.reference: Kini ohun ti a o ṣe bi Arakunrin Trump ba da Igbakeji Agbẹjọro Gbogboogbo Rod Rosenstein duro, ẹni ti o n ṣakoso ayanmọ iwaadi Arakunrin Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: Rosenstein ti wa ninu omi gbona lati igba ti iwe iroyin yii royin pe, ni ọdun to kọja, o daba lati fi ẹsun kan aarẹ naa ni ikoko o si sọ asọtẹlẹ nipa pe ko dara fun ipo naa.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ti wa ninu iyọnu lati igba ti akọsilẹ yii ti jabọ pe, lọdun to kọja, o gbohun aarẹ silẹ nikọkọ ti o sọ nip ape oun o peye lati tẹsiwaju lẹnu iṣẹǝ.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Rosenstein sọ pé àkọsílẹ̀ Times náà kò tọ́.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Rosenstein wi pe akọọlẹ Times naa ko koju-oṣuwọn.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: "Báwo ni a ó ṣe fèsì sí ìwádì tí a béèrè fún lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ F.B.I. ti Brett Kavanaugh tí kò péye tàbí tó tọ́ - tàbí tí wọ́n bá yàn án sí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀sùn ìfipá báni lọ́nà ìbálòpọ̀ tí ó ní ìtọ́kasí àti ìtànkálẹ̀ ìtànkálẹ̀?
rows.reference: "Báwo ni a ṣe máa fèsì tí ìwádìí túntun tí F.B.I bèèrè fún lórí Brett Kavanaugh kò bá kún tó tàbí tí ó bá ṣègbè - tàbí tí ìwádìí náà bá ṣàfomọ́ rẹ̀ fún Ilé Ẹjọ́ tó ga jùlọ láìwo bí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìfipabánilòpọ̀ àti ìjẹ́rìí èkè ṣe wúwo sí?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Àti ní gbogbo rẹ̀, ṣé a óo dìbò nínú ìdìbò àárin-ọ̀sẹ̀ fún ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tí yóò mú kí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump jẹ́?
rows.reference: Ní pàtàkì jùlọ, ńjẹ́ a máa ìbò ní ìdìbò tó ń bọ̀ fún Ìlé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tí ó máa mú kí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump tẹ̀lé ìlànà tí òfin là kalẹ̀?

rows.source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
rows.output: Tí a bá kùnà nínú àwọn ìdánwò wọ̀nyí, ìjọbá tiwantiwa yóò wà nínú ìgbà òtútù tó gùn.
rows.reference: Tí a bá kùnà àwọn ìdánwò wọ̀nyẹn, ìjọba àwaarawa máa ní ìfàṣẹ́yìn fún ọjọ́ pípẹ́.

rows.source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n mo gbàgbọ́ pé a kò ní kùnà, nítorí ẹ̀kọ́ tí mo kọ́ ní Prague.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n mo gbàgbọ́ pé a kò ní kùnà, nítorí ẹ̀kọ́ tí mo kọ̀ ní Prague.

rows.source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
rows.output: Ìyá mi jẹ́ Júù Czechoslovak tó ti lé kúrò ní Auschwitz nípa ìjọba Nazi tó ti ń gbé ní ilé àṣòfin mi tẹ́lẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ìyá mi jẹ́ ẹ̀yà Jew ti Czechoslovak tí ìjọba Nazi kannáà t’ó ń ṣojú orílẹ̀ èdè mi ní ìgbà kan lé kúrò sí Auschwitz.

rows.source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
rows.output: Ó wà láàyè, ó sì lọ sí ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà, ó sì fi mí ránṣẹ́ ní ọdún 60 lẹ́yìn náà láti tan iná ìtọ́jú Sabbath lórí tábìlì tí ó ní àmì ìkùnsín.
rows.reference: Ó yè é ó ṣì gbọ̀nà Amẹ́ríkà lọ, ọdún 60 sí ìgbà náà, ó rán mi lọ tàn iná àbẹ́là ọjọ́ ìsinmí lórí tábìlì Suwasitikà náà.

rows.source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
rows.output: Pẹ̀lú èyí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun tí mo ti jẹ́, báwo ni mo ṣe lè má jẹ́ olùgbọ́wọ́ fún ọjọ́ iwájú wa?
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú ìyẹ́n tó jẹ́ ìpilẹ̀ṣẹ̀ mi, báwo ní n kò ṣe ní jẹ́ onírètí ẹ̀dà nípa ọjọ́ iwájú"

rows.source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.output: Norman Eisen, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀jọ̀gbọ́n ní Ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ Brookings, jẹ́ alága fún Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington, ó sì jẹ́ onkọ̀wé ti “The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House.”
rows.reference: Norman Eisen, ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ọ̀gá wa ní ilé ẹ̀kọ́ Brookings, jẹ́ alága fún Ojúṣe àti ìhùwàsí ọmọlúàbí fún Ọmọ onílùú ní Washington tí ó sì jẹ́ òǹkọ̀wé “The Last Palace: Ẹgbẹrun ọdun Inira Uropu ninu Igba aye Marun ati Ile Olokiki Kan.”

rows.source: Rangers' Graham Dorrans optimistic ahead of Rapid Vienna clash
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers' Graham Dorrans ní ìmúdàgbàsọ̀rọ̀ ṣáájú ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú Rapid Vienna
rows.reference: Ireti Rangers Graham Dorrans ṣaaju ikọlu Rapid Vienna

rows.source: Rangers host Rapid Vienna on Thursday, knowing that victory over the Austrians, following the impressive draw in Spain against Villarreal earlier this month, will put them in a strong position to qualify from Group G of the Europa League.
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers ń gbé àwọn Rápídì Vienna lọ́jọ́bọ̀, ní mímọ̀ pé ìṣẹ́gun lórí àwọn ará Austria, lẹ́yìn ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tó ṣe pàtàkì pẹ̀lú Villarreal ní Sípéènì ní oṣù yìí, yóò mú wọn wà ní ipò tó dára láti yọrí sí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti Group G ti Europa League.
rows.reference: Awọn Rangers gbalejo Vidna Rapid ni Ojobo, ti wọn mọ pe iṣẹgun awọn Austrian, lẹhin ọmini ti o ni Spain pẹlu Villarreal ni ibẹẹrẹ oṣu yi, yoo fi wọn si ipo ti o lagbara lati pegede lati Ẹgbẹ G ti Uropa Liigi.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Ìfarapa ìkìlà kan dènà agbábọ́ọ̀lù Graham Dorrans láti ṣe àbùkù àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ ní àkókò yìí títí di ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ 2-2 pẹ̀lú Villarreal ṣùgbọ́n ó gbà pé Rangers lè lo abajade yìí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìpìlẹ̀ láti lọ sí àwọn ohun tó ga jù lọ.
rows.reference: Ipalara orukun ṣe idiwọ fun olugbabọlu aarin Grafield Dorrans lati ṣe ifarahan akọkọ ti titi ti ayo ọmini 2-2 pẹlu Villarreal ṣugbọn o gbagbọ pe Rangers le lo esi naa gẹgẹ bi orisun igunke si awọn ohun ti o tobi julọ.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ó jẹ́ ibi tí ó dára fún wa nítorí Villarreal jẹ́ ẹgbẹ́ tó dára."
rows.reference: "O jẹ koko ti o dara fun wa nitori Villarreal jẹ ẹgbẹ ti o dara," ọmọdun 31 ni o sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: "A lọ sínú eré náà gbàgbọ́ pé a lè gba nǹkan kan, a sì padà pẹ̀lú ìyàwó kan."
rows.reference: "A lọ sinu ere pẹlu igbagbọ pe a le gba nnkankan a si wa pẹlu koko kan.

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Bóyá a lè ti gba wọ́n ní òpin, ṣùgbọ́n, ní gbogbogbòò, ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ni ó ṣeé ṣe.
rows.reference: Boya a le ti gba ni opin ṣugbọn, ni gbogbo rẹ, ọmini jẹ abajade ti o dara kan.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Wọ́n ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n dára jù lọ ní ìdajì àkọ́kọ́, a sì jáde wá ní ìdajì kejì, a sì jẹ́ ẹgbẹ́ tó dára jù.
rows.reference: Wọn dara julọ ni idaji akọkọ ati pe a jade ni idaji keji asi jẹ ẹgbẹ ti o dara ju.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́bọ̀, ìpàdé ẹlèyàmẹyà ńlá kan wà ní Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Lilọsi Ọjọbọ, o jẹ aṣalẹ nla Uropu kan.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: Ní ìrètí, a lè gba àwọn àmì mẹ́ta náà, ṣùgbọ́n yóò jẹ́ eré tó le gan-an nítorí pé wọ́n ní àbájade rere nínú eré tó kọjá, ṣùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú àwọn olùgbọ́ tí ń tẹ̀ lé wa, mo ní ìdánilójú pé a lè tẹ̀síwájú kí a sì gba àbájade rere.
rows.reference: Pẹlu ireti, a le gba awọn oju ami mẹta ṣugbọn eyi yoo jẹ ere alakikanju nitori pe wọn ni abajade rere ni ere ti wọn gba kẹhin ṣugbọn, pẹlu ero lẹhin wa, Mo mọ daju pe a le tẹsiwaju ki a si ni abajade rere.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: Ọdún tó kọjá jẹ́ èyí tó le gan-an, láàárín gbogbo ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìfarapa mi àti àwọn ìyípadà tó wà nínú ẹgbẹ́ náà fúnra rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ìmúláradá wà nípa ibi yìí báyìí.
rows.reference: Ọdun to kọja jẹ eyi ti o le gidigidi, laarin ohun gbogbo ti o ṣẹlẹ pẹlu awọn ifarapa mi ati awọn ayipada ti o wa ni ẹgbẹ funrararẹ ṣugbọn a ni ero ti o dara nipa ibi bayi.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ náà dára, àwọn ọmọkùnrin náà ń gbádùn rẹ̀ gan-an; ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà dára.
rows.reference: Awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ dara ati pe awọn ọmọkunrin n gbadun rẹ; ikẹkọọ dara.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: Ní ìrètí, a lè tẹ̀síwájú báyìí, kí a sì fi àkókò tó kọjá sílẹ̀, kí a sì ṣe àṣeyọrí.”
rows.reference: Pẹlu ireti, a le tẹsiwaju ni bayi, fi akoko to koja sẹhin wa ki a si ṣe aṣeyọri."

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Obinrin n sọnu nitori ẹru ifipamọ igbesẹ wọn
rows.reference: Awọn obinrin o ri oorun sun nitori ẹru owo ifipamọ ifẹhinti

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn olùkópa nínú ìwádìí náà ní òye tó mọ́ nípa bí wọ́n ṣe fẹ́ kí wọ́n tọ́jú, àwọn ènìyàn díẹ̀ ni wọ́n ń bá àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí wọn sọ̀rọ̀ nípa rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ jẹpe o daju pe awọn olukopa iwaadi ni oye ti o ṣe kedere bi wọn ṣe fẹ ki wọn ṣe itọju fun wọn, diẹ ninu awọn eniyan ni o n sọrọ nipa rẹ fun awọn ẹbi wọn.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: Nípa ìdajì àwọn ènìyàn nínú ìwádìí Nàìjírìà sọ pé wọ́n ń bá àwọn alábàáwọ́n wọn sọ̀rọ̀ nípa owó ìtọ́jú pẹ́pẹ́pọ̀.
rows.reference: Idaji awọn eniyan kọọkan ni iwaadi gbogbo orilẹ-ede sọ pe wọn n sọrọ pẹlu awọn ti wọn fẹ nipa iye owo iṣeduro igba pipẹ.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Ní ọ̀dọ́ mẹ́wàá nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún ni wọ́n sọ pé wọ́n ń bá àwọn ọmọ wọn sọ̀rọ̀ nípa rẹ̀.
rows.reference: 10 ninu ida ọgọrun sọ pe wọn sọrọ pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn nipa rẹ.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: "Awọn ènìyàn fẹ́ ọmọ ẹbí kan láti tọ́jú wọn, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò ń ṣe àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ láti ní ìjíròrò náà," ni Holly Snyder, igbakeji ààrẹ ti iṣẹ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìyè ti Nationwide sọ.
rows.reference: "Awọn eniyan fẹ pe ẹbi ni o bikita fun wọn, ṣugbọn wọn ko gbe awọn igbesẹ lati ni ibaraẹnisọrọ naa," Holly Snyder, igbakeji aarẹ ti idabobo okowo orilẹ-ede, sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Ẹ̀yà yìí ni ìbèrè rẹ.
rows.reference: Ibi ti o ti bẹrẹ niyi.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Bá a sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìyàwó àti àwọn ọmọ: O kò lè mú kí ìdílé rẹ̀ ṣètọ́jú rẹ bí o kò bá sọ ohun tí o fẹ́ mọ́ wọn kí àkókò tó tó.
rows.reference: Ba aya/ọkọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ sọrọ: O ko le gbaradi ẹbi rẹ lati pese abojuto ti o ko ba jẹki wọn mọ ero rẹ daradara siwaju ti akoko.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Ṣe iṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú olùtọ́jú rẹ àti ẹbí rẹ láti jíròrò ibi àti bí a ṣe lè gba ìtọ́jú, nítorí àwọn yíyàn wọ̀nyí lè jẹ́ ohun pàtàkì tó ń ṣe àkóbá ìye owó náà.
rows.reference: Ṣiṣe pẹlu agbaninimọran rẹ ati ẹbi rẹ lati jiroro ibi ati bi o ṣe le gba itọju, bi awọn ipinnu wọnyi ṣe le jẹ ipinnu pataki ninu ṣiṣe ipinnu iye owo naa.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
rows.output: Mu olùrànlọ́wọ́ owó rẹ wá: Olùrànlọ́wọ́ owó rẹ lè ràn é lọ́wọ́ láti wá ọ̀nà láti san àwọn owó náà.
rows.reference: Mu agbaninimọran owo rẹ wa: Agbaninimọran rẹ le tun ṣe iranlọwọ fun ọ lati wa ọna lati sanwo awọn inawo naa.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣayan ìnáwọ́ rẹ fún ìtọ́jú pẹ́ jẹ́ ìpèníjà ìtọ́jú pẹ́ kan, ìpèníjà ìyè owó-ọ̀rọ̀ kan láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti bo àwọn owó wọ̀nyí tàbí kí o fi owó rẹ̀ pamọ́ - bí o bá ní owó.
rows.reference: Awọn ipinnu ifowopamọ fun iṣeduro igba pipẹ le pẹlu eto imulo iṣeduro abojuto igba pipẹ, iṣeduro iye owo onibara lati ṣe iranlọwọ lati bo awọn inawo tabi imuduro ọrọ ara rẹ - niwọn igba ti o ba ni owo naa.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Ṣe àwọn ìwé òfin rẹ: Fọwọ́ sowọ́ pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìjà òfin ní ibi tí wọ́n ti ń lọ.
rows.reference: Tọka awọn iwe ofin rẹ: Gbe igbesẹ ogun ofin ni kia.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Gba olutọju ilera kan ki o si fi ẹniti o gbọ́gbọ́ ranṣẹ́ lati ṣe abojuto itọju iṣoogun rẹ ki o si ri daju pe awọn akọṣẹmọṣẹ n tẹle awọn ifẹ rẹ ti o ba jẹ pe o ko le ba sọ̀rọ̀.
rows.reference: Gba ilera totọ kan ni ipo ki iwọ ki o yan eniyan kan ti o gbẹkẹle lati ṣetọju ilera rẹ ati ki o ri pe awọn akọṣẹmọṣẹ tẹle ibamu pẹlu awọn ohun ti o fẹ bi o ko ba le sọrọ.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Pẹlupẹlu, ronu nipa agbara ti o ni fun awọn owo rẹ.
rows.reference: Bakan naa, ronu agbara ti agbẹjọro fun awọn inawo rẹ.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: O máa yan ẹnìkan tí o gbà gbọ́gbọ́ láti ṣe àwọn ìpinnu owó fún ọ, kí o sì ríi dájú pé àwọn àdéhùn rẹ̀ ń san tí o bá di aláìlera.
rows.reference: O yan eniyan ti o fọkantan lati ṣe ipinnu owo fun ọ ati rii daju pe owo rẹ yoo di sisan ti o bani idiwọ.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Maṣe gbàgbé àwọn àlàyé kékeré: Rò pé òbí rẹ̀ àgbà ní ìṣòro ìlera kan tí ó sì ń lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn.
rows.reference: Maṣe gbagbe awọn alaye kekere: Foju inu wo pe obi rẹ agbalagba ni aisan pajawiri ati pe o wa ni ọna ile-iwosan.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Ṣé o lè dáhùn àwọn ìbéèrè nípa àwọn oògùn àti àwọn àfihà?
rows.reference: Ṣe iwọ yoo le dahun awọn ibeere lori awọn oogun ati awọn ikorira ara?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Ṣe àtòkọ àwọn àlàyé náà sínú ètò tí a kọ sílẹ̀ kí o sì ṣetán.
rows.reference: Kọ awọn alaye naa jade ni kikun ki o le gbaradi.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Kii ṣe awọn inawo nikan ni o wa ni ṣiṣẹ, ṣugbọn tani awọn dokita?" beere Martin.
rows.reference: "kiiṣe awọn owo nikan ni a n sọ, ṣugbọn awọn wo ni awọn onisegun?" Martin beere.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: "Kí ni àwọn oògùn náà?"
rows.reference: "Kini awọn oogun naa?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Tani yóò tọ́jú ajá náà?
rows.reference: Tani yoo tọju aja?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: "Ṣe àtòkọ náà ní ìpamọ́."
rows.reference: Ni eto naa ni ibikan.”

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: Ọkùnrin kan ni wọ́n yìnbọn sí ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà pẹ̀lú ìbọn afẹ́fẹ́ ní Ilfracombe
rows.reference: Wọn yinbọn fun ọkunrin kan ni ọpọ igba pẹlu ibọn ojú afẹfẹ ni Ilfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Ọkùnrin kan ni wọ́n ti yìnbọn sí ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà pẹ̀lú ìbọn afẹ́fẹ́ bí ó ti ń rìn lọ sí ilé láti ibi ìgbafẹ́.
rows.reference: Ọkunrin kan ni a ti ta nibọn ni igba pupọ pẹlu ibọn afẹfẹ bi o ti nlọ si ile ni aṣalẹ.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Olùfaragbá, ní ọ̀rùndún mẹ́rin, wà ní agbègbè Oxford Grove ti Ilfracombe, Devon, nígbà tí wọ́n yìnbọn sí àyà, inú àti ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Olufarapa, jẹ ọjọ ori 40, wa ni agbegbe Oxford Grove ti Ilfracombe, Devon, nigba ti wọn ta ibọn laya, inu ati ọwọ.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: Àwọn ọlùpàá ṣàpèjúwe ìfọ́fọ́ náà, tí ó wáyé ní nǹkan bí 02:30 Àárọ̀ Ìwọ̀ Oòrùn, gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìṣe àìmọtótó.”
rows.reference: Awọn ọlọpa ti ṣe apejuwe ibon naa, eyiti o waye ni bii 02:30 BST, gẹgẹbi "leralera".

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Olùfaragbá náà kò rí ẹni tí ó kọlu.
rows.reference: Olufarapa naa kori ẹniṣe ni jamba.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Àwọn ìfarapa rẹ̀ kò lè fa ikú, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sì ti pè fún àwọn ẹlẹ́wọ̀n.
rows.reference: Awọn ipalara rẹ kiiṣe ohun a mu ẹmi lọ ṣugbọn ọlọpa ti pe fun awọn ẹlẹri.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Ìwárìrì ilẹ̀ àti ìjì líle ní Indonesia
rows.reference: Awọn iwariri-ilẹ ati awọn ruru omi ni Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: Ni o kere ju 384 eniyan ni o ti pa nipasẹ ìwárìrì alágbára kan ati ìjì omi ti o kọlu ilu Palu ti Indonesia ni ọjọ Jimọ, awọn alaṣẹ sọ, pẹlu iye ti o ti ku ti o nireti lati pọ si.
rows.reference: O kere ju 384 eniyan ni o ti ku nipasẹ ìṣẹlẹ nla iwariri-ilẹ ati ruru omi ti o kọlu ilu Indonesian ti Palu ni Ọjọ Ẹtì, awọn aṣoju sọ, pẹlu awọn nọmba iku ti a n reti lati pọsi.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: Pẹlu awọn ibaraẹnisọrọ ti o ti wa ni pipa, awọn oṣiṣẹ igbala ko le gba eyikeyi alaye lati Donggala regency, agbegbe ariwa ti Palu ti o sunmọ aarin iwariri 7.5 magnitude.
rows.reference: Pẹlu awọn ibaraẹnisọrọ ti kosi, awọn aṣoju iderun ko ni anfani lati gba alaye eyikeyi lati igberiko Donggala, agbegbe kan ariwa ti Palu ti o sunmọ si ẹgbẹ ti iwariri ti wiwa 7.5.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: Ni Palu, ju 16,000 eniyan ni wọn gbe lọ l'ẹyìn ti ajalu na sele.
rows.reference: Ni Palu, ju 16,000 eniyan ni a gbe kuro lẹhin ajalu ti o ṣẹlẹ.

rows.source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
rows.output: Eyi ni diẹ ninu awọn otitọ pataki nipa Palu ati Donggala, lori erekusu Sulawesi:
rows.reference: Eyi ni awọn ẹri kan nipa Palu ati Donggala, ni erekuṣu ti Sulawesi:

rows.source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
rows.output: Palu ni olú ìlú ìpínlẹ̀ Central Sulawesi, tó wà ní ìparí àfonífojì tó sì wà ní etíkun ìwọ̀ oòrùn ti erékùṣù Sulawesi, pẹ̀lú ìdá 379,800 ènìyàn ní ọdún 2017.
rows.reference: Palu ni olu-ilu ti Aarin ẹkun Sulawesi, ti o wa ni opin orisun omi ti o wa ni etikun ti erekuṣu Sulawesi, pẹlu awọn olugbe ti o to 379,800 ni ọdun 2017.

rows.source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
rows.output: Ìlú náà ń ṣe ayẹyẹ ọjọ́ ìbí 40 ọdún rẹ̀ nígbà tí ìkún omi àti ìkún omi náà kọlu.
rows.reference: Ilu naa n ṣe ayẹyẹ ọdun iranti ogoji rẹ nigbati ilẹ mimi ati rur omi ṣẹlẹ.

rows.source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
rows.output: Donggala jẹ ijọba kan ti o gbooro ju 300 km (180 maili) ti etikun ni ariwa iwọ-oorun ti erekusu Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Donggala jẹ atunṣe kan ti o gun ju 300 km (180 maili) ti etikun ni iha ariwa ti erekuṣu ilu Sulawesi.

rows.source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
rows.output: Ìjọpọ̀ ìjọba, agbègbè ìjọba tí ó kéré ju ìpínlẹ̀ lọ, ní ìdá 299,200 ènìyàn ní ọdún 2017.
rows.reference: Ijọba, agbegbe isakoso ti o wa ni igberiko, ni awọn eniyan to 299,200 ni ọdun 2017.

rows.source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
rows.output: Ìkójá àti iṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀ jẹ́ àwọn ohun èlò pàtàkì ti ètò ọrọ̀ ajé ti ìpínlẹ̀ Sulawesi Àárín, pàápàá ní agbègbè etí òkun ti Donggala.
rows.reference: Ẹja pipa ati iṣẹ ọgbin ni ojulowo iṣẹ ti ọrọ aje agbegbe Sulawesi, paapa ni agbegbe etikun ti Donggala.

rows.source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
rows.output: Ìwakùsà nickel tún ṣe pàtàkì ní ìpínlẹ̀ náà, ṣùgbọ́n ó jẹ́ pàtàkì jùlọ ní Morowali, ní ìhà kejì ìlà oòrùn Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Wiwa alumọni nikẹli tunṣe pataki ni agbegbe naa, ṣugbọn o wa julọ ni Morowali, ni etikun keji ti Sulawesi.̀

rows.source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.output: Palu àti Donggala ti kọlu nipasẹ awọn igbi omi ni ọpọlọpọ igba ni ọdun 100 sẹhin, ni ibamu si Ile-iṣẹ Idena Ajalu Indonesia.
rows.reference: Palu ati Donggala ti ni akọku omi riru ni igba pupọ ninu ọgọrun ọdun ti o ti kọja, ni ibamu si Ijabọ Ajalu Orilẹ-ede ti Indonesia.̀

rows.source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 1938, ìkún omi omi kan pa ọpọlọpọ awọn eniyan ju 200 lọ, o si ba awọn ile ti o ju 1000 lọ ni Donggala.
rows.reference: Ni ọdun 1938, riru omi pa ju eniyan 200 lọ, o si ba ogogorun ile jẹ ni Donggala.

rows.source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
rows.output: Ìjì líle kan tún kọlu ìwọ̀ oòrùn Donggala ní ọdún 1996, ó sì pa mẹ́sàn-án.
rows.reference: Riru omi tun ṣẹlẹ ni ila oorun Donggala ni 1996, o pa eniyan mẹsan.

rows.source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
rows.output: Indonesia wà lórí Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀ Ìpìlẹ̀
rows.reference: Indonesia joko lori Iwọn Ilẹ-oorun ti Ina ti o si maa n ni iriri ilẹ mimi nigbagbogbo.

rows.source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
rows.output: Èyí ni àwọn ìṣàn omi ńlá àti ìṣàn omi ńlá ní àwọn ọdún díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn:
rows.reference: Eyi ni diẹ ninu awọn ilẹ mimi nla ati awọn riru omi ni awọn ọdun diẹ sẹhin:

rows.source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: Ìwárìrì ńlá kan ní etíkun ìwọ̀ oòrùn ti Indonesia ní ìpínlẹ̀ Aceh ní apá àríwá Sumatra ní ọjọ́ 26 Oṣù Kejìlá, ó fa ìkún omi tí ó kọlu orílẹ̀-èdè mẹ́rìnlá, tí ó sì pa ènìyàn 226,000 ní etíkun Òkun India, ju idaji wọn lọ ní Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: Iwariri nla kan ni iha iwọ-oorùn ti agbegbe Aceh ti Indonesia ni ariwa Sumatra ni 26 Oṣu kejila ṣe okunfa riru omi kan ti o kọlu awọn orilẹ-ede 14, o pa awọn eniyan 226,000 ni etikun okun India, ju idaji wọn lọ ni Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.output: 2005: Àwọn ìjì líle kan ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní etíkun ìwọ̀ oòrùn ti Sumatra ní ìparí March àti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ April.
rows.reference: 2005: Ọpọlọpọ awọn iwariri ti o lagbara kọlu iha iwọ-oorùn ti Sumatra ni igbẹhin Oṣu Kẹta ati Oṣu Kẹrin.

rows.source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.output: Ọgọ́rùn-ún ni o kú ní Nias Island, ní etíkun Sumatra.
rows.reference: Ọgọrun eniyan ku ni erekuṣu Nias, ni etikun Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
rows.output: 2006: Ìwọ̀n 6.8 kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní gúúsù Java, erekùṣù tí ó pọ̀ jùlọ ní Indonesia, tí ó fa ìkún omi tí ó fọ́ sí etíkun gúúsù, tí ó sì pa àwọn ènìyàn tó tó 700.
rows.reference: 2006: Iwọn giga 6.8 kọlu iha gusu Java, Orilẹ-ede Indonesia ti o erekuṣu ni o wọpọ julọ, ti o ṣokunfa riru omi kan ti o lọsi etikun gusu, ti o pa awọn eniyan to fere to 700.

rows.source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.output: 2009: Ìjì líle 7.6 kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní nǹkan bí 160 km sí ìwọ̀ oòrùn ìlà oòrùn Padang, olú ìlú Sumatra Ìwọ̀ Oòrùn.
rows.reference: 2009: Iwọn ilẹ mimi 7.6 kọlu ibi ti o sunmọ ilu ti Padang, olu-ilu ti iwọ-oorun agbegbe Sumatra.

rows.source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lùpọ̀ ènìyàn tó lé ní 1,100 ni wọ́n pa.
rows.reference: O ju ẹgbẹrun eniyan ti o ku lọ.

rows.source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
rows.output: 2010: Ìjì líle 7.5 kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn erekùṣù Mentawai, lọ́wọ́ Sumatra, tí ó sì fa ìjì líle tó ga tó 10mèta tí ó bàjẹ́ àwọn abúlé mẹ́ta àti pé ó pa àwọn ènìyàn tó tó 300.
rows.reference: 2010: Iwọn iwariri nla ti 7.5 kan kọlu awọn erekusu Mentawai, niyana Sumatra, ti o fa omi ruru ti o to mita 10 ti o pa ọpọlọpọ awọn abule run ti o ai pa awọn eniyan to 300.

rows.source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
rows.output: 2016: Ìjì líle kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Pidie Jaya ní Aceh, tí ó fa ìparun àti ìdààmú bí àwọn ènìyàn ṣe ranti ìparun tí ìjì líle àti tsunami tó pa ní 2004.
rows.reference: 2016: Ilẹ mimi ti ko jin kọlu agbegbe ijọba Pidie Jaya ni Aceh, o si fa iparun ati ipaya bi awọn eniyan ṣe ranti nipa iparun ti ibanujẹ ati ilẹ mimi ti o lewu ọdun 2004.

rows.source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
rows.output: Kò sí ìjì líle tí a fa ní àkókò yìí, ṣùgbọ́n ju 100 lọ ni wọ́n pa nígbèkùn tí wọ́n ṣubú.
rows.reference: Ko si riru omi ti o ṣẹlẹ ni akoko yii, ṣugbọn ju 100 eniyan ni o ku nipasẹ awọn ile ti o wo lulẹ.

rows.source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
rows.output: 2018: Ìwárìrì ńlá kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Lombok, erékùṣù tó gbajúmọ̀ fún àwọn arìnrìn-àjò, tó sì pa àwọn ènìyàn tó lé ní 500, ní pàtàkì ní apá àríwá erékùṣù náà.
rows.reference: 2018: Awọn ilẹ mimi ti o lapẹrẹ kọlu erekuṣu awọn alejo ti Lombok ni orile-ede Indonesia, ti o si pa ju eniyan 500 lọ, paapaa julọ ni apa ariwa ti erekusu naa.

rows.source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
rows.output: Ìwárìrì náà ba ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé jóná, ó sì fi ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn arìnrìn-àjò sílẹ̀ ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́.
rows.reference: Iwariri run egbegberun awọn ile ti ẹgbẹgbẹrun awọn alejo kosi le kuro nibẹ.

rows.source: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges
rows.output: Ìwà ọ̀daràn tí Sarah Palin jẹ́ ọmọ rẹ̀ tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún mẹ́rìnlélógóje, tí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn ìwà ọ̀daràn tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ìbálòpọ̀.
rows.reference: Agba ọmọ ọkunrin Sarah Palin ni a mu lori ẹsun Iwa Ipa Ilé

rows.source: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.
rows.output: Ìwádì Palin, ọmọ tó tóbi jù lọ ti gómínà Alaska tó ti kọjá àti olùdíje fún ipò igbakeji ààrẹ Sarah Palin, ni wọ́n ti mú fún ẹ̀sùn ìkọlù.
rows.reference: Track Palin, ọmọ akọbi ọkunrin ti gomina tẹlẹ ri ti Alaska ati odije igbakeji aarẹ Sarah Palin, ni wọn mu lori ẹsun ikọluni.

rows.source: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.
rows.output: Palin, 29, ti Wasilla, Alaska, ni wọ́n ti mú nítorínáà pé wọ́n fọwọ́ sí ìwà ọ̀daràn ilé, ìdènà ìrònú nípa ìwà ọ̀daràn ilé, àti ìdènà ìdènà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìwé ìròyìn tí a ṣe ní ọjọ́ Satidee tí Alaska State Troopers ṣe.
rows.reference: Palin, 29, ti Wasilla, Alaska, ni a mu ni idaniloju iwa-ipa abele, ni idajọ pẹlu ijabọ kan ti iwa-ipa abele ati lati tako imuni, ni ibamu si ijabọ kan ti Ipinlẹ Alaska Troopers ti ọjọ Satidee.

rows.source: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìrònú ọlọ́pàá ṣe sọ, nígbà tí obìnrin kan tí ó mọ̀ ọ́ fi ẹ̀rọ ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ọlọ́pàá láti fi ẹ̀sùn kan àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà, ó mú fóònù rẹ̀ kúrò lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Gẹgẹbi ijabọ olopa, nigba ti obirin ajumọgbe kan ti o gbiyanju lati pe awọn olopa lati ṣabọ awọn odaran ti o jẹbi, o gba foonu rẹ lọwọ rẹ.

rows.source: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.
rows.output: Palin ni a fi silẹ ni Mat-Su Pretrial Facility ati pe o wa ni idaduro lori $500 unsecured bond, royin KTUU.
rows.reference: Palin ni a timọ ẹwọn Mat-Su Pretrial ati pe a mu nitori owo bọndi ailailabo ti iye rẹ jẹ $500, KTUU njabọ.

rows.source: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.
rows.output: Ó farahàn ní ilé ẹjọ́ ní ọjọ́ Satide, níbi tí ó ti sọ pé “kò jẹ̀bi, ní ìdánilójú” nígbà tí wọ́n bi í ní ìdáhùn, tí àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ ìròyìn sì ròyìn.
rows.reference: O farahan ni ile-ẹjọ ni Satidee, nibi ti o ti sọ pe "n ko jẹbi, o daju" nigba ti wọn beere ẹbẹ rẹ, nẹtiwọki ni o jabọ.

rows.source: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.
rows.output: Palin dojú kọ́ mẹ́ta nínú àwọn ẹ̀sùn A, èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé ó lè jẹ́ ẹ̀wọ̀n fún ọdún kan àti pé a ó fi $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin ni a fẹsun iwa ibajẹ onipele Kilaasi A kan, eyi ni pe o le wa ni ẹwọn fun ọdun kan ati pe ki o san $250,000 owo itanran.

rows.source: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.output: Ó tún ti fi ẹ̀sùn kan pé ó jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn Klas B, tí ó lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí ó sì lè jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn kan, tí
rows.reference: O tun ti gba ifisun iwa ibajẹ onipele Kilaasi B, eyi ti ijiya rẹ jẹ ẹwọn ọjọ kan ati sisan $2,000 owo itanran.

rows.source: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.
rows.output: Ó ti jẹ́ ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ tí wọ́n ti fi ẹ̀sùn kan Palin.
rows.reference: Kiiṣe igba akọkọ ni awọn ẹsun ọdaràn ti a fi sun si Palin.

rows.source: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.
rows.output: Ni Oṣu kejila ọdun 2017, wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan an pe ó ti kọlu baba rẹ̀, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: Ni osu kejila ọdun 2017, a fi ẹsun kan pe o pa baba rẹ lara, Todd Palin.

rows.source: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.
rows.output: Ìyá rẹ̀, Sarah Palin, pe àwọn ọlọ́pàá láti fi ẹ̀sùn kan ìkìlọ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Iya rẹ, Sarah Palin, pe awọn ọlọpa lati ṣabọ ikọlu yii.

rows.source: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.
rows.output: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà wà lọwọlọwọ ní Ilé ẹjọ́ Alaska fún àwọn ọmọ ogun.
rows.reference: Ọran naa wa ni iwaju ile ẹjọ Olokiki Alaska.

rows.source: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.
rows.output: Ni Oṣu Kini ọdun 2016, wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan an pé ó ń fọ́ ọkàn, ó ń dènà ìrònú nípa ìwà ọ̀daràn, ó sì ní ohun ìjà nígbà tí ó ń mutí.
rows.reference: Ni Oṣu Kini ọdun 2016 o gba ẹsun ikọlu abẹle, ti n tako ijabọ ti iwa-ipa ti abele, ati nini ohun ija oloro lakoko ti o ti mu ọti-lile pẹlu asopọ iṣẹlẹ naa.

rows.source: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.
rows.output: Ẹni tó ń ṣe ìgbéyàwó rẹ̀ ti sọ pé ó fọwọ́ kan òun ní ojú.
rows.reference: Ọrẹbinrin rẹ ti sọ wi pe o fi ọwọ gba oun ni oju.

rows.source: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.
rows.output: Sarah Palin ni awọn ẹgbẹ ọmọ ogun ti bu 2016 fun asopọ rẹ si iwa-ipa ọmọ rẹ si PTSD ti o wa lati iṣẹ rẹ ni Iraq.
rows.reference: Sarah Palin ni awọn olokiki bẹnu atẹ lu ni ọdun 2016 lẹhin ti o so iwa-ipa iwa ọmọ rẹ mọ PTSD ti o waye lati iṣẹ rẹ ni Iraq.

rows.source: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed
rows.output: Ìjì líle ilẹ̀ Indonesia: ọgọ́rùn-ún ni wọ́n pa
rows.reference: ìṣẹlẹ ilẹ mimi riru omi Indonesia: awọn ogogorun ni o ku

rows.source: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.output: O kere ju 384 ènìyàn ni o ti ku leyin ti ilẹ ti n rọ ni erekùṣù Sulawesi ti Indonesia ni ọjọ Jimọ.
rows.reference: O kere ju eniyan 384 lẹhin ti ìṣẹlẹ ilẹ mimi waye ni erekuṣu Indonesia ti Sulawesi ni Ọjọ Ẹtì.

rows.source: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.output: Ìjì líle 7.5-magnitude fa ìkún omi àti pé ó ti bàjẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé.
rows.reference: Iwọn iwariri 7.5-nla ti ilẹ mimi mu omi riru waye ti o si run awọn ẹgbẹrun ile.

rows.source: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.
rows.output: Ẹ̀rù àti àwọn nẹ́tíwọ́kù ìbára-ẹni-sọ̀rọ̀ ti dín kù, àwọn ìṣirò ikú tí a ń retí pé yóò pọ̀ sí i ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
rows.reference: Kosi ina mọna-mọna ati nẹtiwọki ibaraẹnisọrọ ti o si le mu iku pọsi ni awọn ọjọ to nbọ.

rows.source: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
rows.output: Ìwárìrì náà ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ìhà kejì ìlà oòrùn Sulawesi, tí ó wà ní ìlà oòrùn ti olú ìlú Íńdíòní, Jakarta.
rows.reference: ilẹ mimi naa kọlu Aarin Sulawesi ti o wa ni ariwa ti olu-ilu ti Indonesian, Jakarta.

rows.source: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.
rows.output: Àwọn fídíò ń lọ káàkiri lórí àwọn ìkanni ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀ tí ń fi hàn ní àkókò ìpàdé náà.
rows.reference: Awọn fidio n ṣafihan lori midia ti o nfihan akoko ti ikọlu.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.
rows.output: Ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn ènìyàn ló wà fún ayẹyẹ etíkun kan ní ìlú Palu nígbà tí ìjì líle náà kọlu etíkun.
rows.reference: Ọgọrun eniyan ti kojọpọ fun ajọdun apejọ eti okun ni ilu Palu nigba ti omi riru kanlu eti okun.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect
rows.output: Àwọn agbègbè ìjọba apapọ̀ tí ń wá ìjìyà ikú fún olùfọkànsìn ìkọlù ìbàjẹ́ ní ìlú New York.
rows.reference: Awọn agbẹjọro gbogboogbo n wa ijiya iku fun afurasi aṣekupani NYC.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.
rows.output: Àwọn agbègbè ìjọba apapọ̀ ní New York ń wá ìjìyà ikú fún Sayfullo Saipov, ẹni tí a fọ̀kànsí nínú ìkọlù New York City tí ó pa àwọn ènìyàn mẹ́jọ—ìjìyà tí a kò fi ṣe ní ìpínlẹ̀ náà fún ẹ̀sùn ìjọba apapọ̀ láti ọdún 1953.
rows.reference: Awọn agbẹjọro ilu New York n wa ẹbi iku fun Sayfullo Saipov, afurasi aṣekupani ti New York City ti o pa awọn eniyan mẹjọ - -ijiya ti a ko ṣe ni ipinle naa fun idajọ irufin lati 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.
rows.output: Saipov, 30, ni wọn fi ẹsun kan pe o lo ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ ti ile itaja Home Depot lati kọlu ọna keke ti o wa ni ẹ̀gbẹ́ ọna West Side ni Lower Manhattan, ti o n lu awọn aririnajo ati awọn alupupu ni ọna rẹ ni Oṣu Kẹwa.
rows.reference: Saipov, 30, lo ọkọ Akẹru Ile kan ti Ile Depot lati ṣe ikọlu kan lori ọna opopona kẹkẹ Opopoona Apa Iwọ oorun ni Lower Manhattan, ti osi tẹ awọn ẹlẹsẹ ati awa kẹkẹ pa ni oju ọna ni Oṣu Kẹwa.

rows.source: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.output: Láti fi ẹ̀sùn ikú, àwọn olùgbèjà yóò ní láti fi hàn pé Saipov “ní ìfọkànsìn” pa àwọn olùfaragbá mẹ́jọ náà, àti pé “ní ìfọkànsìn” fa ìfarapa tó lágbára, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkìlọ̀ tí wọ́n fi hàn pé wọ́n fẹ́ ẹ̀sùn ikú, tí wọ́n fi sílẹ̀ ní Agbègbè Gúùsù New York.
rows.reference: Lati le ṣe idajọ, awọn agbẹjọro yoo ni lati fi han pe Saipov "mọọmọ" pa awọn eniyan mẹjọ ati "mọọmọ" ṣe ipalara nla, gẹgẹbi akiyesi idiyele lati wa ijiya iku, ti a fiwe si ni Gusu DISTRICT ti New York.

rows.source: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.
rows.output: Mejeeji ninu awọn kaadi wọnyi ni ẹsun ti o le fa iku, gẹgẹ bi iwe ile-ẹjọ ti sọ.
rows.reference: Awọn ẹsun mejeji ni o ni ijiya iku, ni ibamu si iwe ile ẹjọ.

rows.source: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn ọ̀sẹ̀ díẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ìkọlù náà, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìgbìmọ̀ àdúràpọ̀ àpapọ̀ fi ẹ̀sùn 22 kan Saipov, èyí tó ní ìdá mẹ́jọ nínú ẹ̀sùn ìpànìyàn láti ṣèrànwọ́ fún ìwà ọ̀daràn, tí àwọn agbèjọ́pọ̀ àpapọ̀ sábà máa ń lò nínú àwọn ọ̀ràn ìwà ọ̀daràn, àti ẹ̀sùn ìwà ipá àti ìparun ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́.
rows.reference: Awọn ọsẹ lẹhin ti ikolu naa, adajọ gbogboogbo kan fun Saipov ni idajọ 22 kan ti o ni awọn ẹjọ mẹjọ ti ipaniyan ni iranlowo fun ipalara, eyi ti awọn agbẹjọro nlo ni idajọ ni awọn ajọ ọdaràn, ati idiyele iwa-ipa ati iparun ti ọkọ awọn ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ.

rows.source: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."
rows.output: Ìkọlù náà nílò “èto tó pọ̀ àti ìmúra,” gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn olùgbèjà ti sọ, tí wọ́n sì ṣàpèjúwe ọ̀nà tí Saipov gbà ṣe é gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìbínú, ìbínú, àti ìbínú.”
rows.reference: Ipalara naa ni "ipinnu ati iṣeduro pataki," Awọn agbẹjọro sọ bẹẹ, wọn ṣapejuwe ọna ti Saipov gbe gba ṣe gẹgẹbi "oloro, onigbọn ati itiju."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.
rows.output: "Ìfarapa, ìpalára, àti ìpàdánù tí Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov fa sí àwọn ìdílé àti ọ̀rẹ́ Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, àti Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," ìkìlọ̀ náà sọ.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov fa ipalara, ipalara, ati pipadanu si idile ati awọn ọrẹ ti Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, ati Alejandro Damian Pagnucco, "Ifitonileti ti idiyele ni ipinlẹ.

rows.source: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.
rows.output: Mẹ́ta lára ​​àwọn olùfaragbá náà jẹ́ àwọn arìnrìn-àjò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ láti Argentina.
rows.reference: Marun ninu awọn olufaragba jẹ awọn alejo afe-ajo lati Argentina.

rows.source: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.
rows.output: Ó ti pé ọdún mẹ́wàá báyìí tí Ìpínlẹ̀ Gúsù Ìwọ̀ Oòrùn ti New York ti dá ẹjọ́ ẹ̀sùn ikú.
rows.reference: O ti to ọdun mẹwa lati igbati igberiko Gusu ti New York ti ṣe idajọ ẹjọ iku kan.

rows.source: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.output: Ẹni tí ó ń ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́, Khalid Barnes, ni wọ́n dá lọ́wọ́ ìpànìyàn àwọn olùpèsè oògùn méjì, ṣùgbọ́n nígbẹ̀yìngbẹ́yín, wọ́n dá a lọ́wọ́ ìjìyà fún ìyè fún ìgbésí ayé ní September 2009.
rows.reference: Olujẹjọ, Khalid Barnes, ni a fi ẹsun pipa awọn onta egbogi oloro meji sugbon o gba ẹjọ ẹwọn gbere ni September 2009.

rows.source: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.
rows.output: Ìgbà tí wọ́n ti pa ẹni tó jẹbi ikú ní ọ̀ràn ìjọba àpapọ̀ ní New York tẹ́lẹ̀ jẹ́ 1953 fún Julius àti Ethel Rosenberg, tọkọtaya kan tí wọ́n pa lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n jẹbi pé wọ́n ń fọwọ́ sowọ́ pọ̀ láti fi ẹ̀sùn kan fún ìfipá mú àwọn ohun ìníà, fún Soviet Union nígbà Ogun Tó Kù ní ọdún méjì ṣáájú.
rows.reference: Ni igba ikẹhin ti a funni ni idajọ iku nni ẹjọ Gbogboogbo New York ni 1953 fun Julius ati Ethel Rosenberg, tọkọtaya kan ti a pa lẹhin ti wọn ti fi ẹsun iyọkẹlẹ wolu fun Soviet Union nigba ogun buburu ni ọdun meji ṣaaju.

rows.source: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Àwọn Rosenbergs méjèèjì ni wọ́n pa nígbèkùn ní ọjọ́ kẹrìndínlógún, oṣù kẹfà, ọdún 1953.
rows.reference: Awọn Rosenbergs mejeeji ni wọn pa nipasẹ ijoko mọnamọna ni June 19, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.output: Saipov, ará Uzbekistan, kò fi ìdáríjì hàn ní àwọn ọjọ́ àti oṣù tó tẹ̀ lé ìkọlù náà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ìwé ilé ẹjọ́ ti sọ.
rows.reference: Saipov, ọmọ abinibi ti Usibekisitani, ko ronupiwada ni awọn ọjọ ati awọn osu lẹhin ikọlu, ni ibamu si awọn iwe ile ẹjọ.

rows.source: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.
rows.output: Ó sọ fún àwọn olùwádìí náà pé ó ní ìmúláradá nípa ohun tí ó ṣe, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ.
rows.reference: O sọ fun awọn oluwadi pe inu oun dun si ohun ti oun ṣe, awọn olopa jabọ.

rows.source: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.
rows.output: Saipov sọ fún àwọn aláṣẹ pé ó gbàgbé láti ṣe ìkọlù náà lẹ́yìn tí ó ti wo àwọn fídíò ISIS lórí fóònù rẹ̀, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdìbò náà ti sọ.
rows.reference: Saipov sọ fun awọn alase pe oun ni imisi lati ṣe ikọlu naa lẹhin wiwo awọn fidio ISIS lori foonu rẹ, gẹgẹbi ibawi naa.

rows.source: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.
rows.output: Ó tún béèrè láti fi àmì ISIS hàn ní yàrá ìwòsán rẹ̀, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ.
rows.reference: O tun bere lati ṣe ifihan asia ISIS ni yara iwosan rẹ, awọn olopa jabọ.

rows.source: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.
rows.output: Ó ti jẹbi pé kò jẹbi sí ẹ̀sùn 22.
rows.reference: O ti gba ẹbi pe ko jẹbi si ẹsun-aṣiṣe 22.

rows.source: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.
rows.output: Dafidi Patton, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn olùgbèjà ìjọba àpapọ̀ tí ń ṣojú Saipov, sọ pé wọ́n “ní ìbànújẹ́” pẹ̀lú ìpinnu ìgbèjà.
rows.reference: David Patton, ọkan ninu awọn agbẹjọro awọn eniyan gbogboogbo ti o ṣoju Saipov, sọ pe wọn "ni idaniloju ijakulẹ" pẹlu ipinnu ẹjọ naa.

rows.source: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.
rows.output: "A ro pe ipinnu lati wa ẹsan iku dipo gbigba ẹbi ẹbi si igbesi aye ni tubu laisi agbara lati tu silẹ yoo kan fa irora ti awọn iṣẹlẹ wọnyi fun gbogbo eniyan ti o kan."
rows.reference: "A ro pe ipinnu lati wa ẹbi iku yatọsi ki eeyan gba ẹsun ijẹbi fun igbesi aye ni tubu laini ọna abayọ yoo mu ero ibanujẹ pupọ ti iṣẹlẹ yii wa fun gbogbo awọn ti o kan," Patton sọ.

rows.source: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ agbègbè Saipov ti béèrè fún àwọn olùgbèjà rẹ̀ ní ìgbèjà rẹ̀ kí wọ́n má ​​ṣe wá ìjìyà ikú.
rows.reference: Awọn ẹgbẹ ajẹjọ ti Saipov beere tẹlẹ bẹẹbẹ lọwọ awọn agbẹjọro lati maa beere fun ijiya iku.

rows.source: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations
rows.output: Tọki MP sọ pé NIGEL FARAGE yẹ kí a fi lépa ìjíròrò Brexit
rows.reference: Tory MP sọ wipe NIGEL FARAGE yẹ ki o wa ni iṣakoso fun awọn ijiroro Brexit

rows.source: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.
