rows.output: Nigel Farage ṣe ileri láti “mú àwọn ọmọ ogun àwọn ènìyàn” lọ́jijì nígbà ìfihàn kan ní ìpàdé àwọn Tóòrì.
rows.reference: Nigel Farage bura lati 'ṣe ikojọ igbimọ ogun awọn eniyan’ loni lakoko iwọde kan ni apejọ Tory.

rows.source: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.
rows.output: Agbáàwọlé Ukip tẹ́lẹ̀ sọ pé àwọn olóṣèlú gbọ́dọ̀ “ní ìmọ̀lára ooru” láti ọwọ́ àwọn alátakò Ìwọ̀ Oòrùn - gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Theresa May ṣe dámọ̀ràn pé kí wọ́n jẹ́ olórí ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú EU.
rows.reference: Olori Ukip tẹlẹ sọ pe awọn oloselu gbọdọ 'ni igbona ooru naa' lati awọn Eurosceptics - gẹgẹbi ọkan ninu awọn MP ti Theresa May ti daba pe o yẹ ki o jẹ olujiroro pẹlu EU:

rows.source: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.
rows.output: Ìṣòro ìdìbò Peter Bone ní Birmingham sọ pé UK yóò ti jáde ní báyìí tí ó bá jẹ́ Akọ̀wé Brexit.
rows.reference: Alatako atẹhinwa Peteru Bone sọ fun iwọde ni Birmingham pe UK yoo 'ti jade' ni bayi bi Mr Farage bajẹ Akowe Brexit.

rows.source: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìpèníjà tí Mrs May dojú kọ ní ìṣọ̀kan àwọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ tí ó yàtọ̀ síra ni a ti fi hàn nípa àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ tó ń ṣe atilẹyin ìdúróṣinṣin nínú ìjọpọ̀ ìṣọ̀kan kan lòdì sí Brexit ní ìlú náà.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn ipenija ti Arabinrin May ni ni ilaja awọn ẹgbẹ ti o pin ti awọn ti awọn Remain Tories darapọ mọ awọn oluwọde miiran lodisi Brexit ni ilu.

rows.source: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.
rows.output: Ìpínlẹ̀ náà ń tiraka láti pa ètò ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ Chequers rẹ̀ mọ́lè bí ó ti ń dojú kọ́ àwọn ìkọlù láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn Brexiteers, àwọn Remainers àti EU.
rows.reference: Oluṣaju n tiraka lati mu ipinnu ileri rẹ ṣẹ laarin ikọlu lọdọ awọn Brexit, Remainer ati EU.

rows.source: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.
rows.output: Àwọn alágbára náà tẹnu mọ́ ọn pé yóò tẹ̀síwájú láti gbìyànjú láti ṣe ìpinnu kan pẹ̀lú Brussels láìka ìdáhùn náà sí, àti láti fi agbára mú àwọn Eurosceptics àti Labour láti yan láárin package rẹ̀ àti ‘ìdàrúdàpọ̀’.
rows.reference: Awọn ẹgbẹ sọ daju pe yoo tẹsiwaju pẹlu igbiyanju lati ni asọye pẹlu Brussels pelu isọrọdisi - ati ki o fi ipa mu Eurosceptics ati Ẹgbẹ oṣiṣẹ lati yan laarin ohun ti o sọ ati 'Idarudapọ'.

rows.source: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.
rows.output: Ọgbẹ́ni Bone sọ fún àwọn olùkópa nínú ìpàdé náà ní Solihull pé òun fẹ́ “fi Chequers sílẹ̀”.
rows.reference: Ọgbẹni Bone sọ fun iwọde Fisilẹ Tumọsi Fisilẹ ni Solihull pe oun fẹ lati 'Fun Awọn Alayẹwo'.

rows.source: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.
rows.output: Ó dámọ̀rì pé kí wọ́n fún Farage ní ipò àlààbò, kí wọ́n sì fún un ní ojúṣe fún ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú Brussels.
rows.reference: O daba pe Ọgbẹni Farage yẹ lati jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ kan ki o si ni ojuse lati ṣe idunadura pẹlu Brussels.

rows.source: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.
rows.output: Tí ó bá ti jẹ́ olórí, a ó ti jáde ní báyìí.
rows.reference: 'Ti o ba jẹ olori, a o ti jade ni bayi,' o wi pe

rows.source: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'
rows.output: Ìwé Ìròyìn Wellingborough sọ pé: 'Èmi yóò dúró fún Brexit ṣùgbọ́n a nílò láti ju Chequers lọ.'
rows.reference: MP ti Welingborough fi kun: 'Emi yoo duro fun Brexit ṣugbọn a nilo lati ṣawari Awọn Oluṣayẹwo.'

rows.source: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.
rows.output: Nípa títẹ̀síwájú sí ìdàrúdàpọ̀ rẹ̀ sí EU, ó sọ pé: “A kò jà ogun àgbáyé láti jẹ́ aláwọ̀dá.
rows.reference: Ṣiṣeto atako yii si EU, o sọ bẹẹ: 'A ko ja ogun agbaye lati wa laaye.

rows.source: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'
rows.output: A fẹ́ ṣe òfin wa ní orílẹ̀-èdè wa.
rows.reference: A fẹ ṣe awọn ofin ti ara wa ni orilẹ-ede wa.'

rows.source: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'
rows.output: Ọgbẹ́ni Bone kọ̀ láti jẹ́wọ́ pé èrò gbogbogbòò ti yí padà láti ìgbà ìdìbò 2016: ‘Èrònú náà pé àwọn ará ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ti yí ìpinnu wọn padà tí wọ́n sì fẹ́ dúró ni a kò mọ̀.’
rows.reference: Ọgbẹni Bone fagile imọran pe ero ti awọn eniyan ti yipada lati ọdun idibo 2016: 'Awọn idaniloju pe awọn eniyan Britani ti yi ọkàn wọn pada ati pe wọn fẹ lati duro jẹ irọ patapata.'

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.output: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns tun wa ni igbafẹ, sọ fun awọn onirohin: 'Mo n sọ ni pato: Alakoso, gbọ awọn eniyan.
rows.reference: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns naa wa ni iwọde, o sọ fun awọn oniroyin: 'Mo kan n sọ pe: Minisita Alakoso, fetisi awọn eniyan.

rows.source: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.
rows.output: 'Chequers kò fẹ́ràn àwọn aráàlú, àwọn alátakò kò ní dìbò fún un, kò fẹ́ràn àwọn ẹgbẹ́ wa àti àwọn olùfọkànsìn wa tí ń rìnrìnrín àti tí ń jẹ́kí a dìbò ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́.
rows.reference: 'Awọn Oluṣayẹwo jẹ alailokiki lọdọ gbogbogbo, Alatako ko ni dibo fun, ko lokiki ninu ẹgbẹ wa ati awọn ajijagbara wa ti o wa ita gbangba lati dibo fun wa.

rows.source: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'
rows.output: Jọ̀wọ́ dín Chequers kù, kí o sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí gbọ́.'
rows.reference: Jọwọ fi awọn Ṣayẹwo silẹ ki o bẹrẹ si gbọ.'

rows.source: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'
rows.output: Ní ìfọkànsìn kan sí Ọwọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀wọ́ Ọ̀
rows.reference: Ninu ifiranṣẹ ti o tọ si Arabinrin May, o fi kun: 'Awọn aṣoju Minisita n pa iṣẹ wọn mọ nigba ti wọn ko ba mu awọn ileri wọn ṣẹ.'

rows.source: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Farage sọ fún àwọn ìpàdé náà pé àwọn olóṣèlú gbọ́dọ̀ “ní ìmọ̀lára ooru” bí wọn bá ń fẹ́ fọwọ́ sowọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ ìpinnu tí wọ́n ṣe ní ọdún 2016.
rows.reference: Ọgbẹni Farage sọ fun awọn oluwọlu pe awọn oloselu gbọdọ ‘lero ooru’ lara ti wọn ba fẹ yi ipinnu ti a ṣe ni idibo ti 2016 pada.

rows.source: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.
rows.output: Èyí ni báyìí nípa ọ̀rọ̀ ìgbọ́kùúlù láàrin wa - àwọn ènìyàn - àti àwọn ẹlẹ́ṣin wa.
rows.reference: 'Eyi jẹ nipa ọrọ ifọkantan laarin wa - awọn eniyan - ati egbe oselu wa,' o sọ.

rows.source: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'
rows.output: Wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti tan Brexit jẹ, a sì wà l'íhà yìí l'ónìí láti sọ fún wọn pé, ‘a kò jẹ́ kí o lè ṣe ìyẹn.’
rows.reference: 'Wọn n gbiyanju lati da Brexit a wa loni lati sọ fun wọn pe,' Awa ki yoo jẹ ki ẹ mu eleyi jẹ'.

rows.source: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.
rows.output: Ní sọ̀rọ̀ sí àwọn ènìyàn tó ń ṣe ìdùnnú, ó fi kun un pé: “Mo fẹ́ kí ẹ sọ fún àwọn ènìyàn wa pé kí wọ́n máa ṣe ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ìdìbò wa, tí wọ́n ti ń ṣe ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ìdìbò wa.
rows.reference: Ninu ifiranṣẹ kan si ero ti o ni itara ti o fi kun: 'Mo fẹ ki ẹ jẹki awọn oselu wa, ti o wa ni ipo dida Brexit, lero ooru naa.

rows.source: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'
rows.output: A ń ṣe ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò àwọn ọmọ ogun orílẹ̀-èdè yìí tí ó fún wa ní ìṣẹ́gun ní Brexit tí yóò sì máa ṣe ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò títí tí a ó fi di orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó jẹ́ olómìnira, tí ó jẹ́ aláṣẹ, tí ó sì jẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè United Kingdom tí ó ní ìgbọràn.
rows.reference: 'A n ṣe akojọ ẹgbẹ ọmọ ogun ti orilẹ-ede yii ti o fun wa ni iṣẹgun ni Brexit ati pe ko ni si isimi titi di igba ti a ba ti di ominira, iṣakoso ara-ẹni, ounyangan iṣejọba ara ẹni United Kingdom.'

rows.source: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.
rows.output: Ní báyìí, àwọn tí wọ́n ń dúró de ìpadàbọ̀ ń rìn káàkiri Birmingham kí wọ́n sì ṣe ìpàdé wákàtí méjì ní àárín ìlú náà.
rows.reference: Nibayi, Ramainers wọ kọja Birmingham ṣaaju ki wọn to pejọ fun iwọde wakati meji ni aarin ilu naa.

rows.source: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.
rows.output: Àwọn olùfọkànsìn kan ń fọwọ́ sowọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ àwọn àmì ẹ̀yà Tóories Lodi sí Brexit lẹ́yìn ìdásílẹ̀ ẹgbẹ́ náà ní òpin ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí.
rows.reference: Awọn alakikanju ti awọn ajafitafita lo Tories Lodi si Asia Brexit lẹhin ifilole ẹgbẹ naa ni ìparí ọsẹ yii.

rows.source: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.
rows.output: Ìjọbà peer Lord Adonis ṣe ẹlùú àwọn Konsafáàsì fún àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ ààbò tí wọ́n dojú kọ pẹ̀lú ohun èlò ẹgbẹ́ wọn nígbà tí ìpàdé náà bẹ̀rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ẹlẹgbẹ Oṣiṣẹ Oluwa Adonis ṣe ẹlẹya awọn olutẹle ohun atẹhinwa nitori iṣẹlẹ aabo ti wọn ni pẹlu iṣafilọlẹ ẹgbẹ kan bi apejọ ti ṣí bẹrẹ.

rows.source: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.output: Àwọn ni àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n sọ fún wa pé wọn lè ní àwọn eto IT ní ibi àti gbogbo ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ fún Canada pọ̀, fún ààlà tí kò ní ìdààmú, fún ìtajà ọfẹ́ láìsí ààlà ní Ireland, ó sì fi kun.
rows.reference: 'Awọn wọnyi ni awọn eniyan ti o sọ fun wa pe wọn le ni awọn ilana IT ni ojuṣe ati gbogbo imọ-ẹrọ fun Canada ni afikun pẹlu, fun iyipo ailopin, fun iṣowo ọfẹ laisi awọn aala ni Ireland,’o fi kun.

rows.source: 'It is a complete farce.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ àwàdà tó péye.
rows.reference: 'O jẹ aiṣeeṣe patapata.

rows.source: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.
rows.output: Kò sí nǹkan bíi ti o dára bí ìdáwọ́le Brexit, ó sì fi kun.
rows.reference: Kosi nnkan ti o dabi Brexit ti o dara,’o fi kun.

rows.source: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president
rows.output: Warren ngbero lati wo 'pupa' lati dije fun aarẹ
rows.reference: Warren ń gbèrò ‘gidi gan-an’ láti jẹ ààrẹ

rows.source: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.
rows.output: Alagbawi Amẹrika, Elizabeth Warren sọ pe yoo wo “oju ti o lewu lati ṣe idibo aarẹ” lẹhin awọn idibo Oṣu kọkanla.
rows.reference: ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà Sínátọ̀ Elizabeth Wareen ní òun “gbèrò gidi gan-an láti díje fún ipò ààrẹ” lẹ́yìn ibò oṣù kọkànlá.

rows.source: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.
rows.output: Iroyin Boston Globe sọ pe Massachusetts Democrat sọrọ nipa ọjọ iwaju rẹ lasiko ipade ilu ni iwọ-oorun Massachusetts ni Satidee.
rows.reference: The Boston Globe ni àtẹ̀jáde yìí ti jáde ní àkókò tí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat ti ìlú Massachusetts ṣe ìpàdé pẹ̀lú àwọn ará ẹkùn ẹ̀ ní iwọ̀-oòrùn Massachusetts ní ọjọ́ Sátidé.

rows.source: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.output: Warren, ẹni tí ó sábà máa ń tako Ààrẹ Donald Trump, ń ṣe ìdìbò fún ìdìbò lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i ní November lòdì sí Republikani State Rep. Geoff Diehl, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ alága ìpìlẹ̀ Trump ní 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.reference: Warren, alátakò Ààrẹ Donald Trump ní gbogbo ìgbà, máa díjẹ lẹ́ẹ̀kan si pẹ̀lú Geoff Diehl , ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican àti aṣojú ìpínlẹ̀ ní oṣù kọkànlá. Diehl jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn alága ní ìlú Massachusetts fún ìpolongo Trump ní 2016.

rows.source: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.
rows.output: Ó ti wà ní àárín àwọn ìrònú pé ó lè dojú kọ Trump ní 2020.
rows.reference: Àwọn èèyàn tí n sọ káàkiri pé ó fẹ́ díje ju ipò ààrẹ pẹlú Trump ni ọdún 2020.

rows.source: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.
rows.output: Ọjọ́ Àarọ̀ ní Holyoke jẹ́ ìpàdé 36th rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn aráàlú ní fọ́ọ̀mù ilé ìgbìmọ̀ náà láti ìgbà tí Trump ti gba ọ́fíìsì.
rows.reference: Ìpàdé tó wáyé ní ọ̀sán Sátidé ní Holyoke ni ìpàdé ìkẹ́rindínlógójì (36) tó ṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn t’ọ́n wà ní ẹkùn ẹ̀ láti ìgbà tí Trump ti wọlé.

rows.source: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.
rows.output: Ẹni tó wà níbè béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ bóyá òun yóò di ààrẹ.
rows.reference: Ọ̀kan nínú àwọn t’ọ́n wà fún ìpàdé náà bíi léèrè pé ǹjẹ́ ó ń pinnu láti jẹ ààrẹ?

rows.source: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."
rows.output: Warren dahun pe o to akoko fun “awọn obinrin lati lọ si Washington lati ṣe atunṣe ijọba wa ti o bajẹ, ati pe eyi pẹlu obinrin ni oke.”
rows.reference: Warren ní àkókò ti tó “fún àwọn òbinrin láti lọ sí Washington láti to ìjọba tó doríkodò, àti pé obìnrin gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ olórí.”

rows.source: Arrest made in shooting death of LSU's Sims
rows.output: Ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ní ìpànìyàn ìpànìyàn ti LSU's Sims
rows.reference: Ìtìmọ́lé ẹni tó yìnbọn pa Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU

rows.source: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ní Baton Rouge, La., kéde ní ọjọ́ Satidee pé wọ́n ti mú ẹni tí wọ́n fọwọ́ sí nínú ìpànìyàn ti Wayde Sims, ọmọ eré bọ́ọ̀lù basketi LSU ní ọjọ́ Jimọ.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Sátidé, àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue, La., kéde àtìmọ́lé olùfurasí tó yìnbọn pa Wayde Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU, ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀.

rows.source: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, 20, at an 11 a.m. ET news conference.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka ọlọ́pàá Baton Rouge kéde ìdádúró Dyteon Simpson, 20, ní ìpàdé ìròyìn 11 a.m. ET.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue kéde àtìmọ́lé Dyteon Simpson, ọmọ ogún ọdún (20) ní aago mọkànlá òwúrọ̀ lásìkò.

rows.source: They had released a video of the shooting on Friday, asking for help identifying a man seen in the footage.
rows.output: Wọ́n ti tu fidio ìfọwọ́kù kan jáde ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́, tí wọ́n ń béèrè fún ìrànwọ́ láti mọ ọkùnrin tí a rí nínú fídíò náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣe àfihàn fídíò ìbọn yínyìn ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Wọ́n ní ẹni tó bá dá ẹni tó yìnbọn náà mọ̀, kó sọ fún àwọn.

rows.source: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.
rows.output: Sims, 20, ni wọ́n yìnbọn pa, wọ́n sì fi í sílẹ̀ ní ibi tí ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga ti Southern University wà ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọjọ́ Jimọ́.
rows.reference: Ní kùtùkùtù ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, nítọ̀sí Southern University, ni ọta ìbọn ba Sims, ọmọ ogun (20) ọdún, tó sì kú.

rows.source: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.
rows.output: "Wayde Sims ní ìfarapa ọwọ́ kan ní orí, ó sì kú nígbá tí ó pé." Aláṣẹ ọlọ́pàá Murphy J. Paul sọ fún àwọn oníròyìn ní ọjọ́ Satide, gẹ́gẹ́ bí 247sports ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gá ọlọ́pàá, Murphy J. Paul sọ fún ilé-ìròyìn 247sports pe “Ọgbẹ́ orí látàrí ọta ìbọn tó ba Wayde Sims ló pa á.”

rows.source: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.
rows.output: Wayde ti wà níbè láti dáabobo ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì yìnbọn pa á.
rows.reference: Wayde ń gbèjà ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀ ni kí Simpson tó yìnbọn fun un.

rows.source: Simpson was questioned and admitted to being on scene, in possession of a weapon, and admitted to shooting Wayde Sims.
rows.output: Simpson ni a beere lọwọ rẹ, o si jẹwọ pe o wa ni ibi ti o ti wa, ti o ni ohun ija, o si jẹwọ pe o ti yin Wayde Sims.
rows.reference: Nínú ìdáhùn ẹ, Simpson jẹ́wọ́ pé òun wà ní ibi iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, òun ní ìbọn lọ́wọ́, àti pé òun ló yìnbọn fún Wayde Sims.

rows.source: Simpson was arrested without incident and taken into custody at East Baton Rouge Parish Police Department.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n Simpson ni wọ́n mú ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́, wọ́n sì gbé e lọ sí ọ́fíìsì ẹgbẹ́ ọlọ́pàá Parish East Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: Simpson ‘ò bá àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣagídí bí wọ́n ṣe tì í mọ́ àtìmọ́lẹ́ ti àwọn ọlọ́pàá ní East Baton Rouge Parish.

rows.source: A 6-foot-6 junior who grew up in Baton Rouge, Sims played in 32 games with 10 starts last season and averaged 17.4 minutes, 5.6 points and 2.9 rebounds per game.
rows.output: Ọmọ ọdún mẹ́fà-ọgọ́rùn-ún mẹ́fà (6-6) tí ó dàgbà ní Baton Rouge, Sims kópa nínú àwọn eré 32 pẹ̀lú ìbèrè 10 nígbèkùle àkóràn tó kọjá, ó sì ń ṣe ìwọ̀n ìṣẹ́jú 17.4, 5.6 àwọ̀n àti 2.9 ìdáwọ́lè fún eré kan.
rows.reference: Sims, ọmọ tó ga fíofío, ṣe kékeré ẹ̀ ní Baton Rogue. Ní sáà tó kọjá, ó gbá bọ́ọ̀lu-aláfọwọ́gbá fún ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ ní ìgbà méjìlélọ́gbọ̀n (32). Ó bá wọn bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ẹ̀mẹwàá nínú ẹ̀.

rows.source: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel
rows.output: Ìdíje Grand Prix ti Rọ́ṣíà: Lewis Hamilton sunmọ́ àmì àgbáyé lẹ́yìn tí àwọn ìtọ́nisọ́nà ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ fún un ní ìṣẹ́gun lórí Sebastian Vettel
rows.reference: Erésísáonímọ́tò ní Russia Lewis Hamilton ló gbégbá orókè nínú ìdíjẹ àgbáyé. Mọ́tò tuntun tí Mercedes ráà ló fún ní àǹfààní láti borí Sebastian Vettel.

rows.source: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.
rows.output: Ó di kedere ní ìgbà tí Valtteri Bottas ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ níwájú Lewis Hamilton ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta pé àwọn ìtọ́sọ́nà ẹgbẹ́ Mercedes yóò ṣe pàtàkì nínú eré náà.
rows.reference: Valtteri Bottas ló kọ́ dé ìfẹsẹ̀wọnsè tó kẹ́yìn ni ọjọ́ Sátidé. Bí Mercedes ṣe gbọ́, wọ́n ra mọ́tò míì tó kó ipa pàtàkì nínú eré náà.

rows.source: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.
rows.output: Láti ibi ìpìlẹ̀, Bottas ní ìbèrè tó dára, ó sì fẹ́rẹpẹ́rẹpẹ́ láti jẹ́ kí Hamilton jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ kí
rows.reference: Botta bẹ̀rẹ̀ dáadáa. Ó ku díẹ̀ kó ti Hamilton kúrọ̀ lọ́nà torí ó fẹ́ gbé ipò kìíní. Kódà, ó lo Vettel láti ko lù ú.

rows.source: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.
rows.output: Vettel lọ sí ibi ìpamọ́ àkọ́kọ́, ó sì fi Hamilton sílẹ̀ láti sáré sínú ìkùukùu ní ẹ̀yìn ọ̀wọ́ ẹgbẹ́.
rows.reference: Vettel ‘ò fi ọgbọ́n ṣe é. Ó já sí kòtò, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Hamilton wà lẹyìn nínú súnkere-fàkere.

rows.source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
rows.output: Ìyàwó náà fi ọwọ́ kan ìjìnlé lẹ́yìn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ tí ó sì jáde lẹ́yìn Vettel, ṣùgbọ́n Hamilton tẹ̀ síwájú lẹ́yìn tí ó ti ṣe ìgbọ̀wọ́ kan tí ó sì fi ẹ̀wù rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ ìsàlà ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ kẹta.
rows.reference: Mercedes dúró níbi kòtò láti jáde lẹ́yìn Vettel. Láìpẹ́, Hamilton bọ́ síwájú. Àwọn awakọ̀ náà dá onírúurú ọgbọ́n bí wọ́n ṣe n wọkọ̀ . Awakọ̀ Ferari fi ojú-ọ̀nà sílẹ̀ torí kò fẹ́ ki ọkọ kọ̀ọ̀kan kọjá lára òun nígbà kẹta.

rows.source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.

rows.output: "Ìyàlẹ́nu kan ni pé ohun tí ó lè ṣẹlẹ̀ ni ohun tó dára jùlọ tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin ní àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn, nígbà tí o bá rí ìbínú, nígbà tí o bá rí àwọn ènìyàn tí ó bínú àti tí ó ní ìbínú àti tí ó burú àti tí kò tọ́," ó sọ.
rows.reference: Ó ní “Ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀, àti ohun tí òun rò pé ó dára nípa ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà lẹ́nu ọjọ́ mẹ́ta yìí jẹ́ àfihàn ìbínú. Àwọn èèyàn ń bínú, ṣìkà, àti aláìṣòótọ́.”

rows.source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
rows.output: Ìwé àṣírí tí ó ní àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan Kavanaugh ni a rán Feinstein lọ́dún July, ó sì di ìfihánṣẹ́ ní September, ṣùgbọ́n Feinstein kọ̀ láti jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ pé ìfihánṣẹ́ náà wá láti ọ́fíìsì rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Oṣù keje ni Ford kọ lẹ́tà nípa onírúurú ẹ̀sùn tí Kavanaugh ṣè sí Feinstein, àmọ́ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù kẹsàn-án, gbogbo èèyàn mọ̀ nípa ẹ̀sùn yí àmọ́ Feinstein ní òun ‘ò tú ẹ̀sùn náà síta fún àwọn èèyàn.

rows.source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
rows.output: "Mo máa ń fi ẹ̀rí Dr. Ford hàn, mo sì máa ń fi ìtàn rẹ̀ hàn," ni Feinstein sọ fún ẹgbẹ́ náà, The Hill sọ.
rows.reference: Ìròyìn The Hill ní Feinstein sọ fún ìgbìmọ̀ pé “Mo ‘ò fi onírúurú ẹ̀sùn Ford pamọ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni mo ‘ò tu síta.”

rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìdáhùn rẹ̀ kò dàbí ẹni pé ó dùn sí ààrẹ náà, ẹni tí ó sọ nígbèkùn alẹ́ Saturday: “Èmi yóò sọ fún ọ, ìyẹn burú jù lọ.

rows.output: Bóyá kò ṣe, ṣùgbọ́n ìyẹn ni ìfarahàn ara tó burú jù tí mo ti rí rí.
rows.reference: Bí ‘ò bá mọ̀, kó lọ pé mo ‘ò ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ tó burú jáyì tó yìí rí.”

rows.source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
rows.output: Tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀ fún olùdíje ilé ẹjọ́ gíga, ẹni tí a fi ẹ̀sùn kan pé ó ti ṣe ìbálòpọ̀ pẹ̀lú obìnrin mẹ́ta, Ààrẹ náà dámọ̀ràn pé àwọn Democrats ń lò àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà fún èrè wọn.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ tó gbárúkùtì mọ́ ẹni tó yàn sí ipò adájọ́ ní Ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà, eni tí àwọn obìnrin mẹ́ta fi ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilòpọ̀ kàn, ní àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat fẹ lo ẹ̀sùn yí fún àǹfààní ti wọn ni.

rows.source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.output: Ìdíje Elite: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.reference: Eré-ìdárayá fún àwọn Gbajúmọ̀: Dundee Stars 5, Belfast Giants 3

rows.source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
rows.output: Patrick Dwyer gba ibọn meji fun awọn Giants lodi si Dundee
rows.reference: Patrick Dwyekr, ọmọ Giants, ju bọ́ọ̀lù sí àwọ̀n Dundee ní èèmejì

rows.source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
rows.output: Àwọn Ìrìbọmi Dundee ní ìdánilójú fún ìpadàbọ̀ Àgbáye Elite lọ́jọ́ Jimọ́ sí Belfast Giants nípa ṣíṣe ìṣégun ìbọ̀wọ̀ 5-3 ní Dundee ní ọjọ́ Saturday.
rows.reference: Belfast Giants na Dundee Stars ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Àmọ́ ní ọjọ́ Sátidé ní Dundee, Dundee Stars na Belfast Giants ní 5 sí 3.

rows.source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
rows.output: Àwọn Gíga náà gba ìlà ọwọ́ méjì ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ láti ọwọ́ Patrick Dwyer àti Francis Beauvillier.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ Giants, Patrick Dwyer àti Francis Beauvillier, ni wọ́n ju bọ́ọ̀lù ní èẹ̀mejì sí àwọ̀n Dundee Stars.

rows.source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
rows.output: Mike Sullivan àti Jordan Cownie mú kí àwọn ará ìlú náà dọ́gba, ṣùgbọ́n Dwyer tún mú kí àwọn Gíga náà padà sí iwájú.
rows.reference: Mike Sullivan àti Jordan Cownie náà sọ bọ́ọ̀lù ní èẹ̀mejì sí àwọ̀n Giants. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Dwyer sọ ẹyọ kan si i.

rows.source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
rows.output: François Bouchard ti dọ́gba fun Dundee ṣaaju awọn ibọn meji ti Lukas Lundvald Nielsen ṣe idaniloju iṣẹgun wọn.
rows.reference: Francois Bouchard náà padà fún Dundee. Bọ́ọlù tí Lukas Lundvald Nielsen sọ sí àwọ̀n Giants lẹ́ẹ̀mejì ló mu Dundee borí.

rows.source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìṣòro ẹgbẹ́ Elite League kẹta fún àwọn ọkùnrin Adam Keefe ní àkókò yìí, tí wọ́n ti wá láti ẹ̀yìn láti borí Dundee 2-1 ní Belfast ní alẹ́ Jimọ́.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀kẹ́rin rèé tí àwọn ọmọ Adam Kefee, tí wọ́n na Dundee ní 2 sí 1 ní Belfast ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, máa pàdánù ní Eré-ìdárayá Gbajúmọ̀ ti sáà yí nìyí.

rows.source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìpàdé kẹrin ní àkókò yìí láàárín àwọn ẹgbẹ́ méjèèjì, pẹ̀lú àwọn Gíga tí wọ́n ti ṣẹ́gun àwọn ìpàdé mẹ́ta tó ti kọjá.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀kẹ́rin rèé tí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ méjèèjì máa padà nínú ìdíje. Giants borí ní ìdíje mẹ́ta tó ṣáájú.

rows.source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Dwyer wá ní ìṣẹ́jú kẹrin, 3:35 láti ọwọ́ Kendall McFaull, pẹ̀lú ìrànwọ́ David Rutherford gẹ́gẹ́ bí Beauvillier ti mú kí ìlà ọ̀nà rẹ̀ pọ̀ sí i ní ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́rin lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: Kendall McFaull ló gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sí Dwyer, tí Dwyer sì gba wọle láàrin ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́rin tí bọ́ọ̀lù bẹ̀rẹ̀. Láàrin ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́rin mìíì, David Rutherford náà gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sí Beauvillier, tí Beauvillier sì gba wọlé.

rows.source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
rows.output: Ni akoko ibẹrẹ ti o nšišẹ, Sullivan mu ẹgbẹ ile pada si ere naa ni 13:10 ṣaaju ki Matt Marquardt to di olutọju fun Cownie's equaliser ni 15:16.
rows.reference: Sulivan tún sọ bọ́ọ̀lù sí àwọ̀n, àmọ́ Matt Marquardt fún Crownie ni bọ́ọ̀lù, tí Crownie sì gba wọlé.

rows.source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
rows.output: Dwyer rii dájú pé àwọn Gígańsì mú àkójọpọ̀ wọ́n wá sí ìsinmi àkọ́kọ́ nígbà tí ó gba àmì ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kejì rẹ̀ ní òpin àkókò àkọ́kọ́.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ Dwyer, ọmọ Giants, tún sọ bọ́ọ̀lù míì sí àwọ̀n -ẹlẹ́kèjì irú ẹ̀ - kí wọ́n tó sinmi ráńpé.

rows.source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ilé náà tún ṣètò, Bouchard sì tún jẹ́ kí wọ́n padà sí ìpele pẹ̀lú góòlù tí wọ́n ṣe ní àkókò ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní 27:37.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ Dundee túnramú. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Bouchard sọ bọ́ọ̀lù míì sí àwọ̀n.

rows.source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
rows.output: Cownie àti Charles Corcoran ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti jẹ́ kí Nielsen fún Dundee ní àkọ́kọ́ nínú eré náà pẹ̀lú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní ìparí àkókò kejì, ó sì jẹ́ kí ó dájù pé ó ṣẹ́gun pẹ̀lú ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ ní ìdá márùn-ún ní àárín àkókò ìparapọ̀.
rows.reference: Bí ìfẹsẹ̀wọnsẹ̀ náà ṣe fẹ kásẹ̀ nílẹ̀ Cownie àti Charles gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sí Nielsen láti sọ bọ́ọ̀lù sí àwọ̀n fún góòlù ẹlẹ́kaarùn-ún.

rows.source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
rows.output: Àwọn Gíga, tí wọ́n ti pàdánù mẹ́rin nínú àwọn eré márùn-ún tó kẹ́yìn, yóò ṣe eré lọ́dọ̀ Milton Keynes ní eré tó ń bọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́.
rows.reference: Àwọn ikọ̀ Giants, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé wọ́n pàdánù ìdíje mẹ́rin nínú márùn-ún, máa wà ní gbàgéde ti wọn láti kojú ikọ̀ Milton Keynes ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀.

rows.source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
rows.output: Olùṣàkóso ọkọ̀ òfurufú kú láti jẹ́ kí ọgọ́rùn-ún ènìyàn tí ó wà nínú ọkọ̀ náà lè sá kúrò nínú ìjì líle náà.
rows.reference: Adarí Ọkọ̀ Òfurúfú Kú Torí Àtigba Ọ̀pọ̀ Èèyàn T’ọ́n Wà Nínú Ọkọ̀-òfúrufú Sílẹ̀ Lọ́wọ́ Ìjì-ilẹ̀

rows.source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
rows.output: Olùṣàkóso ọkọ̀ òfurufú ní Indonesia ni wọ́n ń pè ní akọni lẹ́yìn tí ó kú láti rí i dájú pé ọkọ̀ òfurufú kan tó ń gbé ọgọ́rùn-ún ènìyàn lọ́wọ́ lè jáde lọ́wọ́ ilẹ̀ láìsé.
rows.reference: Adarí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú, ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia, ni ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn ti kan sárá sí gẹ́gẹ́ bí akínkanjú torí ó kú nítorí kí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú tó gbé ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn lè fò kúrò nílẹ̀ láì léwu.

rows.source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn tó lé ní 800 lọ́wọ́ ti kú, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sì sọnù lẹ́yìn tí ìjì líle kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní erékùṣù Sulawesi ní ọjọ Jimọ, èyí tó fa ìjì líle.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, yàtọ̀ sí àwọn t’ọ́n sọnù, àwọn èèyàn t’ọ́n lé ní ẹgbẹ̀rin ló kú ní erékùsù Sulawesi látàrí ijì-ilẹ̀ tó fa àgbàrá líle.

rows.source: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.
rows.output: Àwọn ìjì líle ń bá a lọ́wọ́ ní àgbègbè náà, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sì wà nínú ìdọ̀tí nínú ìlú Palu.
rows.reference: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìjì-líle níwọ̀nba ń ja ní àgbègbè yí. Àti pé ọ̀pọ̀ wà ní àhámọ́ ilé tó wó bò wọ́n mọlẹ̀ ní ìlú Palu.

rows.source: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n láìka àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ tí wọ́n ń sá lọ fún ìyè, Anthonius Gunawan Agung tó jẹ́ ọdún 21, kọ̀ láti lọ kúrò ní ibi iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ní ilé-iṣẹ́ ìṣàkóso tó ń rọ̀ ní pẹpẹ ọkọ̀ òfurufú Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Palu.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ sá àsálà fún ẹ̀mí wọn, Anthonius Gunawan Agung, ọmọ ọdún oókanlélógún (21) kọ̀ láti fi iṣẹ́ ẹ̀ sílẹ̀ bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ilé tó ń darí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ní ibùdó ọkọ-òfúrufú Mutiara Sis Al Jufri ní Palu ń mì gidi gan-an.

rows.source: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.
rows.output: Ó dúró ṣinṣin láti ríi dájú pé ọkọ̀ òfurufú Batik Air 6321, tó wà lórí pátákó ní àkókò yẹn, lè fò lọ́wọ́ láìsé.
rows.reference: Ó dúró pa síbẹ̀ torí kí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú Batik Air 6321, tó fẹ́ gbéra, lè fò kúrò nílẹ̀ láì léwu.

rows.source: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.
rows.output: Ó sì fò kúrò ní ìlà ọ̀dọ́ ọkọ̀ ojú irin nígbà tí ó rò pé ó ń ṣubú.
rows.reference: Ìgbà tí ó fò kúrò ní ilé tó ń darí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ni ìgbà tí ilé náà fẹ́ dà wó.

rows.source: He died later in hospital.
rows.output: Ó kú nígbèyìn nínú ilé ìwòsàn.
rows.reference: Ilé-ìwòsàn ló kú sí.

rows.source: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.
rows.output: Agbẹnusọ fun Iṣakoso Ọkọ ofurufu Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, sọ pe ipinnu naa le ti gba awọn ẹmi ọgọrun lọwọ, gẹgẹbi iroyin ABC News ti Australia.
rows.reference: Ní ìròyìn ABC News, Yohannes Sirait, agbẹnusọ àwọn t’ọ́n wa ọkọ̀-òfúrufú, ní ìṣe ọmọkùnrin yìí ni kò jẹ́ kí ọ̀pọ̀ eèyàn kú.

rows.source: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.
rows.output: A ti gbaradì ẹ̀rọ ọkọ̀ òfurufú láti Balikpapan ní Kalimantan láti mú un lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn ńlá kan ní ìlú mìíràn.
rows.reference: A pèṣè hẹlikópítà kan láti Balikpapan ní Kalimantan láti mú lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn tó tún tóbi jù ní ìlú mìíràn.

rows.source: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.
rows.output: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí a pàdánù rẹ̀ ní òwúrọ̀ yìí kí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà tó dé Palu.
rows.reference: Ó mà ṣe o, a pàdánù rẹ̀ ní òwúrọ̀ yìí kí ó tó di pé hẹlikópítà náà dé Palu.

rows.source: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.
rows.output: "Ìyàlẹ́nu wa láti gbọ́ nípa èyí," ó fi kún un.
rows.reference: "Ọkàn wa gbọgbẹ́ láti gbọ́ nípa eléyìí,” Our heart breaks to hear about this," Ó fi kú un.

rows.source: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.
rows.output: Ní báyìí, àwọn aláṣẹ ń bẹ̀rù pé ìwọ̀n ikú náà lè dé ẹgbẹ̀rún, bí ilé-iṣẹ́ ìṣípayá orílẹ̀-èdè náà ṣe sọ pé ìrántí sí àwọn abúlé Donggala, Sigi àti Boutong ti dín kù.
rows.reference: Bayii, awọn alaṣẹ n bẹru pe iye iku yoo ga to ẹgbẹgbẹrun pẹlu bi ajọ oluṣabojuto ajalu ṣe n sọ pe iwọle si awọn ilu bii Donggala, Sigi ati Boutong yoo kere.

rows.source: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.
rows.output: "Ìdààmú náà gbọ́dọ̀ ń pọ̀ sí i nítorí pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ara ni wọ́n ṣì wà lábẹ́ ìparun náà nígbà tí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ kò tíì lè dé," agbẹnusọ́ ilé iṣẹ́ náà Sutopo Purwo Nugroho sọ.
rows.reference: ”Ó ṣeéṣe k’áwọn t’ọ́n kú pọ̀ si torí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èèyàn ni ilé wò bò mọ́lẹ̀, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni wọn ‘ò gbúròó àwọn míì,” ni ohun tí Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ àjọ náà sọ.

rows.source: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.
rows.output: Àwọn ìjì líle tó ga tó mítà mẹ́fà ti bà jù Palu, tí yóò sì ṣe ìsìnkú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Àìkù.
rows.reference: Ìjì omi líle tó tó ìwọn mẹ́fà ti run Palu; ibi tí ìsìnkú ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn ti máa wáyé ní ọjọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.
rows.output: Àwọn ọkọ̀ òfurufú ológun àti okòwò ń mú ìrànwọ́ àti ohun èlò wá.
rows.reference: Ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ti àwọn ọmọ-ogun àti ti ilé-iṣẹ́ aládàáni ń gbé oúnjẹ, ẹ̀ṣọ́ ilé àti ẹ̀ṣọ́ ara wá fún àwọn èèyàn.

rows.source: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: Risa Kusuma, ìyá mẹ́rìnléláàádọ́ta [35] ọdún, sọ fún Sky News: “Ìṣéjù ìṣẹ́jú kọ̀ọ̀kan, ọkọ̀ ojú omi ambulance ń mú àwọn ara wá.
rows.reference: Risa Kusuma, ọmọ ọdún márùn-úndínlógójiị̀ (35) tó tún jẹ́ òbí sọ fun Sky News pé: “Gbogbo ìgbà ni wọ́n n fi mọ́tò-agbókùú gbé òkú wa.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce.
rows.output: Omí tó mọ́ jẹ́ ohun tí kò rọrùn láti rí.
rows.reference: Ó le láti rí omi tó mọ́.

rows.source: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."
rows.output: Àwọn ilé ìtajà kékeré ni a ń jí ní gbogbo ibi."
rows.reference: Wọ́n ń jí nǹkan ní isọ̀ káàkiri ni.”

rows.source: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.
rows.output: Jan Gelfand, olori International Red Cross ni Indonesia, sọ fun CNN: "Red Cross ti Indonesia n sare lati ran awọn ti o yege lọwọ ṣugbọn a ko mọ ohun ti wọn yoo ri nibẹ.
rows.reference: Jan Gelfand, olórí Red Cross Àgbáyé ti orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia sọ fún CNN pé: “Awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Red Cross ti orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia ń wá àwọn tí wọ́n wà láàyè sùgbọ́n wọn ‘ò mọ ohun tí wọ́n máa bá ní abẹ́ àwọn ilé t’ọ́n wọ́n náà.

rows.source: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."
rows.output: Èyí ti jẹ́ ìbànújẹ́ kan, ṣùgbọ́n ó lè burú si.
rows.reference: Kódà, àdánù yí lè pọ̀ si.”

rows.source: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.
rows.output: Ààrẹ ilẹ̀ Indonesia Joko Widodo dé Palu ní ọjọ́ Sunday, ó sì sọ fún àwọn ọmọ ogun orílẹ̀-èdè náà pé: “Mo ń bèèrè lọ́wọ́ gbogbo yín láti ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́jọ́ àti lọ́jọ́ orí láti parí gbogbo iṣẹ́ tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ìkójọpọ̀.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Indonesia, Joko Widodo, wá sí Palu ní ọjọ́ Àìkú. Ó sọ fún àwọn ọmọ-ogun orílẹ̀-èdè náà pé: “Kí wọ́n ṣiṣẹ́ tọ̀san-tòru láti kó àwọn tí ilé wó mọ́ lórí jáde.

rows.source: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
rows.output: "Ṣé o ti ṣetán?" CNN royin.
rows.reference: Ẹ se tán?” Gẹ́gẹ́ bí CNN ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.
rows.output: Indonesia ni wọ́n ti kọlu rẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí pẹ̀lú ìkún omi ní Lombok, níbi tí ó lé ní 550 ènìyàn ti kú.
rows.reference: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí ni ijì-ilẹ̀ jà ní ìlú Lombok ní orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia. Àwọn t’ọ́n kú lé ni 550.

rows.source: Micronesia plane crash: Air Niugini now says one man missing after lagoon plane crash
rows.output: Ìjì líle ní Micronesia: Air Niugini ní báyìí sọ pé ọkùnrin kan ṣoṣo ni ó sọnù lẹ́yìn ìjàm̀bá ọkọ̀ òfurufú lagoon
rows.reference: Ọkọ̀-òfúrufú run ní Micronesia Ile-iṣẹ́ Air Niugini ní àwọn ‘ò rí èèyàn kan látàrí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú tó run sínu ọ̀kun

rows.source: The airline operating a flight that crashed into a Pacific lagoon in Micronesia now says one man is missing, after earlier saying all 47 passengers and crew had safely evacuated the sinking plane.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú kan tí ó fọ́ sínú adágún omi Pacific ní Micronesia sọ báyìí pé ọkùnrin kan ṣoṣo ni ó sọnù, lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti sọ tẹ́lẹ̀ pé gbogbo àwọn arìnrì àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ mẹ́rìnlélógójì [47] ti jáwọ́ kúrò nínú ọkọ̀ náà tí ó ń fọ́.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí Ile-iṣẹ́ tó ni ọkọ̀-òfúrufú, tó run sínu ọ̀kun ti Micronesia, kéde pé àwọn ti kó èrò àti abániṣiṣẹ́ 47 kúrò nínú ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà, ni wọ́n tún ní àwọn ‘ò rí èèyàn kan.

rows.source: Air Niugini said in a release that as of Saturday afternoon, it was unable to account for a male passenger.
rows.output: Air Niugini sọ pé ní ìpàdé Saturday, kò lè ṣe àléébù fún ọkùnrin kan.
rows.reference: Ile-iṣẹ́ Air Niugini ní ọ̀sán Sátidé ní àwọn ‘ò rí ọmọkùnrin kan

rows.source: The airline said it was working with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to try to find the man.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà sọ pé wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn aláṣẹ àgbègbè, ilé ìwòsàn, àti àwọn olùṣàwárí láti wá ọkùnrin náà.
rows.reference: Ile-iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà ní àwọn ń ṣiṣẹ́ pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn aláṣẹ, ile-ìwòsaǹ àti olùwádìí láti wá ọmọkùnrin náà.

rows.source: The airline did not immediately respond to requests for more details about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà kò fèsì lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ sí ìbéèrè fún àwọn àlàyé síwájú si nípa arìnrìn-àjò náà, bíi ọjọ́ orí rẹ̀ tàbí orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ile-iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú lọ́ra láti sọ ohunkóhun, bíi ọjọ-orí ẹ̀ tàbí ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè tó jẹ́, nípa ọmọkùnrin náà bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn èèyàn bèrè.

rows.source: Local boats helped rescue the other passengers and crew after the plane hit the water while trying to land at the Chuuk Island airport.
rows.output: Àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi agbègbè náà ṣèrànwọ́ fún ìgbèjà àwọn aráàlú àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ tókù lẹ́yìn tí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà ti lu omi nígbà tí wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti balẹ̀ ní pápákọ̀ òfurufú Chuuk.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́kò oju-omi ni wọ́n gbé àwọn èrò àti abániṣíṣẹ́ jáde kúrò nínú omi tí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà jásí lásìkò tó ń gbìyànjú láti bà sí ilé-ọkọ̀ òfurufú ti Chuuk Island.

rows.source: Officials said on Friday that seven people had been taken to a hospital.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ sọ pé ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ ni wọ́n gbé àwọn ènìyàn méje lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, àwọn aláṣẹ ní èèyàn méje ni wọ́n ti gbé lọ sí ilé-ìwòsàn.

rows.source: The airline said six passengers remained at the hospital Saturday, and all of them were in stable condition.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà sọ pé àwọn arìnrìn-àjò mẹ́fà wà ní ilé ìwòsàn ní ọjọ́ Satide, tí gbogbo wọn sì wà ní ipò tí ó dára.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Satidé, àwọn èèyàn mẹ́fà tó kù ní ilé-ìwòsàn. Béẹ̀ ni ara wọn tí n balẹ̀.

rows.source: What caused the crash and the exact sequence of events remains unclear.
rows.output: Ìdí tí ìkún omi náà fi ṣẹlẹ̀ àti ìtànkálẹ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà kò tíì mọ́.
rows.reference: Okùnfà ọkọ̀ tó jà àti àwọn iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ t’ọ́n rọ̀ mọ kọ̀ yẹ́ èèyàn.

rows.source: The airline and the U.S. Navy both said the plane landed in the lagoon short of the runway.
rows.output: Ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà àti Agbègbè Ọgagun ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà sọ pé ọkọ̀ náà wà nínú adágún náà ṣáájú kí ó tó dé ojú ọ̀nà.
rows.reference: Ilé-iṣẹ́ tó ni ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà, àti àjọ tó ń ṣe àmójúto ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ní Amẹ́ríkà ní ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà balẹ̀ kó tó ojú-ọ̀nà tí wọ́n là sílẹ̀ fún àwọn ọkọ̀-òfúrufú.

rows.source: Some witnesses thought the plane overshot the runway.
rows.output: Diẹ ninu awọn ẹlẹri ro pe ọkọ ofurufu naa kọja oju-ọna.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ àwọn tí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà ṣojú ẹ̀ ní ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà yà bàrà kọjá ojú-ọ̀nà ẹ ni.

rows.source: American passenger Bill Jaynes said the plane came in very low.
rows.output: Ọmọ ogun ọkọ ofurufu Amẹrika Bill Jaynes sọ pe ọkọ ofurufu naa wà ni isalẹ pupọ.
rows.reference: Bill Jaynes, ọmọ Amẹ́ríkà to jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn èrò ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà, ní ọkọ̀-òfúrufú yìí rọra wálẹ̀ ni.

rows.source: "That's an extremely good thing," said Jaynes.
rows.output: "Ìyẹn jẹ́ ohun tó dára jù," ni Jaynes sọ.
rows.reference: Jaynes ni “Ohun tó da ni o.”

rows.source: Jaynes said he and others managed to wade through waist-deep water to the emergency exits on the sinking plane.
rows.output: Jaynes sọ pé òun àti àwọn mìíràn ni wọ́n ṣàṣeyọrí láti lọ sínú omi tí ó ga ní ìbàdí láti jáde kúrò nínú ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tí ń rì.
rows.reference: Jaynes ní òun àti àwọn t’ọ́n kù láti rìn nínú omi tó mù wọ́n dé ìbàdí k’áwọn tó dé ẹnu ọ̀nà àbájáde ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà.

rows.source: He said the flight attendants were panicking and yelling, and that he suffered a minor head injury.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà ń bẹ̀rù, wọ́n sì ń pariwo, ó sì sọ pé òun ní ìfarapa orí kékeré kan.
rows.reference: Ó ní àwọn abániṣíṣẹ́ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà ń bẹ̀rù, bẹ́ẹ̀ni wọ́n ń jágbe. Ó ní òun ṣìṣe lórí.

rows.source: The U.S. Navy said sailors working nearby on improving a wharf also helped in the rescue by using an inflatable boat to shuttle people ashore before the plane sank in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ọkọ̀ ojú omi ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà sọ pé àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú omi tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ nítòsí láti mú kí àgọ́ náà dára sí i tún ran àwọn tí wọ́n ń gbé lọ́wọ́ nínú ìgbèjà náà lọ́wọ́ nípa lílo ọkọ̀ ojú omi tí a lè fọwọ́ kan láti gbé àwọn ènìyàn lọ sí etíkun kí ọkọ̀ ojú omi náà tó rì nínú omi tó jinlẹ̀ tó 30 mítà (100 ẹsẹ̀).
rows.reference: Àjọ ọmọ-ogun omi Ti ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lóri ibùdóò àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú-omi lo ọkọ̀ ojú-omi láti gbé àwọn èèyàn láti iwọ̀n ọgbọ̀n (30) sí ibi tí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà rì sí lọ sí orí ilẹ̀.

rows.source: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates 111 people have died in crashes of PNG-registered airlines in the past two decades but none involved Air Niugini.
rows.output: Data lati Aviation Safety Network fihan pe eniyan 111 ti ku ninu awọn ijamba ti awọn ọkọ ofurufu ti o forukọsilẹ PNG ni awọn ọdun meji sẹhin ṣugbọn ko si ninu wọn pẹlu Air Niugini.
rows.reference: Àkọsílẹ̀ Aviation Safety Network fi hàn pé àwọn èèyàn 111 l’ọ́n ti kú láàrin ogún ọdún látàrí ìjàm̀bá ọkọ-òfúrufú tí wọ́n wà ní egbẹ́ PNG, àmọ́ Air Niugini ‘ò sí níbẹ̀.

rows.source: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive
rows.output: Onímọ̀ ọgbọ́n orí ṣe àtòkọ àkókò tí obìnrin náà jẹ́ alágbára
rows.reference: Agbaniníyànjú sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àkókò tí wọ́n sun obìnrin tó ń rìnde òru lóòyẹ̀.

rows.source: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
rows.output: Ìjìyà náà parí ọjọ́ Satidee ní ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà kan tí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan pé ó jókò lórí obìnrin Mississippi kan ní 2014.
rows.reference: Olùpẹ̀jọ́ parí ọ̀rọ̀ tiẹ̀ ní àkókò ẹjọ́ tó kan ọmọkùnrin tó sun ọmọbìnrin tó wá láti Mississippi lóòyẹ̀ ní ọdún 2014.

rows.source: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.
rows.output: Onímọ̀ ọgbọ́n orí ní U.S. Department of Justice, Paul Rowlett, jẹ́ ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ẹlẹ́gbẹ́ nínú ẹ̀ka ìmọ̀ ọgbọ́n orí.
rows.reference: U.S. Paul Rowlett, tó jẹ́ agbaniníyànjú ní ẹ̀ka Òfin, jẹ́ ẹlẹ́rìí òun akọṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ lórí ọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyé.

rows.source: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.
rows.output: Ó ṣe àpèjúwe fún àwọn olùgbọ́ ìdájọ́ bí ó ṣe lo àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ fóònù alágbèéká láti fi kó àwọn ìrìn àjò ti ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin 29 ọdún, Quinton Tellis, àti ọ̀dọ́mọbìnrin 19 ọdún, Jessica Chambers, ní alẹ́ tí ó kú.
rows.reference: Ó ṣàlàyé fún adájọ́ bí òun ṣe fi fóònù fíìmù ẹniàpélẹ́jọ́, Quinton Tellis, ọmọ ọdún 29, àti ẹni tí ó pa, Jessica Chambers, ọmọ ọdún 19, ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ tó kú.

rows.source: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .
rows.output: Ìwé ìròyìn Clarion Ledger sọ pé Rowlett sọ pé ó gba data ibi tí ó fi hàn pé Tellis wà pẹ̀lú Chambers ní alẹ́ tí ó kú, èyí tó tako àwọn ẹ̀sù tí ó ti sọ tẹ́lẹ̀.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àtẹ̀jáde tó wà ní The Clarion Ledger, Rowlett ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ fóònù fi hàn pé Tellis àti Chambers jọ wà papọ̀ ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ tí ọmọbìnrin náà kú. Àmọ́ Tellis ní kò rí bẹ́ẹ̀.

rows.source: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.
rows.output: Nígbà tí data fi hàn pé fóònù rẹ̀ wà pẹ̀lú Chambers ní àkókò tí ó sọ pé òun wà pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ Michael Sanford, àwọn ọlọ́pàá lọ láti bá Sanford sọ̀rọ̀.
rows.reference: Ní àkókò tó ní òun wà pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ òun, Michael Sanford, ẹ̀rí fi hàn pé fóònù ẹ̀ wà lọ́wọ́ Chambers. Ìdí rèé tí àwọn ọlọ́pàá fi pe Sanford wá sí àágọ wọn.

rows.source: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.
rows.output: Sanford dúró ní ọjọ́ Satidee, ó sì sọ pé kò sí ní ìlú náà ní ọjọ́ yẹn.
rows.reference: Sanford náà wá jẹ́rìí ní ọjọ́ Sátidé. Àmọ́ ó ní òun ‘ò sí nílé ní ọjọ́ tí Telli ń sọ.

rows.source: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."
rows.output: Nígbà tí àwọn olùgbèjà sọ pé, “Ṣé Tèllìs ń sọ òtítọ́ nípa pé òun wà nínú ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ Sanford ní alẹ́ yẹn?” Sanford sọ pé, “Ó ń purọ́, nítorí pé ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ mi wà ní Nashville.”
rows.reference: Olùpẹjọ́ bíi Tellis léèerè pé ǹjẹ́ òótọ́ ni Tellis wà nínú ọkọ̀-ajàgbé ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ tí ìṣẹlẹ̀ yí ṣẹ̀? Sanford dáhùn. Ó ní “Irọ́ ló pa a torí Nashville ni ọkọ̀-ajàgbe wà ní ọjọ́ náà.

rows.source: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.
rows.output: Ìyàtọ̀ mìíràn ni pé, Tèllìs sọ pé òun ti mọ́ Chambers fún bíi ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì ṣáájú ikú rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Tellis tún pa irọ́ mìíì. Ó ní kòju ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì tí òun mọ Chambers ló kú.

rows.source: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.
rows.output: Àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ fóònù alágbèéká fi hàn pé wọn mọ ara wọn fún ọ̀sẹ̀ kan ṣoṣo.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ àkọsílẹ̀ fóònù ní wọn ‘ò mọra ju ọ̀sẹ̀ kan lọ.

rows.source: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.
rows.output: Rowlett sọ pé nígbàmíràn lẹ́yìn ikú Chambers, Tellis yọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ Chambers, àwọn ìpè, àti ìsopọ̀ rẹ̀ kúrò ní fóònù rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Rowlett ní lẹ́yìn ikú Chambers, Tellis pa lẹ́tà àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́, ìpè, àti nọ́ḿbà Chambers kúrò lóri fóònùu ẹ̀.

rows.source: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.
rows.output: "Ó pa á kúrò nínú ìgbésí ayé rẹ̀," Hale sọ.
rows.reference: Lérò Hale, “Ó mu kúrò láyé ẹ̀.”

rows.source: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.
rows.output: Ìjìyà náà ti ṣètò láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjìyà rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ Sundee.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Àìkú, ẹniapèlẹ́jọ́ máa kẹ́sẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ ẹ̀ nílẹ̀

rows.source: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.
rows.output: Onidajọ na sọ pe o nireti pe ẹjọ naa yoo lọ si awọn ọmọ-ogun ni opin ọjọ yẹn.
rows.reference: Adájọ́ ní ẹjọ́ náà máa dé ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn àpapọ̀ adájọ́ kí ilẹ̀ tó ṣú ní ọjọ́ náà.

rows.source: The High Breed: What is conscious hip hop?
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n Gíga: Kí ni ìmúrasílẹ̀ hip hop?
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ High Breed Kí ni ìtumọ̀ orin hip hop tó dá lórí òṣèlú àti àwùjọ?

rows.source: A hip hop trio wants to challenge the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ hip hop mẹ́ta fẹ́ sọ ìwòye tí ó burú ti irú ẹ̀dá náà di àfihàni nípa fífi orin wọn kún pẹ̀lú àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ rere.
rows.reference: Àwọn eléré hip hop mẹ́ta ní àwọn ṣe tán láti lo hip hop fún ìdàgbàsókè àti ìwúrí.

rows.source: The High Breed, from Bristol, claim hip hop moved away from its origins of political messages and tackling social issues.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀n Ìbèrè, láti Bristol, sọ pé hip hop ti lọ kúrò nínú àwọn ìpìlẹ̀ rẹ̀ ti àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ òṣèlú àti ìṣòro àwùjọ.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ High Breed láti Bristol ní hip hop ti fi orísun ẹ̀ sílẹ̀ tó dá lórí òṣèlú àti àwùjọ.

rows.source: They want to go back to its roots and make conscious hip hop popular again.
rows.output: Wọn fẹ́ padà sí àwọn gbòǹgbò rẹ̀ kí wọn sì mú orin hip hop mọ́gbọ́n dání padà wá.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ wọ́n tí pinnu láti padà sí orísun hip hop.

rows.source: Artists like The Fugees and Common have seen a recent resurgence in the UK through artists such as Akala and Lowkey.
rows.output: Àwọn oṣere bíi The Fugees àti Common ti ní ìrísí àtọkànwá ní UK nípasẹ̀ àwọn oṣere bíi Akala àti Lowkey.
rows.reference: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn òǹkọrin bíi Akala àti Lowkey ti tọ ipàsẹ̀ The Fugees àti Common ní orílẹ̀-èdè UK.

rows.source: Another black person?!
rows.output: Ẹni dúdú mìíràn?!
rows.reference: Èèyàn dúdú kẹ̀?

rows.source: NY nanny sues couple over firing after "racist" text
rows.output: Obìnrin olùtọ́jú ọmọ ní New York ń bá àwọn tọkọtaya náà tí wọ́n lé kúrò ní iṣẹ́ lẹ́yìn “ìwà ọ̀daràn” ọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀rọ̀
rows.reference: Agbọmọtọ́ ní New York gbé tọkọtaya t’ọ́n da dúró, t’ọ́n tú tẹ lẹ́tà àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà si lọ sí kọ́ọ̀tù.

rows.source: A New York nanny is suing a couple for discriminatory firing after receiving a misdirected text from the mother complaining that she was "another black person."
rows.output: Obìnrin olùtọ́jú ọmọ ní New York ń béèrè fún àwọn tọkọtaya náà ní ilé ẹjọ́ nítorí ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ tí wọ́n fi lé e lọ́wọ́ lẹ́yìn tí ó ti gba ọ̀rọ̀ ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ tí kò tọ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìyá náà tí ó sọ pé òun jẹ́ “ọmọ ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà mìíràn.”
rows.reference: Agbọmọtọ́ ní New York gbé tọkọtaya lọ sí ilé-ẹjọ́ látàrí ìdádúró lẹnu iṣẹ́ láìnídìí. K’ọ́n tó dá agbọmọtọ́ dúró, màmá ọmọ náà t pè é ní “èèyàn dúdú.”

rows.source: The couple deny they are racist, likening the suit to "extortion."
rows.output: Àwọn tọkọtaya náà kọ̀ láti jẹ́ oníjàgídíjàgan, wọ́n sì fi ẹ̀sùn kan ẹ̀sùn náà sí “ìfipá mú.”
rows.reference: Àmọ́ tọkọtaya ni àwọn kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà. Wọn ní “ìlónilọ́wọ́gbà” ni ìpẹ́jọ yí.

rows.source: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, a mother of two, expressed dismay when finding out that the new child care provider, Giselle Maurice, was black upon arriving for her first day of work in 2016.
rows.output: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, ìyá méjì, fi ìbànújẹ́ hàn nígbà tí ó rí i pé olùtọ́jú ọmọ tuntun, Giselle Maurice, jẹ́ dúdú nígbà tí ó dé ibi iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ ní ọdún 2016.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún 2016, gbàrà ti Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, ìyá ọlọ́mọ, bá Giselle Maurice pàdé ní ọjọ́ àkọ́kọ́ tí Giselle Maurice wá sílẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí agbọmọtọ́, ẹnú yà á torí pé èèyàn dúdú ni i.

rows.source: "NOOOOOOOOOOO ANOTHER BLACK PERSON," wrote Mrs Plasco-Flaxman to her husband in a text.
rows.output: "RÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁR
rows.reference: ”ÈÈYÀN DÚDÚ KẸ̀? ‘Ò TÍ OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO,” ni àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ tí Aya Plasco-Flaxman kọ sí ọkọ ẹ̀.

rows.source: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Maurice, twice.
rows.output: Àmọ́ nígbèésí, dípò fífi rẹ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ọkọ rẹ̀, ó fi ránṣẹ́ sí Ms. Maurice, lẹ́ẹ̀mejì.
rows.reference: Dípò kó tẹ̀ ẹ́ sí nọ́ḿbà ọkọ ẹ̀, ó ṣèṣì tẹ̀ ẹ́ sí nọ́ḿbà Omidan Maurice ní èèmejì.

rows.source: After realizing her gaffe, an "uncomfortable" Plasco-Flaxman fired Ms. Maurice, stating that their outgoing nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and that she was instead expecting a Filipino, according to the New York Post.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí ó mọ̀ pé ìṣòro kan wà, Plasco-Flaxman tí ó ń ṣe àbójútó náà lé Ms. Maurice kúrò, ó sì sọ pé nọ́ọ̀sì wọn tó ń jáde, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọmọ Afíríka, kò ṣe iṣẹ́ tó dára, ó sì ń retí ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọmọ Filipino, gẹ́gẹ́ bí New York Post ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Látàrí àṣìṣe yìí, ara Aya Plasco-Flaxman “‘ò balẹ̀”. Kíá ló dá Omidan Maurice dúró. Ó ní ọmọ Filipino ni òun ń wá. Àtipé, ọmọ Amẹríkà-ṣe-Adúláwò tí òún gba tẹ́lẹ̀, iṣẹ́ ẹ̀ ‘ò dára tó ni ohun tí New York Post sọ.

rows.source: Ms. Maurice was paid for her one day of work and then sent home for an Uber.
rows.output: Arábìnrin Maurice ni wọ́n sanwó fún ọjọ́ kan tí wọ́n sì rán lọ sí ilé fún Uber.
rows.reference: Owó ọjọ́ kan ló san an fún omidan náà, Bẹ́ẹ̀ ‘ó ní kí ọkọ̀ Uber da pádà sílé ẹ̀.

rows.source: Now, Maurice is suing the couple for compensation over the firing, and is seeking compensation to the tune of $350 a day for the six-month, live-in gig she had initially been hired to do, albeit without a contract.
rows.output: Ní báyìí, Maurice ń bá àwọn tọkọtaya náà jẹ́ fún ìsanwó lórí ìfipòpadà, ó sì ń wá ìsanwó tó tó dọ́là 350 lójoojúmọ́ fún iṣẹ́ ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́fà, tí ó ń gbé nínú ilé tí wọ́n ti yàn án láti ṣe, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò sí ìwé àdéhùn.
rows.reference: Omidan Maurice ní kí tọkọtaya yìí san owó-gbaà-má-binú fún òun látàrí ìdáduụró lẹ́nu iṣẹ́. Ó ní kí wọ́n san 350 dọlà ní ojúmọ́ fun oṣù mẹ́fà, gbé àdúgbò olówó ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àdéhùn tó wà láàrin wọn tẹ́lẹ̀ bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò sí àkọsílẹ̀ láàárin wọn.

rows.source: "I want to show them, look, you don't do stuff like that," she told the Post on Friday, adding "I know it's discrimination."
rows.output: "Mo fẹ́ fi hàn wọn, wo, o ò ń ṣe nǹkan bíi èyí," ó sọ fún Post ní ọjọ Jimọ, ó sì fi kun "Mo mọ̀ pé ó jẹ́ ìyàsọ́tọ̀."
rows.reference: ”Wọ́n á gbà. Wọn kì í ṣe nǹkan bẹ́ẹ̀ yẹn,” ni ohun tí ó sọ fún Post ti ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Ní àfikún, “Ó ní ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà ni.”

rows.source: The couple have hit back at the claims that they are racist, saying that terminating Maurice's employment was the reasonable thing to do, fearing they could not trust her after offending her.
rows.output: Àwọn tọkọtaya náà ti dáhùn sí ẹ̀sùn pé wọn jẹ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà, ní sọ pé ìfipáṣẹ́ ìṣòwò Maurice jẹ́ ohun tó yẹ, ní ìbẹ̀rù pé wọn kò lè gbọ́yà rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n bá bàa jẹ́.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ àwọn tọkọtaya yìí ní àwọn kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà. Wọ́n ní bí àwọn ṣe dá Maurice dúró ló da torí kò ṣé e fi inú tán án mọ́ látàrí ẹ̀sẹ̀ tí á̀wọn ṣẹ̀ ẹ́.

rows.source: "My wife had sent her something that she didn't mean to say.
rows.output: "Ẹ̀yà ara mi ti fi nǹkán ránṣẹ́ sí i tí kò fẹ́ sọ.
rows.reference: ”Ohun tí ìyàwó mi sọ ṣè ṣì ni.

rows.source: She's not a racist.
rows.output: Kò jẹ́ oníjàgídíjàgan.
rows.reference: Kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyá̀.

rows.source: We're not racist people," husband Joel Plasco told the Post.
rows.output: A kìí ṣe ènìyàn oníjàgídíjàgan, ọkùnrín Joel Plasco sọ fún Post náà.
rows.reference: A kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà,” ni ohun ti ọkọ ẹ̀, Joel Plasco sọ fún Post.

rows.source: "But would you put your children in the hands of someone you've been rude to, even if it was by mistake?
rows.output: Ṣugbọn yóò fi àwọn ọmọ rẹ̀ sí ọwọ́ ẹnìkan tí o ti kọ̀ láti fi ẹ̀bùn rẹ̀ hàn, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ó jẹ́ àṣìṣe?
rows.reference: ”Kò ṣéeṣe fún wa lái kó àwọn ọmọ wa tìí látàrí aáwọ̀ tó wà láàárin wa bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àṣìṣe ló fà á.

rows.source: Your newborn baby?
rows.output: Ìyẹn ni ọmọ rẹ tuntun?
rows.reference: Àbí èèyàn lè kó àwọn ọmọbíbí èèyàn tìí?

rows.source: Come on."
rows.output: "Ẹ wá."
rows.reference: Ka má ri.”

rows.source: Likening the suit to "extortion," Plasco said his wife was just two months off having a baby and was in a "very difficult situation."
rows.output: Ṣíṣe àfihàn ẹ̀wù náà sí “ìfipá mú,” Plasco sọ pé ìyàwó rẹ̀ jẹ́ méjì péré ní ìdá mẹ́ta láti bí ọmọ kan, ó sì wà nínú ipò “tí ó nira gan-an.”
rows.reference: Ọkọ ẹ̀ ni “ìlọ́nilọ́wọ́gbà” ni ẹjọ́ náà torí kò ju oṣù méjì tí ìyàwó òun ṣẹ̀ bímọ. Àtipé “kò gbádùn ara ẹ̀.”

rows.source: "You're going to go after someone like that?
rows.output: "O ma n lọ lọ́wọ́ ẹnìkan bí èyí?
rows.reference: Ṣé irú èèyàb bẹ́ẹ̀ yẹn ni èèyàn máa bá fa wàhálà?”

rows.source: That's not a very nice thing to do," the investment banker added.
rows.output: "Ìyẹn kìí ṣe ohun rere láti ṣe," ẹni tí ó ń ṣe ìdoko-owò náà fi kún un.
rows.reference: Kò tọ̀nà rárá,” ni ohun tí òṣìṣẹ́ báǹkì lórí ìdókòwò wí,

rows.source: While the legal case is still ongoing, the court of public opinion has been quick to denounce the couple on social media, slamming them for their behavior and logic.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ẹjọ́ náà ṣì ń lọ, ilé ẹjọ́ gbogbogbòò ti yára ju láti dáhùn àwọn tọkọtaya náà lórí àwọn mídíà àwùjọ, tí wọ́n ń fi ẹ̀sùn kan wọn fún ìwà wọn àti ìmọ̀ ọgbọ́n orí wọn.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ejọ́ wà ní ilé-ẹjọ́, àmọ́ àwọn èèyàn káàkiri orí íntánẹ́ẹ́tì ti bu ẹnu àtẹ́ lu tọkọtaya náà fún ìwà t’ọ́n wù.

rows.source: Paddington publishers feared readers wouldn't relate to a talking bear, new letter reveals
rows.output: Àwọn olùtẹ̀jáde Paddington bẹ̀rù pé àwọn olùkà kòní ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú bèárì tó ń sọ̀rọ̀, lẹ́tà tuntun fi hàn.
rows.reference: Lẹ́tà tí èẹ̀yàn kan kọ fi hàn pé ẹ̀rù ń ba ilé-ìtẹ̀wé Paddington torí pé wọ́n ní ó ṣẹéṣe kí àwọn èèyàn máa rí ọgbọ́n nínú àtẹ̀jáde tó ní ajá igbó ń sọ̀rọ̀.

rows.source: Bond's daughter Karen Jankel, who was born shortly after the book was accepted, said of the letter: "It's hard to put oneself in the shoes of somebody reading it for the first time before it was published.
rows.output: Ìyàwó Bond, Karen Jankel, tí a bí ní kíákíá lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n gba ìwé náà, sọ nípa lẹ́tà náà: “Ó nira láti fi ara rẹ̀ sínú bẹ́ẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni tí ń ka ìwé náà fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ kí wọ́n tó tẹ̀ jáde.
rows.reference: Karen Jankel, ọmọ tí Bond bíi lẹ́yìn tí àwọn èèyàn tẹ́wọ́gba ìwé yìí ló sọ̀rọ̀ nípa lẹ́tà náà. Ó ní: “Ǹjẹ́ ó ṣẹéṣe láti fi ara èèyàn sí ipò ẹni tó kọ́ kàwé yìí k’ọ́n tó tẹ̀ ẹ́?

rows.source: It's very amusing knowing now what we know about Paddington's huge success."
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ohun tó ń jẹ́ kí ènìyàn rẹ́rìn-ín láti mọ̀ báyìí pé a mọ̀ nípa ìrísí ńlá ti Paddington.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé gbogbo wa lè sọ nípa àseyọrí ǹlà ti Paddington látàrí ìwé yìí.”

rows.source: Saying her father, who had worked as a BBC cameraman before being inspired to write the children's book by a small toy bear, would have been sanguine about his work being rejected, she added the 60th anniversary of the books publication was "bittersweet" after his death last year.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé bàbá rẹ̀, ẹni tí ó ti ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí olùṣàkóso fídíò BBC ṣáájú kí ó tó ní ìmísí láti kọ ìwé àwọn ọmọdé náà nípa ọ̀rùndún kékeré kan, yóò ti ní ìdùnnú nípa iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ tí a kọ̀ láti ọwọ́ rẹ̀. Ṣùgbọ́n ó tún sọ pé ọjọ́ ìbí ọdún 60 tí ìwé náà jáde jẹ́ “ìdùnnú” lẹ́yìn ikú rẹ̀ ní ọdún tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Ó ní bàbá òun tó kọ ìwé ná́à ṣiṣẹ́ onífídíò pẹ̀lú BBC rìí. Ó ní bàbá òun ní ìmísí láti kọ ìwé náà látàrí ajá igbó ọlọ́mọlangidi. Ó ní ọkàn kan ni bàbá òun fi kọ ìwé náà bí ó tiẹ̀ ń bẹ̀rù pé àwọn èèyàn lè máa tẹ́wọ́gbà á. “Ìbànújẹ́oọunayọ̀” ni pé ó ti tó ọgọ́ta ọdún tí ìwé náà ti jáde bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé bàbá òun kú ní ọdún tó kọjá.

rows.source: Of Paddington, whom she describes as a "very important member of our family," she added her father was quietly proud of his eventual success.
rows.output: Láti inú Páàdìngtọ́n, ẹni tí ó ṣàpèjúwe gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ pàtàkì nínú ìdílé wa,” ó fi kún un pé bàbá rẹ̀ ní ìdùnnú tó jinlẹ̀ sí àṣeyọrí rẹ̀ nígbàmígbá.
rows.reference: Ó ní Paddington “ti di ara ẹbí wa,” àtipé inú bàbá mi dùn sí àṣeyọrí ẹ̀.

rows.source: "He was quite a quiet man, and he wasn't a boastful person," she said.
rows.output: "Ó jẹ́ ọkùnrin aláàánú, tí kò sì jẹ́ ẹni tí ó fẹ́ràn láti sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ara rẹ̀," ni ó sọ.
rows.reference: ”Èèyàn jẹ́jẹ́ tí kì í ṣe onígbèrágaa ni.”

rows.source: "But because Paddington was so real to him, it was almost like if you have a child who achieves something: you're proud of them even though it's not your doing really.
rows.output: "Ṣùgbọ́n nítorí pé Páàdìngtọ́n jẹ́ gidi gan-an sí i, ó dàbí pé bí o bá ní ọmọ tí ó ṣe nǹkan: o ní ìgbọràn nínú wọn bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kìí ṣe ìṣé rẹ̀ gan-an.
rows.reference: Torí àjọṣe Paddington àti bàbá mi wọnú ara wọn, àṣeyọrí Paddington jẹ́ ìwúrí fún bàbá mi torí bàbá àti ọmọ ni àwọn méjèèjì.

rows.source: I think he viewed Paddington's success sort of in that way.
rows.output: Mo lérò pé ó wo ìṣeyàtọ̀ tí Paddington ní bí bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí àjọṣẹ wọn ṣe rí nìyẹn.

rows.source: Although it was his creation and his imagination, he always used to give the credit to Paddington himself."
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ó jẹ́ ẹ̀dá rẹ̀ àti ìmọ̀lára rẹ̀, ó máa ń fi ẹ̀sùnkún fún Pádingtọ́n fúnra rẹ̀."
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé bàbá mi ló kọ ìwé náà, ó máa n gbóríyìn fún Paddington fún àṣeyọrí ẹ̀.”

rows.source: My daughter was dying and I had to say goodbye over the phone
rows.output: Ọmọbinrin mi ń kú, mo sì ní láti sọ fún un pé kí nọ́ ṣe kí n sọ̀rọ̀ lọ́nà tààrà
rows.reference: Orí fóònù ni mo ti dágbére fún ọmọ mi obìnrin tó ń kú lo pé ó digbére.

rows.source: On landing her daughter had been rushed to Nice's Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, where doctors worked in vain to save her life.
rows.output: Nígbà tí wọ́n dé, wọ́n gbé ọmọbìnrin náà lọ sí Ilé ìwòsàn Louis Pasteur 2 ní Nice, níbi tí àwọn dókítà ti ṣiṣẹ́ láìdáni láti gba ẹ̀mí rẹ̀ là.
rows.reference: Ilé-ìwòsàn Nice ní Louis Pasteur 2 ni wọ́n gbé ọmọbìnrin yìí lọ àmọ́ àwọn dókítà gbìyànjú, síbẹ̀, ó kú ni.

rows.source: "Nad was calling regularly to say it was really bad, that she wasn't expected to make it," said Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.output: "Nadì ni o ń pè ní gbogbo ìgbà láti sọ pé ó burú jù, pé kò ní retí láti wà láàyè," ni Ìyáàfin Ednan-Laperouse sọ.
rows.reference: Aya Ednan-Laperouse ní “gbogbo ìgbà ni Nad ń pè láti mọ bóyá ó máa yèé.”

rows.source: "Then I got the call from Nad to say she was going to die within the next two minutes and I had to say goodbye to her.
rows.output: "Ìyẹn ni mo gba ìpè láti ọ̀dọ̀ Nad láti sọ fún mi pé òun yóò kú ní ìṣẹ́jú méjì tí ó bá ti kọjá, mo sì ní láti sọ fún un pé kí n máa bọ̀wọ̀ fún un.
rows.reference: Nad náà ló tún pè mí láti sọ fún mi pé láàrin ìṣẹ́jú méjì, ọmọ náà máa kú. Bẹ́è ni mo ní ó digbére.

rows.source: And I did.
rows.output: Mo sì ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Mo ní ó digbére.

rows.source: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, darling.
rows.output: Mo wí pé, “Tààrà, mo nífẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ ju, olólùfẹ́ mi.
rows.reference: Mo ní, “Tashi, ọmọ dáadáa, mo ní ìfẹ ẹ.

rows.source: I'll be with you soon.
rows.output: Mo máa wà pẹ̀lú rẹ ní kíákíá.
rows.reference: Mò ń bò láìpẹ́.

rows.source: I'll be with you.
rows.output: Emi yóò wà pẹ̀lú rẹ.
rows.reference: Mò ń bò wá bá ẹ.

rows.source: The drugs doctors had given her to keep her heart pumping were slowly petering out and leaving her system.
rows.output: Àwọn òògùn tí àwọn dókítà ti fún un láti pa ọkàn rẹ̀ mọ́ ti ń lọra láti já sílẹ̀̀ àti láti jáde kúrò nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn oògùn tí dókítà fún láti lè mí kò ṣiṣẹ́ lára mọ.

rows.source: She had died some time before hand and this was it all shutting down.
rows.output: Ó ti kú ní àkókò kan ṣáájú, èyí ni gbogbo ohun tí ń ṣe.
rows.reference: Ó ti kú sára kó tó dágbére pátápátá.

rows.source: I had to just sit there and wait, knowing this was all unfolding.
rows.output: Mo ní láti jókò síbè kí n dúró, mo mọ̀ pé gbogbo èyí ń ṣẹlẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni mò ń wòó bó se ń ṣẹlẹ̀.

rows.source: I couldn't howl or scream or cry because I was in a situation surrounded by families and people.
rows.output: Mi ò lè kigbe tàbí pariwo tàbí sunkún nítorí pé mo wà nínú ipò kan tí ó yí mi ká, tí ó kún fún àwọn ìdílé àti àwọn ènìyàn.
rows.reference: N kò lè kígbe tàbí ké torí àwọn mọ̀lẹbí t’ọ́n wà pẹ̀lú mi.

rows.source: I had to really hold it together."
rows.output: Mo ní láti máa fi ara mọ́ ara mi.
rows.reference: Mo gbe sára ni.”

rows.source: Eventually Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, by now grieving for the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane alongside the other passengers - oblivious to the ordeal she was going through.
rows.output: Nígbèkùndò, Ìyáàfin Ednan-Laperouse, tí ó ti ń banújẹ́ fún ìpàdánù ọmọbìnrin rẹ̀, wọ inú ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà pẹ̀lú àwọn arìnrìn-àjò yòókù - láì mọ̀ pé ó ń lọ sí ìrìnkiri.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Aya Ednan-Laperouse ń ṣàárò ọmọ e tó kú, àmọ́ ó wọ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú pẹ̀lú àwọn èrò tó kù láìmọ ohun tó ṣee ẹ́.

rows.source: "No-one knew," she said.
rows.output: "Kòsí ẹni tí ó mọ̀," ó sọ.
rows.reference: Kò sí ẹni tó mọ̀.

rows.source: "I had my head down, and tears were falling the whole time.
rows.output: "Mo fi orí mi sílẹ̀, tí omi ìdọ̀tí sì ń ṣubú nígbà gbogbo.
rows.reference: Màmá ẹ̀ sorí kodò, bẹ́è ni omi ń dà lójú ẹ̀.

rows.source: It's hard to explain, but it was on the flight I felt this overwhelming sense of sympathy for Nad.
rows.output: Ó ṣòro láti ṣàlàyé, ṣùgbọ́n ó wà nínú ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà ni mo nímọ̀lára ìmúláradá ńlá fún Nad.
rows.reference: Nǹkan to fà á mo ‘ò le sọ àmọ́ àánú Nad ṣe mí.

rows.source: That he needed my love and understanding.
rows.output: Ó nílò ìfẹ́ mi àti òye mi.
rows.reference: Mo gbọ́dọ̀ fi ìfẹ́ àti àánú ba lo ní àkókò yí.

rows.source: I knew how much he loved her."
rows.output: Mo mọ̀ bí ó ti nífẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀."
rows.reference: Ó nífẹ̀ẹ́ ọmọ mi mi obìnrin gan-an.

rows.source: Grieving women post cards to prevent suicides on bridge
rows.output: Àwọn obìnrin tí ń bẹ̀rù ń fi kọ́kọ́rín ránṣẹ́ láti dènà ìpànìyàn lórí afárá
rows.reference: Àwọn obìnrin tí wọn pàdánù àwọn èèyàn wọn le káàdì mọ́ afárá-ẹlẹ́sẹ̀.

rows.source: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide are working to prevent others from taking their own lives.
rows.output: Àwọn obìnrin méjì tí wọ́n pàdánù àwọn olólùfẹ́ wọn sí ikú ara ẹni ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti dènà àwọn ẹlòmíràn láti gbé ìgbé ayé wọn kúrò.
rows.reference: Àwọn obìnrin méjì tí wọ́n pàddánù àyànfẹ́ wọn nípaṣẹ́ ìgbẹ́mí ara ẹni ni wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti dènà àwọn míràn lọ́wọ́ ìgbẹ̀mí ara ẹni.

rows.source: Sharon Davis and Kelly Humphreys have been posting cards on a Welsh bridge with inspirational messages and phone numbers that people can call for support.
rows.output: Sharon Davis àti Kelly Humphreys ti ń fi àwọn kọ́kósì ránṣẹ́ sórí àpáta Welsh pẹ̀lú àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ ìmísí àti àwọn nọ́mù fóònù tí àwọn ènìyàn lè pè fún àtìlẹ́yìn.
rows.reference: Sharon Davis àti Kelly Humphreys ní wọ́n ti ń lẹ Káàdì káàkiri lórí afárá Welsh pẹ̀lú àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ awúnilórí àti àwọn nọ́ńbà fóònù tí àwọn ènìyàn le pè fún àtìlẹyìn.

rows.source: Ms Davis' son Tyler was 13 when he began suffering with depression and killed himself aged 18.
rows.output: Ìyàwó Dáfídì, Tyler, jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún mẹ́tàlá nígbà tí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní jiyàn pẹ̀lú ìbànújẹ́ tí ó sì pa ara rẹ̀ ní ọdún méjìdínlógún.
rows.reference: Ọmọ ọkùnrin Ìyàáfin Davis, Tyler, jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 13 nígbàtí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì ọkàn tí ó sì pa ara rẹ.

rows.source: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I have to feel everyday," she said.
rows.output: "Mi ò fẹ́ kí ìyá tàbí bàbá kankan ní ìmọ̀lára tí mo máa ń ní lójoojúmọ́," ni ó sọ.
rows.reference: "Èmi kó fẹ́ kí òbí kankan fójú sunkún ọmọ bí tèmi lójoojúmọ́ ayé,” ó sọ bẹ́ẹ̀,”

rows.source: Ms Davis, aged 45, who lives in Lydney, said her son was a promising chef with an infectious grin.
rows.output: Arábìnrin Davis, tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 45, tó ń gbé ní Lydney, sọ pé ọmọ rẹ̀ jẹ́ olùṣètò oúnjẹ tó ní ìmúra, tó sì ní ẹ̀rín tó ń múni lọ́kàn.
rows.reference: Ìyàáfin Davis, ọmọ ọdún 45, tíó ń gbé ní Lydney, sọ pé ọmọ òun jẹ́ olúwáńjẹ tí ‘’o ní ọjọ́ iwáajú pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rín tó fanimọ́ra

rows.source: "Everyone knew him for his smile.
rows.output: "Ẹnikẹ́ni mọ̀ ọ́ fún ẹ̀rín rẹ̀.
rows.reference: "Gbogbo èníyàn ló mọ́ fún rínrín ẹ̀rín múṣẹ́.

rows.source: They always said his smile lit up any room."
rows.output: Wọ́n máa ń sọ pé ẹ̀rín rẹ̀ ń tan ilé gbogbo tí ó bá wọlé.
rows.reference: Wọ́n máa ń sábà sọ wípé ẹ̀rín rẹ̀ máa ń hey always said his smile lit up any room."

rows.source: However, he gave up work before he died, as he was "in a really dark place."
rows.output: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, ó fi iṣẹ́ sílẹ̀ kí ó tó kú, nítorí pé òun wà “ní ibi òkùnkùn gan-an.”
rows.reference: O fi iṣẹ́ sílẹ̀ kó tó kù torí “inú òkùkùn ló wà”.

rows.source: In 2014, Tyler's brother, who was 11 at the time, was the one to find his sibling after he had taken his own life.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 2014, arakùnrin Tyler, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọdún 11 ní àkókò yẹn, ni ó rí i tí ó sì rí i lẹ́yìn tí ó ti gbé ìgbésí ayé rẹ̀ lọ.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún 2014, àbúrò Tyler, ọmo-ọdún 11, ló rí òkú ẹ̀gbọ́n ẹ̀ tó pa ara ẹ̀.

rows.source: Ms Davis said: "I continually worry that there's going to be a knock on effect."
rows.output: Arábìnrin Davis sọ pé: “Mo ń bẹ̀rù pé ìyípadà kan yóò ṣẹlẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Ìyáàfin Davis sọ pé: “Èrò mi ni pé ó ma tó kan ilẹ̀kùn.”

rows.source: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.
rows.output: Arábìnrin Davis dá àwọn kaadi náà sílẹ̀, “láti jẹ́ kí àwọn ènìyàn mọ̀ pé àwọn ènìyàn wà níta tí o lè lọ sọ̀rọ̀ sí, paapaa bí ó bá jẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́ kan.
rows.reference: Aya Davis te káàdì yìí láti ta àwọn èèyàn jí láti bá èèyàn kan tàbí ọ̀rẹ́ kan sọ̀rọ̀.”

rows.source: Don't sit in silence - you need to talk."
rows.output: "Maṣe jókò nínú ìdákẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ́jẹ
rows.reference: Má dakẹ́ – sọ̀rọ̀.

rows.source: Ms Humphreys, who has been friends with Ms Davies for years, lost Mark, her partner of 15 years, not long after the death of his mother.
rows.output: Arábìnrin Humphreys, ẹni tí ó ti mọ̀ Arábìnrin Davies fún ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún, pàdánù Mark, alábàá rẹ̀ fún ọdún mẹ́rìnlá, láìpẹ́ lẹ́yìn ikú ìyá rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Aya Humphreys, ọ̀rẹ́ ọjọ́ pípẹ́ lòun àti Aya Davies. Mark, ọkọ Humphreys fún ọdún 15, kú lẹ́yìn ikú màmá ẹ̀.

rows.source: "He didn't say that he was feeling down or depressed or anything," she said.
rows.output: "Ó sọ pé òun kò ní ìmọ̀lára tàbí ìbànújẹ́ tàbí ohunkóhun," ni ó sọ.
rows.reference: Humphreys ní ”Kò ní nǹkan mú òun,”

rows.source: "A couple of days before Christmas we noticed his change in attitude.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ díẹ̀ ṣáájú Kérésìmesì, a rí ìyípadà nínú ìhùwàsí rẹ̀.
rows.reference: ”Kérésìmesì ku ọjọ́ bíi mélòó kan la kófìrí ìyàtọ̀ nínú ìṣesí ẹ̀.

rows.source: He was at rock bottom on Christmas Day - when the kids opened their presents he didn't make eye contact with them or anything."
rows.output: Ó wà ní ìsàlẹ̀ òkè ní ọjọ́ Kérésìmesì - nígbà tí àwọn ọmọ náà ṣí àwọn ẹ̀bùn wọn, kò bá wọn wo ojú tàbí ohunkóhun.
rows.reference: Kò sọ ‘ó’ ní ọjọ́ Kérésìmesì rárá. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò sọ nǹkan bí àwọn ọmọ ṣe ṣí ẹ̀bùn ọdún wọn.”

rows.source: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé ikú rẹ̀ jẹ́ ìbànújẹ́ ńlá fún wọn, ṣùgbọ́n wọn ní láti ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú rẹ̀: “Ó mú ihò kan wá nínú ìdílé.
rows.reference: Ikú ẹ̀ wọ gbogbo wa lára sùgbọ́n a lá ti túraká ni. “Bíi ọ̀gbun ni ikú ẹ̀ nínú ẹbí.

rows.source: It tears us apart.
rows.output: Ó ń ya wa sọ́tọ̀.
rows.reference: Ó tú ẹbí tán.

rows.source: But we've all got to carry on and fight."
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n a gbọ́dọ̀ tẹ̀síwájú kí a sì jà."
rows.reference: Àmọ́ a láti kórajọ torí ọjọ́-iwájú.”

rows.source: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.
rows.output: Tí o bá ń tiraka láti farada, o lè pè Samaritans ní ọ̀fẹ́ lórí 116 123 (UK àti Ireland), fi imeeli ránṣẹ́ sí jo@samaritans.org, tàbí ṣàbẹ̀wò sí ojúlé wẹẹbù Samaritans níbè.
rows.reference: To bá ní irú ìṣoro yìí pe Samaritans sí nọ́ḿbà to lè pè lọ́fẹ̀ẹẹ 116 123 (ní UK àti Ireland), tàbí méèlì jo@samaritans.org tàbí àdírẹ̀sì wa lóri íntánẹ́ẹ́tì.

rows.source: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation
rows.output: Ìjọra Brett Kavanaugh wà nínú ewu bí FBI ṣe bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í ṣe ìwádìí
rows.reference: Ọjọ́-iwájú Brett Kavanaugh's dálórí ìwádií tí FBI ń se

rows.source: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.
rows.output: "Mo rò pé, bí a bá lè gba nǹkan bíi ohun tí ó ń béèrè - ìwádìí tí a ti fi àkókò àti àgbègbè dè - a lè mú kí ìṣọ̀kan wá," ni Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Flake sọ ní ọjọ́ Àtàwọ́dá, ní fífi kọ́ pé ìgbìmọ̀ náà "ń yọ́" ní ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ìdàrúdàpọ̀ òṣèlú.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Flake ní, “Kí ni ọkùnri yìí fẹ́ gan-an – ìwádìí tí kò ní pẹ́, tàbí iwádìí tó mọ níwọ̀n? Ìbá dára ka mọ ibi tí à ń lọ gan-an. Ó tún ní “ìyapa” ti wà láárin ìgbìmọ̀ olùwádìí látàrí ìbájọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀ú àwọn olóṣèlú.

rows.source: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?
rows.output: Kínni ó jẹ́ pé Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Kavanaugh àti àwọn alátìlẹyìn rẹ̀ ní Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà kò fẹ́ kí àwọn ọlọ́pàá ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà (FBI) ṣe ìwádìí?
rows.reference: Kí ló dé tí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Kavanaugh àti àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican tako ìwádìí FBI?

rows.source: Their reluctance is all due to timing.
rows.output: Ìdààmú wọn jẹ́ gbogbo rẹ̀ nítorí àkókò.
rows.reference: Àkókò ló fà á

rows.source: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.
rows.output: Àwọn ìdìbò àarín-àkókò náà jẹ́ ọ̀sẹ̀ márùn-ún péré lọ́nà, ní ọjọ́ kẹfà, oṣù kọkànlá - bí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ti ń retí, àwọn Páàrìtàntì kò bá ṣe dáadáa, wọ́n yóò sì jẹ́ aláìlera gan-an nínú ìsapá wọn láti mú kí wọ́n yan ẹni tí wọ́n fẹ́ sí ilé ẹjọ́ tó ga jùlọ ní ilẹ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ kẹfà, oṣù kọkànlá, nìbò ọlọ́dún mẹ́jì máa wáye, Bí egbẹ́ Republican ‘ò bá se dáadáa, ó ṣeéṣe kí ẹni t’ọ́n fẹ́ yàn sí ipo ní ilé-ẹjọ́ to ga jùlọ má débẹ̀.

rows.source: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.
rows.output: George W. Bush ti n pe awọn Sẹnetọ lati pe wọn lati ṣe atilẹyin Ọgbẹni Kavanaugh, ẹni ti o ṣiṣẹ ni Ile White fun Bush ati pe o pade iyawo rẹ Ashley, ẹni ti Bush jẹ akọwe ti ara ẹni.
rows.reference: George W. Bush pe ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ Sìnàtọ̀ láti rọ̀ wọn kí wọ́n gbárùkùtì Ọ̀gbẹni Kavanaugh, òṣìṣẹ́ Ọ̀gbẹni Bush ní White House. Làti ipasẹ̀ ẹ̀ ni Ọ̀gbẹni Bush pàdé Ashley, ìyàwó ilé ẹ̀ tó ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú nígbà kan rí gẹ́gẹ́ bí akọ̀wé,

rows.source: What happens after the FBI produces its report?
rows.output: Kí ni ó ṣẹlẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí àwọn ọlọ́pàá orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà (FBI) bá ṣe àtọ́ka rẹ̀?
rows.reference: Kí ló máa ṣẹ̀lẹ lẹ́yìn ìwádìí FBI?
