rows.reference: Robyn Christie na Melrose ya ce: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ayr, sun ɗauki damammakinsu sosai fiye da yadda muka yi.”

rows.source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
rows.output: A cikin mintuna na 14, Grant Anderson ya ci, kuma Frazier Climo ya canza shi, ya sanya Ayr a gaba, amma, bayan da aka ba Rory Hughes, wanda ya buga wa Scotland wasa, ya bar filin wasa, Melrose ya yi amfani da wannan kuma ya ci Jason Baggot a cikin rashi.
rows.reference: Gwajin mintina na 14 na gudunmawar Anderson, da  Frazier Climo ya sauya, sa Ayr a gaba, amma, wani rawayar kati don kyaftin na Scotland Rory Hughes, da Warriors suka sake don wasan, ya bari Melrose ta yi lambobin faɗa da Jason Baggot

rows.source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
rows.output: Climo ya faɗi giciye a kan Ayr, kafin, a karshen rabin lokaci, ya ci kuma ya canza bugun daci don sanya Ayr 17-5 a rabin lokaci.
rows.reference: Climo ya faɗaɗa shugabancin Ayr tare da wani fenalti, kafin, lokacin hutun rabin lokaci, ya ci shi ke nan ya musanya wani gwajin kai kaɗai don ya sa ya zama 17 zuwa 5 zuwa Ayr a hutun.

rows.source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
rows.output: Amma Melrose ya fara rabin na biyu da kyau kuma Patrick Anderson ya ci, wanda Baggot ya canza, ya rage gibin zuwa maki biyar.
rows.reference: Amma Melrose ta fara rabi na biyun ne daidai kuma Patrick Anderson ya yi kokari, da Baggot ya musanya, rage hanyar wucewar zuwa matakai biyar.

rows.source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
rows.output: Sannan an yi jira mai tsawo saboda raunuka masu tsanani ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka kai shi asibitin, kuma daga sake fara wasan, Ayr ta ci gaba da ci gaba ta hanyar Stafford McDowall, wanda Climo ya ci.
rows.reference: A da akwai a lokacin wani jinkiri mai tsayi don wani rauni mai yawa ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka ɗauka a kan makara, kuma sake farawar, Ayr ta tura gaba dan saman ta hanyar wani gwaji na Stafford McDowall, da Climo ya musanya.

rows.source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
rows.output: Kyaftin Ayr Blair Macpherson ya samu jan kati, kuma Melrose ya sake cin nasara da bugun daci Bruce Colvine, a karshen wani lokaci na matsi mai tsanani.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan an ba wa muƙaddashin kyaftin ɗin Ayr Blair Macpherson kati rawaya, haka kuma, Melrose ya sa mutumin ya ƙara biya wani gwajin Bruce Colvine da ba a musanya ba, daga ƙarshe wani mummuna harin matsi.

rows.source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
rows.output: Gida ya dawo baya, duk da haka, kuma lokacin da Struan Hutchinson ya samu jan kati don yin kaca-kaca da Climo ba tare da kwallo ba, daga layin harsashi, MacPherson ya taba kasa a baya na Ayr mai ci gaba.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren gidan ya dawo, amma, kuma a lokacin da aka ba da kati rawaya a Struan Hutchinson don tunkarar Climo ba tare da ƙwallo ba, daga layin wajen fenalti the penalty, MacPherson ya taɓa ƙasa daga bayan tunkuɗewar Ayr da ke kusantowa.

rows.source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
rows.output: Climo ya canza, kamar yadda ya yi sau da yawa daga farkon, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tattara bugun dawowar David Armstrong ya aika da Gregor Henry a gefen gida don cin nasarar gida ta biyar.
rows.reference: Climo ya musanyu, kamar yadda ya sake yi aƙalla daga farawa, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tara bugun akwati na David Armstrong kuma ya aika Gregor Henry wani waje don gwajin gefen gida na biyar.

rows.source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
rows.output: Tauraruwar wasan kwaikwayo har yanzu tana shirin sabon sana'a a masana'antar cin abinci
rows.reference: Har yanzu tauraro Game ya shirya don sabon aiki a masana’antar sayar da abinci

rows.source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
rows.output: Tauraron wasan barkwanci na har yanzu a cikin wasan Ford Kieran ya bayyana cewa zai shiga masana'antar masu masaukin baki bayan an gano cewa an nada shi a matsayin darakta na wani kamfani mai lasisi na gidajen cin abinci.
rows.reference: Har yanzu tauraro Game Ford Kieran ya nuna ya shirya shiga zuwa cikin masana’antar kulawa bayan an gano an ba shi matsayi na daraktan wani kamfani mai lasisin sayar da abinci.

rows.source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: Wani mutum mai shekaru 56 yana taka rawa a matsayin Jack Jarvis a cikin wani shahararren shirin BBC, wanda ya rubuta kuma ya yi aiki tare da abokin wasan barkwanci na tsawon lokaci Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: Mai shekaru 56 yana fitowa a Jack Jarvis a cikin sanannen shirin BBC, wanda yake rubutawa da sauran taurari tare da mai haɗn gwiwa dan barkwanci Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
rows.output: An sanar da duo cewa jerin na tara na gaba zai kasance na karshe a cikin wasan kwaikwayo, kuma yana bayyana cewa Kiernan yana shirin rayuwa bayan Craiglang.
rows.reference: Su biyun sun sanar da cewa jerin nau’uka na tara da ke zuwa za su zama na ƙarshe a cikin gudanar da shirin, kuma ya bayyana Kiernan yana shirya rayuwa bayana Craiglang.

rows.source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: Bisa ga rajistar hukuma, shi ne daraktan Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: A cewar rubutaccen labari na jere-jere na kamfani, shi ne darakta na Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
rows.output: Dan wasan ya ki yin tsokaci kan labarin, duk da haka wani tushen jaridar The Scottish Sun ya nuna cewa Kiernan na neman shiga cikin kasuwanci na gidajen cin abinci a Glasgow.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan kwaikwayon ya ki yin ya ce wani kome a kan labarin, kodayake wata kafar labari ta Scottish Sun ta tsegunta cewa Kiernan yana neman ya shiga cikin “kasuwar sayar da abinci mai ci gaba” ta Glasgow.

rows.source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
rows.output: "Tekun namu ne": Bolivia da ba ta da bakin teku tana fatan kotun za ta sake bude hanyar zuwa Tekun Pasifik.
rows.reference: ‘Tekun namu ne’: Bolivia da ke rufe da ƙasa tana fatan kotu za ta buɗe hanyar zuwa Pacific

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Masu jirgin ruwa suna zagayawa hedikwatar sojojin ruwa mai riguna a La Paz.
rows.reference: Matuƙan jirgin ruwa suna sintiri a wurin tsayuwa na hedikwatar sojojin ruwa a cikin La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.output: Ginin jama'a yana tashi da tutar ruwan teku.
rows.reference: Gine-ginen gwamnati sun daga tutar launin teku shudi.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Tashin jiragen ruwa daga tafkin Titicaca zuwa Amazon an yi wa lakabin: "Teku namu ne ta hakki."
rows.reference: Sansanonin sojojin ruwa daga Tabkin Titicaca zuwa  Amazon da aka sa wa motto: “Teku namu ne a haƙƙi.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Don dawo da shi wani aiki ne."
rows.reference: Dawo da shi haƙƙinmu ne.”

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: A duk faɗin ƙasar Bolivia da ba ta da bakin teku, tunanin bakin teku da aka rasa ga Chile a cikin rikicin albarkatun da ya yi zub da jini a karni na 19 har yanzu yana da haske - kamar yadda sha'awar tafiyarka a cikin Tekun Pasifik.
rows.reference: A cikin gaba ɗaya Bolivia da ke kewaye da ƙasa, tuna rasa wani yankin bakin teku ga Chile wani mummunan rikicin albarkar abu na ƙarni na 19 har yanzu a fili a yake - don saboda shi ne buƙatar su sake bi ta ruwan Tekun Pacific Ocean.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: Wannan fatarar ta kasance a mafi girman shekaru da suka gabata, yayin da Bolivia ke jiran hukunci daga kotun kasa da kasa a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar na tattaunawa.
rows.reference: Waɗannan ire-iren fata suna watakila mafi girma a cikin shekaru, a lokacin da Bolivia din ke jiran wani ƙaramin hukunci daga kotun duniya a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar ana jin bahasi.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "An samu ci gaba a Bolivia, da ruhin hadin kai da zaman lafiya, kuma ba shakka ana sa ran samun sakamako mai kyau," in ji Roberto Calzadilla, jakadan Bolivia.
rows.reference: "Bolivia tana da kuzari, da halin haɗin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana tsammanin wani kyakkyawan batu da zai fito,” inji Roberto Calzadilla, wani jami’in diflomasiyya na Bolivia.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Mutane da yawa a Bolivia za su kalli hukunci na kotun a kan manyan alluna a faɗin ƙasar, suna fatan cewa kotun a The Hague za ta yanke hukunci a kan Bolivia cewa - bayan shekaru da yawa na tattaunawa - Chile tana da wajibcin tattaunawa da Bolivia don ba ta damar samun hanyar shiga teku.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Bolivia za su kalli hukuncin na Kotun Duniyar a kan manyan talabijoji a faɗin ƙasar, suna masu fatan cewa kotun ta The Hague za ta sami matsaya na yarda da neman na Bolivia - bayan shekaru masu yawa na tattaunawa da ba nasara - Chile ta yarda da tattaunawa inda ta ba wa Bolivia ‘yancin mafita zuwa ga tekun.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, shugaban ƙasar Bolivia mai ban sha'awa wanda ke fuskantar gwagwarmayar sake zaben shekara mai zuwa - kuma yana da yawa da za a yi a ranar Litinin - kuma yana da yawa da za a yi a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, shugaban Bolivia mai farin jini ɗan asali - wanda ke fuskantar wani yaƙi mai ruɗarwa na sake zaɓe shekara mai zuwa yana da dama mai yawa daga hukuncin na ranar Litinin.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "Muna kusa da komawa zuwa Tekun Pasifik," ya yi alkawarin a karshen watan Agusta.
rows.reference: “Mun kusan dawowa zuwa ga Tekun Pacific,” a wata  jaddadawa a cikin ƙarshen Agusta.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Amma wasu masu nazari sun yi imanin cewa kotun ba za ta yanke hukunci a kan Bolivia ba - kuma ba za a yi canji mai yawa ba idan ta yi.
rows.reference: Amma wasu masu fashin baƙi sun yi imani cewa zai yi wahala ta yanke hukunci yadda Bolivia ɗin ke so - kuma cewa ba abin da zai canza idan ta yi.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
rows.output: Jamusawa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta kasa da kasa ta
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar mai mazauni a Netherlands ba ta da iko na bayar da iyakar ta Chile, kuma ta bayyana cewa ba za ta ƙudurta abin da zai bayyana na tattaunawar da za yiwu.

rows.source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
rows.output: Wannan hukuncin da kotun ta ICJ ta yanke, ya zo ne kawai watanni shida bayan an yi wa karar, yana nuna cewa "ba ta da wahala," in ji Paz Zárate, kwararre kan dokokin kasa da kasa na kasar Chile.
rows.reference: Cewar hukunci na Kotun Duniyar yana zuwa ne kawai a bayan watanni shida da jin mahawarorin ƙarshe ya nuna shari’ar “ba ta da rudani,” inji Paz Zárate wata ƙwararriya ‘yar Chile a kan shari’ar ƙasa-da-ƙasa.

rows.source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
rows.output: Kuma ba tare da kara wa Bolivia amfani ba, shekaru hudu da suka gabata na iya sa ta baya.
rows.reference: Kuma bai yi kusa da taimakon shari’ar ta Bolivia ba, shekaru huɗun da suka wuce kila sun jawo mata koma baya.

rows.source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
rows.output: "Batun samun damar zuwa ga teku an kama shi da gwamnati mai ci a Bolivia," in ji Zárate.
rows.reference: “Gwamnatin Bolivia ta yanzun ta kame batun na samun iso ga tekun,” inji Zárate.

rows.source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
rows.output: Maganganun Morales na tashin hankali sun yi wa duk wani kyakkyawar jin dadi da Chile ta rage, ta ba da shawarar.
rows.reference: “Surutan Morales marassa kyau sun ƙare duk wani tausayi na Chile, a ra’ayinta.

rows.source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
rows.output: Bolivia da Chile za su yi magana a wani lokaci, amma zai yi matukin jirgi a yi tattaunawa bayan haka.
rows.reference: Bolivia da Chile za su a wani lokaci ci gaba da magana, amma zai zama abu mai wahala sosai a yi wa tattaunawa a bayan wannan.

rows.source: The two countries have not exchanged ambassadors since 1962.
rows.output: Ƙasun biyu ba su yi musayar jakadanci ba tun daga shekarar 1962.
rows.reference: Ƙasashen biyun ba su yi musayar jakadu ba tun 1962.

rows.source: Former president Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, Bolivia's representative at The Hague, rejected the idea that the court's decision-making was unusually speedy.
rows.output: Tsohon shugaban kasa Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, mai wakiltar Bolivia a The Hague, ya ki yarda da ra'ayin cewa yanke hukunci na kotun ya yi sauri fiye da yadda aka saba.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban ƙasa Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, wakilin Bolivia a Hague, ya ki batu na cewa tsarin yanke hukuncin na kotun yana sauri ba yadda aka saba ba.

rows.source: Monday will bring Bolivia "an extraordinary opportunity to open a new era of relations with Chile" and a chance to "put an end to 139 years of disagreements with mutual benefits," he said.
rows.output: Lahadi zai kawo Bolivia "dama ta musamman wajen bude wani sabon zamani na dangantakar da Chile" da kuma damar "kawo karshen shekaru 139 na rashin jituwa da amfanin juna," in ji shi.
rows.reference: Litinin za ta kawo wa Bolivia “wata dama da ba irinta don bude wani sabon shafi na huldodi tare da Chile” da kuma wata dama ta “kawo wani karshe ga shekaru 139 na rashin jituwa tare da fa’idoji da juna,” inji shi.

rows.source: Calzadilla also denied that Morales - still one of Latin America's most popular presidents - was using the maritime issue as a political crutch.
rows.output: Calzadilla ya musanta cewa Morales - har yanzu daya daga cikin shugaban kasa mafi shahara a Latin Amurka - yana amfani da batun teku a matsayin tukunyar siyasa.
rows.reference: Calzadilla kuma ya ƙi cewa Morales - wanda har yanzu ɗaya ne daga shugabannin Latin America da suka fi farin jini - ya yi amfani ne da batun na teku a matsayin wani abin siyasa.

rows.source: "Bolivia will never give up its right to have access to the Pacific Ocean," he added.
rows.output: "Ba za a taba ba da damar Bolivia ta shiga cikin Tekun Pasifik ba," ya kara.
rows.reference: Ya kara da cewa "Bolivia ba za ta taɓa barin haƙƙin taɓa na samun iso zuwa ga Tekun Pacific.”

rows.source: "The ruling is an opportunity to see that we need to overcome the past."
rows.output: "Hukuncin dama ce ta ga cewa muna buƙatar shawo kan baya."
rows.reference: “Hukuncin wata dama ce ta ganin cewa an manta abin da ya faru a bayan.”

rows.source: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce kawar da makamai ba zai zo ba sai an amince da Amurka
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce rage makaman nukiliya ba zai zo ba sai har za ta iya aminta da Amurka

rows.source: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.
rows.output: Ministan Harkokin Waje na Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong Ho ya ce kasar ta za ta yi watsi da makamin nukiliyar ta farko idan ba ta da tabbas kan Washington.
rows.reference: Ministan Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong Ho ya ce ƙasarsa ba za ta taɓa rabuwa da makamanta na nukiliya daga farko ba sai idan ba za aminta da Washington ba.

rows.source: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.
rows.output: Ri tana magana ne a ranar Asabar a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya.
rows.reference: Ri yana magana ne ranar Asabar a Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya.

rows.source: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.
rows.output: Ya yi kira ga Amurka da ta cika alkawuran da aka yi a lokacin taron da aka yi a Singapore tsakanin shugabannin masu hamayya.
rows.reference: Ya kira Amurka da ta bi aiwatar da alkawura da aka yi a babban taro a cikin Singapore  tsakanin shugabannin masu gaba.

rows.source: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
rows.output: Kalamansa sun zo ne a lokacin da sakatare na harkokin waje na Amurka Mike Pompeo ya yi kamar yana kan hanyar sake farfado da tattaunawar nukiliyar da ta tsaya tsawon watanni uku bayan taron Singapore da shugaban Koriya ta Arewa Kim Jong Un.
rows.reference: Zantukan nasa sun zo ne a yayin da Sakataren Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka Mike Pompeo yake dab da sake fara maganar diflomasiyyar da ta ci tura a kan nukiliyar fiye da watanni uku bayan taron Singapore tare da Kim Jong Un na Koriya ta Arewa.

rows.source: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.
rows.output: Ri ya ce "maganar bututu" cewa ci gaba da takunkumi da kin amincewa da Amurka da sanarwar karshen yakin Koriya za ta taba sa Arewacin Koriya ta yi kishi.
rows.reference: Ri ya ce wani kawai “mafarki ne” da ke ci gaba da takunkumi da ki na Amurka ga wani furuci wanda kawo ƙarshen Yaƙin Koriya zai taɓa kawo Arewar zuwa ga gwiwowinta.

rows.source: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.
rows.output: Washington na da damuwa game da amincewa da sanarwar ba tare da Pyongyang ta fara yin manyan matakai na rage makamai ba.
rows.reference: Washington tana jin shakkun na yarda da furucin ba tare da Pyongyang da farko ta yi wata muhimmiyar hoɓɓasa na rage makaman ba.

rows.source: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.
rows.output: Duk Kim da shugaban Amurka Donald Trump suna son wani taron na biyu.
rows.reference: Gaba ɗaya Kim da Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump suna son wani babban taro na biyu.

rows.source: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.
rows.output: Amma akwai shakkun da yawa cewa Pyongyang na da gaske game da barin makamin da kasar ta yi imani da shi ne kawai hanyar da za ta tabbatar da tsafinta.
rows.reference: Amma akwai rashin yarda mai yawa cewa Pyongyang ba ta himmatu sosai ba game da watsi da wani makami da ƙasar ke ganin shi ne kusan kaɗai hanyar garanti ɗinta na samun kariya.

rows.source: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.
rows.output: Pompeo na shirin ziyartar Pyongyang a watan mai zuwa don shirya taron Kim da Trump na biyu.
rows.reference: Pompeo yana shirin ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu da Kim da Trump.

rows.source: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you
rows.output: Baje kolin kayan kwalliya na Paris ya nuna sabon layin manyan kayan kwalliya da ke kan hanyar zuwa wani shagon da ke kusa da ku
rows.reference: Nune-nunen kayan ado na Paris ya fito da mafi sabon layi a cikin kayan ka a kan hanyarsa ta zuwa wani Babban Titi kusa da kai

rows.source: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.
rows.output: Idan kana son ƙara tarin hularka ko kuma ka toshe rana gaba ɗaya, to ka duba ba kaɗan.
rows.reference: Idan kana son kara girman hularka da ka tara ko toshe gaba ɗaya rana shi ke nan kar ka ƙara gaba.

rows.source: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Masu zanen kaya Valentino da Thom Browne sun nuna tarin kayan kwalliyar kai masu ban mamaki da aka yi da hannu don tarin SS19 a kan titi wanda ya burge masu sha'awar kayan kwalliyar a Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Masu tsara kaya Valentino da Thom Browne sun baje-koli wa kayan kai masu girma da kyau don tarun kayansu na SS19 a kan hanyar wucewa waɗanda suka ƙayatar da salon da aka kafa a Makon Kayan Ado na Paris.

rows.source: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.
rows.output: An yi wa Instagram mamakin kwalliyar da ba ta da amfani a wannan lokacin rani, kuma wadannan masu zanen suna sanya abubuwan da suka yi ban mamaki a kan titi.
rows.reference: Hulunan da ba a iya tunani sun mamaye Instagram wannan damunar kuma waɗannan masu tsara kayan sun zuba idanunsu na ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire a ƙasan tattakin nuna salon kaya.

rows.source: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.
rows.output: Babban yanki na Valentino shine babban hular beige mai ban mamaki da aka yi da fuka-fukan fuka-fukan da suka mamaye kan kawunan samfuran.
rows.reference: Abin da ya fito daga Valentino wata hula ce ta sama da ake sawa da wani gashi da ya mamaye kan masu nuna samfurorin.

rows.source: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.
rows.output: Sauran kayan ado masu girma sun haɗa da ruwan 'ya'yan itace masu yadin da aka yi, hular mayen da kuma ayaba - amma ba a yi su ne don ka ji dumi ba.
rows.reference: Sauran manyan abubuwan tallafin sun haɗa da kankana mai kayan ado, wata hular masu da ma wata abarba - amma ba a tsara su don sa dumi a kanka ba.

rows.source: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne ya kuma bayyana wani zaɓin mask- da kuma kawai a lokacin da Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne kuma ya fio da wani zaɓi na ban mamaki safofin fuska - kuma kawai don lokaci na Halloween.

rows.source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.
rows.output: Da yawa daga cikin kayan ado masu launuka sun yi bakin ciki da aka dinka kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter fiye da haute couture.
rows.reference: Da yawa daga cikin safofin fuskar masu launi suna da ɗinki a leɓɓa kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter a maimakon salon ado na haute couture.

rows.source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
rows.output: Wani abu da aka halicce shi ya yi kama da kayan nutsewa na ruwa, tare da mask da gilashin ido, yayin da wani ya yi kama da kwayar cakulan da ta narke.
rows.reference: Wata ƙagowar ya yi kama da kayan shiga ruwan teku na scuba tare da snorkel da tubarau, wani kuwa ya yi kama da bututun ƙanƙarar madara mai narkewa.

rows.source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
rows.output: Kuma idan ka ci gaba da wannan babban furuci na kayan kwalliya - kana da sa'a.
rows.reference: Kuma idan ka ci gaba da babban bayani a kan kayan ado - kana cikin nasara.

rows.source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
rows.output: Masu lura da salon suna hasashen cewa manyan kofunan na iya zuwa kan titi kusa da kai.
rows.reference: Masu kallon salo sun yi kintace cewa manyan bonnets za su iya fara zuwa manyan titunan na kusa da kai.

rows.source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: Ƙwanƙwasa masu girma sun zo ne nan da nan bayan 'La Bomba', hular ciyawa mai fatar da ta kai ƙafa biyu a diamita wanda aka ga kowa daga Rihanna zuwa Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: Manyan hulunan suna zuwa da kyau a kan takalma masu tsawo na 'La Bomba', hula mai tsinke tare da ƙafofi biyu gajeru da aka gani a kan kowa daga Rihanna zuwa ga Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.
rows.output: Alamar al'ada a bayan wannan babban hular da ba ta da amfani da aka baje a kan kafafen sada zumunta ta aika da wani babban abu na halitta a kan titi - jakar bakin teku da aka yi da ciyawa da ta kai girma kamar rigar wanka da samfurin ke dauka.
rows.reference: An watsa irin yadda hular take da ake maitar so sosai a cikin kafofin sada zumunta mai aika wata babbar kirkira har zuwa wurin tattakin nuna salon ado - ga wata jakar kara ta bakin teku kusan babba kamar samfuri na rigar wanka a ruwa da ake sawa.

rows.source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Jaka mai launin lemu mai konewa, wanda aka yi masa ado da raffia mai yanka, kuma an yi masa ado da jakar fata mai launin fari, shine babban abin da ya fi daukar hankali a cikin tarin Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 a Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Jakar mai launin lemo, da aka gyara tare da gefe-gefen raffia mai sama na wani farin mariki na fata, ita ce abin da ya yi fice a cikin kayan La Riviera SS19 na Jacquemus a Makon Kayon Ado na Paris. Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris

rows.source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
rows.output: Mai tsara salon fitacciyar mutane Luke Armitage ya gaya wa FEMAIL: 'Ina sa ran ganin manyan hula da jaka na bakin teku suna zuwa kan titunan birni don bazara mai zuwa - kamar yadda mai zanen ya yi tasiri sosai, zai yi wuya a yi watsi da buƙatun manyan kayan.
rows.reference: Sanannen mai salo Luke Armitage ya fada a FEMAIL: ‘Ina tsammanin ganin manyan huluna da jakakkunan bakin teku sun zo a kan babban titi don damuna ta gaba - don saboda mai tsarawar ya yi wani babban tasiri zai yi wahala a manta da buƙatar ta manyan kayayyakin tallafin.’

rows.source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
rows.output: John Edward: Ilimin harsuna na da muhimmanci ga 'yan ƙasa na duniya
rows.reference: John Edward: Muhimman hikimomin harsuna don ‘yan kasa na duniya

rows.source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
rows.output: Ilimin Scotland na zaman kansu ya ci gaba da samun nasarar ilimi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a shekarar 2018 tare da wani saitin sakamako na musamman, wanda ya kara karfinsa ta hanyar nasarar da mutane da kuma ayyukan al'umma a wasanni, zane-zane, kiɗa da sauran ayyukan al'umma.
rows.reference: Makarantun Scotland masu zaman kansu suna riƙe da wani rubutaccen bayani na fice ta fuskar ilmi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a cikin 2018 tare da wani yanki na sakamakon jarrabawa da ta yi fice, wanda kawai cin nasara mutum da ta tare cikin wasanni, da fasaha, waƙa da sauran al’amuran al’umma ke ƙarfafawa.

rows.source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
rows.output: Tare da sama da ɗalibai 30,000 a duk faɗin Scotland, waɗannan makarantu, wanda Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS) ke wakiltar su, suna ƙoƙarin samar da mafi kyawun matakin hidima ga ɗalibai da iyayensu.
rows.reference: Tare da samun ƙarin yara ‘yan makaranta 30,000 a faɗin Scotland, wadannan makarantun, wanda Majalisar Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu (Scottish Council of Independent Schools), ke hoɓɓasa don samar da lebur na aiki mafi kyau ga ƙananan yara da iyayensu.

rows.source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
rows.output: Makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba suna da burin shirya dalibansu don samun ilimi na gaba da na manyan makarantu, sana'ar da suka zaba, da kuma matsayinsu na 'yan kasa da kasa.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansun na da manufa ta shirya yaransu don karin samun babban ilmi, hanyar rayuwa da suka zaɓa da wurinsu a matsayin ‘yan ƙasa na duniya.

rows.source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na bangaren ilimi wanda zai iya tsara da kuma aiwatar da tsarin karatun gida na musamman, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da zama wani abu mai shahara da kuma wanda ake so a cikin makarantu.
rows.reference: A matsayin wani sashe na ilmi da zai iya tsara da aiwatar da manhajar makaranta da ake magana, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da da sanuwa da kuma darasi da ake so na zabi a cikin makarantu.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela ya ce: "Idan ka yi wa mutumin da ke magana da harshen da ya fahimta, hakan zai yi masa tasiri.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela ya ce: “Idan ka yi magana da wani mutum a cikin wani harshe da yake fahimta, wannan yakan shiga kansa.

rows.source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
rows.output: Idan ka yi magana da shi a cikin harshen da ya fi so, hakan yana zuwa ga zuciyarsa.
rows.reference: Idan ka yi magana da a cikin harshensa wannan yakan shiga zuciyarsa.”

rows.source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.output: Wannan tunatarwa ce mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogara da Ingilishi kawai ba idan muna son gina alaƙa da kuma yarda da mutane daga ƙasashen waje.
rows.reference: Wannan wata tunatarwa ce mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogaro da Turanci ba a yayin son gina hulɗoɗi da aminci tare da mutane daga sauran ƙasashe.

rows.source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
rows.output: Daga sakamakon jarabawar da aka yi kwanan nan, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna kan teburin gasa tare da mafi girman kashi a cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu.
rows.reference: Daga sakamakon jarrabawa na kwanan nan na wannan shekara, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna saman teburan jaddawali tare da kimomi da suka fi girma a cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu.

rows.source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
rows.output: Akwai kashi 68 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi karatu a cikin harsuna na waje da suka samu darajar A a matakin digiri.
rows.reference: Wata jimillar kashi 68 cikin ɗari ne na ɗalibai da suka karanta harsunan ƙasashen waje suka sami wata Babbar daraja ta A.

rows.source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
rows.output: Bayanan da aka tattara daga makarantu 74 na SCIS, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi Mandarin sun samu maki A, yayin da kashi 72 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi karatun Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi karatun Faransanci, da kashi 63 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi karatun Sipaniya suma sun samu maki A.
rows.reference: Bayanan, da aka tattara daga mambobin makaranta 74 na SCIS ɗin, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin ɗari na ɗaliban sun ci wata Babbar daraja ta A a cikin Mandarin, sai kuma kashi 72 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Farasanci da kashi 63 cikin ɗari da ke karanta Spanish su ma sun sami wata A.

rows.source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
rows.output: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantu masu zaman kansu a Scotland suna goyon bayan harsunan waje a matsayin muhimman kwarewar da yara da matasa za su yi amfani da su a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantu masu zaman kansu a cikin Scotland suna goyon bayan harsunan ƙasashen waje a matsayin muhimman hikimomi da yara da samari za su babu shakka buƙata a nan gaba.

rows.source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
rows.output: Yanzu, a matsayin zaɓin darussa, harsuna ana ɗaukar su a matsayin darussa masu daraja kamar STEM (kimiyya, fasaha, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin tsarin karatun makarantu masu zaman kansu da sauran wuraren.
rows.reference: Harsuna a yanzu, a matsayin darasin zaɓi, ana riƙe su a matsayi iri guda kamar darussan STEM (kimiyya, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin manhajojin makarantun masu zaman kansu da kuma wasu wani wurin.

rows.source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
rows.output: Wani binciken da Hukumar Birtaniyya ta Yi aiki da Kwarewar Ma'aikata ta yi a shekarar 2014 ya gano cewa daga cikin dalilan da ma'aikata ke da su wajen cika mukaman da ke cikin fanko, kashi 17 cikin 100 na rashin kwarewar harshe ne.
rows.reference: Wani safiyo na Hukumar Ingila don Aiki da Hikimomi a cikin 2014 ya samo dalilai da masu ɗaukan aiki suka bayar don gwagwarmaya wajen cike guraben da ba kowa, an danganta kashi 17 cikin ɗari zuwa ga wani rashin isassun hikimomin harsuna.

rows.source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
rows.output: Don haka, ƙarin da ƙarin, ƙwarewar harshe ta zama tilas don shiryawa matasa don sana'o'insu na gaba.
rows.reference: Don haka hikimomin harshe da yawa sosai suna sake zama da muhimmanci saboda a shirya samari don abubuwan da za su yi nan gaba a rayuwa.

rows.source: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.
rows.output: Tare da ƙarin damammaki na aiki da ke buƙatar harsuna, waɗannan ƙwarewar suna da muhimmanci a duniya mai haɗin kai.
rows.reference: Tare da ƙarin damammakin aiki da za a iya samu masu buƙatar harsuna, wadannan hikimomi suna da muhimmanci a cikin duniya mai dunƙulewa.

rows.source: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.
rows.output: Duk da aikin da wani ya zaɓa, idan ya koyi harshe na biyu, zai sami fa'ida ta gaske a nan gaba da samun kwarewar da za ta dore kamar haka.
rows.reference: Ba tare da la’akari da irin aiki da wani ya zaɓa na rayuwa ba, idan suka koyi wani harshe na biyu, za su haƙiƙa wata fa’ida a nan gaba mai hikima ta tsawon rayuwa irin wannan:

rows.source: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.
rows.output: Ikon sadarwa kai tsaye da mutane daga ƙasashen waje zai sanya mutum mai harsuna da yawa a gaba a gasa.
rows.reference: Samun dama ta sadarwa kai tsaye tare da mutane daga ƙasashe na waje zai kai tsaye sa wani mutum mai harsuna da yawa a saman gasar.

rows.source: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.
rows.output: Bisa ga wani YouGov na baje kolin fiye da 4,000 na manyan jama'ar Birtaniya a shekarar 2013, kashi 75 cikin 100 ba su da damar magana da wani yare na waje da kyau don su yi tattaunawar, kuma Faransanci shine kawai harshen da ake magana da shi da kashi 15 cikin 100.
rows.reference: A cewar wani zaɓen jin ra’ayi na YouGov na fiye da manya 4,000 ‘yan Ingila a 2013, kashi 75 cikin ɗari sun gagara su yi magana da wani harshen ƙasar waje sosai yadda za su iya yin tattaunawa da kuma Faransanci da ya zama kawai harshen magana da kashi cikin ɗari na wani gurbin lambobi biyu kawai ta mai lamba, kashi 15 cikin ɗari.

rows.source: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.
rows.output: Wannan shine dalilin da ya sa sanya hannun da aka yi a kan koyarwa da harsuna yanzu yana da muhimmanci ga yara a yau.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ya sa zuba jari a cikin koyar da harshe a yanzu yana da amfani don yaran gobe.

rows.source: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.
rows.output: Samun yarurruka da yawa, musamman na tattalin arzikin da ke tasowa, zai ba yara damar samun aiki mai ma'ana.
rows.reference: Samun harsuna da yawa, musamman waɗanda na ire-iren tattalin arziki ne masu tasowa, zai ba wa yara wata dama mai kyau ta samun aiki mai ma’ana.

rows.source: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.
rows.output: A cikin Scotland, kowane makaranta zai bambanta a cikin harsunan da suke koyarwa.
rows.reference: A cikin Scotland, kowace makaranta za ta bambanta a cikin harsuna da suke koyarwa.

rows.source: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
rows.output: Da yawa daga cikin makarantu za su mai da hankali kan harsunan zamani na gargajiya, yayin da wasu za su koyar da harsunan da ake ganin suna da muhimmanci ga Birtaniya idan aka yi la'akari da 2020, kamar Mandarin ko Jafananci.
rows.reference: Da yawan makarantu za su himmatu ne a kan karin fitattun harsunan zamani, amma dai sauran za su koyar da harsuna da ake ganin mafi amfani don Ingila a yayin duba gaba zuwa 2020, kamar su Mandarin ko Jafanisanci.

rows.source: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.
rows.output: Duk da sha'awar yaranku, koyaushe za a sami adadin harsuna da za a iya zaɓa daga makarantu masu zaman kansu, tare da ma'aikatan koyarwa waɗanda suka kware a wannan fannin.
rows.reference: Ko ma wace irin sha’awa yaranka ke da ita, koyaushe za a sami wasu harsuna na zaba daga cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu, tare da malamai masu koyarwa da suke kwararru a cikin yankin.

rows.source: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.
rows.output: Makarantu masu zaman kansu na Scotland suna da niyyar samar da yanayin koyo da zai shirya yara kuma ya ba su damar samun kwarewar da ake buƙata don samun nasara, duk da abin da makomar ta kasance.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansu na Scotland suna sadaukar da kai don samar da wani yanayi na koyo da zai shirya yara da ba su karfi na hikimomi da ake nema don ci nasara, duk abin da kuwa zai nan gaba.

rows.source: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.
rows.output: Ba za a iya musanta hakan ba a wannan lokacin, a cikin mahallin kasuwanci na duniya, cewa harsuna suna ci gaba da kasancewa masu matuƙar muhimmanci ga makomar ƙasar, don haka dole ne wannan ya nuna a cikin ilimi.
rows.reference: Ba za a iya ki a wannan lokacin ba, a cikin wani yanayin kasuwanci na duniya, harsuna suna ci gaba taka rawa mai amfani ga makomar kasar, don haka dole sa wannan a cikin ilmi.

rows.source: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."
rows.output: Tabbas, harsunan zamani ya kamata a yi la'akari da su a matsayin "kwarewar sadarwa ta kasa da kasa."
rows.reference: Hakika, ya kamata a zahiri a dauki harsunan zamani “hikimomin sadarwa na kasa-da-kasa.”

rows.source: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.
rows.output: Makarantu masu zaman kansu za su ci gaba da bayar da wannan zaɓi, bambance-bambance da kuma ƙwarewa ga matasa na Scotland.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansu za su ci gaba da samar da wannan zabin, zama da juna da fice ga samarin mutane na Scotland.

rows.source: Il faut bien le faire.
rows.output: Ya kamata a yi.
rows.reference: Il faut bien le faire.

rows.source: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.output: John Edward shi ne Darakta na Majalisar Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu ta Scotland
rows.reference: John Edward shi ne Darekta na Majalisar Scotland ta Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu

rows.source: LeBron to make Lakers debut Sunday in San Diego
rows.output: LeBron zai yi wasan farko na Lakers a ranar Lahadi a San Diego
rows.reference: LeBron zai sa Lakers su bayyana ranar Lahdi a cikin San Diego

rows.source: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.output: Jiran ya kusan ƙare ga masu sha'awar ganin LeBron James ya fara buga wa Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.reference: Jiran ya kusan karewa ga magoya bayan da ke neman ganin LeBron James ya yi farawarsa don Los Angeles Lakers.

rows.source: Lakers coach Luke Walton has announced that James will play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Denver Nuggets in San Diego.
rows.output: Kociyan Lakers Luke Walton ya sanar da cewa James zai buga wasan sanyin na farko da Denver Nuggets a ranar Lahadi a San Diego.
rows.reference: Mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Lakers Luke Walton ya sanar da cewa James zai yi wasa a farkon wasan bude lokaci na Lahdi da Denver Nuggets a cikin San Diego.

rows.source: But just how many minutes he'll play has yet to be determined.
rows.output: Amma kawai nawa mintuna zai taka rawa har yanzu ba a yanke hukunci ba.
rows.reference: Amma kawai ba san mintina nawa ne zai yi wasan ba har yanzu.

rows.source: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.
rows.output: "Zai fi ɗaya kuma ƙasa da 48," in ji Walton a shafukan yanar gizo na hukuma na Lakers.
rows.reference: "Zai zama fiye da daya da kusa da 48" inji Walton a kan shafin yanar gizo na Lakers din.

rows.source: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.
rows.output: An ruwaito daga mai ba da rahoton Lakers Mike Trudell cewa James zai yi wasan ne kawai a cikin mintuna kaɗan.
rows.reference: Mai rahoto na Lakers Mike Trudell a Twitter cewa James zai kila yi kayyadedden wasan mintina ne.

rows.source: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.
rows.output: Bayan yin atisaye a farkon wannan makon, an yi wa James tambayoyi game da shirinsa na wasan sanyin na Los Angeles Lakers na wasanni shida.
rows.reference: A bayan gwaji na farkon wannan makon, an tambayi James game da shirye-shiryensa don tsarin wasanni shida na kafin lokaci na Lakers.

rows.source: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.
rows.output: "Ban buƙaci wasannin da za a yi kafin kakar wasa a wannan mataki na sana'ata don in shirya ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba na bukatar wasanni na kafin lokaci a wannan matakin na aikina don na shirya,” inji shi.

rows.source: Trump's West Virginia Rally Time, YouTube Channel
rows.output: Taron Trump a West Virginia, Lokaci, Tashar YouTube
rows.reference: Lokacin Taron Trump na Virginia ta Yamma, Tashar  YouTube Channel

rows.source: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: Shugaba Donald Trump ya fara jerin gangamin yakin neman zabe a daren yau a Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: Shugaba Donald Trump ya fara ‘yan wasu taruka yau da dare a cikin Wheeling, Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: It's Trump's first of five scheduled rallies in the next week, including stops in friendly places including Tennessee and Mississippi.
rows.output: Lamarin Trump na farko ne a cikin gangamin biyar da aka tsara a cikin makonni masu zuwa, ciki har da wuraren da suka fi dacewa a Tennessee da Mississippi.
rows.reference: “Shi ne farkon daya daga cikin tarukan Trump guda biyar a cikin mako mai zuwa da ya hada da tsaye-tsaye a wuraren da ke abota da suka da Tennessee da Mississippi.

rows.source: With the confirmation vote on hold for his pick to fill the Supreme Court vacancy, Trump is aiming to build support for upcoming mid-term elections since Republicans are at risk of losing control of Congress when votes are cast on Nov.
rows.output: Tare da jiran kuri'ar tabbatar da zabensa don cike gurbin Kotun Koli, Trump na da burin gina goyon baya ga zaben tsakiya da ke tafe saboda 'yan jam'iyyar Republican na fuskantar hadarin rasaancin majalisar dokokin kasar idan an yi zabe a watan Nuwamba.
rows.reference: Tare da dakatar da kada kuri’ar tabbatarwa wanda ya zaba don cike gurbin Kotun Koli, Trump yana da niyyar gina goyon baya don zabubbukan tsakiyar zango da za su zo tun da ‘yan Republican suna cikin hadari na rasa sarrafa Majalisar Dokoki a lokaci da za a kada kuri’un a Nuwamba.

rows.source: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?
rows.output: Mene ne lokacin taron Trump a West Virginia a daren yau kuma ta yaya za ka iya kallo a yanar gizo?
rows.reference: Yaushe ne taron Trump na dare na Virginia ta Yamma kuma yaya zan kalla ta yanar gizo?

rows.source: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Taron Trump a Wheeling, West Virginia yana jadawalin 7 na dare ET a daren Asabar, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: An tsara taron Trump din ne na Wheeling, Virginia ta Yamma da karfe 7 na daren yau Asabar, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.source: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.
rows.output: Za ka iya kallon gangamin Trump na West Virginia a kan layi a ƙasa ta hanyar watsa shirye-shirye na YouTube.
rows.reference: Za ka iya kallon taron Trump ɗin na Virginia ta Yamma ta yanar gizo da ke ƙasa lokacin da ake yi a kan YouTube.

rows.source: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.
rows.output: Trump zai yi magana kan zaman da aka yi a makwanni na baya-baya na zaben Kotun Koli na Brett Kavanaugh, wanda ya yi tsanani kan zarge-zargen cin zarafi na jima'i, tare da jiran a amince da majalisar dattijai na tsawon makonni zuwa makwanni guda yayin da hukumar ta FBI ke bincike.
rows.reference: Trump ba mamaki ya yi magana a kan bahasin wannan mako don zaɓan Brett Kavanaugh Kotun Koli, wanda ya tsananta a kan kagen cin zarafi na jima’i tare da tsammani wata dakatar da kaɗa kuri’a ta Majalisar Dattawa har zuwa wani mako a yayin da hukumar FBI ke bincike.

rows.source: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.
rows.output: Amma babban manufar wannan guguwar gangami shine taimakawa 'yan jam'iyyar Republican da ke fuskantar zaben watan Nuwamba mai wahala su samu karin kuzari.
rows.reference: Amma babbar manufa ta wannan dandazon taruka shi ne taimakon ‘yan Republican da ke fuskantar taɓa zaɓuɓɓukan Nuwamba su sami ɗan kuzari.

rows.source: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Don haka, yakin neman zabe na shugaban kasa Trump ya ce wadannan gangamin da za a yi a cikin makonni masu zuwa na da nufin "kawo karfafa ga masu goyon baya da masu aiki yayin da jam'iyyar Republican ke kokarin kare da fadada rinjaye da suke da shi a majalisar dattijai da majalisar wakilai," a cewar Reuters.
rows.reference: Don haka, kamfe na Shugaba Trump ya ce manufar waɗannan taruka biyar a cikin mako mai zuwan shi ne “zaburar da masu sa-kai da magoya baya a lokacin da ‘yan Republican ke ƙoƙarin kare da faɗaɗa fin yawan jama’a da suke da shi a Majalisar Dattawa da Majalisar Wakilai,” a cewar Reuters.

rows.source: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.
rows.output: "Kasancewar Majalisar Dokoki ta kasa tana da matuƙar muhimmanci ga shirin sa, don haka shugaban kasa zai yi tafiya zuwa jihohin da za su yiwu yayin da muke tunkarar lokacin yakin neman zabe," wani mai magana da yawun yakin neman zabe na Trump wanda ya ki a ba shi sunansa ya ce da Reuters.
rows.reference: “Sarrafa Majalisar Dokoki yana da muhimmanci sosai ga ajandarsa cewa shugaban ƙasa zai je jihohi masu yawa a yayin da muke shiga lokacin da ba zama,” inji wani mai magana da yawun kamfe na Trump da ya faɗa wa Reuters amma ya ki a ambaci sunansa.

rows.source: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.
rows.output: An shirya taron a Wesbanco Arena a Wheeling, wannan taron na yau na iya jawo masu goyon baya daga "Ohio da Pennsylvania da kuma jawo hankalin kafafen yada labarai na Pittsburgh," a cewar West Virginia Metro News.
rows.reference: Tsarin da aka don Wesbanco Arena a cikin Wheeling, yau da dare zai kawo magoya baya daga "Ohio da Pennsylvania da kuma jawo kafofin watsa labarai su zo na Pittsburgh," a cewar Metro News ta Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.
rows.output: Asabar za ta kasance ta biyu a cikin wata da ta gabata da Trump ya ziyarta West Virginia, jihar da ya lashe ta da kashi 40 cikin dari a shekarar 2016.
rows.reference: Asabar za ta zama lokaci na biyu a watan da ya wuce da Trump zai ziyarci Virginia ta Yamma, jihar da ya ci da fiye da kashi 40 na ɗigo-ɗigo a cikin 2016.

rows.source: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.
rows.output: Trump yana kokarin taimakawa dan takarar majalisar dattawan jam'iyyar Republican ta West Virginia, Patrick Morrisey, wanda ke baya a zaben.
rows.reference: Trump yana ƙoƙari ne na taimakon ɗan takarar Sanata na Republican na Virginia ta Yamma Patrick Morrisey, wanda ke baya a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan.

rows.source: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.
rows.output: "Ba alama mai kyau ba ne ga Morrisey cewa shugaban kasa ya zo ya yi ƙoƙarin ba shi kuzari a zaben," in ji Simon Haeder, masanin siyasa a Jami'ar Jihar West Virginia, a cewar Reuters.
rows.reference: “Wannan ba wata alama ce mai kyau ga Morrisey ba cewa har sai da shugaban ƙasa ya zo don ƙoƙarin ya ƙara masa wani farin jini a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan,” inji Simon Haeder, wani masanin kimiyyar siyasa a Jami’ar Virginia ta Yamma, a cewar Reuters.

rows.source: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles
rows.output: Gasar Ryder 2018: Tawagar Amurka ta nuna jarumta wajen ci gaba da fatan samun nasara a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Kofin Ryder 2018: Team USA sun nuna ciki don yaƙi don raya fatan da ake yi mai shiga cikin ɗaiɗaikun Lahadi

rows.source: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.
rows.output: Bayan zaman uku na gefe ɗaya, bayan rana, juma'a, na iya zama abin da wannan gasar Ryder ta buƙaci.
rows.reference: Bayan lokuta masu gefe guda, wasan huɗu-huɗu na Asabar zai kila kawai zama abin da ke wannan Kofin Ryder ke buƙata.

rows.source: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.
rows.output: Juyin juyawar na'urar motsawa wani ra'ayi ne da aka kirkira gaba ɗaya a cikin wasanni, amma wanda 'yan wasa ke yarda da shi, kuma ba a taba yin imani da shi ba fiye da a gasar da ta ke nan.
rows.reference: Canjin halin da ake cikin na shekar wani ƙago batun wasa ne gaba ɗaya amma wanda ‘yan wasa da gaske suka yi imani da shi, kuma bai taɓa zama hakan ba sai ma a gasa kamar waɗannan.

rows.source: So where would they say the momentum is now?
rows.output: A ina za su ce momentum ɗin yake yanzu?
rows.reference: Don haka a ina za su ce hoɓɓasan take yanzu?

rows.source: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.
rows.output: "Suka samu maki shida a gaba, yanzu haka hudu ne, don haka muna daukar hakan a matsayin dan karamin ci gaba, ina tsammani," in ji Jordan Spieth yayin da ya fita daga rana.
rows.reference: “A da suna da ja gaba na ɗigo shida kuma yanzu huɗu ne, don haka muna ɗaukan hakan a matsayin dan hoɓɓasa a tunanina,” inji Jordan Spieth a lokacin da ya gama don ranar.

rows.source: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.
rows.output: Yuroopu na da fa'ida, ba shakka, maki hudu a gaba tare da goma sha biyu a cikin wasa.
rows.reference: Turai tana da fa’ida, haƙiƙa, digo huɗu a gaba tare da ƙarin goma sha biyu a cikin wasa.

rows.source: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.
rows.output: Amurkawa, kamar yadda Spieth ya ce, suna jin suna da dan iska a cikin jiragen su, kuma suna da abubuwa da yawa da za su yi musu kuzari, ba kawai yanayin da Spieth da Justin Thomas suka yi ba duk ranar, kuma kowanne yana da maki uku daga hudu.
rows.reference: Amurkawa, kamar yadda Spieth ke faɗa, suna jin suna da ɗan taimako ne a cikin lamarin kodayake suna da abubuwa da yawa da za ƙarfafa musu gwiwa, mafi aƙalla ba shi ne nau’i na Spieth da Justin Thomas waɗanda suka yi wasa tare dukkan rana kuma kowanne ya tashi da ɗigo-ɗigo uku daga huɗu.

rows.source: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.
rows.output: Spieth ya kasance mai guba daga tee zuwa kore kuma yana jagorantar da misali.
rows.reference: Spieth ya kasance guba daga tee zuwa kore kuma yana shugabanci da misali.

rows.source: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.
rows.output: Wannan ihun na murna na ciki ya kara karfinsa yayin da ya ci gaba da zagayawa, ya yi kwalliyar da ta dace don ya kai wasan na hudu da ci 2-2 lokacin da ya da Thomas suka kasance 2-2 bayan biyu.
rows.reference: Waɗannan ihu na biki sun yi kamari kamar yadda kewayansa ya ci gaba, yana nutsar da wani muhimmin abu don daukan murabba’i guda huɗu a lokacin da shi da Thomas suka kasance a kashe su biyu bayan biyun.

rows.source: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.
rows.output: Kwallonsa da ya yi nasara a kan 15 ya samu irin wannan ihu, irin wanda ke nuna cewa yana ganin cewa tawagar Amurka ba ta fita daga wannan ba.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarinsa da ya ciyo musu wasan ranar 15 inda ya haɗu da irin ihun, wanda ke nuna maka ya yi imani cewa ƙungiyar Amurkan ba wai ba ta cikin wannan ba ne.

rows.source: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.
rows.output: "Kuna da gaske kawai ku nutse da damuwa game da wasan ku."
rows.reference: “Dole sai a zahiri ka shiga ciki ƙasa sosai kuma ka damu game da wasanka,” inji Spieth.

rows.source: It is all each of these players has left now.
rows.output: Duk wani abu ne da ya rage wa kowace daga cikin wadannan 'yan wasa.
rows.reference: Shi dukkan kowane daga waɗannan ‘yan wasan ya tafi yanzu.

rows.source: 18 holes to make a mark.
rows.output: Holes 18 don yin alamar.
rows.reference: Ramuka 18 don yin wani maki.

rows.source: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Kawai 'yan wasa biyu da suka fi maki fiye da Spieth da Thomas a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata sune Francesco Molinari da Tommy Fleetwood, labarin da ba a iya musantawa na gasar Ryder.
rows.reference: ‘Yan wasan kawai da ke da ɗigo-ɗigo da yawa fiye da Spieth da Thomas a sama da kwanaki biyu su ne Francesco Molinari da Tommy Fleetwood, labari da ba isasshe ba na  Ryder Kulob.

rows.source: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.
rows.output: Kasashen Turai masu ban mamaki da ban sha'awa suna da 'ya'ya hudu daga cikin huɗu kuma ba za su iya yin kuskure ba.
rows.reference: Ma’aurata wani iri amma da ake so na Turai su ne huɗu daga huɗu kuma ba za su yi abin da ba daidai ba.

rows.source: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.
rows.output: "Moliwood" su ne kawai ma'auratan da ba su yi bogey a ranar Asabar ba, amma kuma sun guji yin bogey a ranar Asabar da kuma rana ta Juma'a da kuma baya na Juma'a.
rows.reference: “Moliwood” sun zama kawai su ne biyu kar su harbe wani shirme a ranar Asabar da rana amma kuma sun guje wa shiririta a ranar Asabar da safe, Juma’a da rana kuma na bayan tara a ranar Juma’a da safe.

rows.source: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.
rows.output: Wannan gudu, da kuma yadda kuzarinsu ke bayyana a matsayin wanda ke gudana a cikin wannan taron mai cike da kuzari, ya tabbatar da cewa su ne 'yan wasa da za su yi nasara a ranar Lahadi, kuma ba za a sami wani dan wasa da ya fi shahara wajen tabbatar da nasarar Turai a matsayin rana ta faduwa a kan Le Golf National ba, sai Fleetwood ko Molinari.
rows.reference: Wannan ya wuce, kuma irin yadda kuzarinsu ke wucewa gaba ɗaya daga zuwa da kuma dandazon jama’a da suka ƙarfafa cewa su ne ‘yan wasan da za a buge a ranar Lahdi, kuma ba za a sake samun ƙarin ɗan wasa da zai rufe wani cin nasara da za a iya yi ta Turai kamar yadda rana ta fito a saman Le Golf National maimakon Fleetwood ko Molinari.

rows.source: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.
rows.output: A mafi kyau a lokaci guda a kan ramuka daban-daban.
rows.reference: Idan abin so ne gaba ɗaya a lokaci guda a ramuka daban-daban.

rows.source: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.
rows.output: Tattaunawar darajar Turai ta ci gaba da kasancewa a gaba, duk da haka.
rows.reference: Maganar ɗaukakar Turai har yanzu ba ta nuna ba.

rows.source: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.
rows.output: Bubba Watson da Webb Simpson sun yi aiki da sauri a kan Sergio Garcia, jarumin rabin safe, lokacin da aka sanya shi tare da Alex Noren.
rows.reference: Bubba Watson da Webb Simpson sun yi gajeren aiki na Sergio Garcia, gwarzon ƙwallo huɗu na safe, a lokacin da aka yi musu haɗin biyu tare da Alex Noren.

rows.source: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.
rows.output: Wani bogey da kuma biyu a kan gaba na gaba ya sa Spaniya da Swidiya a cikin ramin da ba su taba fita ba.
rows.reference: Wani bogey da ruɓanya sau biyu a kan gaban tara mai tona Spaniard da Swede din a cikin wani rami da ba su taɓa zuwa kusa ga fita ba.

rows.source: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.
rows.output: A ranar Lahadi, duk da haka, babu wanda zai iya taimaka maka ka fita daga ramukan ka.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, kodayake, babu wani da zai taimake ka fita daga raminka ba.

rows.source: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.
rows.output: Kwallayen hudu da foursomes suna da ban sha'awa a kallonsa kusa saboda hulɗar da ke tsakanin ma'aurata, shawarwarin da suke bayarwa, waɗanda ba sa ba da su, da kuma yadda dabaru za su iya canza a cikin dakika guda.
rows.reference: Ƙwallaye huɗun da haɗin huɗun suna da ban sha’awa a kalla daga kusa saboda ma’amala tsakanin haɗe-haɗen biyu, shawarar da suke bayarwa, shawarar da ba sa bayarwa da kuma hanyar da wata dabara za ta iya canjuwa a wani bigiren.

rows.source: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.
rows.output: Afrilu sun taka rawa sosai a matsayin ƙungiya, kuma suna da babban ci gaba zuwa ranar karshe amma wannan zagayen na biyu ya nuna cewa Tawagar Amurka tana da ƙarfin gwiwa don yaƙin da wasu, musamman waɗanda ke ƙasar, sun yi shakkun.
rows.reference: Turai sun yi wasa sosai a matsayin wata ƙungiya ya zuwa yanzu kuma sun zama shugabanni a cikin rana ta ƙarshe amma wannan lokacin na huɗu-huɗun yana nuna kuma cewa Team USA yana da ciki don yaƙin na cewa, musamman Stateside, sun yi ta shakka.

rows.source: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day
rows.output: Yuroopu ta ɗauki 10-6 a gaba a ranar karshe ta gasar Ryder Cup
rows.reference: Turai tana ja gaba 10 da 6 a cikin ƙarshen ranan Ryder Cup

rows.source: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.
rows.output: Za a yi amfani da fa'idodin lafiya a ranar karshe ta gasar Ryder Cup bayan da Turai ta fito daga wasan juyayi na ranar Asabar da ci 10-6 a kan Amurka.
rows.reference: Turai za ta sami wata fa’ida mai amfani a cikin ranar ta ƙarshe ta Ryder Cup bayan tasowa daga ƙwallaye huɗu na Asabar da wasannin huɗu-huɗu tare da wani ja gaba na 10 da 6 a cikin Amurka.

rows.source: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.
rows.output: An yi wa duo Tommy Fleetwood da Francesco Molinari kawanya da nasara biyu a kan Tiger Woods da ke fama da matsalar, don haka sun kai jimlar su a Le Golf National zuwa maki hudu.
rows.reference: Su biyun da suka sami ƙarfin gwiwa Tommy Fleetwood da Francesco Molinari sun jagori canji da cin nasarori biyu a saman Tiger Woods da ke gwagwarmaya don ɗaukan lamba ya zuwa yanzu a Le Golf National zuwa ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu.

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.
rows.output: Tawagar Turai ta Thomas Bjorn, da ke neman kare kofin da suka rasa a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, sun yi galaba a kan tawagar Amurka da ta yi kaca-kaca a safiyar ranar, inda suka samu nasarar 3-1.
rows.reference: Sashen Turai na Thomas Bjorn, mai neman riƙe kofin ba su ci nasara ba a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, da mamaye wani rashin sa’a a sashen Amurka a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu na safe, inda suka ɗauki jere-jere 3 da 1.

rows.source: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.
rows.output: An ba da ƙarin juriya daga Amurka a cikin ƴan wasa, inda suka lashe wasanni biyu, amma ba za su iya cin kashi ba.
rows.reference: Amurka ta ƙara turjiya a cikin huɗu-huɗun, tana ci nasarar wasanni biyu, amma sun gagara ci a cikin tawayar.

rows.source: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Kungiyar Jim Furyk suna buƙatar maki takwas daga wasan guda goma sha biyu da za a yi a ranar Lahadi don kare kofin.
rows.reference: Sashen Jim Furyk suna buƙatar ɗigo-ɗigo daga wasanni ɗaiɗaiku 12 na ranar Lahadi don riƙe kofin.

rows.source: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.
rows.output: Fleetwood shine farkon dan wasan Turai da ya lashe maki hudu a jere, yayin da shi da Molinari, wanda aka fi sani da "Molliwood" bayan wani karshen mako mai ban mamaki, su ne kawai ma'aurata na biyu da suka lashe maki hudu daga wasan farko na hudu a tarihin gasar Ryder.
rows.reference: Fleetwood shi ne farkon rookie na Turai da ya ci ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu a yayin da shi da Molinari, da aka cewa "Molliwood" bayan wani ƙarshen mako da ake magana kuma kawai su ne haɗin biyu da suka ci ɗigo-ɗigo hudu daga budewa wasanninsu huɗu a cikin tarihin Ryder Cup.

rows.source: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.
rows.output: Bayan da suka yi nasarar cin nasara a kan Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin wasan da aka yi a cikin rukunoni hudu, sai suka yi aiki sosai don cin nasara a kan Woods da sabon dan wasan Amurka Bryson Dechambeau da ci 5&4.
rows.reference: Bayan sun buge Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin ƙwallaye huɗun sai kuma suka tashi suke buge Woods da rookie na Amurka Bryson Dechambeau ta kuma wani abin gani na 5 da 4.

rows.source: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.
rows.output: Woods, wanda ya ja kansa ta cikin wasanni biyu a ranar Asabar, ya nuna wasu lokacin da ya nuna kyan gani amma ya rasa wasanni 19 daga cikin 29 da ya buga a cikin jiga-jigan biyu da jiga-jigan hudu, da kuma nasara bakwai a jere.
rows.reference: Woods, wanda ya ja kansa zuwa cikin wasanni biyu a ranar Asabar, ya nuna wata bayyana ta ilimi amma yanzu ya rasa 19 na wasanninsa a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da wasannin huɗu-huɗu da bakwai a cikin wani jeri.

rows.source: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.
rows.output: Justin Rose, wanda ya huta a safiyar ranar, ya dawo ya yi aiki tare da Henrik Stenson a cikin foursomes, inda ya sha kashi da ci 2&1 a hannun Dustin Johnson da Brooks Koepka - wanda ya kasance na farko da na uku a duniya.
rows.reference: Justin Rose, ya huta don ƙwallaye huɗu na safen, ya dawo ga abokin hulɗa Henrik Stenson a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu zuwa ga wata dokewa 2 da 1 ci na Dustin Johnson da Brooks Koepka - mai kima ɗaya da uku a cikin duniya.

rows.source: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.
rows.output: Asiya ba ta da shi a duk lokacin da take da shi, a rana mai kyau da iska a kudu maso yammacin Paris.
rows.reference: Turai ba ta samu ba yadda take da sauki, ranar kudu-maso-yamma mai iska ta Paris.

rows.source: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.
rows.output: Wani mai lashe gasar sau uku, Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas sun saita ma'auni ga Amurka da maki biyu a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Babban mai cin nasara sau uku Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas sun kafa wani layi don Amurkawa tare da ɗigo-ɗigo biyu a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.
rows.output: Sun samu nasara mai wahala 2&1 akan Jon Rahm na Spain da Ian Poulter a cikin wasan kwalla hudu, sannan suka dawo daga baya don cin nasara a kan Poulter da Rory McIlroy 4&3 a cikin wasan foursomes, bayan da suka yi rashin nasara a ramukan farko biyu.
rows.reference: Sun sami wani ci da ba daɗi na 2 da 1 a kan Jon Rahm Ian Poulter na Spain a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da kuma dawowa daga baya don buge Poulter da Rory McIlroy 4 da 3 a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu bayan su rasa cin nasara ta buɗewa ramukan biyu.

rows.source: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Kawai sau biyu a tarihin gasar Ryder Cup ne tawagar da ta dawo daga raguwar maki hudu (4) da ke shiga wasan gida, duk da cewa a matsayin masu rike da kambun, tawagar Furyk za ta iya samun maki daya don kiyaye kambun.
rows.reference: Kawai sau ɗaya ne a tarihin Ryder Cup wata ƙungiya ta sake dawowa daga wani rasa ɗigo huɗu a cikin ɗaiɗaiku,  kodayake kamar yadda masu riƙon na sashen Furyk ke buƙatar kawai tsayuwar doki don riƙe kofin.

rows.source: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.
rows.output: Bayan da aka yi mata na biyu na kwanaki biyu, duk da haka, wata hari a ranar Lahadi tana da alama za ta wuce su.
rows.reference: Bayan kasancewa na biyu mafi kyau na kwanaki biyu, amma, wani sake hari na ranar Lahadi ya yi kamar dai zai fi ƙarfinsu.

rows.source: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce "babu hanya" za ta rabu da makamai ba tare da amincewa ba
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce ‘ba yadda’ za ta rage makami ita kaɗai ba tare da aminci ba

rows.source: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.
rows.output: Ministan Harkokin Waje na Koriya ta Arewa ya gaya wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar cewa takunkumin da aka ci gaba da yi ya kara dagula amanarsu ga Amurka, kuma babu wata hanya da kasar za ta yi watsi da makamai na nukiliya ba tare da wani sharadi ba a cikin irin wadannan yanayi.
rows.reference: Ministan Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Koriya ta Arewa ya faɗa wa Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar ci gaba da takunkumi yana ƙara tura rashin amincewarta da Amurka kuma babu wata hanya da ƙasar za ta bar makamanta na nukiliya ita kaɗai a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin.

rows.source: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
rows.output: Ri Yong Ho ya sanar da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta shekarar da ta gabata cewa Koriya ta Arewa ta ɗauki "matakai masu kyau na kyauta" a cikin shekarar da ta gabata, kamar dakile gwaje-gwajen nukiliya da na makami, rushe wurin gwaje-gwajen nukiliya, da kuma alkawari na rashin yawaitar makamai na nukiliya da fasahar nukiliya.
rows.reference: Ri Yong ya faɗa wa Babban Taro na shekara na na hukumar duniya cewa Koriya ta Arewa ta yi “masu matakai na mutunci” a cikin shekarar ta da wuce, kamar tsaida gwaje-gwajen nukiliya da makamai masu linzami, rusa wurin gwajin nukiliya, kuma da yin alkawari ba za ta ƙara makaman nukiliya da fasahar nukiliya ba.

rows.source: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.
rows.output: "Amma, ba mu ga wani amsa da ya dace daga Amurka ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Amma, ba mu ga kowane abu na martani daga Amurka,” inji shi.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."
rows.output: "Ba tare da wani yarda da Amurka ba, ba za a yi imani da tsaro na kasa ba kuma a cikin irin wannan yanayi ba za mu iya rage makaminmu da kanmu ba."
rows.reference: “Ba tare da kowane aminci ba na Amurka ba za a sami ƙarfin gwiwa a cikin tsaronmu na ƙasa kuma a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin babu wata hanya da mu kaɗai za mu rage makamai mu da farko.”

rows.source: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.
rows.output: Yayin da Ri ya sake maimaita korafe-korafe na yau da kullun na Koriya ta Arewa game da jajircewar Washington ga hanyar "matakai" na kawar da makamai, inda Koriya ta Arewa za ta samu lada yayin da take daukan matakai na hankali, bayanin nasa ya bayyana mai mahimmanci a cikin cewa bai ki kawar da makamai ba bisa ka'ida, kamar yadda Pyongyang ta yi a baya.
rows.reference: A yayin da Rike same maimaita koke-koken Koriya ta Kudu da aka sani game da ƙin Washington na bin wata hanyar “a hankali” don rage makaman nukiliyat a ƙarƙashinsa da za a ba da kyauta ga Koriya ta Arewan a yayin da ɗauki wasu matakai a hankali, jawabin nasa ya bayyana da muhimmanci saboda ba ta ƙi rage makaman nukiliyar ita kaɗai ba haka kawai kamar yadda Pyongyang ɗin ta yi a baya ba.

rows.source: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.
rows.output: Ri ya yi nuni ga wani sanarwa da aka fitar da shi tare da Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump a wani taron farko tsakanin shugaban kasar Amurka mai ci da shugaban kasar Koriya ta Arewa a Singapore a ranar 12 ga Yuni, lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawarin yin aiki kan "kawancen yankin Koriya" yayin da Trump ya yi alkawarin ba da tabbaci kan tsaro na Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: Ri ya yi dube ne ga wani jawabin hadin gwiwa daga Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump a wani babban taro da aka taba yi tsakanin shugaban Amurka mai ci da wani shugaban Koriya ta Arewa a cikin Singapore a ranar 12 ga Yuni, a lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawari yin aiki zuwa ga "rage makaman nukiliya a zirin Koriya" a lokacin da Trump ya yi alkawarin ba da garanti na tsaron Koriya ta Arewa din.

rows.source: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa tana neman a kammala yakin Koriya na 1950-53, amma Amurka ta ce Pyongyang ta fara barin makamai.
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa tana neman wani kawo wa ƙarshen Yakin Koriya na shekarun 1950 zuwa 53, amma Amurkan ta ce Pyongyang dole ta bar makamanta na nukiliya daga farko.

rows.source: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.
rows.output: Washington kuma ta yi adawa da kiraye-kirayen a sassauta tsauraran takunkumin kasa da kasa kan Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Washington ta ki kiraye-kiraye na ta sassauta takunkumin ƙasa-da-ƙasa a kan Koriya ta Arewa.
