rows.source: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.
rows.output: "Amurka tana da'awar "denuclearization-first" kuma tana kara matsawa ta hanyar takunkumi don cim ma burinsu ta hanyar tilastawa, har ma da adawa da "bayyana ƙarshen yakin,"" in ji Ri.
rows.reference: “Amurka ta jajirce a kan “barin nukiliya daga farko” kuma ta ƙara matakin matsai ta takunkumi don cimma manufarta a cikin halin tilastawa, da kuma ma ƙin “furuci na ƙarshen yaƙi,”” inji Ri.

rows.source: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.
rows.output: "Ra'ayin cewa takunkumin zai iya sa mu a kan ƙafafu ba wani mafarkai ba ne na mutanen da ba su da ilimi game da mu.
rows.reference: “Fahimta ta cewa takunkumi zai iya kawo mu kan gwiwowinmu wani mafarki ne na mutane waɗanda suka zahilci abu game da mu.

rows.source: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."
rows.output: Amma matsalar ita ce cewa ci gaba da takunkumin ya kara tsananta rashin yarda da juna."
rows.reference: Amma matsalar ita ce ci gaba da takunkumi suna kara rashin yardarmu.”

rows.source: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.
rows.output: Ri bai ambaci wani shiri na wani taron haduwa tsakanin Kim da Trump da shugaban Amurka ya bayyana a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a farkon mako ba.
rows.reference: Ri bai yi furuci na shirye-shirye don wani babban taro na biyu tsakanin Kim da Trump wanda shugaban Amurka da ya tsokaci a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a cikin farkon makon.

rows.source: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."
rows.output: Ministan ya mayar da hankali kan taron uku tsakanin Kim da shugaban Koriya ta Kudu Moon Jae-in a cikin watanni biyar da suka gabata, ya kara da: "Idan jam'iyyar da ke da alhakin wannan batu na kawar da makamai ta kasance Koriya ta Kudu ba Amurka ba, to kawar da makaman Koriya ta Arewa ba zai kasance a cikin wannan matsaya ba."
rows.reference: A maimakon haka ministan ya yi tsokaci ne na taruka uku tsakanin Kim da shugaban Koriya ta Kudu Moon Jae-in a cikin watanni biyar da suka wuce kuma ya ƙara da cewa: “Idan kasar da ke cikin wannan batun na barin nukiliya za a ce Koriya ta Kudu ne ba Amurka ba da barin nukiliyar na zirin Koriya da ba sami irin matsalar ba.”

rows.source: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.
rows.output: Har ila yau, yanayin jawabin Ri ya sha bambam a wannan shekara, idan aka kwatanta da na shekarar da ta gabata, lokacin da ya gaya wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya cewa kawo U.S. a matsayin manufa ga tarkacen North Korea ya zama tilas bayan "Mista Shugaban Mugunta" Trump ya kira Kim "mutumin roka" da ke kan hanyarsa ta kashe kansa.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, lafazin jawabin na Ri ya dan zama daban daga na shekarar da ta gabata, a lokacin da ya gaya wa Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar cewa cikin yankin Amurka da rokokin Koriya wani abu ne da dole zai wakana bayan “Mista Shugaba Mai Neman Bala’i” Trup ya kira Kim da wani “mutum mai roka” da ke neman kashe kansa.

rows.source: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.
rows.output: A wannan shekarar a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Trump, wanda a shekarar da ta gabata ya yi barazana ga "cikar lalata" Koriya ta Arewa, ya yabawa Kim bisa jarumtaka da ya yi wajen rage makaman, amma ya ce har yanzu akwai aiki mai yawa da za a yi kuma dole ne a ci gaba da sanya takunkumi har sai Koriya ta Arewa ta daina amfani da makamai.
rows.reference: Wannan shekarar a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, Trump, wanda shekarar da ta gabata ya yi barazana ta “rusa gaba ɗaya” Koriya ta Arewa, ya yabi Kim don karfin halinsa na ɗaukan matakai na rage makamai, amma ya ce har yanzu a akwai aiki da dole za a yi kuma takunkumi suna nan sa har Koriya ta Arewan ta bar nukiliya.

rows.source: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."
rows.output: A ranar Talata, Trump ya ce bai da wani lokaci na musamman da zai yi wannan ba, yana cewa "Idan ya ɗauki shekaru biyu, uku ko watanni biyar - ba komai ba."
rows.reference: A ranar Laraba, Trump ya ce ba ya da lokaci ƙayyadedde don wannan, yana cewa “Idan zai ɗauki shekaru biyu, shekaru uku ko shekaru biyar - ba damuwa.”

rows.source: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.
rows.output: Sin da Rasha sun yi jayayya cewa Majalisar Tsaro ta Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ya kamata ta ba Pyongyang lada bisa matakai da aka ɗauka.
rows.reference: China da Rasha sun yi mahawara cewa ya kamata Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya ba da kyauta ga Pyongyang don matakan da ta ɗauka.

rows.source: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."
rows.output: Duk da haka, Sakatare-Janar na Amurka Mike Pompeo ya gaya wa Majalisar Tsaro ta Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a ranar Alhamis cewa: "Dole ne a ci gaba da aiwatar da takunkumin da Majalisar Tsaro ta yi ba tare da gajiya ba har sai an cim ma cikar, cikar, tabbatar da an kawar da makaman nukiliya."
rows.reference: Amma, Sakataren Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka  Mike Pompeo ya faɗa wa Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Alhamis cewa: “Dole tilasta takunkumin Kwamitin Tsaro ya ci gaba sosai ba tare da gazawa ba sai har mun ga cikekken barin nukiliya da aka tantance daga ƙarshe.”

rows.source: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
rows.output: Majalisar Tsaro ta yi jajircewar takaita takaita kan Koriya ta Arewa tun daga shekarar 2006 domin hana samun kudi ga shirye-shiryen nukiliyar Pyongyang da na makami mai linzami.
rows.reference: Kwamitin Tsaro gaba daya ya sa karfafa takunkumi ne a kan Koriya ta Arewa tun 2006 a wani yinkuri na dakile samun kudi don shirye-shiryen Pyongyang na nukiliya da makamin fashewa mai linzami.

rows.source: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.
rows.output: Pompeo ya gana da Ri a gefen taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, ya kuma ce bayan haka zai ziyarci Pyongyang a watan mai zuwa don shirya wani taron.
rows.reference: Pompeo ya haɗu da Ri a gefen Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya inda ya ce bayan hakan zai sake ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu.

rows.source: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.
rows.output: Pompeo ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau uku a wannan shekarar, amma tafiyarsa ta ƙarshe ba ta yi kyau ba.
rows.reference: Pompeo ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau uku tun tuni wannan shekarar, amma zuwan nasa bai yi daɗi sosai ba.

rows.source: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."
rows.output: Ya bar Pyongyang a watan Yuli yana mai cewa an samu ci gaba, sai kuma kasar Koriya ta Arewa ta yi masa tsokaci cikin sa'o'i kaɗan da ya yi "irin bukatun 'yan fashi."
rows.reference: Ya bar Pyongyang a cikin Yuli yana mai cewa an samu ci gaba, kawai sai dai a cikin sa’o’i Koriya ta Arewa ta yi watsi da neman “buƙatu kamar na 'yan daba.”

rows.source: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta yi alkawarin a wani taro da Moon a wannan watan na rushe wurin harba makamai da kuma wani wurin samar da makamai idan Amurka ta dau "matakan da suka dace."
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa ta yi alkawari a wani mitin tare da Moon wannan watan za ta ruguza wani wuri na gwajin makami mai linzami da kuma wani gini na nukiliya idan Amurka ta ɗauki “wasu matakai ta ɓangaren.”

rows.source: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.
rows.output: Ya ce Kim ya gaya masa cewa "matakan da suka dace" da yake neman su ne tabbatattun alkawuran tsaro da Trump ya yi a Singapore da kuma kokarin da ake yi na kawo karshen takaddun.
rows.reference: Ya ce Kim ya faɗa masa "wasu matakai ta ɓangaren" da yake nema su ne garanti na tsaro da Trump ya yi alkawari a Singapore da kuma yin motsi zuwa ga daidaita hulɗoɗi tare da Washington.

rows.source: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest
rows.output: Daliban Harvard suna koyon yadda za su huta sosai
rows.reference: Daliban Harvard sun ɗauki kwas a kan samun isasshen barci

rows.source: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'
rows.output: Wani sabon darasi a Jami'ar Harvard a wannan shekarar ya sa dukkan daliban da ke karatun digiri su samu karin bacci domin yakar al'adun da ke kara yawan shan kofi da ke sa su yi bacci a duk dare.
rows.reference: Wani sabon kwas a Jami’ar Harvard wannan shekarar ya samar wa dukkan ɗalibansa samun ƙarin barci a cikin wani yinƙuri na dakile girman al’adar ƙarti ta karatu ta hanyar shan kafen ‘dukkan dare.’

rows.source: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.
rows.output: Wani malami ya gano cewa dalibai a jami'ar da ta fi kowa a duniya galibi ba su da masaniya game da abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci dangane da yadda za su kula da kansu.
rows.reference: Wani malami ya sami ɗalibai a jami’a ta daya a duniyar yawanci ba su san kome ba idan an zo maganar muhimman abubuwa game da yadda za su kula da kansu.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.
rows.output: Charles Czeisler, farfesa a fannin ilimin barci a Jami'ar Harvard ta Likitanci da kuma ƙwararre a Asibitin Brigham da Mata, ya tsara wannan darasi, wanda yake ganin shine na farko a irin wannan a Amurka.
rows.reference: Charles Czeisler, farfesa na maganin barci a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Likita ta Harvard kuma wani kwararre a Brigham da Asibitin Mata, shi ne ya tsara kwas din, wanda ya yi imani shi ne na farko irinsa a cikin Amurka.

rows.source: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.
rows.output: Ya samu kuzari ya fara shirin ne bayan ya yi jawabi kan tasirin rashin barci kan koyo.
rows.reference: An janyo hankalinsa ya fara kwas ɗin bayan ya yi jawabi a kan tasiri na hana barci a kan koyon ilmi.

rows.source: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'
rows.output: A ƙarshe, wata yarinya ta zo ta ce min: 'Me ya sa aka gaya min wannan kawai yanzu, a cikin shekarar karshe ta?
rows.reference: ‘Daga ƙarshe wata yarinya guda ɗaya ta zo ta same ni ta ce: ‘Me ya sa sai yanzu aka gaya mun wannan, a cikin shekarata ta karshe?’

rows.source: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.
rows.output: Ta ce ba a taɓa ba ta da labarin muhimmancin barci ba - wanda ya yi mamakin ni,' ya gaya wa The Telegraph.
rows.reference: Ta ce ba wanda ya taɓa gaya mata game da amfani na barci - abin da ya ba ta mamaki,’ ta faɗa wa The Telegraph.

rows.source: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.
rows.output: An fara gabatar da wannan darasi a wannan shekarar, yana bayyana wa dalibai abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci na yadda samun barci mai kyau ke taimakawa a fannin ilimi da wasanni, da kuma inganta lafiyarsa gaba daya.
rows.reference: Kwas ɗin ya fara ne yin lokacin farko a wannan shekarar, inda aka yi bayani ga dalibai fa’idoji na yadda halaye masu kyau na barci ke taimakon aikin koyon ilimi da wasan tsalle-tsalle, har ma da inganta lafiyarsu gaba ɗaya.

rows.source: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.
rows.output: Paul Barreira, farfesa a fannin ilimin kwakwalwar mutum a Makarantar Magani ta Harvard da kuma darakta na ayyukan lafiya na jami'ar, ya ce jami'ar ta yanke shawarar gabatar da wannan kwasa-kwasan ne bayan ta gano cewa daliban suna cikin mawuyacin hali na rashin barci a cikin mako.
rows.reference: Paul Barreira, farfesan ilmin mahaukata a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Asibiti ta Harvard kuma babban darakta na ayyukan lafiya na jami’ar, ya ce jami’ar ta yanke hukunci ne na gabatar da kwas ɗin bayan ta gano ana matuƙar hana ɗalibai yin barci a lokacin mako.

rows.source: The hour long course involves a series of interactive tasks.
rows.output: Sa'o'i ɗaya na darasi ya ƙunshi jerin ayyukan hulɗa.
rows.reference: Kwas mai tsawon sa’a ɗayan ya haɗa ne da jerin wasu ayyukan tattaunawa.

rows.source: In one section there is an image of a dorm room, where students click on coffee cups, curtains, trainers and books to be told about the effects of caffeine and light and how athletic performance is impacted by sleep deficiency, and the importance of a bedtime routine.
rows.output: A wani sashe akwai hoto na dakin barci, inda dalibai ke danna kofuna na kofi, labule, takalmi, da littattafai don a sanar da su illolin kafein da haske da kuma yadda aikin motsa jiki yake shafar rashin barci, da kuma muhimmancin da ake da shi na yin wani tsari na barci.
rows.reference: A wani sashe akwai wata sura ta wani ɗakin kwana, inda ɗalibai suka danne kofunan kofi, labulaye, masu horarwa da litattafai don a fada musu illoli na kafen da haske da yadda aikin tsale-tsalle ke tasiri a kan rashin isasshen barci, da amfani na al’adar abin da za a yi lokacin kwanciya.

rows.source: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.
rows.output: A wani sashe, mahalarta sun sami bayani kan yadda rashin barci na dogon lokaci zai iya kara haɗarin bugun zuciya, bugun zuciya, damuwa da kuma ciwon daji.
rows.reference: A cikin wani sashen, an gaya wa masu shigan yadda hana barci na zango mai tsawo zai iya ƙara haɗuran hare-haren zuciya, shanyewar jiki, baƙin ciki da sankara.

rows.source: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.
rows.output: Wani taswira na harabar, tare da alamomin da za a iya mu'amala da su, sannan ya ƙarfafa mahalarta su yi tunani game da harkokin yau da kullum.
rows.reference: Wata taswirar makarantar, tare da alamomi na ma’amala, sa’an nan ƙarfafa gwiwar masu halartar don tunani game da abin da suke yi a kullum ɗinsu.

rows.source: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.
rows.output: 'Muna san cewa ba zai canza halayen ɗalibai nan take ba.
rows.reference: ‘Mun sani ba zai canza ɗabi’ar ɗalibai nan take ba.

rows.source: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.
rows.output: Amma mun yi imani suna da 'yancin sanin hakan - kamar yadda kuke da 'yancin sanin illolin lafiya na zabar shan taba, 'injiniyan Czeisler ya kara.
rows.reference: Amma mun yi imani suna da ‘yanci su sani - kawai kamar yadda kake da wani ‘yanci na sanin illoli ga lafiya na zaɓan shan sigari,’ Farfesa Czeisler ya ƙara da cewa.

rows.source: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.
rows.output: Al'adar alfahari da "tsalle dare" har yanzu tana wanzuwa, ya ce, yana mai cewa fasaha ta zamani da kuma matsi da ake yi wa dalibai ya sa rashin barci ya zama matsala mai girma.
rows.reference: Al’adar cika baki a cikin ‘jan dukkan dare’ har yanzu tana nan, inji shi, yana mai ƙari da cewa fasahar zamani da kuma ci gaba da matsi a kan ɗalibai yana nufin hana barci yana fara zama wata matsala mai girma.

rows.source: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.
rows.output: Tabbatar da cewa kana samun isassun bacci, na inganci, ya kamata ya zama 'maganin sirri' na ɗalibi don yaƙar damuwa, gajiya, da damuwa, ya ce - har ma don gujewa samun ƙiba, saboda rashin bacci yana sanya kwakwalwa cikin yanayin yunwa, yana sa su ci gaba da jin yunwa.
rows.reference: Ya kamata tabbacin samun isasshen barci, wani mai kyau, ya zama wa ɗalibi ‘makami na boye’ don daƙile baƙin ciki, gajiya da tashin hankali, inji shi - ko don guje wa yin ƙiba, saboda hana barci yakan sa ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin yanayin rashin abinci, yana mai sa su koyaushe a yunwa.

rows.source: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.
rows.output: Raymond So, wani ɗan ƙasar California mai shekaru 19 da ke nazarin ilimin kemikali da ilimin jiki, ya taimaka wa Farfesan Czeisler wajen tsara wannan kwasa-kwasan, bayan ya shiga daya daga cikin darussa na sa a shekarar da ta gabata a farkon shekarar sa a Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, wani mai shekaru 19 dan California mai karanta ilmin sinadarai da ilmin tsirrai da dabbobi na zahiri, shi ya taimaka wa Farfesa Czeisler tsara kwas ɗin, bayan ya ɗauki ɗaya daga ajizuwan shekarar da ta wuce a lokacin shekararsa ta farko a Harvard.

rows.source: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.
rows.output: Ya ce ya buɗe idanunsa ya kuma zaburar da shi ya yi ƙoƙarin a gabatar da wani darasi a duk fannin jami'ar.
rows.reference: Ya ce kwas ɗin ya buɗe masa idanuwansa da jan hankali don tura samun kwas ɗin a faɗin makarantar.

rows.source: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.
rows.output: Mataki na gaba, in ji shi, shi ne ya tambayi duk daliban da suka kammala karatun digiri na biyu su kammala shirin karatun da ya yi kama da shi kafin su shiga wannan cibiyar gasa.
rows.reference: Yana fatan mataki na gaba, zai nemi dukkan ɗaliban sashen ƙarin karatu bayan digiri su cika irin shiri na karatun kafin su shiga makaranta mai gasar.

rows.source: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.
rows.output: Farfesan Czeisler ya ba da shawarar cewa ɗalibai su yi la'akari da saita agogon don lokacin kwanciya barci, da kuma lokacin da za su tashi, kuma su san illolin da ke tafe da haske mai shuɗi da ke fitarwa daga allunan lantarki da fitilun LED, wanda zai iya kawo cikas ga juyin halitta na halitta, wanda zai haifar da matsalar barci.
rows.reference: Farfesa Czeisler  ya ba shawarar cewa ya kamata ɗalibai su kula da saita wata faɗakarwa ta lokacin da za su kwanta barci, har ma da lokacin da za su farka, da kuma sanin illolin cutarwa na ‘shuɗin haske’ da ke fitowa daga fuskokin kayayyakin lantarki da haske na LED, wanda zai iya jefa tsarin lafiyarku ta tashi a barci a cikin wani yanayi, wanda zai kai ga matsalolin kasa barci.

rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
rows.output: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Kwallon da Menga ta yi ta doke 'yan wasan da suka yi kawanya
rows.reference: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard

rows.source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers sun sha wahala a ranar wasa ta biyu yayin da Dolly Menga ya ci kwallo a raga, wanda ya sa Steven Gerrard ya rasa da ci 1-0 a Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.

rows.source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.output: Kungiyar Ibrox na neman samun nasarar farko a waje tun daga nasarar da suka samu da ci 4-1 a kan St Johnstone a watan Fabrairun, amma Gary Holt's team ya yi rashin nasara a kan Gerrard na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manaja wanda ya bar kungiyarsa a bayan Hearts da ke kan gaba a gasar Ladbrokes Premiership da maki takwas.
rows.reference: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.

rows.source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
rows.output: Menga ya buga mintuna bakwai kafin a kammala rabin lokaci, kuma layin Rangers da ba su da kuzari ba a kodayaushe suka yi kama da da'awarsu.
rows.reference: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.

rows.source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.output: Yayin da Rangers ke saukowa zuwa matsayi na shida, Livingston ya hau na uku kuma kawai bayan Hibernian ta hanyar bambanci a cikin kwallaye.
rows.reference: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.

rows.source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
rows.output: Kuma akwai yiwuwar ƙarin matsala ga Rangers bayan mai layi Calum Spence ya sami kulawar asibiti saboda raunukan da ya samu a kai bayan wani abu da ake zaton an jefa shi daga gefen da ke nesa.
rows.reference: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.

rows.source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
rows.output: Gerrard ya yi canji guda takwas a cikin tawagar da ta yi nasarar shiga wasan karshe na gasar Betfred.
rows.reference: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas zuwa ga ɓangaren wanda ya jefa Ayr cikin wasannin kafin ƙarshe na Kofin Betfred.

rows.source: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.
rows.output: Holt, a daya bangaren, ya tafi tare da Livi 11 da ya dauko maki daga Hearts a makonnin da suka gabata, kuma ya yi farin ciki da yadda kungiyar sa ta yi ta shiga cikin kungiyoyinsu a duk wani lokaci.
rows.reference: Holt, a wani ɓangaren, ya tafi tare da irin Livi 11 ɗin wanda ta cire ɗigo daga Hearts mako da wuce kuma da ya yi murna da irin yadda waɗanda ya horar suka wahalar da masu adawarsu a kowane juyin da aka yi.

rows.source: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.
rows.output: Rangers na iya samun iko da mallaka amma Livingston ya yi amfani da kwallo da suka samu.
rows.reference: Za a kila ce Rangers sun mamaye kame ƙwallon amma Livingston sun yi abubuwa da yawa da ƙwallon da suka samu.

rows.source: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.
rows.output: Ya kamata su ci mintuna biyu ne kawai lokacin da Menga ya yi watsawa na farko ya aika Scott Pittman a kan Allan McGregor, amma dan wasan tsakiya ya kasa buga kwallonsa.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce sun ci kawai a mintina biyu na farawa lokacin musayar Menga ta farko da ta aika Scott Pittman ta cikin cin Allan McGregor amma mai tsaron tsakiya ya faɗaɗa damarsa babba sosai.

rows.source: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.
rows.output: Wani bugu mai zurfi na Keaghan Jacobs ya same shi, sannan ya same shi, Craig Halkett, amma abokin tsaron sa, Alan Lithgow, ya yi kokarin bugu a baya.
rows.reference: Wani dukan da ba tarewa na Keaghan Jacobs sai ya sami gola Craig Halkett amma abokinsa mai tsaro Alan Lithgow ya iya kawai faɗaɗawa ne a bayan matsayar.

rows.source: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.
rows.output: Rangers sun kama iko amma akwai alama fiye da imani a cikin wasan su a cikin karshe na uku.
rows.reference: Rangers ta dai kama sarrafa amma akwai alamar ƙarin fata maimakon yarda game da wasansu a ukun ƙarshe.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos ya ji cewa ya kamata ya samu bugun fanareti a minti na goma sha hudu yayin da ya yi karo da Steven Lawless, amma alkalin wasan Steven Thomson ya yi watsi da rokon Morelos.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos ba shakka ya ji ya kamata a ce ya sami wani bugu daga kai sai gola a makin kashi na uku na rabin sa’a kamar yadda shi da Steven Lawless suka yi karo amma alƙalin wasa Steven Thomson ya manta koke-koke na Colombia.

rows.source: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.
rows.output: Rangers sun yi harbin kai biyu a rabin farko, amma tsohon mai tsaron gida na Ibrox Liam Kelly bai yi wa Lassana Coulibaly bugu ba da kuma harbin Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers ta yi ƙoƙarin kawai buge-buge na rabin farko na biyu a kan abin hari amma tsohon golan Ibrox Liam Kelly bai nuna wata damuwa ba daga bugun kai na Lassana Coulibaly da kuma wani harin sauri na Ovie Ejaria.

rows.source: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.
rows.output: A cikin mintuna 34 na farko na Livi, mai yiwuwa ya kasance a kan gaba, amma babu wanda zai iya musanta cewa sun cancanci shi saboda kokarinsu kaɗai.
rows.reference: Yayin da buɗin da Livi ta samu na mintina 34 kila ya zama a kan sake wasa, ba wanda zai iya ƙi sun cancance shi don cinsu da kawai suka samu.

rows.source: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.
rows.output: Koma Rangers ba su iya magance wani tsalle mai zurfi na Jacobs ba.
rows.reference: Rangers sun sake kasa magance wani hoɓɓasa da Jacobs ya yi.

rows.source: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.
rows.output: Scott Arfield bai yi martanin ba yayin da Declan Gallagher ya zura kwallo a ragon Scott Robinson, wanda ya ci gaba da kasancewa cikin nutsuwa don ba da damar Menga ya ci gaba da ci gaba.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield bai yi martani ba inda Declan Gallagher ya sa ƙwallon zuwa ga Scott Robinson, wanda ya yi sanyi ga ɗaukan Menga na ɗan ƙaramin gamawa.

rows.source: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.
rows.output: Gerrard ya yi aiki a lokacin hutun, ya maye gurbin Coulibaly da Ryan Kent, kuma canjin ya yi tasiri nan take yayin da mai tsaron gida ya yi wa Morelos.
rows.reference: Gerrard ya yi aiki a hutun inda ya sauya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent kuma sauyi ya kusan samar da wani tasirin nan da nan a matsayin mai kai hari ta kusurwa na sakun da ka yi wa Morelos amma mai ban sha’awa Kelly ya yi gudu daga layinsa don ya toshe.

rows.source: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.
rows.output: Amma Livingston ya ci gaba da jan masu ziyartar su su buga irin wasan da suke jin daɗin yi, tare da Lithgow da Halkett suna tafasa ƙwallon doguwa bayan dogon.
rows.reference: Amma Livingston ya ci gaba da soka maziyartan zuwa irin ainihin wasan da suke morewa, tare daLithgow da Halkett suna samun doguwar ƙwallo a sama a bayan doguwar ƙwallo.

rows.source: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.
rows.output: Kasashensu na iya kara faɗakarwa a cikin karshe amma McGregor ya yi nasarar hana Jacobs kafin ya yi kawuna daga kusurwar.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Holt da sun faɗaɗa matsayinsu na gaba a cikin matakan ƙarshe amma McGregor ya tsaya sosai ya hana Jacobs kafin Lithgow ya yi bugun ka daga kwanar.

rows.source: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.
rows.output: An ba da belin Rangers Glenn Middleton ya sake yin wata dawowar da ta yi kama da kwallon da ya yi da Jacobs amma Thomson ya sake gujewa.
rows.reference: Mai maye gurbi na Rangers twato Glenn Middleton ya sami wani neman ƙarshe na wani fenalti a inda ya yi ta ƙoƙarin tare da Jacobs amma Thomson ya kau da kai.

rows.source: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter
rows.output: Almanac: Mai ƙirƙira na Geiger Counter
rows.reference: Almanac: Wanda ya ƙago Geiger Counter

rows.source: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.
rows.output: Kuma yanzu shafi daga cikin "Asabar Morning" Almanac: Satumba 30, 1882, shekaru 136 da suka wuce a yau, da kirga ... ranar da masanin kimiyyar lissafi Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger ya haife shi a Jamus.
rows.reference: Kuma yanzu wani shafi ne daga "Sunday Morning" Almanac ɗinmu: 30 ga Satumba, 1882, shekaru 136 a yau, ana kuma CI GABA DA KIRGE ... ranar da aka haifi masanin ilmin yanayin duniya da zai so gaba Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger a cikin Jamus.

rows.source: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Geiger ya haɓaka hanyar gano da auna radiyo, wanda ya haifar da na'urar da aka sani da Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger ya gina wata hanya don gane da auna yanayin aikin tururin, wani abin ƙiƙira daga ya kai ga na’urar da aka sani a matsayin Geiger Counter.

rows.source: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
rows.output: Wani muhimmin ɓangare na kimiyya tun daga lokacin, mai ƙidayar Geiger ya zama wani muhimmin ɓangare na al'adun jama'a, kamar yadda a cikin fim ɗin 1950 "Bells of Coronado," wanda ya nuna waɗanda suka yi kama da 'yan bindiga masu ilimin kimiyya Roy Rogers da Dale Evans:
rows.reference: Wata madogarar kimiyya ne tun wancan lokacin, Geiger Counter ta zama wata madogara a al’adar ta lokaci da ake marmari, inda a fim din 1950 "Bells of Coronado," da waɗanda ba a gani masana ne na kimiyya Roy Rogers da Dale Evans suka fito a taurari:

rows.source: Man: "What in the world is that?"
rows.output: Mutum: "Mene ne a duniya?"
rows.reference: Mutum: "Mene ne a cikin duniyar nan shi ɗin?"

rows.source: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.
rows.output: Rogers: "Wannan na'urar auna radiyo ce, ana amfani da ita wajen gano ma'adanai masu radiyo, kamar uranium.
rows.reference: Rogers: "Shi ne Geiger Counter, da ake amfani wajen gano albarkatun ƙasa, irin su sinadaran uranium.

rows.source: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."
rows.output: Lokacin da ka sanya waɗannan na'urar kunne, za ka iya jin tasirin atam da aka fitar daga cikin abubuwan da ke cikin mineral.
rows.reference: A yayin da ka sa waɗannan na’urorin kunne, za ka iya ainihin jin halayen aiwatar na sinadaran atom da aikin tururin ke samarwa a cikin albarkatun.”

rows.source: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"
rows.output: Evans: "To, da alamu ya yi zafi sosai yanzu!"
rows.reference: Evans: "Ka ce, da tabbaci yana fitowa yanzu!"

rows.source: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.
rows.output: "Hans" Geiger ya mutu a shekara ta 1945, jim kadan kafin ya cika shekaru 63.
rows.reference: "Hans" Geiger ya rasu a cikin shekara ta 1945, kawai ‘yan kwanaki dab da cika shekaru 63 da kewayowar ranar haihuwarsa.

rows.source: But the invention that bears his name lives on.
rows.output: Amma ƙirƙirar da ke da sunansa tana ci gaba.
rows.reference: Amma abin da ya ƙago da ke amfani da sunansa yanan nan a raye.

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells
rows.output: Sabon rigakafin cutar daji na iya koya wa tsarin garkuwar jiki ya ga ƙwayoyin da ba su dace ba.
rows.reference: Sabuwar allurar sankara za ta iya koyar da tsarin kariyar jiki zuwa ‘ganin’ sel-sel masu matsala

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them
rows.output: Sabon rigakafin cutar daji na iya koya wa tsarin garkuwar jiki ya ga ƙwayoyin da ba su dace ba kuma ya kashe su.
rows.reference: Sabuwar allurar sankara za ta iya koyar da tsarin kariyar jiki zuwa ‘ganin’ sel-sel masu matsala da kuma kashe su

rows.source: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment
rows.output: Magani yana koyar da tsarin garkuwar jiki ya gane ƙwayoyin da ba su dace ba a matsayin wani ɓangare na maganin.
rows.reference: Allurar takan koyar da tsarin kariya jiki don ganewa sel-sel masu matsala a matsayin ɓangare na kula

rows.source: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab
rows.output: Hanyar ta ƙunshi fitar da ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki daga majinyacin, canjawa a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje
rows.reference: Hanyoyin sun haɗa da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jikin daga wani marar lafiya, jirkita su a cikin ɗakin gwajin kimiyya

rows.source: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected
rows.output: Sannan za su iya 'gani' wani furotin da ya zama ruwan dare a yawancin ciwukan daji sannan a sake shigar da shi
rows.reference: Za su iya sa’an nan ‘ganin’ wani sinadarin abinci mai gina jiki da yawancin sankarori suka sani kuma sa’an nan su sake shigarwa

rows.source: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.
rows.output: An gwada allurar rigakafin cutar ta nuna sakamako mai kyau a cikin marasa lafiya da ke da nau'ikan cututtuka daban-daban.
rows.reference: Wata allurar gwaji tana nuna sakamako mai kyau a jikin marassa lafiya da ke wani ranji na sankarorin.

rows.source: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.output: Mace ɗaya da aka yi mata magani da allurar, wadda ke koyar da tsarin garkuwar jiki ya gane ƙwayoyin da ba su dace ba, ta ga ciwon ovarian ɗin ta ya ɓace fiye da watanni 18.
rows.reference: Mata ɗaya da aka yi wa jinya da allurar, da ke koyar da tsarin kariyar jikin don gano sel-sel masu matsalar, ta ga sankararta ta mahaifa ta bace na fiye da watanni 18.

rows.source: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.
rows.output: Hanyar ta ƙunshi fitar da ƙwayoyin garkuwar jiki daga majinyacin, canza su a cikin dakin gwaje-gwaje don su "gani" wani furotin da ya zama ruwan dare a cikin yawancin ciwukan daji da ake kira HER2, sannan a sake shigar da ƙwayoyin.
rows.reference: Hanyar ta hada ne da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jiki daga wani marar lafiya, inda ake gyara su a cikin dakin gwajin kimiyya yadda za su iya “ganin” wani sinadarin protein mai gina jiki da sankarori masu yawa suka sani da ake kira HER2, inda kuma ake sake shigar da su sel-sel din.

rows.source: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."
rows.output: Farfesan Jay Berzofsky, na Cibiyar Kwayoyin Halitta ta Kasa ta Amurka a Bethesda, Maryland, ya ce: "Sakamakonmu yana nuna cewa muna da rigakafin da ya yi alkawari."
rows.reference: Farfesa Jay Berzofsky, na Cibiyar Sankara ta Amurka da ke Bethesda, Maryland, ya ce: “Sakamakonmu yana nuna cewa da wata allura da za ta amfanar."

rows.source: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.
rows.output: HER2 "ana amfani da shi wajen girma da yawa daga cikin nau'ukan ciwon daji," ciki har da ciwon mama, ovarian, huhu da kuma ciwon colorectal, in ji Farfesan Berzofsky.
rows.reference: Farfesa Berzofsky ya yi cewa HERS takan "janyo girman sankarori iri-iri da yawa," da suka haɗa da nono, mahaifa, huhu da ƙaba.

rows.source: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.
rows.output: Wani irin wannan hanyar ta ɗaukar ƙwayoyin garkuwan jiki daga marasa lafiya da "koyawa" su yadda za su kai hari kan ƙwayoyin cutar kansa ya yi aiki wajen maganin wani nau'in cutar leukemia.
rows.reference: An yi amfani da irin hanyar ta ɗaukan sel-sel da jikin marassa lafiya da "koyar" da su yadda za su kai hari ga sel-sel na sankara kuma ya yi aiki a wajen jinyar irin cutar fara.

rows.source: Kanye West Embarked on a Pro-Trump Diatribe, Wearing a MAGA Hat, After his SNL Appearance.
rows.output: Kanye West ya fara tafiyarsa ta pro-Trump, yana sanye da hular MAGA, bayan bayyana a cikin SNL.
rows.reference: Kanye West Ya Fara Zagin Masu Ƙin Trump, Sanye da wata Hular MAGA, Bayan Bayyanarsa ta SNL.

rows.source: It Didn't Go Well
rows.output: Ba Ta Samu Kyakkyawar Sakamarta ba
rows.reference: Bai Yi Daida Ba

rows.source: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.
rows.output: An yi wa Kanye West kukan a cikin dakin rikodi a lokacin wani shirin Live na daren Asabar bayan wani wasan kwaikwayo da ya yi ya yi tsokaci game da shugaban Amurka Donald Trump kuma ya ce zai tsayar da takarar shugaban kasa a 2020.
rows.reference: An yi ihu ga Kanye West a cikin ɗakin watsa shirye-shirye a lokacin Saturday Night Live bayan wani surutu inda ya yabi Shugaban Amurka. Donald Trump kuma ya ce zai neme tsayawa a cikin 2020.

rows.source: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.
rows.output: Bayan da ya yi waƙarsa ta uku a daren, mai suna Ghost Town, inda ya sanya kibiya mai taken Make America Great Again, ya yi tsokaci kan jam'iyyar Democrat ya sake jaddada goyon bayansa ga Trump.
rows.reference: Bayan yin waƙarsa ta uku da daren, da ake kira Ghost Town inda yake sanye da wata hular Make America Great, ya wuce yana wani surutu a kan 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat da kuma jaddada goyon bayansa ga Trump.

rows.source: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"
rows.output: "Da yawa na yi magana da wani farare kuma su ka ce: "Yaya za ka so Trump, shi mai nuna wariya ne?"
rows.reference: "A lokuta da dama na yi magana da wani farin mutum kuma sun ce: "Yaya za a yi kake son Trump, yana da aƙidar bambancin jinsi?"

rows.source: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.
rows.output: To, idan na damu da wariyar launin fata, da na yi hijira daga Amurka da daɗewa.
rows.reference: To, idan da na damu game da bambancin jinsi da na fice daga Amurka tun tuni," inji shi.

rows.source: SNL started the show with a skit starring Matt Damon in which the Hollywood star made fun of Brett Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judicial Committee on sexual assault claims made by Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: SNL ya fara wasan ne da wani skit da ya nuna Matt Damon, inda Damon ya yi dariya kan shaidar Brett Kavanaugh a gaban kwamitin shari'a na Majalisar Dattijai kan zarge-zargen cin zarafi da Christine Blasey Ford ta yi.
rows.reference: SNL ya fara nuna shirin da wani barkwancin fitowar Matt Damon inda tauraron na Hollywood ya ba da ban dariya a kan shaidar Brett Kavanaugh a gaban Kwamitin Majalisar Dattawa a kan Shari'a game da koke-koken cin zarafin jima'i da Christine Blasey Ford ta yi.

rows.source: Although it was not broadcast, the footage of West's rant was uploaded to social media by comedian Chris Rock.
rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a watsa shi ba, an saka fushin West a shafukan sada zumunta ta hanyar mai barkwanci Chris Rock.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba a watsa ba, amma Chris Rock ne ya ɗora ƙaramin bidiyon surutun na West a kafar sada zumunta.

rows.source: It is unclear if Rock was trying to mock West with the posting.
rows.output: Ba a bayyana ba ko Rock yana ƙoƙarin yaudarar West da wallafa.
rows.reference: Ba a sani ba ko Rock ya yi ƙoƙari ne ya muzanta West da abin da ya fitar.

rows.source: Also, West had complained to the audience that he had got a hard time backstage about his head wear.
rows.output: Haka kuma, West ya yi korafi ga masu sauraro cewa ya sami wahala a bayan fage game da kayan da yake sawa a kan kansa.
rows.reference: Haka kuma, West ya koka a masu sauraron cewa ya sha wahala a bayan fage game da abin da ke kan nasa.

rows.source: "They bullied me backstage.
rows.output: "Sun yi min tsawa a bayan fage.
rows.reference: "Sun zalunce ni a bayan fage.

rows.source: They said, 'don't go out there with that hat on.'
rows.output: Sun ce, 'Kada ka fita can da wannan hular a kai.'
rows.reference: Sun ce, 'kar ka fita zuwa can sanye da hular.'

rows.source: They bullied me!
rows.output: Suna yi min tsawa!
rows.reference: Sun zalunce ni!

rows.source: And then they say I'm in a sunken place," he said, according to the Washington Examiner.
rows.output: Sannan kuma sun ce ina wani wuri mai nutsewa," ya ce, a cewar Washington Examiner.
rows.reference: Kuma sun ce ni wani dan kore ne," inji shi kamar yadda  Washington Examiner ta kawo.

rows.source: West went on: "You wanna see the sunken place?" saying that he would "put my superman cape on, because this means you can't tell me what to do. You want the world to move forward?
rows.output: Yamma ya ci gaba da cewa: "Kina son wurin da aka nutse?" yana cewa zai "sanya rigar superman, domin wannan yana nufin ba za ka iya gaya min abin da zan yi ba. Kina son duniya ta ci gaba?
rows.reference: West ya ci gaba: Kuna so ku ga wurin aikin kore ne? yana cewa "zan sa hulata ta babban mutum, saboda yana nufin ba za ka faɗa mun abin da zan yi ba. Kuna son duniya ta ci gaba?

rows.source: Try love."
rows.output: "Kuna so ku gwada soyayya."
rows.reference: Gwada soyayya."

rows.source: His comments drew boos at least twice from the audience and SNL cast members appeared to be embarrassed, Variety reported, with one person there telling the publication: "The entire studio fell dead silent."
rows.output: An yi masa tsokana a kalla sau biyu daga masu sauraro, kuma membobin SNL sun bayyana cewa sun ji kunya, a cewar Variety, inda wani mutum a wurin ya gaya wa mujallar cewa: "Dakin dakin ya yi shuru gaba daya."
rows.reference: Sharhohin nasa sun janyo ihu aƙalla sau biyu da masu sauraro kuma mambobin da suka fito a SNL sun nuna kunyata, a cewar rahoton Variety, tare da mutum ɗaya a can yana fada wa abin da aka wallafar: Gaba daya sutudiyon ya ti tsit."

rows.source: West had been brought in as a late replacement for singer Ariana Grande, whose former boyfriend, the rapper Mac Miller had died a few days ago.
rows.output: An kawo West a matsayin maye gurbin da ya yi wa mawakiya Ariana Grande, wanda tsohon saurayinta, mawakin rap Mac Miller ya rasu 'yan kwanaki da suka wuce.
rows.reference: An kawo West ne ciki a matsayin maye gurbin daga ƙarshe na mawaki Ariana Grande, wanda tsohon saurayinta, rapper Mac Miller ya mutu wasu 'yan kwanaki da suka wuce.

rows.source: West puzzled many with a performance of the song I Love it, dressed as a Perrier Bottle.
rows.output: Yamma ta bani sha'awa da wani wasan waƙar da na so, sanye da kwalbar Perrier.
rows.reference: West ya ba da mamaki ga mutane da yawa da yin wata waka Ilove it, da ya sa tufa kamar wata Kwalbar Perrier.

rows.source: West got backing from head of conservative group TPUSA, Candace Turner who tweeted: "To one of the most courageous spirits: THANK YOU FOR STANDING UP TO THE MOB."
rows.output: Yamma ta samu goyon baya daga shugaban kungiyar masu ra'ayin mazan jiya, Candace Turner wanda ya wallafa a shafinta na Twitter: "Ga daya daga cikin ruhohin da suka fi jarumta: NA GODIYA DA KAKE TSAYA GABAN GUNAGUNI."
rows.reference: West ya sami goyon baya daga shugaban gungun masu ra'ayin riƙau na TRUSA, Candace Turner wanda a Twitter ta ce: Zuwa ga daya daga cikin masu karfin hali: MUNA GODIYA DA KA TSAYA BA RUWANKA DA 'YAN HAYANIYA."

rows.source: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."
rows.output: Amma mai gabatar da shirin talabijin Karen Hunter ya ce West kawai "yake kasancewa da wanda yake da kuma hakan yana da kyau sosai."
rows.reference: Amma mai karɓar baƙi a shirin Karen Hunter ya faɗa a Twitter cewa kawai West "yana nuna yadda yake ne kuma wannan abu ne ban sha'awa sosai."

rows.source: "But I chose NOT to reward someone (by purchasing his music or clothing or supporting his "art") who I believe is embracing and spewing ideology that is harmful to my community.
rows.output: "Amma na zabi BA na ba da lada ga wani (ta hanyar sayen kiɗan sa ko tufafi ko goyon bayan "fina-finan" sa) wanda na yi imani yana rungumar da kuma yada ra'ayi da ke cutarwa ga al'ummata.
rows.reference: "Amma na zaɓi kar na ba da kyauta ga wani (ta sayan waƙarsa ko kaya ko nuna goyon baya ga "hikimarsa") wanda na yi imani yana watsa da tallata aƙida ne da ke cutarwa ga al'ummata.

rows.source: He is free.
rows.output: Yana da 'yanci.
rows.reference: Yana da 'yanci.

rows.source: So are we," she added.
rows.output: Don haka, mun kasance," ta kara.
rows.reference: Ta kara da cewa, "Haka muma".

rows.source: Before the show, the rapper announced on Twitter that he had changed his name, saying that he was now "the being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Kafin wasan, mawallafin ya sanar da Twitter cewa ya canza sunansa, yana mai cewa yanzu shi ne "wanda aka sani da Kanye West."
rows.reference: Kafin shirin, rapper ɗin ya sanar ta Twitter cewa ya canza sunansa, yana mai cewa yanzu shi "wani ne da a da aka san ni a matsayin Kanye West."

rows.source: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.
rows.output: Ba shine farkon mai fasaha ba da ya canza sunansa, kuma yana bin tafarka na Diddy, wanda kuma aka sani da Puff Daddy, Puffy da P Diddy.
rows.reference: Ba shi ne mawaƙi na farko da ya canza sunansa ba kuma ya bi sahun su Diddy, wanda aka san shi da Puff Daddy, Puffy da P Diddy.

rows.source: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.
rows.output: Abokiyar rapper, Snoop Dogg ya samu sunan Snoop Lion kuma, ba shakka, tsohon mai fasaha mai suna Prince, ya canza sunansa zuwa alamar sannan kuma mai fasaha da aka sani da Prince.
rows.reference: Ɗan uwansa rapper Snoop Dogg a da yana da sunan Snoop Lion sai kuma sanannen mawaƙi Prince, da canza sunansa zuwa wata alama da kuma mawaƙin da aka san shi a da a matsayin Prince.

rows.source: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing
rows.output: An tuhumi da laifin yunƙurin kisan kai a cikin harbin da aka yi a wani gidan cin abinci na Belfast
rows.reference: An yi caji saboda ƙoƙarin kisa da wuƙa a wurin sayar da abinci a Belfast

rows.source: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.
rows.output: Wani mutum mai shekaru 45 an tuhume shi da yunƙurin kisan kai bayan an yanka wani mutum a gidan cin abinci a gabashin Belfast a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: An caji wani mutum mai shekaru 45 da ƙoƙarin kisa bayan an caka wa wani mutum wuka a cikin wurin sayar da abinci a Belfast ta gabas a ranar Juma'a.

rows.source: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.
rows.output: Lamarin ya faru a Ballyhackamore, a cewar 'yan sanda.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a Ballyhackamore, inji 'yan sanda.

rows.source: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.
rows.output: An sa ran wanda ake tuhuma zai bayyana a gaban kotun Magistrati ta Belfast a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin wanda ake tuhuman zai bayyana a gaban Kotun Majistare ta Belfast a ranar Litinin.

rows.source: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
rows.output: Za a duba laifukan da Sashen Shari'a ya yi.
rows.reference: Ofishin Tuhumar na Gwamnati zai sake sabunta caje-cajen.

rows.source: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity
rows.output: Tauraron wasan Game of Thrones Kit Harington ya yi tir da rashin lafiya
rows.reference: Tauraron Game of Thrones wato Kit Harington ya soki aƙidar nuna samartaka

rows.source: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Kit Harington ya shahara da rawar da ya taka a matsayin Jon Snow a cikin jerin talabijin na HBO mai taken Game of Thrones, wanda ya shafi yankan takobi da kuma tashin hankali.
rows.reference: An san Kit Harington da nuna rawar da ya taka ta juya takobi a matsayin Jon Snow a cikin jere-jeren shirin HBO na tashin hankali da aka yi a zamanin da a cikin din Game of Thrones.

rows.source: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.
rows.output: Amma jarumin, mai shekaru 31, ya yi tir da ra'ayin jarumin da ya yi, yana mai cewa irin waɗannan rawar a kan allo yana nufin yara maza suna jin cewa dole ne su kasance masu ƙarfi don a girmama su.
rows.reference: Amma mai shirin fim ɗin, da ke shekaru 31, ya soki son gwarzo namiji, yana cewa ire-iren kwaikwayon suna nufin yara ƙanana yawanci sukan ji kamar sai su zama gagara-badau kafin a mutunta su.

rows.source: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.
rows.output: Yana magana da The Sunday Times Culture, Kit ya ce yana ganin "wani abu ya yi kuskure" kuma ya tambayi yadda za a magance matsalar rashin mutunci a cikin zamanin #MeToo.
rows.reference: Da yake magana da The Sunday Times Culture, Kit ya ce ya yi imani 'wani kuskure ya faru' kuma ya yi tambaya yadda za a magance matsalar mummunan aƙidar nuna ƙaton namiji a cikin lokacin #MeToo.

rows.source: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.
rows.output: Kit, wanda ya auri abokin wasan kwaikwayo na Game of Thrones Rose Leslie, mai shekaru 31, ya amince cewa yana jin "kadan" game da batun.
rows.reference: Kit, wanda bai jima da auren tauraruwar da suka yi fim ɗin Game of Thrones wator Rose Leslie, ita ma mai shekaru 31, ya tabbatar yana jin 'ƙarfi sosai' game da magance batun.

rows.source: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.
rows.output: "Na ji kaina, na yi matuƙar ƙarfi, a halin yanzu - ina jin muna da matsala da namijinmu?," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ina ji a jikina, ƙarfi sosai, a wannan lokacin - a ina muka yi kuskure ne da aƙidar ƙaton namiji?,' inji shi.

rows.source: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'
rows.output: 'Mene ne muka koya wa maza yayin da suke girma, dangane da matsalar da muke gani yanzu?'
rows.reference: Mene ne muke ta karantar da maza a lokacin da suke girma, idan an yi la’akari da matsalar da muke gani yanzu?'

rows.source: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.
rows.output: Kit na ganin talabijin na iya zama wani bangare na dalilin da ya sa mace-mace ke karuwa saboda jaruman da ke cikin talabijin suna da ƙarfi sosai.
rows.reference: Kit ya yi imani talabijin kila zai zama yana dan haƙƙi na ci gaban wannan aƙida ta katon namiji saboda 'yan wasa maza masu katon jiki da ake fitarwa.

rows.source: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?
rows.output: Ya ci gaba da cewa: 'Me ake da shi tun haihuwa kuma me ake koya?
rows.reference: Ya ci gaba: Mene ne abin da ke jikin mutum da abin da aka koyar?

rows.source: What is taught on TV, and in the streets, that makes young boys feel they have to be this certain side of being a man?
rows.output: Me ake koyar da su a talabijin da kan titi, wanda ke sa matasa maza su ji cewa dole ne su kasance a wannan gefen zama namiji?
rows.reference: Abin da ake koyar wa a talabijin, da na kan titina, da ke sa ƙananan yara su ji sai dole sun zama kamar gefen wani mutum?

rows.source: I think that's really one of the big questions in our time - how do we change that?
rows.output: Ina ganin wannan na daya daga cikin manyan tambayoyin a zamaninmu - yaya za mu canza hakan?
rows.reference: Ina jin wannan ɗaya daga cikin manyan tambayoyi ne na cikin lokacinmu - yaya za mu canja wannan?

rows.source: Because clearly something has gone wrong for young men.'
rows.output: Domin a fili wani abu ya lalace ga matasa maza.
rows.reference: Saboda a fili yake wani abu ya lalace ga samari maza.'

rows.source: In the interview he also admitted that he wouldn't be doing any Game of Thrones prequels or sequels when the series comes to an end next summer, saying he is 'done with battlefields and horses'.
rows.output: A cikin hirar, ya kuma amince cewa ba zai yi ko wani Game of Thrones ko kuma na gaba ba lokacin da jerin ya kare a lokacin rani mai zuwa, yana cewa ya "gama da filayen yaki da dawakai".
rows.reference: A cikin wata intabiyu da ya yi ya kuma tabbatar cewa ba zai ƙara yin fim ɗin na Game of Thrones ba a lokacin da jere-jeren fim da ya zo ƙarshe a cikin damunar gaba, yana cewa ya 'gama da filayen yaƙe-yaƙe da dawakai'.

rows.source: From November Kit will star in a revival of Sam Shepard's True West which is the story of a film producer and his brother, who is a robber.
rows.output: Daga watan Nuwamba Kit zai taka rawa a sake fasalin wasan kwaikwayo na Sam Shepard mai suna True West wanda labarin wani mai shirya fim ne da dan uwansa wanda ya kasance mai sata.
rows.reference: Daga Nuwamba Kit zau fito a cikin wani sake dawowa da True West na Sam Shepard wanda wani labari ne na wani furodusan fim da ɗan uwansa, da yake wani ɓarawo mai sata da makami.

rows.source: The actor recently revealed that he considers meeting his wife Rose to be the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.
rows.output: An bayyana a baya-bayan nan cewa ɗan wasan ya yi imani cewa haduwarsa da matarsa ​​Rose ita ce mafi kyau da ta fito daga Game of Thrones.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan fim ɗin kwana nan ya bayyana cewa yana ɗaukan haɗuwa da matarsa Rose shi ne abu mafi kyau da ya fito daga fim ɗin Game of Thrones.

rows.source: 'I met my wife in this show, so in that way it gave me my future family, and my life from here on in,' he said.
rows.output: Na hadu da matar na a wannan wasan kwaikwayo, don haka ta hanyar haka ta ba ni iyali na gaba, kuma rayuwata daga nan gaba.
rows.reference: Na haɗu da matata a cikin wannan shirin, don haka ta wannan hanyar ya ba ni iyalina na nan gaba, kuma rayuwa za ta fara daga nan ne,' inji shi.

rows.source: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Kit's character Jon Snow, in the Emmy award-winning fantasy series.
rows.output: Rose ta buga Ygritte, sha'awar soyayya ta Kit's character Jon Snow, a cikin jerin wasannin almara da suka lashe lambar yabo ta Emmy.
rows.reference: Rose ta fito a Ygritte, sha'awar soyayya ta kwaikwayo na Kit a Jon Snow, a cikin wannan fim da ya sami kyauta ta Emmy.

rows.source: The couple married in June 2018 on the grounds of Leslie's family estate in Scotland.
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun yi aure a watan Yuni 2018 a kan filin gidan dangin Leslie a Scotland.
rows.reference: Ma'auratan sun yi aure ne a cikin Yuni na 2018 a cikin farfajiyar gidajen su iyalin Leslie da ke cikin Scotland.

rows.source: HIV/Aids: China reports 14% surge in new cases
rows.output: HIV/Aids: An ba da rahoton karuwar kashi 14% na sabbin lokuta
rows.reference: CUTAR ƘANJAMAU/Karya garkuwar jiki: China ta ba da rahoton ƙaruwar kashi 14 cikin ɗari na sababbin kamuwa da cutar

rows.source: China has announced a 14% jump in the number of its citizens who are living with HIV and Aids.
rows.output: Sinawa sun sanar da karuwar kashi 14% na 'yan kasar da ke zaune tare da HIV da cutar AIDS.
rows.reference: China ta sanar da tsallen kashi 14 cikin ɗari na yawan 'yan ƙasarta da ke rayuwa da ƙanjamu da cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki.

rows.source: More than 820,000 people are affected in the country, health officials say.
rows.output: Fiye da mutane 820,000 ne ke fama da cutar a cikin ƙasar, a cewar jami'an lafiya.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane 820,000 ne cutar ta shafa a cikin ƙasar, inji jami'an lafiya.

rows.source: About 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.
rows.output: Kimanin 40,000 sababbin shari'o'in sun bayyana a cikin kwata na biyu na 2018.
rows.reference: An ba da rahoton kusan sababbin kamuwar da cutar 40,000 a cikin kwata ta biyu ta 2018 kawai.

rows.source: The vast majority of new cases were transmitted through sex, marking a change from the past.
rows.output: Mafi yawan sababbin masu kamuwa da cutar sun kamu da ita ta hanyar jima'i, wanda ke nuna canji daga baya.
rows.reference: Mafiya yawan sababbin kamuwa da cutar an yaɗa su ne ta hanyar jima'i, abin da ya canja daga da.

rows.source: Traditionally, HIV spread rapidly through some parts of China as a result of infected blood transfusions.
rows.output: A tarihi, cutar HIV ta bazu cikin sauri a wasu sassan kasar Sin saboda allurar jini da ta kamu da cutar.
rows.reference: A gargajiyance, cutar ƙanjamau tana yaɗuwa da sauri a wasu ɓangarori na China a sakamakon shigar da jini da ke da cutar.

rows.source: But the number of people contracting HIV in this way had been reduced to almost zero, Chinese health officials said at a conference in Yunnan province.
rows.output: Amma adadin mutanen da ke kamuwa da cutar kanjamau ta hanyar da ake yi a wannan hanyar ya ragu zuwa kusan sifili, in ji jami'an kiwon lafiya na kasar Sin a wani taron a lardin Yunnan.
rows.reference: Amma yawan mutanen da suka kamu da cutar ƙanjamau ta cikin wannan hanyar ya ragu da kusan sifili, inji jami'an lafiya na a wani tarao a yankin Yunnan.

rows.source: Year-on-year, however, the number of those living with HIV and Aids in China has risen by 100,000 people.
rows.output: A duk shekara, duk da haka, adadin mutanen da ke zaune tare da HIV da AIDS a China ya karu da mutane 100,000.
rows.reference: Shekara bayan shekara, amma, yawan waɗanda ke rayuwa da ƙanjamau da cutar karya garkuwar jiki a cikin China ya ƙaru da mutane 100,000.

rows.source: HIV transmission through sex is an acute issue in China's LGBT community.
rows.output: Matsalar da ke damun al'ummar LGBT a kasar Sin ita ce yadda ake yada cutar HIV ta hanyar jima'i.
rows.reference: Yaɗuwar ƙanjamau ta hanyar jima'i wani babban batu ne a cikin al'ummar 'yan luwaɗi da maɗigo na China.

rows.source: Homosexuality was decriminalised in China in 1997, but discrimination against LGBT people is said to be rife.
rows.output: An soke haramcin jima'i a kasar Sin a shekarar 1997, amma ana cewa ana ci gaba da nuna wariya ga mutanen LGBT.
rows.reference: An cire hanin da aka yi a luwaɗi a China ne a cikin 1997, amma an ce bambanci a kan mutane 'yan luwaɗi da maɗigo ya yi ƙamari.

rows.source: Because of the country's conservative values, studies have estimated that 70-90% of men who have sex with men will eventually marry women.
rows.output: Saboda ka'idojin al'adun ƙasar, an kiyasta cewa kashi 70-90% na maza da suke yin jima'i da maza za su yi aure da mata a ƙarshe.
rows.reference: Saboda al'adun ƙasar na ra'ayin rikau, nazarce-nazarce sun yi kintace cewa kashi 70 zuwa 90 cikin ɗari na maza da suka yi jima'i da maza za su auri mata daga ƙarshe.

rows.source: Many of the transmissions of the diseases come from inadequate sexual protections in these relationships.
rows.output: Yawancin watsawar cututtuka suna fitowa ne daga rashin isassun kariya ta jima'i a cikin waɗannan dangantakar.
rows.reference: Mafi yawan yaɗe-yaɗen cutar yana zuwa ne daga rashin isasshun kare-kare na jima'i a waɗannan hulɗoɗi.

rows.source: Since 2003, China's government has promised universal access to HIV medication as part of an effort to tackle the issue.
rows.output: Tun daga shekarar 2003, gwamnatin kasar Sin ta yi alkawarin samun damar samun magani ga duk wanda ke da cutar kanjamau a matsayin wani bangare na kokarin da take yi na magance matsalar.
rows.reference: Tun 2003, gwamnatin China ta yi alkawari samun iso na ƙasa-da-ƙasa zuwa ga maganin ƙanjamau a matsayin ɓangare na wani ƙoƙari na daƙile batun.

rows.source: Maxine Waters denies staffer leaked GOP senators' data, blasts 'dangerous lies' and 'conspiracy theories'
rows.output: Maxine Waters ta musanta cewa ma’aikaciyar ta fitar da bayanan ‘yan majalisar GOP, ta yi tsokaci kan ‘mugun labarai’ da ‘maganar karya’
rows.reference: Maxine Waters ya ƙi yarda da yoyon bayanin da ake cewa ma'aikacinta ya fitar da bayanan sanatocin GOP, inda a fusace ya kira 'munanan ƙarerayi' da 'batutuwan munafurci'

rows.source: U.S. Rep. Maxine Waters on Saturday denounced allegations that a member of her staff had posted the personal information of three Republican U.S. senators onto the lawmakers' Wikipedia pages.
rows.output: Mataimakiyar Majalisar Wakilai ta Amurka Maxine Waters ta yi Allah wadai da zargin cewa wani memba na ma'aikatan ta ya wallafa bayanan sirri na sanatoci uku na jam'iyyar Republican a shafukan Wikipedia na masu wakiltar.
rows.reference: Amurka Ɗan Majalisar Wakilai Maxine Waters a ranar Asabar ya yi watsi da ƙage-ƙagen cewa wani mamban ma'aikatanta ya fitar da bayanin keɓe na sanatocin Amurka 'yan Republican guda uku a kan shafukan 'yan majalisar a cikin Wikipedia.

rows.source: The Los Angeles Democrat asserted that the claims were being pedaled by "ultra-right wing" pundits and websites.
rows.output: Dan Los Angeles mai ra'ayin jam'iyyar Democrat ya yi iƙirarin cewa da'awar ana sayar da su ne ta "bangaren masu ra'ayin hagu masu tsattsauran ra'ayi" da kuma shafukan yanar gizo.
rows.reference: Jaridar Los Angeles Democrat ta tabbatar da cewa ƙage wasu "masu ra'ayin riƙau" ne da yanonin gizo suke watsa shi.

rows.source: "Lies, lies, and more despicable lies," Waters said in a statement on Twitter.
rows.output: "Karya, ƙarya, da ƙari na ƙaryar ƙarya," Waters ya ce a wani bayanin da ya yi a Twitter.
rows.reference: Ƙarerayi, ƙarerayi, da kuma ƙarin munanan ƙarerayi, inji Waters sa cikin wata sanarwa a kan Twitter.

rows.source: The released information reportedly included the home addresses and phone numbers for U.S. Sens. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, and Mike Lee and Orrin Hatch, both of Utah.
rows.output: An ruwaito cewa bayanan da aka saki sun hada da adiresoshin gida da lambobin waya na Sanatan Amurka Lindsey Graham na Kudu Carolina, da Mike Lee da Orrin Hatch, duka na Utah.
rows.reference: Bayanin da aka fitar din an ce ya hada da adiresoshin gida da lambobin tarho don Majalisar Dattawa ta Amurka. Lindsey Graham na Carolina ta Kudu, da Mike Lee da Orrin Hatch, dukkansu na Utah.

rows.source: The information appeared online Thursday, posted by an unknown person on Capitol Hill during a Senate panel's hearing on the sexual misconduct allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: An bayyana bayanan a kan layi a ranar Alhamis, wanda wani mutum da ba a sani ba ya yi a kan Capitol Hill a lokacin da Majalisar Dattijai ta yi taro kan zarge-zargen cin zarafi da aka yi wa wanda aka zaba a matsayin alkalin kotun koli Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Bayanin ya fito ne ta yanar gizo a ranar Alhamis, wanda wani da ba a sani ba a Capitol Hill a lokacin wani jin bahasi na Majalisar Dattawan a kan ƙage-ƙagen cin zarafin jima'i a kan wanda aka zaɓi sunan nasa zuwa Kotun Kolin Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: The leak came sometime after the three senators had questioned Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Leƙen ya zo ne bayan da 'yan majalisar dattijai uku suka yi wa Kavanaugh tambayoyi.
rows.reference: Yoyon ya zo ne wani lokaci bayan sanatoci uku sun yi tambaya a Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Conservative sites such as Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identifies the source of the posts was associated with Waters" office and released the information of a member of Waters' staff, the Hill reported.
rows.output: Shafukan masu ra'ayin mazan jiyo kamar Gateway Pundit da RedState sun ruwaito cewa adiresoshin IP da ke nuna tushen rubutun sun kasance da ofishinta kuma sun fitar da bayanan wani dan ma'aikatanta, a cewar rahoton Hill.
rows.reference: Wuraren shafin yanar gizo kamar su Gateway Pundit da RedState sun kawo rahoto cewa adireshin IP da ya gano kafar ta fitarwa na da alaƙa tare da ofishin Waters" da ya fitar da bayanin na wani mamba na ma'aikatan Waters, inji rahoton  Hill.

rows.source: "This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie," Waters continued.
rows.output: "Wannan zato mara tushe gaba ɗaya ƙarya ne kuma ƙarya ce," Waters ya ci gaba.
rows.reference: Wannan ƙagen da ba shi tushe gaba ɗaya ƙarya ne kuma wata cikekkiyar ƙarya ce, Waters ya ci gaba.

rows.source: "The member of my staff - whose identity, personal information, and safety have been compromised as a result of these fraudulent and false allegations - was in no way responsible for the leak of this information.
rows.output: "Ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikaciyar ma'aikac
rows.reference: Mamban na ma'aikatana - wanda shaida, bayanin keɓe, da kariya an narkar da su a sakamakon waɗannan zambo da ƙage-ƙagen ƙarya - ba su ne suka haddasa yoyon wannan bayanin ba.

rows.source: This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie."
rows.output: Wannan zato mara tushe gaba ɗaya ƙarya ne kuma ƙarya ce.
rows.reference: Wannan ƙage da ba tushe gada ɗaya ƙarya ne kuma wata cikekkiyar ƙara a fili."

rows.source: Waters' statement quickly drew criticism online, including from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
rows.output: Bayanan Waters sun yi sauri sun jawo cece-kuce a yanar gizo, ciki har da na tsohon mai magana da yawun fadar White House, Ari Fleischer.
rows.reference: Jawabin Waters ya ja suka ta yanar gizo, da ya haɗa da tsohon sakataren yaɗa labarai na fadar White House wato Ari Fleischer.

rows.source: "This denial is angry," Fleischer wrote.
rows.output: "Wannan kin amincewa da fushi ne," Fleischer ya rubuta.
rows.reference: Wannan kin yana da ban haushi, a rubutun Fleischer.

rows.source: "This suggests she doesn't have the temperment to be a Member of Congress.
rows.output: "Wannan yana nuna cewa ba ta da yanayin da za ta zama 'Yar Majalisar Dokoki."
rows.reference: Wannan yana nuna ba ta hali da za ta zama wata Mamba ta Majalisar Dokoki ba.

rows.source: When someone is accused of something they didn't do, they must not be angry.
rows.output: Idan wani ya yi wa wani zargi da bai yi ba, ba su da laifi.
rows.reference: A yayin da aka tuhumi wani da yin wani abu da ba su yi ba, dole ba za su ɓata rai ba.

rows.source: They must not be defiant.
rows.output: Ba za su iya zama masu tsayayya ba.
rows.reference: Ba za su dole jajirce ba.

rows.source: They must not question the motives of the accuser.
rows.output: Ba za su iya tambayar dalilai na wanda ya yi zargin ba.
rows.reference: Ba za su dole tambayi manufofin wanda ake tuhumar ba.

rows.source: They must be calm and serene."
rows.output: Dole ne su kasance cikin nutsuwa da kwanciyar hankali."
rows.reference: Dole su kwantar da hankali kuma su nitsu."

rows.source: Fleischer was appearing to compare Waters' reaction to the Democrats' criticism of Judge Kavanaugh, who was accused by critics of seeming too angry during Thursday's hearing.
rows.output: Fleischer ya bayyana cewa ya kamata a kwatanta martanin Waters ga sukar 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat ga Alkalin Kavanaugh, wanda masu sukar sun yi zargin cewa yana bayyana fushi a lokacin da aka yi masa tambayoyi a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Fleischer yana fitowa ne don kwatanci ga martanin Waters zuwa ga sukar Democrats ga Alƙali Kavanaugh, wanda aka masu suka na kasancewa kamar mai ɓacin rai sosai a lokacin jin bahasi na ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running to unseat Waters in the midterm elections, also voiced his thoughts on Twitter.
rows.output: Omar Navarro, dan jam'iyyar Republican da ke neman tsige Waters a zaben tsakiya, ya kuma bayyana ra'ayinsa a Twitter.
rows.reference: Omar Navarro, wani dan takara da ke neman kwace kujerar Waters a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango, shi ma ya furta tunaninsa a kan Twitter.

rows.source: "Big if true," he tweeted.
rows.output: "Big if true," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Babba idan gaskiya ne," inji shi ta Twitter.

rows.source: In her statement, Waters said her office had alerted "the appropriate authorities and law enforcement entities of these fraudulent claims.
rows.output: A cikin bayanin ta, Waters ta ce ofishinta ya sanar da "hukumomin da suka dace da kuma jami'an tsaro na dokoki game da wadannan da'awar karya.
rows.reference: A cikin jawabinta, Waters ta ce ofishinta ya faɗakar da ita "hukumomi da suka dace da hukumomin zartar da doka na waɗannan koke-koke na zambo.

rows.source: "We will ensure that the perpetrators will be revealed," she continued, "and that they will be held legally liable for all of their actions that are destructible and dangerous to any and all members of my staff."
rows.output: "Muna tabbatar da cewa masu aikata wannan laifi za a bayyana su," ta ci gaba da cewa, "kuma za a sanya su a cikin shari'a saboda dukkan ayyukan da suke da illa da kuma hatsari ga kowane memba na ma'aikatan da ke ƙarƙashin kulina."
rows.reference: Za mu tabbatar da cewa an bayyana masu yin abin, ta ci gaba, "kuma za a kama su da haƙƙi na aikatawa don dukkan ayukansu da ke rusarwa da cutarwa zuwa ga kowa da dukkan mambobi na ma'aikatana."

rows.source: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.output: Johnny English Strikes Again bita - rashin karfi na Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.reference: Johnny English Ya Sake Dawowa sharhi - Rowan Atkinson mai leƙen asiri da aka fi karfi

rows.source: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: Yanzu al'ada ce a duba ma'anar Brexit a duk wani sabon fim mai kishin Birtaniya, kuma hakan ya yi kama da wannan sake dawowa da fim ɗin wasan barkwanci na Johnny English - wanda ya fara a shekarar 2003 da Johnny English, sannan kuma ya sake dawowa a shekarar 2011 da Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: Yanzu wata al'ada ce a duba amfanin Brexit a cikin kowane fim tare da wani dan Birtaniyya kuma wannan ba ya nufi zai gudana ne ga wannan sake dawo da barkwancin Johnny English ba - wanda aka fara tun a 2003 tare da Johnny English da kuma aka dawo da shi a raye a cikin 2011 tare da Johnny English Reborn.

rows.source: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?
rows.output: Shin zagi da ban dariya kan yadda muke da ban mamaki a cikin kasarmu zai zama sabon damarmu na fitar da kaya?
rows.reference: Shin da zolayar kai a kan batun na yadda yake a bayyane shirme ne za a ce mu ne sabuwar ƙasar da ke da damar shigo da kaya?

rows.source: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.
rows.output: A kowane hali, Johnny English mai idanu masu kyan gani, wanda ya yi kama da mai ban dariya, wanda ya yi rashin kima ya sake samun lasisin yin kuskure na biyu - wannan suna na nuna fiye da komai cewa shi ne wani babban hali na ban dariya da aka yi niyya don kasashen da ba na Ingilishi ba.
rows.reference: A kowane irin yanayi, idon ya fito ga fuskar roba ta Johnny English da bai iya ba da ya sami lasisinsa don tsara abubuwa sababbi don lokaci na biyu - wannan sunan nasa ya nuna abu fiye da kome cewa shi wani ƙirƙirar wasa ne mai fadi da aka tsara don masu zuwa silima a wuraren da ba sa magana da Turanci.

rows.source: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.
rows.output: Ya kasance, ba shakka, mai bautar sirri wanda duk da irin wannan halinsa na ban mamaki na sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'awar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar sha'ar
rows.reference: Shi kuwa haƙiƙa wani wawan dan leƙen asiri ne duk da cewa irin yadda yake nunawa wani iri don saukaka ado da ya sa ɗan Clouseau, wani dan aiki na Mista Bean da kuma wani aiki na wannan mutumin da ke ba da gudunmawa a matsayin rubutu guda ɗaya ga jigon sauti na Chariots of Fire a buɗe bikin Olympics a 2012 a Landan.

rows.source: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.
rows.output: Haka kuma ya samo asali ne daga mai yawon bude ido da kuma mutumin duniya mai ban mamaki Atkinson da ya yi a cikin tallan TV na Barclaycard da aka manta da shi, yana barin rudani a cikin tafiyarsa.
rows.reference: Kuma shi ma na asali ne a bisa kan matafiya da kuma mutum na kasa-da-kasa mai ban mamaki Atkinson ya taɓa wasa a cikin tallace-tallacen talabijin na Barclaycard da yanzu aka manta, yana mai barin tashin hankali a farkawarsa.

rows.source: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.
rows.output: Akwai wani ko wani lokaci mai kyau a cikin wannan tafiya ta JE ta baya-bayan nan.
rows.reference: Akwai daya ko biyu kyawawan yanayi a cikin wannan fitar ta JE mafi sabuwa.

rows.source: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.
rows.output: Na so Johnny English yana gabatowa da jirgin sama yayin da yake sanye da rigar zaman zamani kuma ganyayen rotor sun yi ta bugu a kan kwalkwalinsa.
rows.reference: Ina son yadda  Johnny English ke kusantar wani helikwafta a lokacin da ya sa tufa a cikin kayan sulke na wani zamanin da kuma da wuƙaƙen rotor suna da sanye a jikin hular kwanon nasa.

rows.source: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.
rows.output: Kyautar Atkinson don wasan barkwanci na zahiri tana bayyana, amma dariyan yana jin kamar ba shi da ƙarfi sosai kuma ba a sani ba, musamman yayin da finafinan "mai tsanani" kamar 007 da Mission Impossible suka fara ba da barkwanci a matsayin wani sinadari.
