rows.output: Lauya Kristian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi diyya saboda "lalacewar da ta shafi mutunci a cikin adadi mai kyau da ya dace da girman laifin, wanda wataƙila ɗaya ne daga cikin manyan cin zarafi na hakkin ɗan adam a cikin 'yan shekaru da suka gabata."
rows.reference: Lawyer Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi cin tara akan “ɓata masa halaye na dabi'a, a cikin adadin da ya dace da nauyin laifin, wanda yakan iya zama mafi tsananin cin zarafin haƙin ɗan adam a cikin shekarun nan.”

rows.source: The alleged incident is said to have taken place in June 2009 at a suite at the Palms Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.
rows.output: An yi zargin cewa an yi wannan lamari a watan Yuni 2009 a wani daki a otal din Palms da kuma gidan caca a Las Vegas.
rows.reference: Zargin ana cewa wai ya faru ne a Yuni 2009 a wani babban ɗaki na Palm Otel and Casino a Las Vegas.

rows.source: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.
rows.output: Bayan da aka hadu a wani kulob na rawa, Ronaldo da Mayorga sun yi zargin sun koma dakin dan wasan, inda ya yi zargin an yi mata fyade, kamar yadda takardun da aka gabatar a kotun Clark County a Nevada.
rows.reference: Bayan sun hadu a wani gidan wasan kwaikwayo na dare, Ronaldo da Mayorga wai sun koma dakin dan wasan, wurin da a zargin ya mata fyaɗe a duburi, bisa ga takardun da aka saka a fayil ɗin dake Kotun Gundumar Clark a Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."
rows.output: Mayorga ta yi iƙirarin cewa Ronaldo ya fado a kan ƙafafunsa bayan abin da ake zarginsa da shi, ya ce mata yana da "99 cikin ɗari" "mutumin kirki" da aka yi wa "ɗari ɗaya" ya ɓata.
rows.reference: Mayorga tayi ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya faɗi akan gwiwan shi bayan hakan kuma ya ce mata “kashi 99” “mutumin kirki” wanda ke samun akasi daga “kashi ɗaya”.

rows.source: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.
rows.output: Takardun sun yi iƙirarin cewa Ronaldo ya tabbatar da cewa ma'auratan sun yi jima'i, amma cewa hakan na da niyya.
rows.reference: Takardur su na ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya gasganta cewa su biu sun yi jima’i, amma cikin yarjejeniya ce.

rows.source: Mayorga also claims she went to the police and had photographs taken of her injuries at a hospital, but later agreed to an out-of-court settlement because she felt "terrified of retaliation" and was worried about "being publicly humiliated."
rows.output: Mayorga ta yi iƙirarin cewa ta je ga ‘yan sanda ta kuma dauki hotonta a asibitin, amma daga baya ta amince da sulhu a wajen kotun domin ta ji “tsorace da ramuwar gayya” kuma ta damu da “zama a cikin jama’a.”
rows.reference: Mayorga kuma tayi ikirari cewa ta je wajen ‘yan sanda kuma an ɗauki hotunan raunin da ta ji a asibit, amma daga baya ta yadda da sulhu a wajen kotu saboda ta ji “tsoron ramuwa” kuma ta damu akan “dizguwa a fuskar mutane.”

rows.source: The 34-year-old says she is now seeking to overturn the settlement as she continues to be traumatized by the alleged incident.
rows.output: Matar mai shekaru 34 ta ce yanzu tana neman a soke yarjejeniyar saboda har yanzu tana fama da rauni daga lamarin da ake zarginsa da shi.
rows.reference: Yar shekara 34 ɗn yanzu tana neman juya sulhun a yayin da ta ci gaba da fuskantar kunci daga abun da ya farun.

rows.source: Ronaldo was on the verge of joining Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged assault, and this summer moved to Italian giants Juve in a €100 million deal.
rows.output: Ronaldo yana kan bakin dawowar zuwa Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da aka yi zargin cin zarafi, kuma a wannan lokacin ya koma manyan 'yan wasan Juve a kan yarjejeniyar Yuro miliyan 100.
rows.reference: Ronaldo yana kan komawa Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da farmakin da ake zargin ya faru, kuma wannan ranin ya koma babban kungiyar kwallon Italia Juventus a yarjejeniyar Yuro miliyan100.

rows.source: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers
rows.output: Brexit: UK 'zai yi nadama har abada' idan ta rasa masu kera motoci
rows.reference: Brexit: UK ‘har abada zata yi da na sanin’ rasa masu kera motoci

rows.source: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.
rows.output: Birtaniyya za ta yi nadama da hakan har abada idan ta rasa matsayinta na jagorar masana'antar kera motoci a duniya bayan Brexit, in ji Sakatare na Harkokin Kasuwanci Greg Clark.
rows.reference: UK “zata yi da na sanin shi har abada” idan tayi rashin matsayin ta na shugabancin kera mota bayan Brexit, Sakataren Sana’a Greg Clark yace.

rows.source: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.output: Ya kara da cewa, "abu ne mai damuwa" cewa Toyota UK ta gaya wa BBC cewa idan Birtaniya ta bar EU ba tare da yarjejeniyar ba, za ta dakatar da samar da motocin a masaranta ta Burnaston, kusa da Derby na wani dan lokaci.
rows.reference: Ya kara cewa abun “damuwa ne” cewa Toyota UK ta fada wa BBC cewa idan Britain ta fita EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba zata sayar da aiki na dan wani lokaci a masana’antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.

rows.source: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.
rows.output: "Muna buƙatar yarjejeniyar," Mista Clark ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mu na bukatar yarjejeniya,” Mr Clark ya ce.

rows.source: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.
rows.output: Masanin mota na Japan ya ce tasirin jinkirin kan iyaka a cikin yanayin Brexit ba tare da yarjejeniyar ba na iya haifar da asarar aikin yi.
rows.reference: Kamfanin Japan din na mota yace tasirin jinkiri a iyakar kasa a yanayin Brexit babu yarjejeniya zai iya kwao rasa ayyuka.

rows.source: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.
rows.output: Masarauta ta Burnaston - wadda ke samar da Toyota's Auris da Avensis - ta samar da kusan motoci 150,000 a bara, daga cikin 90% an fitar da su zuwa sauran Tarayyar Turai.
rows.reference: Masana’antar Burnaston din - wanda ke hada Toyota Auris da Avensis - sun kera kusan motoci 150,000 bara wanda a ciki kashi 90 aka fitar zuwa sauran kasashen Turai.

rows.source: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.
rows.output: "Ra'ayina shi ne idan Birtaniya ta fado daga EU a karshen watan Maris, za mu ga aikin samarwa ya daina a masarauta," in ji Marvin Cooke, daraktan Toyota a Burnaston.
rows.reference: “A gani na shi ne idan Britain ta fita EU a karshen Maris zamu ga sayawar kira a masana;antar mu,” inji Mavin Cooke, Manajin Direkta na Toyota a Burnaston.

rows.source: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Sauran masu kera motoci a Birtaniya sun yi ta'addama game da barin Tarayyar Turai ba tare da yarjejeniyar yadda cinikin kan iyaka zai yi aiki ba, ciki har da Honda, BMW, da Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Wasu masu kera motocin UK sun nuna jin tsoro akan fita EU ba tare da yarjejniya ba akan yadda kasuwancin tsallaken iyaka zai kasance, har da Honda, BMW da Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.
rows.output: BMW, misali, ta ce za ta rufe masana'antar Mini a Oxford na wani wata bayan Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, kamar misali, ta ce zata kulle karamin masana’antar ta da ke Oxford na tsawon wata daya bayan Brexit.

rows.source: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.
rows.output: Muhimman damuwoyi sun shafi abin da masu kera motoci ke cewa, haɗin kai na samar da kaya a cikin yanayin Brexit da ba a warware ba.
rows.reference: Babban damuwan yana dangance da abun da makera motoci suka ce ne dangane da hadarin samun kayayyakin aiki idan akayi Brexit ba yarjejeniya.

rows.source: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.
rows.output: Layin samar da Toyota yana aiki ne bisa "just-in-time", tare da sassa suna zuwa kowane mintuna 37 daga masu samar da su a Birtaniya da EU don motocin da aka yi wa umarni.
rows.reference: Ana aiwatar da hanyar sarrafawar Toyota na akan tsarin “gab-da-lokaci”, yadda sassa su na isowa ko wani minti 37 daga masu kaya duk daga UK da EU na motocin da ake kira dan sari.

rows.source: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.
rows.output: Idan Birtaniya ta bar Tarayyar Turai ba tare da yarjejeniyar ba a ranar 29 ga Maris, za a iya samun cikas a kan iyakar da masana’anta ke cewa hakan na iya haifar da jinkiri da karancin sassa.
rows.reference: Idan UK ta bar EU ba tare dayarjejeniya ba ranar 29 ga watan Maris, za’a iya samun matsaloli a iyaka wanda masana’antar ta ce yakan iya kawo jinkiri da rashin isashen sassa.

rows.source: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.
rows.output: Ba zai yiwu Toyota ta riƙe fiye da kwanaki ɗaya na ajiya a masana'antar ta Derbyshire ba, in ji kamfanin, don haka za a daina samar da su.
rows.reference: Ba zai yiyu Toyota ta rike fiye da kayan aiki na kwana daya a masana’antar ta na Derbyshire, kamfanin ta ce, dan haka aiki zai saya.

rows.source: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."
rows.output: Mr Clark ya ce shirin Chequers na Theresa May na dangantakar da za ta yi da EU a nan gaba "an tsara shi da kyau don gujewa waɗannan cak."
rows.reference: Mr Clark ya ce tsarin binciken Theresa May na dagantakan gaba da EU an “asalin tsara shi dan kauyce wa wadannan binciken a iyaka.”

rows.source: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
rows.output: "Muna buƙatar yarjejeniyar. Muna son samun mafi kyawun yarjejeniyar da za ta ba mu damar, kamar yadda nake cewa ba kawai samun nasara a yanzu ba, har ma da mu mu yi amfani da wannan dama," ya gaya wa BBC Radio 4's Today program.
rows.reference: “Mu na bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Mu na so mu samu mafi kyakkyawan yarjejeniya da zai bamu daman kamar yadda na fada ba kawai nasaran da zamu ji dadin shi a halin yanzu ba amma mu samu yin amfani da wannan daman,” ya fada a tsarin Yau na Radiyon BBC 4.

rows.source: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."
rows.output: "Shaidun da ba kawai Toyota ba ne, amma masu kera sauran, shi ne muna buƙatar mu ci gaba da abin da ya kasance wani babban ci gaba na sarkar samar da kayan.
rows.reference: “Hujjan da ba na Toyota ba kawai amma har da na wasu makera shi ne mu na asalin bukatar mu ci gaba da abun da yake nasarraren samar da kayaki.”

rows.source: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.
rows.output: Toyota ba zai iya cewa tsawon lokacin da aka dakatar da samar da kayan ba, amma a cikin dogon lokaci, ya yi gargadin cewa ƙarin kuɗin za su rage gasa wajen samar da kayan da kuma haifar da asarar aikin yi.
rows.reference: Toyota ta kasa fadan tsawon lokacin da za a sayar da aiki, amma a hangen gaba, sun bada gargadin cewa farashi zai rage karfin gasar masana’antar kuma hakan zai kai ga asarar ayyuka.

rows.source: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.
rows.output: Pita Tsouvallaris, wanda ya yi aiki a Burnaston na shekaru 24 kuma shine mai gabatar da kungiyar ma'aikata ta Unite a cikin masana'antar, ya ce membobin sa suna kara damuwa: "A cikin kwarewata, da zarar wadannan ayyukan sun tafi, ba su taba dawowa ba.
rows.reference: Peter Tsouvallaris, wanda yayi aiki a Burnaston na tsawon shekaru 24 kuma shi ne kakakin kungiyar hadin kai a masana’antar, yace mambobin su na ci gaba da damuwa: “A cikin kwarewata da zaran wadannan ayyukan sun tafi ba sa taba dawowa.

rows.source: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."
rows.output: Wani jami'in gwamnati ya ce: "Mun gabatar da wani tsari mai kyau da kuma mai inganci na dangantakarmu ta gaba da EU."
rows.reference: Wani kakakin gwamnati ya ce: “Mun mika tsarin daidai kuma na gaskiya don alakar mu ta gaba da EU.”

rows.source: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House
rows.output: Taron Trump da Rosenstain na iya jinkiri, in ji fadar White House
rows.reference: Haduwar Trump da Rosenstein zai iya samun jinkiri kuma, inji White House

rows.source: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.
rows.output: Taron da Donald Trump ya yi da mataimakiyar babbar lauya ta Amurka Rod Rosenstein na iya "jinkirtawa makwanni biyu" yayin da ake ci gaba da takaddama kan zabe na babban kotun Brett Kavanaugh, fadar White House ta ce a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Haduwar Donald Trump na mahimmanci da mataimakin lauya janar Rod Rosenstein zai iya “matsawa gaba da sati daya” a yayin da fada akan waklin babban kotu Brett Kavanaugh ya ci gaba, White House ta ce ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Rosenstein oversees the work of special counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, links between Trump aides and Russia and potential obstruction of justice by the president.
rows.output: Rosenstein yana kula da aikin babban mai bincike Robert Mueller, wanda ke bincike kan tsoma bakin Rasha a zaben, alaƙa tsakanin abokai na Trump da Rasha da kuma yiwuwar hana shari'a da shugaban kasa ya yi.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ke kula da aikin mashawarci na musamman Robert Mueler, wanda ke binciken tsangwamar Rasha akan zabe, mahadi tsakanin ma’aikatan Trump da Russia da yiyuwar toshe adalci daga Shugaban kasar.

rows.source: Whether or not Trump will fire the deputy attorney general, and thereby endanger Mueller's independence, has fuelled Washington gossip for months.
rows.output: Ko Trump zai kawo karshen mataimakiyar babbar lauya, kuma ta hanyar yin haka zai yi barazana ga 'yancin Mueller, wannan ya sa aka yi ta hira a Washington tsawon watanni.
rows.reference: Shin Trump zai kori ko ba zai kori mataimakin alkalin alkalai daga aiki, a hakan ya saka ‘yancin Mueller cikin hadari, ya cika gulmar Washington a watanni.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed wearing a wire to record conversations with Trump and the possibility of removing the president via the 25th amendment.
rows.output: A farkon wannan wata, New York Times ta ruwaito cewa, Rosenstein ya tattauna kan sanya wayar wayar da kai don yin rikodin tattaunawar da Trump da kuma yiwuwar cire shi daga ofishinsa ta hanyar gyarawa na 25.
rows.reference: Farkon watan nan, New York Times sun yi rihoto cewa Rosenstein ya tattauna tare da waya dan rikodin labarin shi da Trump da kuma yiyuwar cire Shugaban kasar ta hanyar doka a 25.

rows.source: Rosenstein denied the report.
rows.output: Rosenstein ya musanta rahoton.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ya karyata rihoton.

rows.source: But last Monday he went to the White House, amid reports he was about to resign.
rows.output: Amma a ranar Litinin da ta gabata ya tafi fadar White House, a cikin rahotanni cewa ya yi shirin yin murabus.
rows.reference: Amma Litinin din da ta wuce ya je White House, a cikin rahoton cewa zai yi marabus.

rows.source: Instead, a meeting with Trump, who was then at the United Nations in New York, was announced for Thursday.
rows.output: Maimakon haka, an sanar da taron da Trump, wanda a lokacin yana a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a New York, a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: A maimakon haka, haduwar shi da Trump, wanda a lokacin yake Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a New York, aka sanar a ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Trump said he would "prefer not" to fire Rosenstein but then the meeting was delayed to avoid a clash with the Senate judiciary committee hearing in which Kavanaugh and one of the women who have accused him of sexual misconduct, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, both testified.
rows.output: Trump ya ce zai "fi so" ba ya so ya kori Rosenstein amma sai an jinkirta taron don gujewa rikici da taron majalisar dattijai na majalisar dattijai inda Kavanaugh da daya daga cikin mata uku da suka yi zargin cin zarafi, Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, suka yi shaida.
rows.reference: Trump ya ce zai “fi son kar” ya kori Rosenstein amma dai an jinkirta haduwar ne dan kar a samu karo da sauraron kwamitin ‘yan majalisa na Shari’a wurin da Kavanaugh da wata matar da suke zargin shi da halayen da ba su dace ba akan jima’i, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, dukka sun bada shaida.

rows.source: On Friday, Trump ordered a one-week FBI investigation of claims against Kavanaugh, further delaying a full Senate vote.
rows.output: A ranar Juma'a, Trump ya umarci a yi bincike na FBI na makonni guda kan zarge-zargen da ake yi wa Kavanaugh, wanda ya kara jinkirta yin zaben majalisar dattijai.
rows.reference: Ranar Juma’a, Trump ya bada umurnin binciken FBI na sti daya, akan ikirarai kan Kavanaugh, wanda ya kara kawo jinkiri ga zaben Yan Majalisa.

rows.source: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, appeared on Fox News Sunday.
rows.output: Mai magana da yada labarai na Trump, Sarah Sanders, ta bayyana a Fox News Sunday.
rows.reference: Sakataren Kakaki na Trump, Sara Saunders, ta bayyana a Fox News ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Asked about the Rosenstein meeting, she said: "A date for that hasn't been set, it could be this week, I could see that pushing back another week given all of the other things that are going on with the supreme court.
rows.output: An yi mata tambaya game da taron da ta yi da Rosenstein, ta ce: "Ba a saita ranar ba, zai iya kasancewa wannan makon, zan iya ganin hakan yana tura makwanni biyu idan aka yi la'akari da sauran abubuwan da ke faruwa a kotun koli.
rows.reference: Da aka tambaye ta akan haduwar Rosenstein din, ta ce: “Ba’a saka rana ba ma wannan, zai iya zama wannan satin, ina ganin za’a iya masar da shi gaba da sati daya bisa ga dukka abubuwan da ke tafiya a babban kotun.

rows.source: But we'll see and I always like to keep the press updated."
rows.output: Amma za mu ga kuma ina son in sanar da 'yan jarida.
rows.reference: Amma za mu gani kuma za muci gaba da ‘yan jarida bayanai."

rows.source: Some reporters would contest that assertion: Sanders has not held a White House press briefing since 10 September.
rows.output: Wasu 'yan jarida sun yi jayayya da wannan ikirari: Sanders ba ya gudanar da taron manema labarai na fadar White House tun daga ranar 10 ga Satumba.
rows.reference: Wasu 'yan jarida za su yi hamayya da wannan bayani: Sanders bai gudanar da wani jawabi a Fadar White House tun 10 Satumba.

rows.source: Host Chris Wallace asked why.
rows.output: Mai masaukin baki Chris Wallace ya tambaya dalilin hakan.
rows.reference: Mai watsa shiri Chris Wallace ya tambayi me yasa.

rows.source: Sanders said the scarcity of briefings was not due to a distaste for TV reporters "grandstanding," although she said: "I won't disagree with the fact that they grandstand."
rows.output: Sander ta ce ƙarancin tarurrukan ba saboda rashin son 'yan jarida na talabijin "su yi tsokana," duk da haka ta ce: "Ba zan yi rashin jituwa da gaskiya cewa suna tsokana ba."
rows.reference: Sanders ya ce, rashin yin jawabin da aka yi bai kasance ba ne saboda matsala ga masu sauraro na TV, "duk da cewa ta ce: "Ba zan karyata gaskiyar ba cewa su na da kima."

rows.source: She then suggested direct contact between Trump and the press will increase.
rows.output: Sannan ta ba da shawarar cewa tuntuɓar kai tsaye tsakanin Trump da kafafen yada labarai za ta karu.
rows.reference: Daga nan sai ta ba da shawarar ganinTrump kai tsaye hakan zai sa ‘yan jarida su karu.

rows.source: "The president does more Q&A sessions than any president has prior to him," she said, adding without citing evidence: "We've looked at those numbers."
rows.output: "Shugaba yana gudanar da zaman tattaunawa fiye da kowane shugaban da ya gabata," in ji ta, inda ta kara cewa ba tare da bayar da hujjoji ba: "Mun duba wadannan lambobin."
rows.reference: "Shugaban ya yi karin Q & A zaman lafiya fiye da kowane shugaban da yake gabansa," inji ta, ba tare da nuna shaida ba: "Mun duba wadannan lambobin."

rows.source: Briefings will still happen, Sanders said, but "if the press has the chance to ask the president of the United States questions directly, that's infinitely better than talking to me.
rows.output: Taron zai ci gaba da faruwa, in ji Sanders, amma "idan manema labarai sun samu damar tambayar shugaban Amurka kai tsaye, hakan ya fi kyau fiye da magana da ni."
rows.reference: Jawabin zai gabata har yanzu, in ji Sanders, amma "idan manema labarai na da damar tambayar shugaban Amurka tambayoyin, kai tsaye toh yafi kyau fiye da magana da ni.

rows.source: We try to do that a lot and you've seen us do that a lot over the last few weeks and that's going to take the place of a press briefing when you can talk to the president of the United States."
rows.output: Muna ƙoƙarin yin hakan sosai kuma kun ga mun yi hakan a cikin makonni da suka gabata kuma hakan zai maye gurbin taron manema labarai lokacin da za ku iya magana da shugaban ƙasar Amurka."
rows.reference: Mun yi ƙoƙarin yin haka sosai kuma kun gan mu yin hakan sosai a cikin 'yan makonnin da suka wuce kuma wannan zai faru na taƙaitaccen jawabi lokacin da za ku iya magana da shugaban Amurka."

rows.source: Trump regularly takes questions when leaving the White House or participating in open sessions or press conferences with visiting dignitaries.
rows.output: Trump yana yin tambayoyi akai-akai lokacin da yake barin Fadar White House ko kuma yana halartan zaman bude ido ko kuma tarurrukan manema labarai tare da manyan baki.
rows.reference: Trump yakan amsa tambayoyi lokacin fita daga White House ko idan ya hallarci budaden taro ko taron manema labarai da baki masu ziyara.

rows.source: Solo press conferences are rare.
rows.output: Taron manema labarai na kai tsaye ba su da yawa.
rows.reference: Boyayen jawabin manema labarai na da wuya.

rows.source: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.
rows.output: A New York wannan makon, shugaban kasa ya yi kamar ya nuna dalilin hakan, ta hanyar yin wani bayani mai ban mamaki da wani lokaci mai ban mamaki a gaban 'yan jarida.
rows.reference: A Birnin New York wannan satin, shugaban kasa ya nuna dalilin da ya sa, ya ke yin ganin daman sa da kuma fitowa lokuta masu ban mamaki kafin ya tattara manema labarai.

rows.source: Health secretary writes to EU workers at NHS Scotland over Brexit fears
rows.output: Sakatare na lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikata na EU a NHS Scotland kan damuwar Brexit
rows.reference: Sakataren kiwon lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU a NHS Scotland game da tsoron Brexit

rows.source: The Health Secretary has written to EU staff working in Scotland's NHS to express the country's gratitude and wish for them to stay on post-Brexit.
rows.output: Ministan Lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU da ke aiki a NHS na Scotland don bayyana godiyar kasar da kuma fatan su ci gaba da kasancewa bayan Brexit.
rows.reference: Sakataren Lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU da ke aikin NHS na Scotland don nuna godiya ga kasar kuma su na so su zauna bayan-Brexit.

rows.source: Jeane Freeman MSP sent a letter with less than six months to go until the UK withdraws from the EU.
rows.output: An aika waƙar Jeane Freeman MSP da ƙasa da watanni shida kafin Birtaniya ta fita daga EU.
rows.reference: Jeane Freeman MSP ta aika da wasika kasa da watanni shida don tafiya har sai Birtaniya ta janye daga EU.

rows.source: The Scottish Government has already committed to meet the cost of settled status applications for EU citizens working in its devolved public services.
rows.output: Gwamnatin Scotland ta riga ta yi alkawarin biyan kuɗin aikace-aikacen matsayin da aka saba ga 'yan ƙasar Turai da ke aiki a cikin ayyukan jama'a da ta raba.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin Scotland ta rigaya ta yi ƙoƙari don saduwa da farashin da za a bi don biyan bukatun 'yan ƙasa na EU waɗanda ke aiki a cikin ayyukan jama'a.

rows.source: In her letter, Ms Freeman wrote: "Over the summer, negotiations between the UK and EU on withdrawal have continued, heading towards expected decisions this autumn.
rows.output: A cikin wasiƙarta, Ms Freeman ta rubuta: "A lokacin rani, an ci gaba da tattaunawar tsakanin Birtaniya da EU kan ficewa, tare da nufin yanke hukunci a wannan kaka.
rows.reference: A cikin wasikar ta, Ms Freeman ta rubuta: "A lokacin rani, tattaunawar tsakanin Birtaniya da EU a kan janyewa ya ci gaba, zuwa ga yanke shawarar wannan kakan.

rows.source: But the UK Government has also been stepping up its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.
rows.output: Amma gwamnatin Birtaniya ta kuma fara shiryawa don wata yiwuwar rashin yarjejeniyar.
rows.reference: Amma Gwamnatin Birtaniya ta ci gaba da shirye-shirye don yiwuwar rashin daidaitawa.

rows.source: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.
rows.output: Na san wannan dole ne ya zama lokaci mai matuƙar damuwa ga dukkan ku.
rows.reference: Na san wannan lokaci dole yako rashin natsuwa gare ku duka.

rows.source: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.
rows.output: Don haka na so in sake jaddada yadda nake darajan gudunmawar da duk ma’aikaci, ba tare da la’akari da ƙasarsu ba.
rows.reference: Shi ya sa nake so in sake nuna yadda kowone ma’aikaci ke da daraja a gudummawar da yake bayarwa, ko dan wane ƙasa ne.

rows.source: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
rows.output: Abokai daga ko'ina cikin Tarayyar Turai, da ma wajen ta, suna kawo ƙwarewa da ƙwarewa masu mahimmanci da ke kara karfafa da inganta aikin aikin kiwon lafiya, kuma suna amfanar marasa lafiya da al'umman da muke yi wa hidima.
rows.reference: Abokan aiki daga ko'ina cikin EU, da kuma bayan haka, su na ba da kwarewa mai mahimmanci don ƙarfafawa da inganta aikin kiwon lafiya, da kuma amfani da marasa lafiya da al'ummomin da muke bautawa.

rows.source: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."
rows.output: "Scotland ita ce gida mafiyarka kuma muna son ka zauna a nan."
rows.reference: Scotland ta zama cikakken gida kuma munfi son ku zauna nan."

rows.source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
rows.output: Christion Abercrombie ya yi aikin tiyata na gaggawa bayan ya ji rauni a kai
rows.reference: Anyi wa Christion Abercrombie Tiyatar Gaggawa Bayan Raunin da ya Samu a Kai

rows.source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
rows.output: An yi wa ɗan wasan ƙwallon ƙafa na Tennessee State Tigers, Christion Abercrombie, tiyatar gaggawa bayan ya ji rauni a kai a lokacin da aka doke shi da ci 31-27 a hannun Commodores na Vanderbilt a ranar Asabar, kamar yadda Tennessean's Mike Organ ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie aka wa tiyata gaggawa bayan raunin da ya ji a kai ranar Asabar da ta sha kashi 31-27 ga Vanderbilt Commodores, kamfanin Organic na Tennessean suka kawo rehoton.

rows.source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
rows.output: Kocin Tennessee State Rod Reed ya gaya wa 'yan jarida cewa an samu rauni ne kadan kafin a kammala rabin lokaci.
rows.reference: Shugaban kocin Tennessee Rod Reed ya shaida wa manema labaru cewa raunin da ya faru ya faru ne kafin rabin lokaci.

rows.source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
rows.output: Ya zo gefen kuma kawai ya fado a can," Reed ya ce.
rows.reference: Ya je daidai layin gefe kuma anan ya fadi”, Reed yace.

rows.source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
rows.output: Masu horarwa da ma'aikatan likitanci sun ba Abercrombie iskar oxygen a gefen filin wasa kafin su sanya shi a kan bencin asibiti su kuma kai shi baya don karin tantancewa.
rows.reference: Masu horarwa da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya sun ba Abercrombie oxygen a kan gefen layi kafin su sanya shi a kan shimfiɗa da kuma mayar da shi don ƙarin kimantawa.

rows.source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.output: Wani jami'in Tennessee State ya gaya wa Chris Harris na WSMV a Nashville, Tennessee, cewa Abercrombie ya fito daga tiyata a Cibiyar Kiwon Lafiya ta Vanderbilt.
rows.reference: Jami’in daga Jaha Tennessee ya fada wa Chris Harris na WSMV a Nashville,Tennessee, cewa Abercrobie ya fito daga tiyatar a Asibitin Vanderbilt.

rows.source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
rows.output: Harris ya kara da cewa, "babu wani bayani kan irin ko girman raunin da ya samu ba" kuma Tennessee State na kokarin gano lokacin da raunin ya faru.
rows.reference: Harris ya kara da cewa "babu cikakkun bayanai akan irin/yawan raunin tukunan" kuma Jihar Tennessee na kokarin gano lokacin da rauni ya faru.

rows.source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
rows.output: Abercrombie, wani ɗan wasan ƙwallon ƙafa mai launin ja mai shekaru biyu, yana cikin kakar farko da Tennessee State bayan ya koma daga Illinois.
rows.reference: Abercrombie, mai jar rigar sophomore,yana cikin kakar sa na farko tare da Jaha Tennessee bayan canja wuri daga Illinois.

rows.source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
rows.output: Ya samu bugun gida biyar a ranar Asabar kafin ya fita daga wasan, wanda ya kai jimlar wasannin da ya yi a kakar wasa 18.
rows.reference: Yana da tabi biyar a ranar Asabar kafin fita daga wasan, wanda ya kawo kakarsa har zuwa tabi 18.

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
rows.output: Masu sayan kasashen waje za su biya haraji mai yawa idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya
rows.reference: Za a caje masu siya na ƙetare mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
rows.output: Masu sayen kasashen waje za su biya haraji mai yawa idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya da kudin da za a yi amfani da su wajen taimakawa marasa gida a cikin sabon shirin na jam'iyyar Conservative.
rows.reference: Za a caje masu siya na ƙetare mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya tare da karin tsabar kudi da ake amfani da su don taimaka wa marasa gida a karkashin sabon shirin Tory

rows.source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
rows.output: Matakin zai soke nasarar da Corbyn ya samu wajen jawo masu kada kuri'a matasa
rows.reference: Wannan motsi zai kawar da nasarar Corbyn don jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
rows.output: Harajin tambarin zai kasance akan wadanda ba sa biyan haraji a Birtaniya
rows.reference: Aikin hatimi zai yi tasiri a kan waɗanda ba su biyan haraji a Birtaniya

rows.source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
rows.output: Rukunin kudi yana sa ran zai samu har zuwa fam miliyan 120 a kowace shekara - don taimakawa marasa gida
rows.reference: Ma’ajiyar kudin tsammanin tashin sa har zuwa miliyan £120 a kowace shekara - don taimaka wa marasa gida

rows.source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
rows.output: Masu sayen kasashen waje za su biya kason haraji mafi girma idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya - tare da karin kudi da za a yi amfani da su wajen taimakawa marasa gida, Theresa May za ta sanar a yau.
rows.reference: Ana sa ran masu siyan na ƙetare za a caje su mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya - tare da ƙarin tsabar kuɗin da ake amfani da su don taimaka wa marasa gida, Theresa May za ta sanar a yau.

rows.source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
rows.output: Za a yi la'akari da matakin a matsayin yunƙurin rage nasarar Jeremy Corbyn na jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a tare da alkawura na samar da gidaje masu araha da kuma kai hari ga masu samun kuɗi mai yawa.
rows.reference: Za a ga wannan matakin a matsayin ƙoƙarin kore nasarar da Jeremy Corbyn ya samu domin jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a tare da alkawurra don samar da gidaje masu araha da kuma ƙaddara da samar da tsauraran matakai.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
rows.output: Harajin tambarin zai kasance akan mutane da kamfanoni da ba sa biyan haraji a Birtaniya, tare da ƙarin kudi da za su taimaka wa gwamnati wajen yin yaki da barci a kan titi.
rows.reference: Aikin hatimin zai tashi ga akan daidaiku da kamfani da rashin biyan haraji a Birtaniya, tare da karin kudaden tallafawa gwamnatin ta hanyar magance rashin barci.

rows.source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
rows.output: Ƙarin kuɗin - wanda ya haɗa da haraji na yanzu, ciki har da matakan da aka ƙara shekaru biyu da suka wuce kan gidajen na biyu da kuma gidajensu - zai iya kai har zuwa kashi uku cikin ɗari.
rows.reference: Ƙarin - wanda da yake kari ne ga aikin hatimi na yanzu, ciki har da matakan da aka gabatar a cikin shekaru biyu da suka gabata a kan gidaje biyu da kuma sayen bada haya - zai iya zama kusan kashi uku cikin dari.

rows.source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
rows.output: Rukunin kudi na sa ran wannan matakin zai kawo sama da fam miliyan 120 a kowace shekara.
rows.reference: Ma’ajiyar kudin na tsammanin tashin sa har zuwa miliyan £120 a shekara.

rows.source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
rows.output: Kimanin kashi 13 cikin ɗari na sababbin gidaje a Landan ana siya ne ta hanyar waɗanda ba 'yan ƙasar Birtaniya ba, wanda hakan ke kara tsadar gidaje da kuma sa waɗanda ke son siya na farko ya yi waɗannnan gidaje.
rows.reference: An kiyasta kimanin kashi 13 cikin dari na sababbin kayan haɗin gine-ginen London ana saye ne daga ‘yan kasar waje masu zama a Britaniya, farashin na hawa kuma yana sa masu sayen farko su wahala wajen samun gidajen shiga.

rows.source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
rows.output: Yankunan da suka yi arziki a ƙasar - musamman a babban birnin - sun zama "garuruwan fatalwa" saboda yawan masu sayen kadarorin kasashen waje da ke ci gaba da kasancewa a ƙasashen waje.
rows.reference: Yawancin yankuna masu arziki a kasar - musamman ma a babban birnin kasar - sun zama "biranen fatalwa" saboda yawan adadin masu saya na kasashen waje waɗanda mafi yawan lokutan basa zaune kasar.

rows.source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
rows.output: Sabuwar manufofin ta zo ne makonnin da suka gabata da Boris Johnson ya yi kira da a rage haraji kan sayen gida don taimakawa karfafa gwiwar matasa su mallaki gidansu na farko.
rows.reference: Sabuwar manufofi ya zo ne kawai makonni bayan Boris Johnson ya yi kira ga takaddamar hatimi don taimakawa matasan da suka mallaki gidansu.

rows.source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
rows.output: Ya zargi manyan kamfanon gine-gine da ci gaba da tsadar gidaje ta hanyar sayen filaye amma ba su amfani da su ba, kuma ya bukaci Mrs. May ta yi watsi da takunkumin gidajen da ake iya ba da su don magance "disgrace na gidaje" na Birtaniya.
rows.reference: Ya zargi manyan Kamfanonin gine-gine da ajiye kayyaki masu manyan farashin ta hanyar karbe ƙasa ba tare da yin amfani da ita ba, kuma ya bukaci Mrs May ta bar kudaden shiga kan gidajen don magance "matsalar gidaje a Britaniya.”

rows.source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
rows.output: Mr Corbyn ya sanar da jerin gyare-gyaren gidan da suka yi fice, wanda ya haɗa da sarrafa hayar da kuma ƙarshen "ba tare da laifi ba" na korar.
rows.reference: Mista Corbyn ya sanar da wani tsari na gyaran gidaje da aka tsara, ciki har da tsarin haya da kuma kawo ƙarshen “rashin-lafin” fitarwa.

rows.source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
rows.output: Yana kuma son ba majalisu damar gina sabbin gidajen.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, yana so ya ba majalisa ikon da zai iya gina gidaje.

rows.source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
rows.output: Mrs May ta ce: "A bara na ce zan sadaukar da premiership dina wajen dawo da mafarkin Birtaniya - cewa rayuwa ya kamata ta fi kyau ga kowace sabuwar al'umma.
rows.reference: Mrs May tace: "A bara na ce zan keɓe mulki don maido da mafarkin Birtaniya - cewa rayuwa ta fi kyau ga kowane sabon ƙarni.

rows.source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
rows.output: Kuma hakan na nufin gyara kasuwar gidajensu.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan yana nufin gyaran gidajen kasuwannin da suka rushe.

rows.source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
rows.output: Birtaniyya za ta kasance a bude ga mutanen da ke son zama, aiki da gina rayuwa a nan.
rows.reference: Birtaniya za ta kasance a bude ga mutanen da suke so su zauna, aiki da gina rayuwa a nan.

rows.source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
rows.output: Duk da haka, ba daidai ba ne cewa yana da sauki ga mutane da ba sa zama a Birtaniya, da kuma kamfanoni da ke kasashen waje, su sayi gidaje kamar yadda masu aiki tuƙuru na Birtaniya ke yi.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, ba daidai ba ne cewa yana da sauƙi ga mutanen da ba su zaune a Birtaniya, da kuma kamfanoni na kasashen waje, don sayen gidaje a matsayin mazaunan Birtaniya masu wahala.

rows.source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
rows.output: Ga mutane da yawa, mafarkin mallakar gida ya yi nisa da yawa, kuma rashin mutunci na barci a waje ya ci gaba da kasancewa a gaskiya."
rows.reference: Ga mutane da yawa mafarkin mallakar gida ya zama da nisa sosai, kuma rashin tausayi na mummunar barci yana kara tabbatuwa da gaske. "

rows.source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
rows.output: Jack Ross: 'Buri na ƙarshe shine in kasance mai kula da Scotland'
rows.reference: Jack Ross: 'Babban burin na shi ne in gudanar da Scotland'

rows.source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
rows.output: Kocin Sunderland Jack Ross ya ce burinsa na karshe shi ne ya zama kocin Scotland a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: Shugaban Sunderland Jack Ross ya ce "burinsa" shi ne ya zama kocin Scotland a wani mataki.

rows.source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
rows.output: Dan Scots, mai shekaru 42, yana jin daɗin kalubalen sake farfado da kungiyar Arewa, wanda a halin yanzu take matsayi na uku a gasar League One, maki uku daga matsayi na farko.
rows.reference: Scot, mai shekaru 42, yana farin cikin kalubalantar dawoda kungiyar wasan na North-East, wanda a halin yanzu ke zama na uku a League na daya, maki uku daga saman.

rows.source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
rows.output: Ya koma filin wasa na haske a wannan bazara bayan ya jagoranci St Mirren zuwa gasar Scottish Premiership a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Ya koma Stadium mai Haske a wannan kakar rani bayan ya jagoranci St Mirren komawa fremiya kakar wasan Scotland.

rows.source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
rows.output: "Na so in buga wa kasar na a matsayin ɗan wasa.
rows.reference: "Ina so in buga wa kasarta wasa.

rows.source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.output: Na samu B cap kuma haka ya ƙare," Ross ya gaya wa BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.reference: Na samu hular B kuma wannan shi ne, "in ji Ross ya shaidawa BBC Scotland’s Muryarwasanni."

rows.source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
rows.output: "Amma na girma ina kallon Scotland a Hampden da yawa tare da ubana a lokacin yarinta, kuma ko da yaushe wani abu ne da ya ja ni zuwa gare shi.
rows.reference: "Amma na girma da kallon Scotland a Hampden da yawa tare da mahaifina a matsayin yaro, kuma yana da wani abu ke jawoni.

rows.source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
rows.output: Wannan damar za ta zo ne kawai, duk da haka, idan na yi nasara a cikin gudanar da kungiyar."
rows.reference: Wannan damar za ta zo, duk da haka, idan na ci nasara a gudanar da kungiyar."

rows.source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
rows.output: Manazartan da suka gabata a matsayin manajan Sunderland sun haɗa da Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet da Paulo Di Canio.
rows.reference: Wadanda suka gabaci Ross a matsayin masu gudarwa Sunderland sun hada da Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet da Paolo Di Canio.

rows.source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
rows.output: Tsohon kocin Alloa Athletic ya ce bai ji tsoro ba ya bi manyan sunaye a wannan babban kulob din, bayan da ya ki aikawa da Barnsley da Ipswich Town.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban Alloa Athletic ya ce ba ya tsoron abin da wadannan sunayen suka kafa a irin wannan babban kungiyar, bayan da yaki tayin Barnsley da Ipswich Town.

rows.source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
rows.output: "Yunwa ta yi mani a halin yanzu za ta kasance 'zaka iya dawo da wannan kulob din zuwa gasar Premier?'
rows.reference: "Nasara a gare ni a wannan lokacin shi ne 'zan iya mayar da kungiyar zuwa Wasanin Fremiya?'

rows.source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
rows.output: Saboda tsarin da kayan aiki a wannan kulob din, ba shakka yana cikin gasar Premier," ya ce.
rows.reference: Saboda tsari da kayayyaki a wannan kungiya, ba abun mamaki ba ne mu na Wassanin Fremiya, "in ji shi.

rows.source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
rows.output: "Ba aikin da ya yi sauƙi ba ne ya samu a can, amma ina ganin zan yi nasara a nan idan zan iya dawo da kulob din a can."
rows.reference: "Ba abu mai sauki ba ne don samun shi a can, amma zan iya ganin kai na kamar yadda na ci nasara a nan idan na iya samun kungiyar a can."

rows.source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
rows.output: Ross yana da shekaru uku kawai a cikin aikin sa na gudanarwa, bayan wani lokaci a matsayin mataimaki na manaja a Dumbarton da kuma wani lokaci na watanni 15 a cikin ma'aikatan Hearts.
rows.reference: Shekaru Ross uku ne kawai a aikin gudanarwa, bayan wani lokaci a matsayin mataimakin mai gudanarwa a Dumbarton da kuma watanni 15 a Hearts 'koyon gudanar da wasanni.

rows.source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
rows.output: Daga nan ya taimaka wa Alloa ya dawo daga relegation zuwa matakin na uku, kuma ya canza St Mirren daga gefen relegation zuwa zakaran gasar Championship a kakar wasa ta gaba.
rows.reference: Ya kuma taimakawa Alloa ta sake farfadowa zuwa rukuni na uku, kuma ya sake canza St Mirren daga rawar ta taka a gasar zakarun Turai a kakar wasa ta gaba.

rows.source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
rows.output: Kuma Ross ya ce ya ji dadinsa yanzu fiye da yadda ya taba ji a lokacin aikinsa na wasan a Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren da Hamilton Academical.
rows.reference: Kuma Ross ya ce yana jin dadi fiye da yadda ya taba yi a lokacin da yake wasa a Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren da Hamilton Academical.

rows.source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
rows.output: "Ya kasance mai yiwuwa wani wuri ne mai muhimmanci," ya tuna, na ɗaukar Alloa.
rows.reference: "Ya zama mai yiyuwa da rudarwa," ya tuna, ya karbi ragamar Alloa.

rows.source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
rows.output: Na yi imani da gaske cewa gudanar da harkokin kasuwanci ya dace da ni, fiye da buga wasan.
rows.reference: "Na yi imani da gaske cewa gudanarwa ya fi dacewa da ni, fiye da wasa.

rows.source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
rows.output: Yana da ban mamaki ne saboda na yi kyau, na sami rayuwa mai kyau daga ciki, kuma na ji wasu manyan abubuwa masu kyau.
rows.reference: Yana da ban mamaki saboda na yi kokari, na yi rayuwa mai kyau daga ciki, kuma na ji dadin wasu daukaka.

rows.source: But playing can be tough.
rows.output: Amma yin wasa na iya zama da wahala.
rows.reference: Amma wasa zai iya zama da wuya.

rows.source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
rows.output: Akwai abubuwa da yawa da za ku yi ta hanyar sati.
rows.reference: Akwai abubuwa masu yawa da za ka fuskanta a kowane mako-mako.

rows.source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
rows.output: Har yanzu ina tafiya ta wannan hanyar dangane da damuwar da matsi na aikin amma gudanarwar ta ji daidai.
rows.reference: Har yanzu ina ci gaba da wannan batun dangane da matsalolin da matsa lamba na aikin amma gudanarwa na ji daidai.

rows.source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
rows.output: Ina so in yi mulki kuma yanzu ina yi, yana jin daɗi fiye da yadda na kasance a jikina a duk tsawon rayuwata ta manya.
rows.reference: A koyaushe ina so in gudanar kuma yanzu ina yin hakan, ina jin dadi sosai da ina cikin kumbin a tsawon rayuwana."

rows.source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
rows.output: Za ka iya sauraron cikakken hirar a Sportsound a ranar Lahadi, 30 ga Satumba, a Radio Scotland tsakanin 12:00 da 13:00 GMT
rows.reference: Kuna iya sauraron cikakken tambayoyi game da Wasanni a Lahadi, 30 Satumba, a kan Radio Scotland tsakanin 12:00 da 13:00 BST

rows.source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
rows.output: Lokaci mafi kyau don kofi na rabin na awanni 5.30 na ranar Asabar, binciken ya gano
rows.reference: Lokaci cikakken pint shi ne 5.30pm a ranar Asabar, binciken ya nuna

rows.source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
rows.output: Zazzabin rani ya kara yawan kudi ga mashaya da ke fama da matsalar kudi a Birtaniya, amma ya kara matsawa kan gidajen cin abinci.
rows.reference: Gudun zafi ya bunkasa shiga wajen shakatawa Birtaniya da ke fafatawa amma ya kara matsa lamba a kan gidajen cin abinci.

rows.source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
rows.output: Kungiyoyin mashaya da gidajen giya sun ga karuwar tallace-tallace da kashi 2.7 cikin 100 a watan Yuli - amma kudaden da ake samu a gidajen abinci sun ragu da kashi 4.8 cikin 100, an bayyana.
rows.reference: Wajajen shakatawa da mashaya sun samu tashin ciniki da kashi 2.7 bisa dari, a yuli amma wajajen cin abinci sun sauka da kashi 4.8 cikin dari, adadi sun nuna.

rows.source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
rows.output: Pita Martin, na kamfanin kasuwanci na CGA, wanda ya tattara bayanan, ya ce: "Haske mai dadi da ya ci gaba da kasancewa da kuma shiga Ingila a gasar cin kofin duniya fiye da yadda ake tsammani, ya sa watan Yuli ya bi irin tsarin watan Yuni, lokacin da gidajen shan barasa suka karu da kashi 2.8 cikin dari, sai dai wuraren cin abinci sun fuskanci karuwar rashin lafiya."
rows.reference: Peter Martin, mai kula da harkokin kasuwancin CGA, wanda ya hada da adadi, ya ce: "Ya ci gaba da haskakawa da Ingila fiye da yadda aka sa ran shiga cikin gasar cin kofin duniya a watan Yuli, wanda ya biyo bayan irin wannan yanayin zuwa watan Yuni na baya, a lokacin da aka samu kashi 2.8 cikin dari, sai dai yawancin gidajen cin abinci sun fi taɓuwa.

rows.source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
rows.output: Faduwar kashi 1.8 cikin ɗari a harkokin cin abinci a watan Yuni kawai ya yi muni a watan Yuli.
rows.reference: Faduwar kashi 1.8 cikin dari a cinikin sayar da abinci a watan Yuni kawai ya munana a watan Yuli.

rows.source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
rows.output: Girkin da ke da al'ada da mashaya sun yi mafi kyawun aiki, tare da kamanceceniya sun karu fiye da gidajen cin abinci, wanda ya ragu.
rows.reference: Rumfunan saida abin sha da mashaya sun kara karfi tare da ire-iren sa fiye da gidajen cin abinci da suka kasance kasa.

rows.source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
rows.output: Guraben abinci sun yi fama da rana, kodayake ba a cikin irin wannan yanayi ba kamar masu gudanar da gidajen abinci.
rows.reference: Rumfunan sayar da abinci suma sun sha wahala a rana, amma bai kai ga irin na ma’ikatan gidajen cin abinci ba.

rows.source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
rows.output: Ya bayyana cewa mutane kawai suna son fita don shan giya.
rows.reference: Da alama mutane su na so su fita ne don samun abun sha.

rows.source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."
rows.output: A cikin gidajen cin abinci da mashaya da aka gudanar, sayar da abubuwan sha sun karu da kashi 6.6 cikin dari na watan, yayin da abinci ya ragu da kashi uku cikin dari."
rows.reference: A duk wuraren da ake gudanar da shan giya da mashayar ababen sha sayarwa ya kai har 6.6 cikin dari na watan, da abinci kasa da kashi uku. "

rows.source: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.
rows.output: Paul Newman, na masana'anta ta hutawa da masu masaukin baki RSM ya ce: "Wadannan sakamakon sun ci gaba da yanayin da muka gani tun karshen watan Afrilu.
rows.reference: Paul Newman, na manazartan shakatawa da karamcin RSM ya ce: "Wadannan sakamakon sun ci gaba da yayi tun daga karshen Afrilu.

rows.source: Weather and the impact of major social or sporting events remain the biggest factors when it comes to sales in the out-of-home market.
rows.output: Yi da tasirin manyan al'amura na zamantakewa ko wasanni na ci gaba da zama manyan abubuwan da ke shafar tallace-tallace a kasuwar waje.
rows.reference: Yanayi da kuma tasirin manyan abubuwan zamantakewar jama'a ko abubuwan dake faruwa a wasanni sun kasance manyan dalilai idan aka zo maganar sayarwa a kasuwar wajen gida.

rows.source: It comes as no surprise that restaurant groups continue to struggle, albeit a sales drop of 4.8 per cent year-on-year will be particularly painful on top of ongoing cost pressures.
rows.output: Ba abu ne mai ban mamaki ba cewa ƙungiyoyin gidajen abinci na ci gaba da fuskantar kalubale, duk da cewa raguwar cinikinsu da kashi 4.8 cikin ɗari a kowace shekara za ta yi matuƙar tsanani a kan matsi na kuɗin da suke fuskanta.

rows.output: Mai bibiyar Coffer Peach Tracker na masana'antar sayar da kaya ga masana'antar gidan cin abinci, mashaya, da gidajen cin abinci na Birtaniya tana tattara da kuma nazarin bayanan aikinsu daga kungiyoyin da ke aiki 47, tare da jinginar da ya wuce £9 biliyan, kuma shine ma'aunin da aka kafa a masana'antar.

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle za ta kasance "muryar 'yan wasa" a kan hukumar Scottish Athletics
rows.reference: Eilidh Doyle zai zama "murya ga 'yan wasa" a hukumar wasan ta Scotland

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
rows.output: An zabe Eilidh Doyle a majalisar Scottish Athletics a matsayin darakta mara aiki a taron babban taron hukumar na shekara.
rows.reference: An zabi Eilidh Doyle zuwa kwamitin hukumar wasanni ta Scottish a matsayin karamin darekta a babban taron kungiyar gudanarwa na shekara-shekara.

rows.source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
rows.output: Doyle ita ce 'yar Scotland da ta fi kima a tseren hanya da filin wasa, kuma shugaban Ian Beattie ya bayyana wannan matakin a matsayin babban dama ga wadanda ke kula da wasan motsa jiki don samun fa'ida daga gogewar ta a matakin kasa da kasa a cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Doyle ne mafi kyawun dan wasan gudu da sauran wasannin fili na Scotland kuma shugaba Ian Beattie ya bayyana cewa wannan matsayi ne mai matukar dama ga waɗanda ke jagorantar wasanni don samun damar amfani da ita a cikin matakin kasa da kasa a cikin shekaru goma da suka wuce.

rows.source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
rows.output: "Eilidh tana da girmamawa sosai a cikin al'ummar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Scotland, Birtaniya da duniya, kuma muna da tabbas cewa ƙwallon ƙafa a Scotland za ta amfana sosai ta hanyar sanya ta a cikin kwamitin," in ji Beattie.
rows.reference: "Eilidh yana da girmamawa sosai a tsakanin al'ummar Scotland, Birtaniya da kuma kungiyar 'yan wasa na duniya, kuma mun tabbata yan wasa a Scotland za su amfana sosai ta hanyar kawo ta ga kwamitin," Beattie ya ce.

rows.source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
rows.output: Doyle ya ce: "Ina son yin aiki a matsayin murya ga 'yan wasa kuma ina fatan zan iya ba da gudummawa sosai kuma in taimaka wajen jagorantar wasan a Scotland."
rows.reference: Doyle ya ce: "Ina sha’awar inyi aikin muryar ga 'yan wasa kuma ina fatan zan iya bada gudunmawata da taimakawa wajen jagorancin wasanni a Scotland."

rows.source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
rows.output: Yawan yara 'yan gudun hijira da aka kama ya karu duk da cewa yawan shiga kan iyaka ya kasance ba a canzawa sosai, a wani bangare saboda tsauraran magana da manufofin da gwamnatin Trump ta gabatar sun sa ya yi wuya a sanya yara da masu kula da su.
rows.reference: Yawan adadin yara 'yan gudun hijirar da ake tsare da su sun karu ko da yake haɗin kan iyakoki a kowane wata ya kasance ba tare da canzawa ba, a wani bangare saboda rashin amincewa da manufofi da gwamnatin Trump ya gabatar da shi ya sa ya fi ƙarfin sanya yara tare da masu tallafawa.

rows.source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
rows.output: A tarihi, yawancin masu tallafin sun kasance 'yan gudun hijira marasa rajista, kuma sun ji tsoron lalata damar su ta zama a kasar ta hanyar bayyana kansu don ɗaukar yaro.
rows.reference: A al'adance, yawancin masu tallafawa sun kasance baƙi ne ba tare da izini ba, kuma su na jin tsoro samun daman ikon kansu na kasancewa a cikin ƙasa ta hanyar ci gaba da bukata yara.

rows.source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
rows.output: Haɗarin ya karu a watan Yuni, lokacin da hukumomin tarayya suka sanar da cewa masu tallafi da sauran manyan membobin gidansu za su gabatar da yatsun hannu, kuma bayanan za a raba su da hukumomin shiga.
rows.reference: Haɗarin ya haɓaka a watan Yuni, lokacin da hukumomin tarayya suka bayyana cewa masu tallafawa da sauran 'yan ƙananan mazaunan su a gida zasu bada zanen hannun su, kuma za a raba bayanai tare da hukumomin shige da fice.

rows.source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
rows.output: A makonnin da ya gabata, Matthew Albence, wani jami'in babban matsayi a Hukumar Shige da Fice da Aikace-aikacen, ya shaida wa Majalisar Dokoki ta kasa cewa hukumar ta kama wasu mutane da dama da suka nemi zama masu kula da yara marasa gida.
rows.reference: A makon da ya gabata, Matthew Albence, babban jami'in ma'aikatar kula da Shige da fice da kwastam, ya shaida wa majalisar cewa, hukumar ta kama mutane da dama da suka nemi tallafa wa kananan yara.

rows.source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
rows.output: Hukumar ta tabbatar da daga baya cewa kashi 70 cikin 100 na wadanda aka kama ba su da tarihin aikata laifuka a baya.
rows.reference: Daga bisani hukumar ta tabbatar da cewar kashi 70 cikin dari na waɗanda aka kama ba su da takardun laifi.

rows.source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
rows.output: "Kusa da kashi 80 cikin ɗari na mutanen da ko dai masu daukar nauyinsu ne ko kuma 'yan uwa na masu daukar nauyinsu suna nan a kasar ba bisa ka'ida ba, kuma babban kashi na wadannan 'yan kasashen waje ne masu laifi.
rows.reference: "Kusan kashi 80 cikin dari na mutanen da suke da goyon baya ko masu goyon baya na gida su na nan a cikin kasar ba tare da izini ba, kuma babban ɓangare na waɗanda su ne masu laifi.

rows.source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
rows.output: Don haka muna ci gaba da neman waɗanda suka tsere," in ji Mista Albence.
rows.reference: Don haka mu na ci gaba da bin wadannan mutane, "in ji Mr. Albence.

rows.source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
rows.output: Ana neman sarrafa yara da sauri, jami'an sun gabatar da sabbin dokoki da za su bukaci wasu daga cikin su su bayyana a gaban kotun cikin wata guda bayan an kama su, maimakon bayan kwanaki 60, wanda shi ne ka'idojin da suka gabata, a cewar ma'aikatan mafaka.
rows.reference: Nema don aiwatar da yara da sauri, jami'ai sun gabatar da sababbin ka'idodin da zasu bukaci wasu daga cikinsu su bayyana a kotu a cikin wata daya da aka tsare, maimakon bayan kwanaki 60, wanda shi ne daidaitattun baya, bisa ga ma'aikatan tsari.

rows.source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
rows.output: Da yawa za su bayyana ta hanyar taron bidiyo, maimakon a zahiri, don roƙon shari'a ga wani jami'in shiga.
rows.reference: Mutane da yawa za su fito ta hanyar kiran taro na bidiyo, maimakon mutum, don yin jigilar su game da shari'a, a matsayin mai hukunci.

rows.source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
rows.output: Wadanda aka ga ba su cancanta ba za a mayar da su cikin sauri.
rows.reference: Waɗanda ake zaton ba su cancanci taimako ba za mu mayar da su.

rows.source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
rows.output: Yara suna cikin kulawa na tsawon lokaci, suna da yawa su zama masu damuwa ko damuwa, wanda zai iya haifar da tashin hankali ko ƙoƙarin tserewa, a cewar ma'aikatan ceto da rahotanni da suka fito daga tsarin a watanni masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Yawancin yaran su na kasancewa a gidan tsaro, mafi yawan su so samu damuwa ko girgiza, wanda zai iya haifar da tashin hankali ko kuma yunkurin tserewa, bisa ga ma'aikatan tsari da rahotanni da suka fito daga cikin tsarin kwanan nan.

rows.source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
rows.output: Masu goyon bayan sun ce damuwar ta karu a wani babban wurin kamar Tornillo, inda alamun cewa yaro yana fama da matsalar lafiya na iya zama a kasa a gani, saboda girman wurin.
rows.reference: Masu bada shawara sun ce wadanada ya shafa su na damuwa sosai a manya gidajen kamar na Tornillo, wurin da alamun cewa yaro na gwagwarmaya na da saukin a kyale shi, saboda girman shi.

rows.source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
rows.output: Sun kara da cewa, matsar da yara zuwa birnin sansani ba tare da samar musu isasshiyar lokaci don shiryarsu ta zuciya ko kuma su yi bankwana da abokai ba, zai iya kara musu damuwa da dama ke fama da ita.
rows.reference: Sun kara cewa mayar da yara birnin alfarwa ba tare da isashen lokaci a shirya hankalin su ko yi ya wabokanansu sallama ba zai iya kara masu takaici wanda da yawan su ke fama da shi.

rows.source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
rows.output: Syria ta gaya wa Amurka, Faransa, da Turkiyya 'maganin' su fita nan take
rows.reference: Sham ta fada wa ‘sojojin mamaya’ na Amurka, Faransa da Turkiya zasu janye ba tare da jinkiri ba

rows.source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
rows.output: A yayin da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta yi magana, Ministan Harkokin Waje Walid al-Moualem ya kuma yi kira ga 'yan gudun hijira na Siriya da su dawo gida, duk da cewa yakin kasar ya kai shekaru takwas.
rows.reference: A jawabi ma Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje al-Moualem yayi kira ga masu gudun hijira na da su dawo gida, duk da yakin kasar yanzu yana cikin shekara na takwas.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, wanda kuma ya yi aiki a matsayin mataimakiyar firaminista, ya ce sojojin kasashen waje suna kan kasa ba bisa ka'ida ba, a karkashin tsarin yaki da ta'adda, kuma za a yi musu "hakuri."
rows.reference: Moualem, wanda yake kuma matsayin mataimakin firayam minista, yace sojojin kasar wajen su na Sham ne ba tare da izini ba, a karkashin babatun yaki da ta’addanci, kuma “za’a magance su yadda ya kamata.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Ya kamata su janye nan take ba tare da wani sharadi ba," ya gaya wa taron.
rows.reference: “Dole su janye ba tare da jinkiri ba kuma ba tare da wani sharaɗi ba,” ya fada wa taron.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem ya yi iƙirarin cewa "yakin ta'addanci ya kusan ƙare" a Siriya, inda sama da mutane 360,000 suka mutu tun daga shekarar 2011, tare da miliyoyin da suka rasa matsugunansu.
rows.reference: Moualem ya dage cewa “yaki da ta’addanci ya kusan karewa” a Sham, wurin da fiye da mutane 360,000 suka rasa rayuwar su tun 2011, tare da rashin gidajen miliyoyin mutane.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: Ya ce Damascus za ta ci gaba da "yaki da wannan yakin mai tsarki har sai mun tsarkake dukkan yankuna na Siriya" daga dukkan kungiyoyin ta'adda da "duk wani kasashen waje da ba bisa ka'ida ba."
rows.reference: ya ce Damascus zata ci gaba da “yakin nan mai sarki har sai an tsarkake dukka yankunan Sham” na duk kungiyoyin ta’addanci da “duk wani jami’i da ke nan ba tare da izini ba.”

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Amurka tana da wasu sojoji kusan 2,000 a Siriya, musamman suna horarwa da ba da shawara ga dukkan sojojin Kurdawa da 'yan Syria masu adawa da shugaban kasa Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: Amurka tana da wasu sojoji 2,000 a Sham, akasarinsu su na ba da horo da shawara wa sojojin Kurdawa da Larabawan Sham da basa son Shugaban kasar Bashar al-Assad.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Faransa tana da fiye da sojojin 1,000 a ƙasar da ta yi fama da yakin.
rows.reference: Faransa tana da fiye da sojoji 1,000 a kasar da ke fama da yakin.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: A kan batun 'yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin ya dace da su su dawo, kuma ya zargi "wasun kasashe na yamma" da "yada tsoratarwa ta rashin hankali" da ta sa 'yan gudun hijira su tsaya nesa.
rows.reference: Akan batun yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin sun gyaru masu su dawo, kuma ya zargi “wasu ƙasashen yammaci” da “yada tsoro mara kyau” da yasa masu gudun hijira suka ƙi dawowa.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "Mun kira al'ummar kasa da kasa da kuma kungiyoyin agaji da su saukaka wajen dawowa," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mun yi kira ga kasashen duniya da kungiyoyin agaji su sauƙaƙe da dawowar su,” ya ce.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: "Suka yi siyasa a kan wani abu da ya kamata kawai ya zama batu na jin kai."
rows.reference: “Su na siyasance abun da zallan batun jin kai ne.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Amurka da Tarayyar Turai sun yi gargadin cewa ba za a samu taimakon sake gina ƙasar Syria ba har sai an cimma yarjejeniyar siyasa tsakanin Assad da 'yan adawa don kawo karshen yakin.
rows.reference: Amurka da Kungiyar Turai sun ba da gargadi cewa ba za’a bayar da agajin sake gine-ginen Sham ba har sai an samu yarjejeniya tsakanin Assad da ‘yan adawa ga yakin.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Diplomats na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce yarjejeniyar da aka yi kwanan nan tsakanin Rasha da Turkiyya na kafa yankin tsagaita wuta a yankin Idlib, wanda ya kasance kagara na 'yan tawaye na karshe, ya ba da damar ci gaba da tattaunawar siyasa.
rows.reference: ma’aikatan hulɗa na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce wani yarjejeniya na kwanan nan tsakanin Rasha da Turkiya dan kebe tudun mun tsira a babban yankin karshe da ‘yan adawa suke rike da shi a Idlib ya samar da daman ci gaba da maganganun siyasa.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Yin yarjejeniyar Rasha-Turkiyya ya hana wani babban hari da sojojin Rasha ke goyon bayan su a Siriya suka kai kan lardin, inda mutane miliyan uku ke zaune.
rows.reference: Yarjejeniyar Rasha da Turkiyar ya kawar da babban hari da ‘yan Sham masu goyon bayan Rasha suka kai lardin, wurin da mutane miliyan uku suke zama.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem ya jaddada cewa yarjejeniyar tana da "takamaimai wa'adai" kuma ya bayyana fatan cewa aikin soja zai kai hari ga masu jihadi da suka hada da 'yan ta'adda daga kungiyar Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta Nusra ta N
rows.reference: Moualem duk da haka ya jadadda cewa yarjejeniyar ta na da “bayyanannen kwanaki” kuma sun bayyana sa rai cewa aikin sojoji zai mayar da hankali ga ‘yan ta’adda ne tare da mafaɗa daga Nusra Front masu alaka da Al-Qaeda, waɗanda “za’a magance.”

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Wani jami'in Majalisar Dinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura na fatan ganin an gudanar da taron farko na wata sabon kwamiti da ya kunshi mambobi daga gwamnati da kuma jam'iyyar adawa domin tsara kundin tsarin mulkin Syria bayan yakin da kuma shirya hanyar gudanar da zabe.
rows.reference: Wakilin Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura yana sa ran cikin kwanan nan zai kira taron farko na kwamitin wanda ke kunsheda mambobin gwamnati da na ‘yan adawa su rubuta tsarin mulkin kasa bayan yaki na Sham ya kuma buɗe hanyar zabe.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem ya bayyana sharuɗɗan da gwamnatin Siriya za ta yi wa kwamitin, yana mai cewa ya kamata aikin kwamitin ya takaita ne "ga duba sashe-sashe na kundin tsarin mulkin da ake da shi," kuma ya yi gargadi game da tsoma bakin.
rows.reference: Moualem ya fitar da sharruɗan da zasu sa gwamnatin Sham ta shiga cikin kwamitin, yana cewa a kuntata aikin bangarorin “zuwa yin bitar dokokin wannan tsarin mulkin na yau,” kuma yana bada gargaɗin tsangwama.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Me yasa Trump zai Yi Nasara a Wa'adi Na Biyu
rows.reference: Abun Da Ya Sa Trump Zai Sake Cin Zabe Karo na Biyu

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: Ta hanyar wannan tunani, Mista Trump zai sake lashe zaben a 2020 sai dai idan, kamar yadda mutane da yawa masu ra'ayin hagu ke fatan, tsige shi da kuma cece-kuce za su kawo karshen mulkin nasa da wuri.
rows.reference: Bisa ga wannan dabarar, Mr. Trump zai sake cin zabe karo na biu a 2020 sai dai idan, yadda mambobin jam’iyyar ‘yanci da yawa suke sa rai, tsiguwa da abubuwan kunya sun kawo karshen shugabancin shi kafin lokacin sa.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: A cikin abin da ba shakka zai kasance "Ƙarshen mafi ban sha'awa na mulkin da ya faru!"
rows.reference: A abun da ba ko gardama zai zama “mafi ban mamakin karshen shugabanci har abada!”

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, babu alamun gajiya daga masu kallo.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, babu wani alamar gajiyar mai kallo.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: Tun daga 2014, kimar lokacin farko ta karu fiye da ninki biyu zuwa miliyan 1.05 a CNN da kusan ninki uku zuwa miliyan 1.6 a MSNBC.
rows.reference: Tun 2014, kididdigar firayim lokaci ya nunku fiye da gida biyu zuwa miliyan 1.05 a CNN da kuma kusan nunki uku zuwa miliyan 1.6 a MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: An ba da rahoton cewa Fox News tana da matsakaicin masu kallo na dare 2.4, wanda ya karu daga miliyan 1.7 shekaru hudu da suka wuce, a cewar Nielsen, kuma MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" ta yi fice a cikin jerin masu kallo na kebul tare da masu kallo miliyan 3.5 a daren labarai masu muhimmanci.
rows.reference: Fox News su na da matsakaicin masu kallon firayim lokaci miliyan 2.4, sama daga miliyan 1.7 shekaru huɗu da suka wuce, a cewar Nielsen, da “Wasar Rachel Maddow” na MSNBC ya yi rinjayen kididdigar kebur da masu kallo har zuwa miliyan 3.5 a daren manyan labarai.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Wannan wani wuta ne da mutane ke jan hankali saboda ba wani abu ne da muke fahimtar ba," in ji Neal Baer, mai shirya wasan kwaikwayo na ABC "Designated Survivor," game da wani sakatare na majalisar da ya zama shugaban kasa bayan wani hari ya lalata Capitol.
rows.reference: “Wannan wuta ne da ake jawo mutane zuwa saboda ba abu ne da muke ganewa ba,” inji Neal Baer, mai gudanar da wasan kwaikwayon ABC “Designated Survivor”, akan sakataren majalisa da ya zama shugaban kasa bayan an kai hari da ya hallaka Capitol.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, tsohuwar marubuciya mai ban dariya kuma marubuciyar "Kawai Sassan Barkwanci: Kuma Wasu Gaskiya Game da Shiga cikin Club na Hollywood Boys," tana da wani tunani.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, tsohon marubucin ban dariya da kuma marubucin “Kawai Sassan Ban Dariyan: Da Wasu Gaskia Mara Daɗi Akan Yin Laɓaɓa Zuwa Cikin Kungiyar Mazan Hollywood”, yana da wani zato.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ta tuna da tuki a Boston kafin zaben 2016.
rows.reference: Ta tuna wani tafiya a taksi a Boston kafin zaben 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Direban ya gaya mata zai yi wa Mista Trump kuri'a.
rows.reference: Direban ya ce mata zai zabi Mr. Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Me ya sa? ta tambaya.
rows.reference: Dan meye? ta tambaya.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: "Ya ce, "Saboda yana sa ni dariya,"" Ms. Scovell ta gaya min.
rows.reference: “Yace, “Saboda yana bani dariya,” Mr. Scovell ta faɗa mun.
