rows.reference: Ha buputere vidio nke egbe ọgbụgba ahụ na Fraịde, na arịọ enyemaka na ịchọpụta otu nwoke ahụrụ na nseta ahụ.

rows.source: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.
rows.output: Sims, 20, egburu n'akụkụ ogige mahadum Southern n'isi Fraịde.
rows.reference: Agbara Sims, 20 egbe ma gbuo ya n’akụkụ ogige Mahadum Southern n’ụtụtụ Fraịde.

rows.source: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.
rows.output: "Wayde Sims nwetara mmerụ ahụ n'isi site na mgbọ ma nwaa ọnwụ n'ihi ya," onye isi ndị uwe ojii Murphy J. Paul gwara ndị mgbasa ozi na Satọde, dị ka 247sports si kwuo.
rows.reference: “Wayde Sims nwere ọnya mgbọ egbe n’isi, ọ nwụrụ n’ihi nke ahụ,” onye isi ndị uwe ojii Murphy J. Paul gwara ndị mgbasa ozi na Satọde, site na 247sports.

rows.source: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.
rows.output: Wayde baturu n'iguzogide enyi ya, e gburu ya site n'aka Simpson.
rows.reference: Wayde kwụpụtara ịgbachitere enyi ya mgbe Simpson gbara ya egbe.

rows.source: Simpson was questioned and admitted to being on scene, in possession of a weapon, and admitted to shooting Wayde Sims.
rows.output: Nkwenye, a jụrụ ya ma kwuo na ọ nọ n'ebe ahụ, nwere ngwa agha, ma kwuo na ọ gbururu Wayde Sims.
rows.reference: Ajụrụ Simpson ajụjụ, ọ kwenyere na ọ n’ebe ahụ, jiri ngwa ọgụ, ma kwenye na ịgba Wayde Sims egbe.

rows.source: Simpson was arrested without incident and taken into custody at East Baton Rouge Parish Police Department.
rows.output: Ejiri Simpson nwude ya, o wee kpọga ya n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na ngalaba ndị uwe ojii parish East Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: Ejidere Simpson na enweghị nsogbu, dubaa ya n’ụlọ mkpọrọ na Ngalaba Ndị Uwe Ojii East Baton Rouge Parish.

rows.source: A 6-foot-6 junior who grew up in Baton Rouge, Sims played in 32 games with 10 starts last season and averaged 17.4 minutes, 5.6 points and 2.9 rebounds per game.
rows.output: Onye na-eto eto nke dị 6-6 si Baton Rouge, Sims gbara egwuregwu 32 na 10 na mmalite oge gara aga ma nwee nkeji 17.4, 5.6 na 2.9 na egwuregwu ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Junịọ 6-ụkwụ-6 toro na Baton Rouge, Sims gwuru egwuregwu 32 nke o bidoro 10 n’afọ asọmpi gara aga ma nweta ọkara nkeji 17.4, akara 5.6 yana nkụghachi 2.9 kwa egwuregwu.

rows.source: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel
rows.output: Asọmpi Grand Prix nke Russia: Lewis Hamilton na-eru nso n'okirikiri mba ụwa ka otu ndị otu ya nyere ya mmeri n'elu Sebastian Vettel
rows.reference: Grand Prix nke Russia: Lewis Hamilton eruwelaị n’iko mba ụwa ka ntimiwu otu nyefere ya mmeri n’elu Sebastian Vettel

rows.source: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka ọ dị na oge Valtteri Bottas mere ka ọ dị elu karịa Lewis Hamilton na Satọde, na Mercedes "iwu otu" ga-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa na asọmpi ahụ.
rows.reference: O doro anya n’oge ahụ na Valtteri Bottas tozuru tupu Lewis Hamilton na Satọde nke otu ndị Mercedes tiri n’iwu nke ga-eme nnukwu mmetụta n’akụkụ ọsọ ahụ.

rows.source: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.
rows.output: Site na mpụta, Bottas nwetara mmalite dị mma ma ọ fọrụ Hamilton n'ụzọ dị ka ọ na-echebe ọnọdụ ya n'ime ntụgharị abụọ mbụ ma kpọọ Vettel ka ọ wakpo onye otu ya.
rows.reference: Na mbido, Bottas nwetara ezigbo mmalite, ntakịrị ihe ka ọ hapụ Hamilton na aja ka ọ na azọchite ọnọdụ ya na ntụgharị abụọ nke izizi ma kpọọ Vettel iji makpuo onye otu ya.

rows.source: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.
rows.output: Vettel gara n'ime ụlọ mposi mbụ ma hapụ Hamilton ka ọ na-agba n'ime okporo ụzọ na tail nke ìgwè, ihe nke kwesịrị ịbụ ihe na-ekpebi.
rows.reference: Vettel buru ụzọ banye na pit ma hapụ Hamilton ka ọ banye n’ụzọ mkpọchi na ngwụcha nke otu ahụ, ihe kwesịrị ịbụ ihe mkpebi.

rows.source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
rows.output: Mercedes pitted otu oge ka e mesịrị, ma pụta n'azụ Vettel, mana Hamilton gara n'ihu mgbe ụfọdụ ihe omume wheel-to-wheel nke hụrụ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala Ferrari na-atụ aro na ọ ga-ahapụ oghere n'ime ya n'ihe ize ndụ nke ijide ya mgbe ọ mere mmegharị abụọ iji chebe na akụkụ nke atọ.
rows.reference: Mercedes ahụ banyere na pit otu lapụ ka emechara ma pụta n’azụ Vettel, mana Hamilton gara n’ihu ka enwechara mmereme ụkwụ-na-ụkwụ nke mere na ọkwọ ụgbọ Ferrari ahụ n’ejighi obi ya hapụ ime ka o ghere oghe n’ihi egwu nke ịgbasi ike ka emechara mkpali-mkpị iji mee nzọchite n’akụkụ nke atọ.

rows.source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.
rows.output: Max Verstappen malitere site na ahịrị azụ nke grid ma nọ na asaa site na njedebe nke mbụ lap na 21st ọmụmụ ya.
rows.reference: Max Verstappen bidoro n’azụ nke usoro ahụ, ọ nọ na nke asaa na ngwụcha nke lapụ izizi na ụbọchị ọmụmụ 21 ya.

rows.source: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.
rows.output: O wee durukwa n'ụzọ dị ukwuu n'oge asọmpi ahụ ka ọ na-ejide taya ya iji nweta njedebe ngwa ngwa ma merie Kimi Raikkonen maka nke anọ.
rows.reference: Ọ gara n’ihu nọrọ n’ihu ọtụtụ oge n’ọsọ ahụ ka o jidere taya ya iji chụba mmecha ọsọ ọsọ ma gafere Kimi Raikkonen na nke anọ.

rows.source: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ọ bịara n'ime ụlọ mposi n'okirikiri nke 44, ma ọ nweghị ike ime ka ọsọ ya dịkwuo elu n'ime okirikị asatọ fọdụrụ ka Raikkonen were nke anọ.
rows.reference: Ọ mechara n’ikpeazụ bata na pit na lap nke 44 mana ọ nwenwughi ike iwelite ọsọ ya na lap asatọ fọdụrụ ka Raikkonen were onye nke anọ.

rows.source: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.
rows.output: Ọ bụ ụbọchị siri ike n'ihi na Valtteri mere ọrụ dị egwu n'izu niile ma bụrụ onye na-eme ihe n'ụzọ dị mma nke gwara m ka m gafere.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ụbọchị siri ike n’ihi Valtteri rụrụ ọmarịcha ọrụ n’izu ụka ahụ niile ma bụrụ nwoke dị nwayọ dị ka esi gwa m.

rows.source: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.
rows.output: Otu ahụ emeela nnukwu ọrụ iji nwee otu abụọ," ka Hamilton kwuru.
rows.reference: Otu ahụ arụọla ọrụ pụrụ iche iji nwee nke izizi na nke abụọ,” Hamilton kwuru.

rows.source: That Was Really Bad Body Language
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ Asụsụ Ahụ Nsọ Nsọ Nsọ
rows.reference: Nke Ahụ Bụ Asụsụ Ahụ Jọrọ Oke Njọ

rows.source: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Donald Trump na-akwa emo onye sinetọ Dianne Feinstein n'oge nnọkọ na Satọde maka na ọ na-arụ ụka na ọ bụghị ya na-ebuga akwụkwọ ozi sitere n'aka Christine Blasey Ford na-ebo ebubo na onye ọka ikpe kachasị elu Brett Kavanaugh na-eme ihe ike.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala Donald Trump kọtọrọ Onye Ọmeiwu Dianne Feinstein na mgbakọ na Satọde maka nkwusi ike ya na ọ bụghị ya kpughepuru leta si n’aka Christine Blasey Ford na ebo Brett Kavanaugh onye ahọpụtara maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị ebubo nke nwakpo nwanyị.

rows.source: Speaking at a rally in West Virginia, the president did not directly address the testimony given by Ford before the Senate Judiciary Committee, instead commenting that what was going on in the Senate showed that people were "mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: Na nnọkọ na West Virginia, onye isi ala ahụ akwụsịghị n'okwu nke Ford nyere n'ihu Senate Judiciary Committee, kama ọ na-ekwu na ihe na-eme n'ime Senate na-egosi na ndị mmadụ "na-akpasu ike na ihe ọjọọ na ndị na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: Ikwu okwu na mgbakọ emere na West Virginia, onye isi ala ekwughi ozugbo maka ihe akaebe nke Ford nyere n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, kama na ekwu na ihe na eme na Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu gosiri na ndị mmadụ bụ ndị “obi akpọ na obi ọjọọ yana ndị aghụghọ.”

rows.source: "The one thing that could happen and the beautiful thing that is going on over the last few days in the Senate, when you see the anger, when you see people that are angry and mean and nasty and untruthful," he said.
rows.output: "Otu ihe nwere ike ime ma ọ bụ ihe mara mma na-eme n'ime ụlọomeiwu n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole gara aga, mgbe ị hụrụ iwe, mgbe ị hụrụ ndị mmadụ na-ewe iwe, na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na-adịghị mma na ndị na
rows.reference: “Otu ihe nwere ike ịme yana ọmarịcha ihe na eme n’ụbọchị ole ma ole gara aga na Nzụkọ Omeiwu, mgbe ị hụrụ iwe ahụ, mgbe ị hụrụ ndị mmadụ iwe na ewe, nwere obi akpọ na bụrụ ndị aghụghọ,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "When you look at releases and leaks and then they say "oh, I didn't do it.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ele ihe ndị a na-ebupụta na ihe ndị a na-eme ka ha na-ekwu "oh, m anaghị eme ya.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ị hụrụ mbupute na mkpughepu emechaa ha ekwuo “oh, emeghị m ya.

rows.source: I didn't do it."
rows.output: Anaghị m eme ya."
rows.reference: Emeghị m ya."

rows.source: Remember?
rows.output: Cheta?
rows.reference: Cheta?

rows.source: Dianne Feinstein, did you leak?
rows.output: Dianne Feinstein, ị mere ka ihe na-esi ísì?
rows.reference: Dianne Feinstein, i kpughepuru?

rows.source: Remember her answer... did you leak the document - "oh, oh, what?
rows.output: Cheta azịza ya... ọ̀ dịla mgbe ị mere akwụkwọ ahụ "oh, oh, gịnị?
rows.reference: Cheta azịza ya... i kpughepuru akwụkwọ ahụ - “oh, oh, gịnị?

rows.source: Oh, no.
rows.output: Ee, mba.

rows.source: I didn't leak."
rows.output: Anaghị m agbapụta."

rows.source: Well, wait one minute.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma, chọọ nkeji otu.
rows.reference: Ọ dị mma, chere otu oge.

rows.source: Did we leak...No, we didn't leak," he added, in an impression of the senator.
rows.output: Anyị wụfuru...Ee, anyị emeghịfuola," o tinyere, n'ụdị onye omebe iwu.
rows.reference: Anyị ekpughepuru...Mba, anyị ekpughipughi,” o tinyere, na nghọrọ nke onye ọmeiwu ahụ.

rows.source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Julaị, ezigara Feinstein akwụkwọ ozi na-akọwa ebubo e boro Kavanaugh, ma e mechara kpughee ya na Septemba, mana Feinstein jụrụ na ọ bụ na ụlọ ọrụ ya ka e si na ya pụta.
rows.reference: Ezigara Feinstein leta kọwara ebubo nke Ford mere Kavanaugh na Julaị gara aga, ma ekpughepuru ya na mbido nke Septemba - mana Feinstein gọnarịrị na mkpughepu ahụ si n’ụlọ ọrụ ya.

rows.source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
rows.output: "Anaghị m ekpuchi ebubo Dr. Ford, anaghị m ebupụta akụkọ ya," ka Feinstein gwara kọmitii ahụ, The Hill kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ezoghi m ebubo Dk. Ford, ekpughepughi akụkọ ya,” Feinstein gwara ọgbakọ ahụ, The Hill kpesara.

rows.source: "She asked me to hold it confidential and I kept it confidential as she asked."
rows.output: "Ọ gwara m ka m mee ka ọ dị n'udo, m wee mee ka ọ dị n'udo dị ka ọ rịọrụ."
rows.reference: “Ọ rịọrọ m ka m jidere ya na nzuzo, m dowere ya na nzuzo dị ka o si rịọ.”

rows.source: But her denial did not appear to sit well with the president, who commented during the Saturday night rally: "I'll tell you what, that was really bad body language.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ na ọ bụghị ihe na-adịghị mma na onye isi ala ahụ, onye kwuru n'oge nnọkọ Satọdee abalị: "Aga m gwa gị ihe, nke ahụ bụ ahụmahụ na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Mana ngọnarị ya adịghị mma n’ebe onye isi ala nọ, onye kwuru okwu na n’abalị mgbakọ Satọde ahụ: “M ga-agwa gị ihe, nke a bụ asụsụ ahụ jọrọ oke njọ.

rows.source: Maybe she didn't, but that's the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Ma eleghị anya ọ mere, mana nke ahụ bụ asụsụ ahụ́ kacha njọ m hụrụla."
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike ọ meghị ya, mana nke ahụ bụ asụsụ ahụ kachasị njọ m hụgoro.”

rows.source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
rows.output: N'ịga n'ihu na-azọpụta onye a họpụtara maka Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, onye e boro ebubo na o mere ihe na-adịghị mma n'ebe ụmụ nwanyị atọ nọ, onye isi ala tụrụ aro na ndị Democrats na-eji ebubo ahụ mee ihe ha.
rows.reference: Ịga n’ihu na mgbachite nke onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị, onye nke ụmụ nwanyị atọ bogoro ebubo nke nwakpo nwanyị, onye isi ala tụnyere na ndị Demokrat na eji ebubo ndị ahụ maka ihe mkpa nke ha.

rows.source: "They are determined to take back power by any means necessary.
rows.output: "Ha na-agbasi mbọ ike iji ike n'ụzọ ọ bụla ha nwere ike.
rows.reference: “Ha kpebisiri ike iweghachi ike site n’ụzọ ọ bụla enwere ike.

rows.source: You see the meanness, the nastiness, they don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over to get power and control," Mediaite reported the president saying.
rows.output: Ị na-ahụ ịkpọasị, ịkpọasị, ha anaghị echegbu onwe ha onye ha ga-emerụ, onye ha ga-agbapụta iji nweta ike na njikwa," ka Mediaite kwuru na onyeisiala kwuru.
rows.reference: Ị hụrụ obi akpọ ahụ, obi ọjọọ ahụ, ha achọghị ịma onye ha na emekpa ahụ, onye ha ga-ekwofere iji nweta ike na njikwa,” Mediaite kpesara na onye isi ala ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.output: Elu League: Ndị kpakpando Dundee 5-3 Giants Belfast
rows.reference: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants

rows.source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
rows.output: Patrick Dwyer gbara goolu abụọ maka ndị Giants megide Dundee
rows.reference: Patrick Dwyer nyere goolu abụọ maka Giants n’egwu ha na Dundee

rows.source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
rows.output: Ndị Dundee Stars nwetara mgbapụta maka mmeri ha meriri na asọmpi Elite League megide ndị Giants nke Belfast site n'imeri asọmpi ahụ 5-3 na Dundee na Satọde.
rows.reference: Dundee Stars kwụrụ ụgwọ maka ntufu Elite League nke Fraịde n’aka Belfast Giants site na imeri asọmpi nlaghachi 5-3 na Dundee na Satọde.

rows.source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
rows.output: Ndị Gọntị nwetara isi abụọ n'isi site na iberibe Patrick Dwyer na Francis Beauvillier.
rows.reference: Giants nwetara ndu goolu abụọ n’oge site na goolu nke Patrick Dwyer na Francis Beauvillier.

rows.source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
rows.output: Mike Sullivan na Jordan Cownie wetakwara otu ha n'otu n'otu, Dwyer wee weghachi ndị Giants n'isi.
rows.reference: Mike Sullivan na Jordan Cownie saghachiri iji tinye ndị ahụ n’ụlọ na nhakọ tupu Dwyer eweghachite ndu nke Giants.

rows.source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
rows.output: François Bouchard hà nhata maka Dundee tupu goolu abụọ Lukas Lundvald Nielsen wee nweta mmeri ha.
rows.reference: Francois Bouchard saghachiri maka Dundee tupu goolu Lukas Lundvald Nielsen abụọ nwetara mmeri ha.

rows.source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
rows.output: Mmeri nke atọ nke oge maka ndị otu Adam Keefe, ndị si n'azụ merie Dundee 2-1 na Belfast na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ntufu nke Elite League atọ n’ime afọ asọmpi a maka ndị otu Adam Keefe ndị si n’azụ wee merie Dundee 2-1 na Belfast n’abalị Fraịde.

rows.source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
rows.output: Ọ bụ nzukọ nke anọ n'oge a n'etiti ndị otu ahụ, ebe ndị Giants meriri egwuregwu atọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nzụkọ nke anọ n’ime afọ asọmpi ahụ n’etiti akụkụ ndị ahụ, ebe Giants meriri asọmpi atọ gara aga.

rows.source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe na Dwyer mere na nkeji nke anọ na 3:35 site n'aka Kendall McFaull, na David Rutherford nyere aka ka Beauvillier kụrụ goolu abụọ n'ime nkeji anọ.
rows.reference: Goolu mmepe Dwyer bịara na nkeji anọ na 3:35 site n’enyemaka Kendall McFaull, ebe David Rutherford wetere enyemaka ka Beauvillier dọtịrị ndu ahụ ka nkeji anọ gachara.

rows.source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
rows.output: N'oge mmalite nke na-adịghị mma, Sullivan butere otu n'ụlọ ka ọ banye n'egwuregwu ahụ na 13:10 tupu Matt Marquardt bụrụ onye nyere aka maka Cownie's equaliser na 15:16.
rows.reference: N’ihe bụ oge mmepe juputara na mmereme, Sullivan kpọghachitere ndị ahụ nọ n’ụlọ n’egwuregwu ahụ na 13:10 tupu Matt Marquardt bụrụ onye enyemaka maka nsaghachi nke Cownie na 15:16.

rows.source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
rows.output: Dwyer hụrụ na ndị Giants na-eburu isi n'ime oge mbụ mgbe ọ gbara goolu nke abụọ ya n'abalị ahụ na njedebe nke oge mbụ.
rows.reference: Dwyer hụrụ na ndị Giants were ndu ahụ banye n’ezumike izizi mgbe ọ nyere goolu nke abụọ ya n’abalị ahụ na ngwụcha nke oge izizi ahụ.

rows.source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
rows.output: Otu nchekwa ahụ gbakọrọ ọnụ ọzọ ma Bouchard nyere ha aka ọzọ na 27:37 site na ihe mgbaru ọsọ ike.
rows.reference: Akụkụ ahụ nọ n’ụlọ chịkọtagharịrị ma Bouchard ọzọ tinyekwara ha n’ọkwa nhakọ site na iji nnukwu goolu na 27:37.

rows.source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
rows.output: Cownie na Charles Corcoran jikọtara ọnụ iji nyere Nielsen aka inye Dundee isi n'oge nke abụọ, ma o jiri otu n'ime ndị otu ya mee ka mmeri ahụ sie ike n'etiti oge ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Cownie na Charles Corcoran jikọtara aka nyere Nielsen aka ịnye Dundee ndu izizi na asọmpi ahụ n’oge ngwụcha nke oge nke abụọ, o kechiri mmeri ahụ site na nke goolu ise nke otu ya n’ọkara oge nke oge ikpeazụ.

rows.source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
rows.output: Ndị Giants, ndị furu efu n'ụzọ anọ n'ime egwuregwu ise ikpeazụ ha, na-anabata Milton Keynes n'ụlọ ha n'ụbọchi Fraịde.
rows.reference: Giants, ndị tufugoro asọmpi anọ n’ime ise ikpeazụ ha, nọ n’ụlọ na Milton Keynes n’asọmpi ha na esote na Fraịde.

rows.source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ụgbọ elu nwụrụ iji hụ na ọtụtụ mmadụ n'ụgbọelu nwere ike ịgbapụ n'ụgbọelu ala ọma jijiji.
rows.reference: Onye Na Ahụ Maka Ụgbọ Elu Nwụrụ Iji Hụ Na Ọnụọgụ Narị Kwụrụ Narị Ndị Mmadụ Nọ N’ụgbọ Elu Gbanarịrị Ala Ọmajiji

rows.source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka okporo ụzọ ikuku na Indonesia bụ onye a na-asọpụrụ dị ka dike mgbe ọ nwụrụ na-eme ka ụgbọ elu nke nwere ọtụtụ mmadụ pụta n'ụgbọelu ahụ.
rows.reference: A na eto otu onye na ahụ maka ụgbọ elu na Indonesia ka dike ka ọ nwụchara ka ọ na ahụ na ụgbọ elu ibu narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ fepụrụ n’ala na enweghị nsogbu.

rows.source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
rows.output: Ihe karịrị mmadụ 800 nwụrụ na ọtụtụ na-efunahụ mgbe nnukwu ala ọma jijiji mere n'agwaetiti Sulawesi na Fraịde, na-ebute idei mmiri.
rows.reference: Ihe gafere ndị mmadụ 800 nwụrụ, imirikiti na efu ka nnukwu ọla ọmajiji dachara na agwaetiti nke Sulawesi na Fraịde, na akpalite tsunami.

rows.source: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ ala na-aga n'ihu na-akpaghasị mpaghara ahụ ma ọtụtụ ndị ka nọ n'ime ihe ndị mebiri emebi n'obodo Palu.
rows.reference: Nnukwu ọmajiji gara n’ihu na enye mpaghara ahụ nsogbu, ejidere imirikiti n’okpuru ahịhịa n’obodo nke Palu.

rows.source: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.
rows.output: Ma n'agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ ibe ya na-agbapụ maka ndụ ha, Anthonius Gunawan Agung dị afọ 21 jụrụ ịhapụ ọrụ ya n'ụlọ njikwa na-atụgharị n'ike n'ike n'ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ elu Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Palu.
rows.reference: Mana agbanyeghị ndị ọrụ ibe ya ịgbapụ ọsọ ndụ ha, Anthonius Gunawang Agung dị afọ 21 juru ịhapụ ọrụ ya n’elu ụlọ njikwa na efegharịsị ike n’ọdụ ụgbọ elu Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu.

rows.source: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.
rows.output: Ọ nọdụrụ ala ka ọ hụ na ụgbọ elu Batik Air 6321, bụ nke nọ n'okporo ụzọ n'oge ahụ, nwere ike ịfe n'enweghi nsogbu.
rows.reference: Ọ nọsiri ike iji hụ na Ụgbọ Elu 6321 Batik Air, nke nọ n’okporo ụzọ mfepụ, nwenwuru ike ịfepụ na enweghị nsogbu.

rows.source: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.
rows.output: O wee si n'elu ụlọ ọrụ na-achịkwa okporo ụzọ mgbe o chere na ọ na-ada.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ ọ wụpụrụ n’elu ụlọ njikwa ụgbọ elu ahụ mgbe ọ chere na ọ na achọ ịda.

rows.source: He died later in hospital.
rows.output: O nwụrụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ ka oge na-aga.
rows.reference: Ọ mechara nwụọ n’ụlọ ọgwụ.

rows.source: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.
rows.output: Onye na-ekwu okwu maka ụgbọ elu Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, kwuru na mkpebi ahụ nwere ike ichebe ọtụtụ narị ndụ, dị ka akụkọ ABC News nke Australia si kwuo.
rows.reference: Onye okwu okwu maka Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, kwuru na mkpebi ahụ nwegoro ike ịzọpụta ọtụtụ ndụ ndị mmadụ, ABC News nke Australia kwuru.

rows.source: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.
rows.output: Anyị mere ụgbọ elu si Balikpapan na Kalimantan were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were
rows.reference: Anyị kwadobere helikọpta si Balikpapan dị na Kalimantan iji buga ya n’ụlọ ọgwụ ka ibu dị n’obodo ọzọ.

rows.source: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.
rows.output: Ọ dị nwute, anyị tụfuru ya n'isi ụtụtụ tupu ụgbọ elu ahụ erute Palu.
rows.reference: Na mwute ọ hapụrụ anyị n’ụtụtụ a tupu helikọpta ahụ erute Palu.

rows.source: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.
rows.output: "Obi anyị na-akụda mgbe anyị nụrụ banyere nke a," o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Obi anyị gbawara ịnụ maka nke a,” o tinyere.

rows.source: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, ndị ọchịchị na-atụ egwu na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ nwere ike iru puku, ebe ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ihe mberede nke mba ahụ kwuru na ịnweta obodo Donggala, Sigi na Boutong dị oke njọ.
rows.reference: Otu aka ọzọ, ndị ikikere na atụ ụjọ na ọnụọgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ga-erute puku kwụrụ puku ebe ụlọ ọrụ mgbochi ọdachi nke obodo na ekwu n’ụzọ esi enweta Donggala, Sigi na Boutong kpọchiri akpọchi.

rows.source: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.
rows.output: "Ọ dị ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ka na-arị elu n'ihi na ọtụtụ ahụ ka dị n'okpuru ihe ndị mebiri emebi ebe ọtụtụ enwetaghị ohere." Onye na-ekwu okwu Sutopo Purwo Nugroho kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere na ọnụọgụ ahụ ka na agbago ebe ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ka nọ n’okpuru mbibi ebe enwebeghị ike ịnweta imirikiti,” onye okwu okwu ụlọ ọrụ Sutopo Purwo Nugroho kwuru.

rows.source: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.
rows.output: Mmiri ndị ruru mita isii n'ogologo emebiwo Palu nke ga-eme olili ozu n'ụka na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Oke ifufe ruru mita isii emebisiela Palu nke na eme nnukwu akwamozu na Sọnde.

rows.source: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.
rows.output: ụgbọelu ndị agha na ndị azụmahịa na-ebunye enyemaka na ihe ndị dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ elu ndị agha na nke azụmahịa na ewebata ihe enyemaka.

rows.source: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: Risa Kusuma, bụ́ nwanyị dị afọ 35, kwuru na Sky News: "Oteaka ọbụla na-ebubata ozu.
rows.reference: Risa Kusuma, nne dị afọ 35, gwara Sky News: “Kwa nkeji ụgbọ ihe mberede na ebubata ahụ ndị mmadụ.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce.
rows.output: Mmiri dị ọcha dị obere.
rows.reference: Mmiri dị ọcha dị ụkọ.

rows.source: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."
rows.output: A na-ezu oke n'ahịa ndị dị obere n'ebe niile."
rows.reference: Ezuru oyi n’obere ahịa dị ebe niile.”

rows.source: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.
rows.output: Jan Gelfand, onye isi nke International Red Cross na Indonesia, gwara CNN: "Red Cross nke Indonesia na-agba ọsọ iji nyere ndị lanarịrị aka mana anyị amabeghị ihe ha ga-ahụ ebe ahụ.
rows.reference: Jan Gelfand, onye isi nke International Red Cross dị na Indonesia, gwara CNN: “Red Cross nke Indonesia na agba ọsọ ịnyere ndị dị ndụ aka mana anyị amaghị ihe ha ga-ahụ ebe ahụ.

rows.source: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."
rows.output: Nke a bụ ihe na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe na-adịghị mma, mana ọ nwere ike ime ka ọ ka njọ."
rows.reference: Nke a abụrụla ọdachi, mana ọ nwere ike ịkawanye njọ.”

rows.source: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Indonesia bụ Joko Widodo rutere na Palu na Sọnde wee gwa ndị agha obodo ya: "Ana m arịọ gị niile ka ị rụọ ọrụ ụbọchị na abalị iji wuchaa ọrụ niile metụtara nnapụta.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala Indonesia Joko Widodo rutere na Palu na Sọnde wee gwa ndị agha obodo ahụ: “M na arịọ unu niile arịọrọ ka unu rụọ ọrụ n’ụbọchị na abalị niile iji mezuo ọrụ ọ bụla metụtara mkpopu.

rows.source: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
rows.output: "Ị dịla njikere?" CNN kwuru.
rows.reference: Ị dị njikere?” CNN kpesara.

rows.source: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.
rows.output: Indoneziya nwetara ihe mberede ala n'afọ a gara aga n'agbata Lombok ebe ihe karịrị mmadụ 550 nwụrụ.
rows.reference: Na mbido nke afọ ala ọmajiji kụrụ Indonesia na Lombok nke ndị mmadụ 550 nwụrụ.

rows.source: Micronesia plane crash: Air Niugini now says one man missing after lagoon plane crash
rows.output: Mgbapụ ụgbọ elu Micronesia: Air Niugini ugbu a na-ekwu na otu nwoke naefunahụ mgbe ụgbọ elu ahụ dara n'ime ọdọ mmiri
rows.reference: Ihe mberede ụgbọ elu Micronesia: Air Niugini kwụrụ otu nwoke na efu ka ihe mberede ụgbọ elu ọmi osimiri mechara

rows.source: The airline operating a flight that crashed into a Pacific lagoon in Micronesia now says one man is missing, after earlier saying all 47 passengers and crew had safely evacuated the sinking plane.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ elu na-arụ ọrụ ụgbọ elu ahụ nke dakwasịrị n'ime ọdọ mmiri Pacific dị na Micronesia ugbu a na-ekwu na otu nwoke na-efu, mgbe ha kwuru na mbụ na ndị njem 47 na ndị ọrụ ụgbọ elu niile apụọla n'ụgbọelu ahụ na-ada.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ elu na ahụta maka ụgbọ elu dakpunyere n’ime ọmị osimiri Pacific na Micronesia ugbu a kwuru na otu nwoke na efu, ka ha kwuchara na mbido na ebupuchaala ndị njem na ndị ọrụ 47 niile n’ụgbọ elu ahụ na ekpu.

rows.source: Air Niugini said in a release that as of Saturday afternoon, it was unable to account for a male passenger.
rows.output: Air Niugini kwuru na nkwupụta na n'ehihie Satọde, o nweghị ike ịkọta otu nwoke nọ n'ụgbọelu ahụ.
rows.reference: Air Niugini kwuru na nkwupute n’ebe ehihie Satọde, na ya enwenwughi ike ịchọta otu nwoke onye njem.

rows.source: The airline said it was working with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to try to find the man.
rows.output: Ụlọ ụgbọ elu ahụ kwuru na ọ na-arụkọ ọrụ na ndị ọrụ obodo, ụlọ ọgwụ na ndị na-enyocha ihe iji gbalịa chọta nwoke ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ elu ahụ kwuru na ya na ndị mpaghara, ụlọ ọgwụ na ndị nyocha na arụkọta ọrụ iji nwaa ịchọta nwoke ahụ.

rows.source: The airline did not immediately respond to requests for more details about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ elu ahụ azaghachighị ngwa ngwa na arịrịọ maka nkọwa ndị ọzọ gbasara onye njem ahụ, dị ka afọ ya ma ọ bụ mba ya.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ elu ahụ azaghachighi ozugbo arịrịọ maka nkọwapụta ndị ọzọ maka onye njem ahụ, dị ka afọ ma ọ bụ obodo.

rows.source: Local boats helped rescue the other passengers and crew after the plane hit the water while trying to land at the Chuuk Island airport.
rows.output: ụgbọ mmiri ndị obodo nyere aka nnapụta ndị ọzọ nọ n'ụgbọelu na ndị ọrụ ya mgbe ụgbọ elu ahụ kụrụ mmiri ahụ mgbe ọ na-anwa ịda n'ọdụ ụgbọ elu Chuuk.
rows.reference: Obere ụgbọ mmiri mpaghara nyere aka na ịzọpụta ndị njem na ndị ọrụ ndị ọzọ ka ụgbọ elu daruru na mmiri ka ọ na anwa ịdasa n’ọdụ ụgbọ elu Agwaetiti Chuuk.

rows.source: Officials said on Friday that seven people had been taken to a hospital.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ahụ kwuru na Fraịde na mmadụ asaa e bugara n'ụlọ ọgwụ.
rows.reference: Ndị ọrụ kwuru na Fraịde na ebugala mmadụ asaa n’ụlọ ọgwụ.

rows.source: The airline said six passengers remained at the hospital Saturday, and all of them were in stable condition.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ elu ahụ kwuru na ndị njem isii ka nọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ Satọde, na ha niile dị n'ọnọdụ dị mma.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ elu kwuru na ndị njem isii nọrọ n’ụlọ ọgwụ na Satọde, na ha niile nọ n’ọnọdụ dị mma.

rows.source: What caused the crash and the exact sequence of events remains unclear.
rows.output: Ihe kpatara mgbapụta ahụ na usoro ihe omume kpọmkwem ka na-ahapụghị anya.
rows.reference: Ihe butere mberede ahụ yana usoro nke mmemme ahụ kpọmkwem edobeghi anya.

rows.source: The airline and the U.S. Navy both said the plane landed in the lagoon short of the runway.
rows.output: Ụlọ ụgbọ elu ahụ na ndị agha mmiri U.S. kwuru na ụgbọ elu ahụ rutere n'oké osimiri ahụ tupu ọ eruo n'okporo ụzọ.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ elu ahụ yana U.S. Ndị agha mmiri kwuru na ụgbọ elu ahụ dakpunyere n’ọmị osimiri ntakịrị ihe tupu o ruo okporo ụzọ.

rows.source: Some witnesses thought the plane overshot the runway.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị akaebe chere na ụgbọ elu ahụ gafere runway.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị akaebe chere na ụgbọ elu ahụ gbafere okporo ụzọ ahụ.

rows.source: American passenger Bill Jaynes said the plane came in very low.
rows.output: Onye njem America bụ Bill Jaynes kwuru na ụgbọ elu ahụ rutere nke ọma.
rows.reference: Onye njem America Bill Jaynes kwuru na ụgbọ elu gbadatara obere.

rows.source: "That's an extremely good thing," said Jaynes.
rows.output: "Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị mma nke ukwuu," ka Jaynes kwuru.
rows.reference: “Nke ahụ nnukwu ezigbo ihe,” Jaynes kwuru.

rows.source: Jaynes said he and others managed to wade through waist-deep water to the emergency exits on the sinking plane.
rows.output: Jaynes kwuru na ya na ndị ọzọ jisiri ike banye n'ime mmiri nke na-eru n'úkwù iji rute n'ụzọ mgbapụta n'ụgbọelu na-ada.
rows.reference: Jaynes kwuru na ya na ndị ọzọ nwara iji gafere mmiri ahụ nọ n’ukwu wee ruo ebe ọpụpụ ihe mberede n’ụgbọ elu ahụ na ekpu.

rows.source: He said the flight attendants were panicking and yelling, and that he suffered a minor head injury.
rows.output: O kwuru na ndị na-anya ụgbọ elu na-atụ ụjọ ma na-eti mkpu, na ya nwetara obere mmerụ n'isi.
rows.reference: O kwuru na ndị ọrụ ụgbọ elu ahụ nọ na atụ ụjọ na eti mkpu, na ya nwere obere ọnya n’isi.

rows.source: The U.S. Navy said sailors working nearby on improving a wharf also helped in the rescue by using an inflatable boat to shuttle people ashore before the plane sank in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water.
rows.output: Ndị agha mmiri US kwuru na ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri na-arụ ọrụ n'akụkụ ebe a na-emezi ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ahụ nyere aka n'ịzụlite ya site n'iji ụgbọ mmiri na-efe efe iburu ndị mmadụ n'ụgbọ mmiri tupu ụgbọ elu ahụ daa n'ime mmiri dị ihe dị ka 30 mita (100 ft) nke mmiri.
rows.reference: The U.S. Ndị agha mmiri kwuru na ndị na ọkwọ ụgbọ mmiri nọ nso na arụ ọrụ iji melite ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri nyerekwara aka na ịme nzọpụta site na iji ụgbọ mmiri afụrụafụ wee bufee ndị mmadụ n’ala tupu ụgbọ elu ahụ emie ihe dị ka mita 30 (ụkwụ 100) nke mmiri.

rows.source: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates 111 people have died in crashes of PNG-registered airlines in the past two decades but none involved Air Niugini.
rows.output: Data sitere na Aviation Safety Network na-egosi na mmadụ 111 egburu n'ihe mberede nke ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ elu ndị debanyere aha na PNG n'ime afọ iri abụọ gara aga mana ọ dịghị nke metụtara Air Niugini.
rows.reference: Data si na Aviation Safety Network gosiri na ndị mmadụ 111 nwụrụ n’ihe mberede nke ndị ụgbọ elu edebanyere-na-PNG n’afọ iri nke agba abụọ gara aga mana ọ nweghị ike ịgụnyere Air Niugini.

rows.source: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive
rows.output: Onye na-enyocha ihe na-egosi oge nke abalị nwanyị ahụ na-ere ọkụ
rows.reference: Ndị nyocha gosiri oge nke abalị agbara nwanyị ọkụ na ndụ

rows.source: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
rows.output: N'ụbọchi Satọde, ndị gbara akwụkwọ nọ n'okwu ha n'ọgụ ikpe nke abụọ nke nwoke a na-ebo ebubo na ọ gbara otu nwanyị Mississippi ọkụ n'ụlọ ya n'afọ 2014.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkaikpe kwụsịrị ikpe ya na Satọde na mkpegharị nke nwoke eboro ebubo ịgba nwanyị Mississipi ọkụ na ndụ na 2014.

rows.source: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.
rows.output: Onye nyocha nke U.S. Department of Justice Paul Rowlett gbara akaebe ruo ọtụtụ awa dị ka onye ọkachamara n'ubi nke nyocha ọgụgụ isi.
rows.reference: U.S. Onye Nyocha Ngalaba nke Akwụmụtọ Paul Rowlett nyere akaebe ogologo oge ka onye akaebe ọkachamara n’akụkụ nke nyocha amamịghe.

rows.source: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.
rows.output: O mere ka ndị juri mara ka o jiri ndekọ ekwentị were jikọta mmegharị nke onye a na-azọpụta afọ iri abụọ na itoolu bụ Quinton Tellis na nke onye a na-azọpụta afọ iri na itoolu bụ Jessica Chambers n'abalị ọ nwụrụ.
rows.reference: Ọ gwara ndị otu ọkaikpe otu o si jiri ndekọ ekwentị mkpanaka iji chọpụta ngagharị nke onye eboro ebubo Quinton Tellis dị afọ 29 yana onye emetụtara dị afọ 19, Jessica Chambers, n’abalị ọ nwụrụ.

rows.source: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .
rows.output: Rowlett kwuru na ya nwetara data ebe site na ekwentị mkpanaaka ole na ole na-egosi na Tellis nọ na Chambers n’uhuruchi ọ nwụrụ, nke na-emegide ihe o kwuru na mbụ, akwụkwọ akụkọ Clarion Ledger kwuru.
rows.reference: Rowlett kwuru na ọ nwetara data ọnọdụ site n’ọtụtụ ekwentị mkpanaka gosiri na Tellis na Chambers nọ na mgbede nke ọnwụ ya, na emegide okwu ikpeazụ ya, The Clarion Ledger kwuru.

rows.source: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.
rows.output: Mgbe data gosiri na ekwentị ya nọ na Chambers n'oge ọ sịrị na ya nọ na enyi ya Michael Sanford, ndị uwe ojii gara ịgwa Sanford okwu.
rows.reference: Mgbe data gosiri na Chambers ji ekwentị ya n’oge o kwuru na ya na enyi ya Michael Sanford nọ, ndị uwe ojii gara ịgwa Sanford okwu.

rows.source: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.
rows.output: Sanford nọdụrụ n'elu ikpo okwu Satọde wee gọnarị na ọ nọghị n'obodo ahụ n'ụbọchị ahụ.
rows.reference: Sanford gbagoro n’oche na Satọde wee kwuo na ya anọghị n’obodo n’ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.source: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."
rows.output: Mgbe ndị ọka ikpe jụrụ ma ọ bụ eziokwu Tellis na-ekwu na ya nọ n'ụgbọala Sanford n'abalị ahụ, Sanford kwuru na ọ "na-azọpụta, n'ihi na ụgbọala m nọ na Nashville."
rows.reference: Mgbe ndị ọkaikpe jụrụ ma Tellis a na ekwu eziokwu mgbe o kwuru na ya nọ na gwongworo Sanford n’abalị ahụ, Sanford kwuru na ọ na atụ “asị, n’ihi gwongoro m nọ na Nashville.”

rows.source: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.
rows.output: Otu ihe na-adịghị kwekọọ bụ na Tellis kwuru na ya maara ụlọ ọrụ maka ihe dị ka izu abụọ tupu ọ nwụọ.
rows.reference: Ihe ọzọ na adabaghị bụ na Tellis kwuru na ya amarala Chambers ihe dị ka izu abụọ mgbe ọ nwụrụ.

rows.source: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.
rows.output: Ihe ndekọ ekwentị ahụ gosiri na ha maara ibe ha naanị otu izu.
rows.reference: Ndekọ ekwentị gosiri na ha abụọ marala onwe ha ihe dị ka otu izu.

rows.source: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.
rows.output: Rowlett kwuru na mgbe ọ nwụrụ, Tellis hichapụrụ ederede, oku na ozi kọntaktị nke Chambers na ekwentị ya.
rows.reference: Rowlett kwuru n’obere oge ka Chambers nwụchara, Tellis hichapụrụ ederede, oku na ozi mkpọtụrụ nke Chambers n’ime ekwentị ya.

rows.source: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.
rows.output: "O wepụrụ ya na ndụ ya," Hale kwuru.
rows.reference: “O hichapụrụ ya na ndụ ya,” Hale kwuru.

rows.source: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.
rows.output: A ga-amalite arụmụkachi na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Atọrọ na ndị mgbachite ahụ ga-ebido nrụrịta ikpeazụ ya na Sọnde.

rows.source: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.
rows.output: Onye ọka ikpe kwuru na o chere na a ga-ebuga ikpe ahụ n'aka ndị otu ahụ n'uhuruchi ahụ.
rows.reference: Nnukwu ọkaikpe kwuru na ya tụrụ anya na ikpe ahụ ga-aga n’aka ndị otu ọkaikpe emechaa n’ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.source: The High Breed: What is conscious hip hop?
rows.output: The High Breed: Gịnị bụ conscious hip hop?
rows.reference: The High Breed: Gịnị bụ hip hop amamịghe?

rows.source: A hip hop trio wants to challenge the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.
rows.output: Otu ndị na-eti egwu hip hop na-achọ ime ka echiche ọjọọ nke ụdị egwu ahụ dịkwuo mma site n'itinye egwu ha na ozi dị mma.
rows.reference: Mmadụ atọ hip hop chọrọ ịgbanwe nhụta jọrọ njọ maka ụdị egwu ahụ site na iji ozi ndị mara mma wee kpojuo egwu ha.

rows.source: The High Breed, from Bristol, claim hip hop moved away from its origins of political messages and tackling social issues.
rows.output: Ndị High Breed, si Bristol, na-ekwu na hip hop si n'isi ya pụọ, bụ́ nke ozi ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na okwu mmekọrịta ọha na eze.
rows.reference: The High Breed, si Bristol, na ekwu na hip hop hapụrụ ozi ndọrọndọrọ ebumpụta ya yana ikwu maka nsogbu mmekọrịta ọhaneze.

rows.source: They want to go back to its roots and make conscious hip hop popular again.
rows.output: Ha chọrọ ịlaghachi n'isi ya ma mee ka egwu hip hop mara amụma na-ewu ewu ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ha chọrọ ịlaghachi na mgbọrọgwụ ya ma mee ka hip hop amamịghe wuo ewu ọzọ.

rows.source: Artists like The Fugees and Common have seen a recent resurgence in the UK through artists such as Akala and Lowkey.
rows.output: Ndị na-ese ihe dị ka The Fugees na Common enweela mweghachi na nso nso a na UK site n'aka ndị na-ese ihe dị ka Akala na Lowkey.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkụegwu dị ka The Fugees na Common ahụla mmalitegharị nso nso a na UK site na ndị ọkụegwu dị ka Akala na Lowkey.

rows.source: Another black person?!
rows.output: Onye ojii ọzọ?!
rows.reference: Onye isi ojii ọzọ?!

rows.source: NY nanny sues couple over firing after "racist" text
rows.output: Nwanyị nọ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ New York na-ekwu na di na nwunye ahụ na-akparị ya mgbe ha chụrụ ya n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Onye na eku nwa na NY gbara di na nwunye akwụkwọ maka ịchụ n’ọrụ ka ọ nwetara ederede “ịkpa oke”

rows.source: A New York nanny is suing a couple for discriminatory firing after receiving a misdirected text from the mother complaining that she was "another black person."
rows.output: Nwanyị na-elekọta ụmụaka na New York na-azọ ndị di na nwunye maka ịwụpụ ya n'ihi ịkpa ókè mgbe ọ nwetara ederede na-ezighị ezi site n'aka nne na-ekwu na ọ bụ "onye ojii ọzọ."
rows.reference: Otu onye na eku nwa na NY na agba otu di na nwunye akwụkwọ maka ịchụ ya n’ọrụ n’ihi agbụrụ ya ka ọ nwetachara ederede jefiere ụzọ n’aka nne ya na ekpesa na ọ bụ “onye isi ojii ọzọ.”

rows.source: The couple deny they are racist, likening the suit to "extortion."
rows.output: Di na nwunye ahụ na-agọnarị na ha bụ ndị na-eyi ọha egwu, na-atụnyere ikpe ahụ na "ịkpọ oku."
rows.reference: Di na nwunye ahụ gọnarịrị na ha na akpa oke, na ekwu na ikpe ahụ bụ “nnapụ ego.”

rows.source: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, a mother of two, expressed dismay when finding out that the new child care provider, Giselle Maurice, was black upon arriving for her first day of work in 2016.
rows.output: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, nne nke abụọ, nwere mwute mgbe ọ chọpụtara na onye na-elekọta ụmụaka ọhụrụ, Giselle Maurice, bụ onye ojii mgbe ọ bịarutere maka ụbọchị mbụ ya n'ọrụ na 2016.
rows.reference: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, nne nke mmadụ abụọ, kwuputere iwe ya mgbe ọ chọpụtara na onye na elekọta nwa ọhụrụ, Giselle Maurice, bụ onye isi ojii ka ọ na erute n’ụbọchị ọrụ izizi ya na 2016.

rows.source: "NOOOOOOOOOOO ANOTHER BLACK PERSON," wrote Mrs Plasco-Flaxman to her husband in a text.
rows.output: "Ọ BỤLA, MGBE ỌZỌ BỤLA," ka Oriakụ Plasco-Flaxman dere n'akwụkwọ ozi nye di ya.
rows.reference: “MBAAAAAAAAAA ONYE ISI OJII ỌZỌ,” Nwada Plasco-Flaxman degara di ya n’ederede.

rows.source: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Maurice, twice.
rows.output: Ọbụna, kama iziga ya n'aka di ya, ọ zigara ya Ms. Maurice ugboro abụọ.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, kama izigara ya di ya, o zigara Nwada Maurice ugboro abụọ.

rows.source: After realizing her gaffe, an "uncomfortable" Plasco-Flaxman fired Ms. Maurice, stating that their outgoing nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and that she was instead expecting a Filipino, according to the New York Post.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ hụrụ mperi ya, Plasco-Flaxman "na-enweghi ahụ iru ala" chụrụ Ms. Maurice, na-ekwu na onye nlekọta ha na-apụ apụ, onye Africa America, mere ọrụ ọjọọ ma na ha na-atụ anya onye Filipino, dị ka New York Post si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ka ọ chọpụtachara mmehie ya, Plasco-Flaxman “na agbakasị ahụ” chụrụ Nwada Maurice n’ọrụ, na ekwu na onye na ekuru ha nwa na apụ apụ, onye bụ onye African-American, rụrụ ajọ ọrụ na ya nọ na atụ anya Filipino, dị ka ndị New York Post siri dee.

rows.source: Ms. Maurice was paid for her one day of work and then sent home for an Uber.
rows.output: Nwunye Maurice nwetara ụgwọ maka otu ụbọchị ọrụ ya, wee ziga ya n'ụlọ maka Uber.
rows.reference: Akwụrụ Nwada Maurice ụgwọ maka ọrụ otu ụbọchị wee jiri Uber zilaa ya ụlọ.

rows.source: Now, Maurice is suing the couple for compensation over the firing, and is seeking compensation to the tune of $350 a day for the six-month, live-in gig she had initially been hired to do, albeit without a contract.
rows.output: Ugbu a, Maurice na-azọpụta di na nwunye ahụ maka ụgwọ maka ịgbapụ, na-achọkwa ụgwọ maka $350 kwa ụbọchị maka ọrụ 6 ọnwa, na-ebi n'otu ụlọ nke e bu n'obi mee ya, n'agbanyeghị na ọ nweghị nkwekọrịta.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, Maurice na agba di na nwunye ahụ akwụkwọ maka ego nkasi obi maka ọchụchụ ahụ, ọ na achọ ego nkasị obi ruru $350 kwa ụbọchị nke ọnwa-isii, nhazi ibi n’ụlọ nke ebubu ụzọ jiri maka ya were ya n’ọrụ, agbanyeghị enweghị nkwekọrịta edere ede.

rows.source: "I want to show them, look, you don't do stuff like that," she told the Post on Friday, adding "I know it's discrimination."
rows.output: "Ana m achọ igosi ha, lee, ị gaghị eme ihe dị otú ahụ," o kwuru n'akwụkwọ Post na Fraịde, na-agbakwunye "Ama m na ọ bụ ịkpa ókù."
rows.reference: “Achọrọ m igosi ha, lee anya, ị gaghị eme ihe dị otu ahụ,” ọ gwara Post na Fraịde, na etinye “Ama m na ọ bụ ịkpa oke.”

rows.source: The couple have hit back at the claims that they are racist, saying that terminating Maurice's employment was the reasonable thing to do, fearing they could not trust her after offending her.
rows.output: Di na nwunye ahụ ekpughere ebubo na ha bụ ndị na-eme ihe ike, na-ekwu na ịkwụsị ọrụ Maurice bụ ihe ziri ezi ime, na-atụ ụjọ na ha enweghị ike ịtụkwasị ya obi mgbe o metụrụ ya n’ahaghị.
rows.reference: Di na nwunye ahụ agọnarịla ebubo ndị ahụ na ha bụ ndị na akpa oke, na ekwu na ịkwụsị ọrụ nke Maurice bụ ihe dị mma ịme, na atụ ụjọ na ha enweghị ike ịnwe ntụkwasị obi na ya ka ha kpasuchara ya iwe.

rows.source: "My wife had sent her something that she didn't mean to say.
rows.output: "Ọlà ya zitere ya ihe ọ na-adịghị eche.
rows.reference: “Nwunye m zigara ya ihe ọ akpachaghị anya kwuo.

rows.source: She's not a racist.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị onye na-eme ihe ike.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ onye na akpa oke.

rows.source: We're not racist people," husband Joel Plasco told the Post.
rows.output: Anyị abụghị ndị na-eme ihe ike, di Joel Plasco gwara Post.
rows.reference: Anyị abụghị ndị na akpa oke,” di ya Joel Plasco gwara Post.

rows.source: "But would you put your children in the hands of someone you've been rude to, even if it was by mistake?
rows.output: "Mana ị ga-etinye ụmụaka gị n'aka onye ị na-emegbu, ọbụbụenyi, ọ bụlagodi na ọ bụ ihe mberede?
rows.reference: “Mana ị ga-etinye ụmụaka gị n’aka onye ị gwagoro ajọ okwu, ọbụlagodi na ọ bụ na mmehie?

rows.source: Your newborn baby?
rows.output: Nwa gị ọhụrụ?
rows.reference: Nwa ọhụrụ gị?

rows.source: Come on."
rows.output: Bịa, ka anyị gaa."
rows.reference: Bịanụ.”

rows.source: Likening the suit to "extortion," Plasco said his wife was just two months off having a baby and was in a "very difficult situation."
rows.output: Na-atụnyere uwe ahụ na "ịkwasa ego," Plasco kwuru na nwunye ya dị naanị ọnwa abụọ n'oge ọmụmụ nwa ma nọ n'ọnọdụ "dị oke egwu."
rows.reference: Na atụnye ikpe ahụ ka “nnapụ ego,” Plasco kwuru na nwunye ya ka mụchapụrụ nwa n’ọnwa abụọ gara aga, na ọ “n’ọnọdụ siri ike.”

rows.source: "You're going to go after someone like that?
rows.output: "Ị ga-aga mgbe ahụ?
rows.reference: “Ị ga-achụba mmadụ dị otu ahụ?

rows.source: That's not a very nice thing to do," the investment banker added.
rows.output: Nke ahụ abụghị ihe dị mma ime," onye na-etinye ego gbakwunyere.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ abụchaghị ezigbo ihe ịme,” onye ọrụ ụlọ akụ nchekwa ego ahụ tinyere.

rows.source: While the legal case is still ongoing, the court of public opinion has been quick to denounce the couple on social media, slamming them for their behavior and logic.
rows.output: N'oge a na-eme ikpe, ọgbọ agha ọha na eze emewokwa ngwa ngwa ikwupụta di na nwunye ahụ na mgbasa ozi ọha, na-akatọ ha maka omume ha na echiche ha.
rows.reference: Ikpe ahụ ka na aga n’ihu, ụlọ ikpe nke echiche ọhaneze ejirila ọsọ ọsọ katọọ di na nwunye ahụ n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze, na akatọ ha maka omume na echiche ha.

rows.source: Paddington publishers feared readers wouldn't relate to a talking bear, new letter reveals
rows.output: Ndị na-ebipụta Paddington na-atụ ụjọ na ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ agaghị enwe ike ịghọta anụ ọhịa na-ekwu okwu, akwụkwọ ozi ọhụrụ na-egosi.
rows.reference: Ndị biputere Paddington tụrụ ụjọ na ndị agụmagụ agaghị aghọta biya na ekwu okwu, leta ọhụrụ gosiri

rows.source: Bond's daughter Karen Jankel, who was born shortly after the book was accepted, said of the letter: "It's hard to put oneself in the shoes of somebody reading it for the first time before it was published.
rows.output: Nwa Bond bụ́ Karen Jankel, onye mụrụ nwa n'oge na-adịghị anya ka e nakwere akwụkwọ ahụ, kwuru banyere akwụkwọ ozi ahụ: "Ọ na-esiri ike ịbanye n'ụkwụ onye na-agụ ya maka oge mbụ tupu e bipụta ya.
rows.reference: Nwa nwanyị Bond Karen Jankel, onye amụchara ozugbo anabatara akwụkwọ ahụ, kwuru maka leta ahụ: “O siri ike mmadụ itinye onwe ya n’ọnọdụ onye na agụ ya oge izizi tupu ebipute ya.

rows.source: It's very amusing knowing now what we know about Paddington's huge success."
rows.output: Ọ na-atọ ụtọ nke ukwuu ịmata ugbu a ihe anyị maara banyere ihe ịga nke ọma Paddington."
rows.reference: Ọ na atọ nnukwu ọchị ugbu a ma ị mara nnukwu akụkọ ọma nke Paddington.”

rows.source: Saying her father, who had worked as a BBC cameraman before being inspired to write the children's book by a small toy bear, would have been sanguine about his work being rejected, she added the 60th anniversary of the books publication was "bittersweet" after his death last year.
rows.output: Nna ya, onye na-arụ ọrụ dị ka onye na-ese foto BBC tupu ọ bụrụ onye na-ede akwụkwọ ụmụaka site n'ịmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụmụ
rows.reference: Na ekwu na nna ya, onye rụrụ ọrụ ka ọsee foto BBC tupu ọ nweta mmụọ iji dee akwụkwọ ụmụaka ahụ maka obere ihe egwuregwu biya, ga-enwe ezi olile anya na a ga-ajụ ọrụ ya, o tinyere na ụbọchị ncheta nke 60 nke mbipụta akwụkwọ ahụ bụ nke “ilu na ụtọ” ka ọ nwụchara n’afọ gara aga.

rows.source: Of Paddington, whom she describes as a "very important member of our family," she added her father was quietly proud of his eventual success.
rows.output: N'ime Paddington, onye ọ na-akọwa dị ka "onye dị mkpa nke ezinụlọ anyị," ọ gbakwunyere na nna ya nwere mpako nke ọma n'ihe ọ rụzuru.
rows.reference: Nke Paddington, onye kọwara ka “onye otu ezinụlọ anyị dị oke mkpa,” o kwukwara na nna ya nwere obi dị elu maka ọganihu ya emechara nwee.

rows.source: "He was quite a quiet man, and he wasn't a boastful person," she said.
rows.output: "Ọ bụ nwoke na-adịghị mma, ọ bụghịkwa onye na-akọ akụkọ," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ nwoke dị nwayọ, ọ bụghị onye mpako,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "But because Paddington was so real to him, it was almost like if you have a child who achieves something: you're proud of them even though it's not your doing really.
rows.output: "Ma n'ihi na Paddington dị nnọọ n'ezie nye ya, ọ dị ka ọ bụrụ na ị nwere nwa nke na-eme ihe: ị na-anya isi n'ihe ha rụzuru, n'agbanyeghị na ọ bụghị ihe ị mere n'ezie.
rows.reference: “Mana n’ihi Paddington dị ndụ nnukwu n’ebe ọ nọ, ọ dị ka ebe mmadụ nwere obere nwa mezuru ihe: ị ga-enwe obi dị elu ebe ha nọ ọbụlagodi na ọ bụchaghị n’ike aka gị.

rows.source: I think he viewed Paddington's success sort of in that way.
rows.output: Echere m na ọ na-ele ihe ịga nke ọma Paddington anya n'ụzọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Echere m na ọ hụrụ ọganihu nke Paddington n’ụzọ ahụ.

rows.source: Although it was his creation and his imagination, he always used to give the credit to Paddington himself."
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ bụ ihe okike ya na echiche ya, ọ na-ejikarị na-enye otu Paddington otu.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị na ọ bụ mmepụta ya na uche ya, oge niile ọ nọ na enye Paddington otito n’onwe ya.”

rows.source: My daughter was dying and I had to say goodbye over the phone
rows.output: Nwa m nwaanyị na-anwụ anwụ, m ga-asị ya n’ekwentị
rows.reference: Nwa m nwanyị nọ na anwụ, naanị n’ekwentị ka m nwere ike isi ya ka ọ dị

rows.source: On landing her daughter had been rushed to Nice's Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, where doctors worked in vain to save her life.
rows.output: Mgbe ụgbọ elu ahụ rutere, e bugara nwa ya nwanyị n'ụlọ ọgwụ Louis Pasteur 2 dị na Nice, ebe ndị dọkịta gbara mbọ na-enweghị isi iji zọpụta ndụ ya.
rows.reference: Na ọdịda na ebugala nwa nwanyị ya na Nice’s Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, ebe ndị dọkịnta rụrụ n’efu iji zọpụta ndụ ya.

rows.source: "Nad was calling regularly to say it was really bad, that she wasn't expected to make it," said Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.output: "Nad na-akpọ mgbe niile ka ọ bụrụ na ọ na-esiri ike nke ukwuu, na ọ bụghị ihe a na-atụ anya ya ịlanarị," ka Oriakụ Ednan-Laperouse kwuru.
rows.reference: “Nad nọ na akpọ kwa oge iji kwuo na ọ jọrọ oke njọ, na atụghị anya na ọ ga-adị ndụ,” Nwada Ednan-Laperouse kwuru.

rows.source: "Then I got the call from Nad to say she was going to die within the next two minutes and I had to say goodbye to her.
rows.output: "Ozugbo m nwetara oku si Nad ka o gwa m na ọ ga-anwuru n'ime nkeji abụọ na-esochi ya, m ga-asị ya ka ọ laa n'udo.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ahụ enwetara m oku n’aka Nad iji kwuo na ọ ga-anwụ n’ime nkeji abụọ na esote, ekwesịrị m ị sị ya ka ọ dị.

rows.source: And I did.
rows.output: M wee mee ya.
rows.reference: Emere m ya.

rows.source: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, darling.
rows.output: M kwuru, "Tashi, m hụrụ gị n'anya nke ukwuu, darling.
rows.reference: Ekwuru m, “Tashi, ahụrụ m gị n’anya, ọ dị m n'obi.

rows.source: I'll be with you soon.
rows.output: Aga m anọnyere gị n'oge na-adịghị anya.
rows.reference: M ga-anọnyere gị n’oge adịghị anya.

rows.source: I'll be with you.
rows.output: M ga-anọnyere gị.
rows.reference: M ga-anọnyere gị.

rows.source: The drugs doctors had given her to keep her heart pumping were slowly petering out and leaving her system.
rows.output: Ọgwụ ndị dọkịta nyere ya iji mee ka obi na-akụ ya na-agwụ n’ụzọ dị nwayọọ, na-ahapụ usoro ya.
rows.reference: Ọgwụ ndị dọkịnta nyere ya iji dowe mkpụrụobi ya ka ọ na akụ ji nwayọ na apụcha ma na ahapụ ahụ ya.

rows.source: She had died some time before hand and this was it all shutting down.
rows.output: Ọ nwụrụla ogologo oge tupu nke a, nke a bụ naanị ihe fọdụrụ.
rows.reference: Ọ nwụọla tupu oge ahụ, nke a bụ ha niile ịgbatu.

rows.source: I had to just sit there and wait, knowing this was all unfolding.
rows.output: Mụ na ya nọdụrụ ala, na-eche na ihe niile a na-eme bụ ihe na-eme.
rows.reference: Etukwuru m ebe ahụ ma chere, mara na ihe niile na apụta ihie.

rows.source: I couldn't howl or scream or cry because I was in a situation surrounded by families and people.
rows.output: Enweghị m ike ịtamu ma ọ bụ tie mkpu ma ọ bụ kụọ aka n'ihi na m nọ n'ọnọdụ gbara m gburugburu ndị ezinụlọ na ndị mmadụ.
rows.reference: Enweghị ike ịkwa akwa ma ọ bụ tie mkpu ma ọ bụ bee anya mmiri n’ihi anọ m n’ọnọdụ nke ndị ezinụlọ na ndị mmadụ gbara m okirikiri.

rows.source: I had to really hold it together."
rows.output: Mụ na ya na-akpakọrịta, na m ga-eme ka m ghara ịgbaji ya.
rows.reference: Ekwesịrị m ịkpakọta onwe m.”

rows.source: Eventually Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, by now grieving for the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane alongside the other passengers - oblivious to the ordeal she was going through.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, Oriakụ Ednan-Laperouse, bụ́ onye na-echegbu onwe ya maka ọnwụ nwa ya nwanyị, banyere n'ụgbọelu ahụ n'akụkụ ndị njem ndị ọzọ - na-enweghị ihe ọmụma banyere ihe isi ike ọ na-agabiga.
rows.reference: N’ikpeazụ Nwada Ednan-Laperouse, onye ugbu a na akwa akwa maka ọnwụ nke nwa nwanyị ya, bara ụgbọ elu n’akụkụ ndị njem ndị ọzọ - ndị na amaghị ihe ọ na agabiga.

rows.source: "No-one knew," she said.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị onye maara," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọnweghị onye ma,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "I had my head down, and tears were falling the whole time.
rows.output: "Agara m n'ụra, na mmiri na-ejupụta n'ụkwụ m.
rows.reference: “Isi nke m kpọdara ala, anya mmiri nọ na ada oge niile ahụ.

rows.source: It's hard to explain, but it was on the flight I felt this overwhelming sense of sympathy for Nad.
rows.output: Ọ dị mfe ịkọwa, mana ọ bụ n'ụgbọelu ahụ ka m nwere mmetụta nke ukwuu nke ịhụnanya maka Nad.
rows.reference: O siri ike ịkọwa, mana ọ bụ n’ụgbọ elu ahụ ka m nwere nnukwu mwute juputara n’ahụ maka Nad.

rows.source: That he needed my love and understanding.
rows.output: Na ọ chọrọ ịhụnanya na nghọta m.
rows.reference: Na ọ chọrọ ịhụnanya na nghọta m.

rows.source: I knew how much he loved her."
rows.output: Ama m ka o si hụrụ ya n'anya."
rows.reference: Ama m otu o si hụ ya n’anya.”

rows.source: Grieving women post cards to prevent suicides on bridge
rows.output: Ụmụ nwanyị na-ebe akwa na-ezigara kaadị iji gbochie igbu onwe ha n'ụgbọ mmiri
rows.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị na eru uju na ebisa kaadị iji gbochie ịkwụ ụdọ n’akwa mmiri

rows.source: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide are working to prevent others from taking their own lives.
rows.output: Ụmụ nwanyị abụọ tufuru ndị hụrụ ha n'anya n'ụzọ dị egwu na-agbalị igbochi ndị ọzọ ịtọgbọ onwe ha.
rows.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị abụọ ndị ịkwụ ụdọ napụrụ ndị ha hụrụ n’anya na arụ ọrụ iji gbochie ndị ọzọ n’igbu onwe ha.

rows.source: Sharon Davis and Kelly Humphreys have been posting cards on a Welsh bridge with inspirational messages and phone numbers that people can call for support.
rows.output: Sharon Davis na Kelly Humphreys na-edegharị kaadị n'elu àkwà mmiri Welsh na ozi na-akpali akpali na nọmba ekwentị ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịkpọ maka nkwado.
rows.reference: Sharon Davis na Kelly Humphreys na ebisa kaadị nwere ozi na akpalite mmụọ na akara ekwentị kemgbe n’akwa mmiri Welsh nke ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịkpọ maka enyemaka.

rows.source: Ms Davis' son Tyler was 13 when he began suffering with depression and killed himself aged 18.
rows.output: Nwanyị ahụ bụ́ onye isi ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, bụ́ Ms Davis, bụ́ onye nwa ya nwoke bụ́ Tyler dị afọ 13 malitere inwe mwute ma gbuo onwe ya mgbe ọ dị afọ 18.
rows.reference: Nwa nwoke Nwada Davis bụ Tyler dị afọ 13 mgbe o bidoro nwebe obi ịda mba wee gbuo onwe ya n’afọ 18.

rows.source: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I have to feel everyday," she said.
rows.output: "Anaghị m achọ ka nne ma ọ bụ nna ọ bụla nwee mmetụta dị ka m na-enwe kwa ụbọchị," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: O kwuru “achọghị m ka nne na nna ọ bụla nwee ụdị mmetụta m na enwe kwa ụbọchị,”.

rows.source: Ms Davis, aged 45, who lives in Lydney, said her son was a promising chef with an infectious grin.
rows.output: Ms Davis, dị afọ 45, onye bi na Lydney, kwuru na nwa ya nwoke bụ onye na-esi nri nwere nkà nwere ọchị na-adọrọ mmasị.
rows.reference: Nwada Davis, afọ 45, onye bi na Lydney, kwuru na nwa nwoke ya bụ osi nri na ekwe nkwa n’ọdịnihu nwere ọchị na efe efe.

rows.source: "Everyone knew him for his smile.
rows.output: "O nwere obi ụtọ nke ukwuu, onye ọ bụla maara ya maka ọchị ọchị ya.
rows.reference: “Mmadụ niile ma ya maka ọchị ya.

rows.source: They always said his smile lit up any room."
rows.output: Ha na-ekwu mgbe niile na ọchị ya na-eme ka ụlọ ọ bụla dị ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ha na ekwu oge niile na ọchị ya na ebulite ime ụlọ ọ bụla.”

rows.source: However, he gave up work before he died, as he was "in a really dark place."
rows.output: Ọbụna, ọ kwụsịrị ịrụ ọrụ tupu ọ nwụọ, n'ihi na ọ nọ "n'ebe gbara ọchịchịrị nke ukwuu."
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ọ kwụsịrị ọrụ tupu ọ nwụọ, n’ihi na ọ “n’ebe jọrọ oke njọ.”

rows.source: In 2014, Tyler's brother, who was 11 at the time, was the one to find his sibling after he had taken his own life.
rows.output: N'afọ 2014, nwanne Tyler, onye dị afọ iri na otu n'oge ahụ, bụ onye chọtara ya mgbe ọ nwụrụ onwe ya.
rows.reference: Na 2014, nwanne nwoke Tyler, onye dị 11 n’oge ahụ, bụ onye nke hụrụ nwanne ya ka o gbuchara onwe ya.

rows.source: Ms Davis said: "I continually worry that there's going to be a knock on effect."
rows.output: Ms Davis kwuru: "Ana m enwe nchegbu mgbe niile na e nwere ike inwe mmetụta."
rows.reference: Nwada Davis kwuru: “Ọ na eche m oge niile na a ga-enwe mmetụta nsotanso.”

rows.source: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.
rows.output: Ms Davis mepụtara kaadị ahụ, "iji mee ka ndị mmadụ mara na e nwere ndị mmadụ n'ebe ahụ ị nwere ike ịga na ị nwere ike ịgwa ha okwu, ọbụna ma ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ enyi.
rows.reference: Nwada Davis mere kaadị ndị ahụ, “iji mee ka ndị mmadụ mara na enwere ndị mmadụ nọ ebe a ha nwere ike ịgakwu ma gwa okwu, ọbụlagodi na ọ bụ enyi.

rows.source: Don't sit in silence - you need to talk."
rows.output: Ekwela ka ị nọdụ ala na-ejighị n'aka - ị ga-agwa ya okwu."
rows.reference: Etukwuna na nkịtị - ị kwesịrị ikwu okwu.”

rows.source: Ms Humphreys, who has been friends with Ms Davies for years, lost Mark, her partner of 15 years, not long after the death of his mother.
rows.output: Ms Humphreys, onye enyela Ms Davies enyi ruo ọtụtụ afọ, tụfuru Mark, onye mmekọ ya afọ iri na ise, n'oge na-adịghị anya ka ọnwụ nne ya gasịrị.
rows.reference: Nwada Humphreys, onye bụ enyi Nwada Davies ọtụtụ afọ, enweghịzị Mark, di ya nke afọ 15, n’obere oge ka nne ya nwụchara.

rows.source: "He didn't say that he was feeling down or depressed or anything," she said.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mgbe o kwuru na ọ na-enwe mwute ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: O kwuru “o kwughi na ọ na enwe obi umeala ma ọ bụ ịda mba ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla,”.

rows.source: "A couple of days before Christmas we noticed his change in attitude.
rows.output: "Ụbọchị ole na ole tupu ekeresimesi, anyị hụrụ mgbanwe n'omuma ya.
rows.reference: “Ụbọchị ole ma ole tupu Ekeresimesi anyị chọpụtara mgbanwe n’omume ya.

rows.source: He was at rock bottom on Christmas Day - when the kids opened their presents he didn't make eye contact with them or anything."
rows.output: Ọ nọ na ala ala na Disemba 25 - mgbe ụmụaka ahụ meghere onyinye ha, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ na-elegide ha anya ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: Ọ nọ n’ala ala na Ubọchi Ekeresimesi - mgbe ụmụaka mepere onyinye ha anya ya na nke ha akụtaghị ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla.”

rows.source: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.
rows.output: Ọ sịrị na ọnwụ ya bụ nnukwu mmerụ ahụ nye ha, ma ha ga-arụ ọrụ n'ime ya: "Ọ na-akụtu oghere n'ime ezinụlọ.
rows.reference: O kwuru na ọnwụ ya bụ nnukwu nkụja n’ebe ha nọ, mana ha ga-arụkọta ọrụ iji gafere ya: “Ọ gbapuru oghere n’ime ezinụlọ ahụ.

rows.source: It tears us apart.
rows.output: Ọ na-akụda anyị.
rows.reference: Ọ na ekewa anyị.

rows.source: But we've all got to carry on and fight."
rows.output: Ma anyị niile ga-aga n'ihu ma na-alụ ọgụ."
rows.reference: Mana anyị niile ga-aga n’ihu na agba mgba.”

rows.source: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agbasi mbọ ike, ị nwere ike ịkpọ ndị Samaritans n'efu na 116 123 (UK na Ireland), ziga ozi-e na jo@samaritans.org, ma ọ bụ gaa na webụsaịtị Samaritans ebe a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị na enwe nhịahụ ịga n’ihu, ị nwere ike ịkpọ Samaritans n’efu na 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, ma ọ bụ gaa na weebụsaịtị ndị Samaritans ebe a.

rows.source: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mkpa, a na-enyocha Brett Kavanaugh n'ihu ọha ka ndị FBI na-eme nyocha.
rows.reference: Ọdịnihu Brett Kavanaugh tọgbọ n’ikuku ka ndị FBI na ebido nyocha

rows.source: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.
rows.output: "Ekwere m, ma ọ bụrụ na anyị nwere ike nweta ihe dị ka ihe ọ na-arịọ - nyocha nke oge, nke ogho - anyị nwere ike ịbata n'udo."
rows.reference: “Echere m, ọ bụrụ na anyị nwere ike ịnweta ihe dị ka ihe ọ na arịọ - nyocha amachiri n’oge, amachiri n’oke - anyị nwere ike iwete obere ịdị n’otu,” Maazị Flake kwuru na Satọde, na etinye na ọ na atụ ụjọ na ọgbakọ ahụ na “etisasi” n’ime mkpọchi ndọrọndọrọ gozusiri ike.

rows.source: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?
rows.output: Gịnị mere Maazị Kavanaugh na ndị nkwado ya Republican anaghị achọ ka ndị FBI nyochaa?
rows.reference: Gịnị kpatara na Maazị Kavanaugh na ndị nkwado Repọblikan achọghị ka ndị FBI mee nyocha?

rows.source: Their reluctance is all due to timing.
rows.output: N'ihi oge, ha enweghị mmasị.
rows.reference: Enweghị mmasị bụ n’ihi oge.

rows.source: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.
rows.output: Ntụli aka n'etiti oge ga-eme n'ime izu ise, na Nọvemba 6 - ma ọ bụrụ na, dị ka a tụrụ anya ya, ndị Republican na-eme nke ọma, ha ga-enwe nnukwu ihe isi ike n'ịgbalị ị nweta onye ha chọrọ ka a họpụtara n'ụlọikpe kachasị elu n'obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka etiti oge bụ naanị n’ime izu ise na abịa, na Nọvemba 6 - ọ bụrụ na, dị ka atụrụ anya, ndị Repọblikan emeghị nke ọma, mgbe ahụ ha agaghị enwe ọtụtụ ike n’ọnwụnwa ha iji nweta nwoke ha chọrọ ka ahọpụta maka ụlọ ikpe kachasị n’ala.

rows.source: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.
rows.output: George W. Bush na-ebuli ekwentị ka ọ kpọọ ndị Sinetọ, na-akwado ha ka ha kwado Maazị Kavanaugh, onye rụrụ ọrụ n'ụlọ White House maka Maazị Bush ma zute nwunye ya bụ Ashley, bụ onye ode akwụkwọ nke onwe ya.
rows.reference: George W. Bush na ewelite ekwentị iji kpọọ Ndị Ọmeiwu, na arịọ ha ka ha kwado Maazị Kavanaugh, onye rụrụ ọrụ na White House n’aka Maazị Bush ma site n’aka ya zute nwunye ya Ashley, onye nke bụ ọde akwụkwọ nkeonwe Maazị Bush.

rows.source: What happens after the FBI produces its report?
rows.output: Gịnị ka ọ ga-eme mgbe ndị FBI wepụtara akụkọ ha?
rows.reference: Gịnị ga-eme mgbe ndị FBI weputere mkpesa ya?

rows.source: There will be a vote in the Senate, where 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats currently sit.
rows.output: A ga-enwe votu n'ime Senate, ebe ndị Republican iri ise na otu na ndị Democrats iri anọ na itoolu nọ ugbu a.
rows.reference: A ga-enwe ntuli aka na Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, ebe ndị Repọblikan 51 na Demokrat 49 nọ ugbu a.

rows.source: It's still not clear whether Mr Kavanaugh can get to at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which would allow Mike Pence, the vice president, to break a tie and confirm him to the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Ọ ka na-adịghị mma ma Maazị Kavanaugh nwere ike nweta votu iri ise na Senate, nke ga-enye Mike Pence, onye isi ala, ohere ịgbanye aka na ntụli aka ma kwadoo ya n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu.
rows.reference: O dobeghi anya ma Maazị Kavanaugh enwere ike ịnweta opekata mpe ntuli aka 50 n’ala Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, nke ga-enye Mike Pence ohere, osote onye isi ala, ịkpọ ndapụta ya ma tinye ya na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị.

rows.source: North Korea defector numbers 'drop' under Kim
rows.output: nọmba ndị na-agbanarị North Korea 'na-ada' n'okpuru Kim
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ ndị gbapụrụ na North Korea ‘gbadara’ n’okpuru Kim

rows.source: The number of North Korean defectors to South Korea has fallen since Kim Jong-un came to power seven years ago, a South Korean lawmaker has said.
rows.output: Ọdịnaya ndị North Korea na-aga South Korea agbadala kemgbe Kim Jong-un bịara n'ọchịchị afọ asaa gara aga, onye omebe iwu South Korea kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ ndị gbapụrụ na North Korea gbagara South Korea agbadaala kemgbe Kim Jong-un banyere n’ọchịchị afọ asaa gara aga, onye ọmebe iwu South Korea kwuru.

rows.source: Park Byeong-seug, citing data from the South's unification ministry, said there had been 1,127 defections last year - compared with 2,706 in 2011.
rows.output: Park Byeong-seug, na-ekwu okwu sitere na ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ịgbakọta obodo South, kwuru na e nwere mgbapụ 1,127 n'afọ gara aga - ma e jiri ya tụnyere 2,706 n'afọ 2011.
rows.reference: Park Byeong-seun, na arụtụ aka na data si na minitri njikọta South, kwuru na enweela mgbapụ 1,127 n’afọ gara aga - tụlee yana 2,706 na 2011.

rows.source: Mr Park said tighter border controls between North Korea and China and higher rates charged by people smugglers were key factors.
rows.output: Maazị Park kwuru na njikwa oke oke dị n'etiti North Korea na China na ọnụego dị elu nke ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ na-akwagharị bụ ihe ndị dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Maazị Park kwuru njikwa oke ala kpachikwuru akpachi n’etiti North Korea na China yana ụgwọ dị elu ndị na akpọfe ndị mmadụ na ana socha n’ihe ndị kpatara ya.

rows.source: Pyongyang has made no public comments.
rows.output: Pyongyang emeghewokwa okwu ọha.
rows.reference: Pyongyang agwabeghị ọhaneze ihe ọ bụla.

rows.source: The vast majority of defectors from the North are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị na-ahapụ North ka a na-enye ha ikike ịbụ ụmụ amaala South Korea.
rows.reference: A na enye ọtụtụ nke ndị gbapụrụ si na North akwụkwọ amaala nke South Korea.

rows.source: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have illegally crossed the border since the end of the Korean War in 1953.
rows.output: Seoul na-ekwu na ihe karịrị 30,000 ndị North Korea na-akwaga n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị n'ókèala ahụ kemgbe njedebe nke Agha Korea na 1953.
rows.reference: Seoul kwuru na ihe gafere ndị North Korea 30,000 gafere oke ala ahụ n’ụzọ dara iwu kemgbe ngwụcha nke Ọgụ Korea na 1953.

rows.source: Most flee via China, which has the longest border with North Korea and is easier to cross than the heavily protected Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị na-agbapụ site na China, nke nwere oke kacha ogologo na North Korea na ọ dị mfe ịgafe karịa ókè nke a na-echebe nke ọma (DMZ) n'etiti Korea abụọ.
rows.reference: Imirikiti na esi China agbapụ, nke nwere oke ala kachasị ogologo n’etiti North Korea ma ka dị mfe ịgafe karịa Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) echedosiri ike n’etiti Korea abụọ ahụ.

rows.source: China regards the defectors as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly repatriates them.
rows.output: China na-ewere ndị na-agbanarị ihe dị ka ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ na-adịghị mma kama ndị na-agbanarị ihe, na mgbe ụfọdụ, ha na-akpagbu ha n'ike.
rows.reference: China na ahụta ndị ahụ gbapụrụ ọsọ ka ndị mgbabata dara iwu karịa ndị mgbabata ọsọ ndụ ma jiri iwe kpọghachi ha.

rows.source: Relations between the North and the South - who are still technically at war - have markedly improved in recent months.
rows.output: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti North na South, bụ́ ndị ka na-ewerekarị na ha na agha - emewokwa ka ọ dịkwuo mma n'ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga.
rows.reference: Mmekọrịta n’etiti North na South - ndị ka nọ n’ọgụ - enwela mmelite ahụrụ anya n’ọnwa nso nso a.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the leaders of the two countries met in Pyongyang for talks that centred on the stalled denuclearisation negotiations.
rows.output: N'oge gara aga, ndị isi mba abụọ ahụ zutere na Pyongyang maka mkparịta ụka nke lekwasịrị anya na mkparịta ụka nkwusioru nke kwụsịrị.
rows.reference: Na mbido ọnwa a, ndị isi nke obodo abụọ ahụ hụrụ na Pyongyang maka ekwumekwu gbadoro na ụbụbọ mkposa ngwa ọgụ nuklịa.

rows.source: This came after June's historic meeting between US President Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un in Singapore, when they agreed in broad terms to work towards the nuclear-free Korean peninsula.
rows.output: Nke a sochiri nzukọ dị mkpa nke June n'etiti Onye isi ala US Donald Trump na Kim Jong-un na Singapore, ebe ha kwetara n'ozuzu ya ka ha rụọ ọrụ maka mpaghara Korea n'efu.
rows.reference: Nke a bịara ka nnukwu nzụkọ Juun mere n’etiti Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump na Kim Jong-un na Singapore, mgbe ha kwenyere n’isiokwu sara mbara iji rụkọta ọrụ maka ala mmiri Korea na enweghị ngwa ọgụ nuklịa.

rows.source: But on Saturday, North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho blamed US sanctions for the lack of progress since then.
rows.output: Ma n'ụbọchị Satọde, onye minista na-ahụ maka ihe ndị mba ọzọ nke North Korea bụ Ri Yong-ho boro ebubo na mmachi ndị America bụ ihe kpatara na enweghị ọganihu kemgbe ahụ.
rows.reference: Mana na Satọde, Minista Ofesi nke North Korea Ri Yong-ho tara ntaramahụhụ ndị US ụta maka ọganihu na adịghị kemgbe ahụ.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the US, there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances, there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first," Mr Ri said in a speech to the UN General Assembly in New York.
rows.output: "Na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi ọ bụla na US, enweghị ntụkwasị obi na nchekwa mba anyị na n'okpuru ọnọdụ ndị a, enweghị ụzọ anyị ga-esi wepụ onwe anyị n'onwe anyị n'ụzọ na-adịghị mma," Maazị Ri kwuru n'okwu ya na ọgbakọ mba ụwa na New York.
rows.reference: “Na enweghị ntụkwasị obi na US, agaghị enwe okwukwe na nchedo obodo anyị yana n’ụdịrị ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, enweghị ụzọ ọ bụla anyị ga-esi bụrụ ụzọ kwekọrịta otu oge ịkwasa ngwa ọgụ anyị,” Maazị Ri kwuru n’okwu na Mgbakọ Ezumezu UN na New York.

rows.source: Nancy Pelosi calls Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," says he is unfit to serve on the Supreme Court
rows.output: Nancy Pelosi na-akpọ Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," na-ekwu na ọ bụghị onye kwesịrị ịnọ n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu
rows.reference: Nancy Pelosi kpọrọ Brett Kavanaugh “isi mgbaka,” o kwuru na o tozughi iji rụọ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị

rows.source: House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi called Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical" and said that he was temperamentally unfit to serve on the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Onye isi ndị na-emegide ọchịchị nke ụlọ Nancy Pelosi kpọrọ onye a họpụtara maka ụlọikpe Kasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical" ma kwuo na ọ nweghị àgwà kwesịrị ekwesị iji rụọ ọrụ n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu.
rows.reference: Onye Ndu Ndị Ntakịrị N’ụlọ Nzụkọ Nancy Pelosi kpọrọ onye nhọpụta maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Kavanaugh “isi mgbaka” ma kwuo na ọ na ewe iwe ọkụ iji rụọ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị.

rows.source: Pelosi made the comments in an interview Saturday at the Texas Tribune Festival in Austin, Texas.
rows.output: Pelosi kwuru okwu a n'ajụjụ ọnụ Satọde na Texas Tribune Festival na Austin, Texas.
rows.reference: Pelosi kwuru okwu ndị ahụ n’ajụjụ ọnụ na Satọde na Texas Tribune Festival na Austin, Texas.

rows.source: "I couldn't help but think that if a woman had ever performed that way, they would say 'hysterical,'" Pelosi said about her reaction to Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Thursday.
rows.output: "Enweghị m ike ịghara iche na ọ bụrụ na nwanyị emeworo otu a, ha ga-asị 'hysterical,'" Pelosi kwuru gbasara mmeghachi omume ya na ikpe Kavanaugh n'ihu kọmitii Senate Judiciary na Tọzdee.
rows.reference: “Enwenwughi m ike ịkwụsị ịche na ọ bụrụ na nwanyị mee ụdịrị ihe ahụ, ha ga-ekwu ‘isi mgbaka,”” Pelosi kwuru maka mmetụta ya n’ihe akaebe Kavanaugh n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu na Tọsde.

rows.source: Kavanaugh emotionally denied allegations that he had sexually assaulted Dr. Christine Blasey Ford when they were both teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh ekpughere na o nweghị ihe akaebe na o mere ihe na-akparị Dr. Christine Blasey Ford mgbe ha bụ ndị na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh jiri nnukwu mwute gọnarị ebubo ndị ahụ na ọ wakporo Dk. Christine Blasey Ford n’ike mgbe ha abụọ bụ ndị ntorobịa.

rows.source: During his opening statement, Kavanaugh was very emotional, at times nearly shouting and choking up while discussing his family and his high school years.
rows.output: N'oge mmalite ya, Kavanaugh nwere mmetụta nke ukwuu, na mgbe ụfọdụ ọ na-eti mkpu ma na-akwa ákwá mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka ezinụlọ ya na afọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị ya.
rows.reference: N’oge nkwupute mmepe ya, mmụọ Kavanaugh di elu nke ukwuu, oge ụfọdụ ọ na achọ iti mkpu ma olu a na agbagbu ya ka ọ na ekwu maka ezinụlọ ya yana afọ ụlọ akwụkwọ kọleji ya.

rows.source: He also explicitly condemned Democrats on the committee, calling the allegations against him a "grotesque and coordinated character assassination" organized by liberals angry that Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 presidential election.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu okwu n'ụzọ doro anya megide ndị Democrats nọ na kọmitii ahụ, na-akpọ ebubo eboro ya dị ka "mmegbu na nhazi nke igbu mmadụ" nke ndị liberals na-ewute na Hillary Clinton furu efu na ntuli aka onye isi ala nke 2016.
rows.reference: Ọ kọtọkwara ndị Demokrat nọ n’ọgbakọ ahụ n’ụzọ doro anya, na akpọ ebubo emere ya “mgbagbu omume dị egwu n’anya, akpara akpa” nke ndị mmesapụ ahụ na ewe iwe na Hillary Clinton dara na ntuli aka onye isi ala 2016 haziri.

rows.source: Pelosi said that she believed Kavanaugh's testimony proved that he could not serve on the Supreme Court, because it showed that he is biased against Democrats.
rows.output: Pelosi kwuru na o kwenyere na ikpe Kavanaugh gosipụtara na ọ gaghị enwe ike ịnọ n'ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, n'ihi na ọ gosipụtara na ọ na-emegide ndị Democrats.
rows.reference: Pelosi kwuru na ọ kwenyere na akaebe nke Kavanaugh gosiri ọ nweghị ike ịrụ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị, n’ihi o gosiri na ọ nweghị mmasị n’ebe ndị Demokrat nọ.
